records.title: Director - New Site Manufacturing-Electric Propulsion
records.description:
**Application Close Date**
Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.
 
 
At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!
 
 
This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.
 
 
We are a team of collaborators, doers, and problem-solvers who are relentlessly committed to a culture of safety. This position will directly impact the history of space exploration and require your commitment and detailed attention toward safe and repeatable space flight. Join us in lowering the cost of access to space and enabling Blue Origin's vision of millions of people living and working in space to benefit Earth.
 
 
We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!
 
 
Blue Origin is scaling production of its electric propulsion systems. We are hiring a Director to own the manufacturing outcome for that product line and to carry it from development hardware into rate production.
 
 
You will be the single-threaded leader for Operations of this program: one person accountable for rate, quality, cost, and people, with full authority over the entire in-program production flow.
 
 
This is a build-it role, not a run-it role. You will define the value streams, stand up integration with support organizations, and build the team that runs the line — working concurrently with an active design program rather than behind a frozen one.
 
 
**Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To**

* Own the strategy, roadmap, and priorities for successful manufacturing outcomes of the electric propulsion thruster line — delivery rate, quality, cost, and the people who produce it.
* Build the production organization. Define the value streams, stand up production control and manufacturing engineering, and hire and develop the leadership beneath you as the program scales.
* Own the get-to-rate plan. Define the path from development build to sustained rate production, and demonstrate cycle time at the rate-readiness gate as a committed acceptance number rather than a projection.
* Lead the transition from development build into rate production, including the qualification of tooling, processes, and work instructions required to produce repeatably at rate.
* Drive producibility into the product during design, rather than absorbing it on the floor later. Own the manufacturing view of the bill of materials as the product configuration evolves.
* Establish and own the program's working interfaces with quality, supply chain, material planning, and test operations.
* Build and manage the program's manufacturing operating budget and capital plan, owning responsibility for product delivery at cost and rate.
* Set the safety and quality culture for a new production team, and hold it as the organization grows.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in an engineering or technical discipline.
* 12+ years of experience in manufacturing, production, supply chain, or operations, including 5+ years leading manufacturing organizations.
* Direct, hands-on experience taking a new product or production line from development into rate production.
* Experience carrying a product through a production-readiness or rate-readiness gate, and owning the cycle-time and capability evidence presented at it.
* Experience building an organization — defining structure, hiring leaders, and developing a team through significant growth.
* Line management of both salaried professionals and craft or technician populations.
* Demonstrated ability to operate in ambiguity: making defensible assumptions and moving forward on an incomplete definition, then correcting as information arrives.
* Ability to travel frequently, up to approximately 35%, to other Blue Origin sites.
* Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 15+ years of manufacturing and operations experience.
* Propulsion, spacecraft, satellite, or other high-reliability low-volume hardware experience.
* Experience transitioning a product from low-volume, high-mix build into repeatable rate production.
* Demonstrated cycle-time or throughput improvement with measured results.
* Experience standing up production at a new or greenfield manufacturing site.
* Experience managing a build against a bill of materials that changed materially during production ramp.
* Formal lean or continuous-improvement training, with applied results on a production line.
* Master’s degree in engineering or technical field, or MBA.

**Base Pay Range For**
WA applicants is $203,165.00 - $284,430.30
 
 
**Other Site Ranges May Differ**
**Culture Statement**
Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
 
 
**Export Control Regulations**
Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.
 
 
**Background Check**

* Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
* Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical

**Benefits**

* Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
* Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
* Paid Time Off: Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.
* Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Fresh & Ready Foods

Please note that employees in this role will work in a temperature-controlled environment with exposure to cold conditions for extended periods of time.

Diversity of thought and inclusion for all is what drives our success - we invite you to start your journey with us today!
 
 
**Job Summary**
**Fresh & Ready Foods**
is seeking a strategic and hands-on
**Operations Director**
to lead our Lenexa, KS manufacturing facility. As the site leader, this role is responsible for overseeing all aspects of production, food safety, quality, maintenance, warehousing, and distribution while driving operational excellence and developing high-performing teams.
 
 
Reporting to the Regional Director, the Operations Director will be accountable for achieving safety, quality, service, inventory, and financial objectives while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and employee engagement. This highly visible leadership role requires a strong manufacturing background, a passion for people development, and the ability to drive results in a fast-paced food production environment.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 
 

* Provide overall leadership for plant operations, including production, quality, food safety, maintenance, warehousing, and distribution.
* Lead and develop managers, supervisors, and frontline teams to create a strong culture of accountability, engagement, and performance.
* Champion safety, regulatory compliance, and food safety programs, including SQF, HACCP, sanitation, and audit readiness.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives to improve productivity, reduce waste, and optimize plant performance.
* Establish and manage KPIs related to safety, quality, labor, yield, inventory, customer service, and on-time delivery.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to support customer growth, new product introductions, and operational initiatives.
* Manage budgets, labor costs, inventory levels, and operational expenses to achieve financial objectives.
* Maintain a visible presence on the production floor, coaching leaders and supporting problem-solving efforts.
* Build succession plans and develop future leaders within the organization.
* Foster a culture focused on operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Operations, Engineering, Business, Food Science, Supply Chain, or related field preferred.
* 7+ years of progressive leadership experience in food manufacturing, beverage manufacturing, CPG, protein processing, bakery, prepared foods, or related manufacturing environments.
* Experience managing large production teams through multiple levels of leadership.
* Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, Six Sigma, TPS, or similar methodologies.
* Proven track record improving safety, quality, productivity, and financial performance.
* Experience with SQF, HACCP, FDA/USDA regulations, sanitation programs, and quality systems.
* Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, labor management, inventory control, and operational reporting.
* Excellent communication, coaching, and leadership skills.

Ideal Candidate
 
 
The ideal candidate is a visible, people-focused manufacturing leader who enjoys building teams, developing talent, and driving operational results. They possess strong food manufacturing experience, a continuous improvement mindset, and a proven ability to lead large-scale operations while improving safety, quality, service, and profitability. Experience in high-volume food production environments is strongly preferred.
 
 
**Associates at Fresh & Ready Food Group are offered many fantastic benefits.**
**Full-time and part-time positions offer the following benefits**
to associates: Retirement Plan, Associate Shopping Program, Health and Wellness Programs, Discount Marketplace, Identity Theft Protection, Pet Insurance, Voluntary Benefits, including Critical Illness Insurance, Accident Insurance, Hospital Indemnity Insurance, Legal Services, and Choice Auto and Home Program
 
 
**Full-time positions also offer the following benefits**
to associates: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance/AD, Disability Insurance, Commuter Benefits, Employee Assistance Program, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)
 
 
*Associates may also be eligible for paid and/or unpaid time off benefits in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. For positions in Washington State, Maryland, or to be performed Remotely,*

records.description:
**Build Our Future Together**
At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. Regeneron is currently looking for a Director of Internal Fill Finish Manufacturing to join our Industrial Operations and Product Supply (IOPS) team. This leadership role is accountable for the aseptic filling operation for clinical and commercial drug products, including vials and syringes in both liquid and lyophilized formats. The Director owns the full filling value stream: materials management; preparation of equipment, format parts, and components; formulation of drug product and placebo; aseptic filling; and lyophilization. The Director also ensures a seamless handoff to downstream finishing operations (Visual Inspection, syringe safety systems and autoinjector assembly, packaging, labeling, and serialization) and oversees facility cleaning and contamination control for the filling suites.
 
 
This role focuses on the start-up and execution of compliant GMP aseptic operations, ensuring the facility is properly staffed and trained, and supporting a dynamic, flexible production planning process that meets the needs of Regeneron’s patients. The Director will work directly with Drug Substance and Finish manufacturing management to ensure production timelines are met and will be a key member of various management teams within IOPS.
 
 
This position offers the opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, science-driven organization making a meaningful difference to patients worldwide.
 
 
**When & Where**

* Location: Rensselaer, NY
* Work model: Monday- Friday, 8am-4:30pm

**Discover Your Role**

* Provides leadership, vision, and management to the Filling team and its supporting functions, and leads all aspects of Filling operations at the facility to manufacture commercial and clinical parenteral medicines according to approved protocols, regulations, and schedules
* Directly oversees aseptic filling of drug product and placebo into vials and syringes, in liquid and lyophilized formats, including stoppering, capping, and crimping
* Directly oversees formulation of bulk drug product and placebo, including solution preparation and sterile filtration
* Directly oversees preparation of equipment, format parts, and components to support aseptic filling, including washing, depyrogenation, sterilization, and setup of filling lines
* Directly oversees lyophilization operations, including loading, cycle execution, and unloading, as well as the management of materials and components required to support filling operations
* Directly oversees cleaning and sanitization of filling suites, including Graded space (Grade A–D) and Controlled Non-Classified rooms (iCNC), and supports the site contamination control strategy, environmental monitoring, and aseptic process simulations (media fills)
* Ensures a smooth, timely handoff of filled product to downstream finishing operations (Visual Inspection, assembly, packaging, and labeling) in partnership with the leaders of those areas
* Troubleshoots and resolves issues impeding filling deliverables, including equipment performance, line interventions, and yield; provides technical input to resolve filling and aseptic process challenges
* Partners with department Directors and Project Management to implement new filling processes, including new formats, PFS and vial filling lines, formulation, aseptic filling, and lyophilization
* Manages department metrics and goals, monitors performance to objectives, and drives continuous improvement initiatives essential to meeting patient and business needs
* Leads the annual merit performance review process, builds departmental structure, and develops long-term staffing plans, including aseptic gowning qualification and training programs
* Collaborates with department Directors to support development of the annual budget, and rapidly and accurately communicates issues to department Directors
* Writes, reviews, and/or approves Standard Operating Procedures, specifications, regulatory filings, or other controlled documents as needed
* Executes Quality Management System assignments (CAPA, Deviation, Investigation, Change Control, etc.)
* Participates in the development and maintenance of a safe manufacturing environment and ensures that IOPS safety standards are maintained
* Oversees, supports, and participates in cGMP audits of all filling areas within the facility; maintains site inspection readiness and represents the filling operation during regulatory and client audits

**This Role Requires**

* BS in any of the physical or biological sciences or chemical engineering, with biopharmaceutical/biotech experience in a GMP drug product production facility, including aseptic filling experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience

+ Director: 12+ years of experience
+ Senior Director: 15+ years of experience
+ Level will be determined based on experience

* Experience overseeing aseptic filling operations in a biologics manufacturing environment, including vial and prefilled syringe filling
* Working knowledge of lyophilization, formulation, and aseptic technique, including barrier and isolator/RABS technologies
* Working knowledge of contamination control, environmental monitoring, and aseptic process simulation requirements
* Experience with multiproduct biologics facility start-up is preferred
* Experience interacting with multiple health authorities (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA)

Does this sound like you? Apply now to take your first step towards living the Regeneron Way! We are committed to building a workplace with an inclusive culture. Regeneron is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief (or lack thereof), sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, civil status, pregnancy or parental status, age, disability, nationality, citizenship status, ethnic or national origin, membership of the Traveler community, familial status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Where required, we will provide reasonable accommodation to applicants with known disabilities or chronic illnesses during the recruitment process, unless such accommodation would impose undue hardship.
 
 
Where necessary, we disclose salary ranges for roles in all countries in which we operate. The final offer will be determined within the relevant range based on the country of employment, specific role level, and your skills and experience. In some countries, collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) may apply and influence certain elements of pay or benefits. Regeneron offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package which may include, depending on country and role: annual bonuses or other incentive plans, equity awards, pension or retirement benefits, 401(k) company match, health and wellness programs, fitness centers, insurance benefits (e.g. medical, dental, vision, life and disability), paid time off, and family support benefits. For additional information about Regeneron benefits in the U.S., please visit https://careers.regeneron.com/en/working-at-regeneron/total-rewards/. For other locations, additional information will be provided during the recruitment process. If you have any questions, please speak with your recruiter.
 
 
Please be advised that at Regeneron, we believe we do our best work when we are together. For that reason, many roles are required to be performed on‑site. Please speak with your recruiter and hiring manager for more information about on‑site expectations for your role and location.
 
 
As part of the recruitment process, certain background checks may be conducted in accordance with the laws of the country where the position is based. The purpose of such checks is to verify certain information prior to the commencement of employment such as identity, right to work and educational qualifications.
 
 
For jobs in Canada: this posting is for an existing position.
 
 
**Salary Range (annually)**
$175,700.00 - $292,700.00

records.title: Director of Operations
records.description:
Job Type
 
 
Full-time
 
 
**Description**
**Spartronics, LLC**
**Career Opportunity: Site Director of Operations**
**Location:**
North Logan, Utah
 
 
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time | Salaried | Exempt
 
 
**Work Arrangement:**
On-Site
 
 
**Schedule:**
Full-Time, Monday–Friday
 
 
**Reports To:**
Vice President of Operations – West / Logan Site Leader
 
 
**Who We Are**
At
**Spartronics**
, we build more than electronics. We build the technology that powers critical applications across aerospace and defense, medical devices, life sciences, and industrial markets.
 
 
As a leading provider of electronic manufacturing services (EMS), Spartronics specializes in complex, high-reliability products, including printed circuit board assemblies (PCBA), electromechanical assemblies, integrated systems, and complete product manufacturing solutions.
 
 
**Career Opportunity: Director of Operations**
Spartronics is seeking an experienced
**Director of Operations**
to lead manufacturing operations and drive operational excellence at our North Logan, Utah facility.
 
 
This senior leadership position is responsible for the overall performance, execution, and continuous improvement of the site's operational functions, including
**Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Materials Planning**
, while providing indirect operational oversight and cross-functional partnership with Program Management.
 
 
Reporting to the Vice President of Operations – West / Logan Site Leader, the Director of Operations will establish operational priorities, develop high-performing teams, optimize manufacturing processes, and ensure the organization consistently achieves its safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, and profitability objectives.
 
 
The ideal candidate is a hands-on manufacturing leader with strong business acumen, experience managing multiple operational disciplines, and a proven ability to drive results in complex, highly regulated manufacturing environments.
 
 
**What You Will Do**

* Provide strategic direction and operational leadership for the facility, translating organizational objectives into actionable plans, performance expectations, and measurable results.
* Direct Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Materials Planning functions, ensuring effective coordination, accountability, and alignment with site and corporate objectives.
* Provide indirect operational oversight and strategic partnership to Program Management, ensuring alignment between customer requirements, program execution, operational capacity and business objectives.
* Direct manufacturing operations, production planning, capacity management, and resource allocation, balancing changing customer demand, product complexity, and manufacturing constraints to achieve safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity objectives.
* Establish operational priorities, evaluate performance against key metrics, and implement corrective actions to address performance gaps and emerging risks.
* Provide leadership and oversight of engineering activities, including process optimization, technical problem resolution, manufacturing readiness, new product introduction, and product transfers.
* Ensure the effectiveness of quality management systems, regulatory compliance, product conformity, and corrective and preventive action processes while preserving Quality's independent authority over product acceptance and compliance decisions.
* Oversee supply chain and materials planning activities, including procurement, supplier performance, inventory management, material availability, and production support.
* Partner with Program Management and other customer-facing functions to address delivery commitments, operational concerns, customer escalations, and changing business requirements.
* Develop operational budgets, resource plans, capital expenditure priorities, and cost improvement initiatives in collaboration with Finance, supporting achievement of site financial objectives and profitability targets..
* Evaluate operational and financial performance, identifying opportunities to improve profitability, reduce waste, control costs, and optimize resource utilization.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives utilizing Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, root cause analysis, and other structured problem-solving methodologies.
* Ensure manufacturing processes, product traceability, configuration and change control, and supporting documentation comply with applicable customer, industry, regulatory, and company requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure operational compliance with applicable environmental, health, and safety requirements.
* Establish and maintain structured operational performance management systems, including KPI reviews, cross-functional accountability, issue escalation, and corrective action follow-through to support timely, data-driven decision-making.
* Build, coach, and develop operational leadership teams, establishing clear performance expectations, succession plans, and workforce competency and development priorities.
* Collaborate with Human Resources on workforce planning, staffing requirements, employee performance, organizational development, and retention strategies.
* Coordinate with Facilities, Security, and other support functions to address infrastructure needs, operational continuity, physical security requirements, and business risks.
* Evaluate manufacturing capacity, technology, equipment, and infrastructure needs to support business growth, operational scalability, and capital investment decisions.
* Identify and mitigate operational risks associated with production disruptions, supplier constraints, quality concerns, regulatory requirements, and customer commitments.
* Represent site operations in corporate leadership discussions, customer interactions, audits, and strategic planning activities, communicating performance, priorities, and resource requirements.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned to support organizational objectives.

**Requirements**
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in manufacturing operations, including at least five years in a senior leadership capacity overseeing multiple operational functions.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex manufacturing operations with accountability for production, engineering, quality, supply chain, and cross-functional business objectives.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, production planning, capacity management, materials management, and operational performance improvement.
* Demonstrated knowledge of manufacturing engineering principles, process controls, technical problem resolution, and new product introduction activities.
* Working knowledge of quality management systems, regulatory compliance, product conformity, corrective action processes, and applicable manufacturing standards.
* Proven ability to develop and execute operational strategies, establish performance objectives, and achieve measurable improvements in quality, delivery, cost, and productivity.
* Strong business and financial acumen, including experience utilizing financial metrics, cost management practices, capital planning processes, and profitability analysis to drive operational decision-making.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, develop, and hold accountable cross-functional management teams while promoting collaboration and organizational effectiveness.
* Experience applying Lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, and structured problem-solving methodologies to complex operational challenges.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and decision-making skills, with the ability to evaluate competing priorities, manage operational risks, and resolve complex business issues.
* Advanced proficiency with business and manufacturing information systems, including ERP/MRP platforms, Microsoft Office applications, and data analysis and reporting tools. Demonstrated ability to interpret operational and financial data, evaluate performance trends, and leverage technology to support strategic planning and informed decision-making.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, interpersonal, negotiation, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with employees, senior leadership, customers, and external stakeholders.
* Ability to manage sensitive business information, exercise sound judgment, and maintain confidentiality in accordance with company and applicable security requirements.
* Ability to read, write, speak, and comprehend English sufficiently to interpret technical documentation, communicate operational requirements, and perform essential job responsibilities.
* Ability to work full-time on-site at the assigned company facility in Logan, UT.

**Security Clearance Requirement**
Candidates must possess current, verifiable eligibility for a U.S. Government Secret-level security clearance or be willing and able to complete the necessary documentation to initiate the company-sponsored clearance process within 60 days of hire. The ability to obtain and maintain the required security clearance eligibility is a continuing condition of employment. Employment may continue while an appropriately initiated clearance application is pending, subject to company authorization and applicable security restrictions. A final determination of ineligibility, denial, or loss of required clearance eligibility will result in disqualification from the position and may result in termination of employment, subject to applicable law and company policy.
 
 
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Leadership experience within electronics manufacturing services (EMS), printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), or high-mix, low-volume manufacturing environments.
* Experience with surface mount technology (SMT), through-hole assembly, electromechanical assembly, manufacturing test, and related electronics manufacturing processes.
* Experience supporting aerospace, defense, medical device, or other highly regulated manufacturing industries.
* Familiarity with AS9100, ISO 9001, ISO 13485, applicable IPC standards, and customer-specific quality requirements.
* Knowledge of ITAR, controlled technical information, and security requirements applicable to defense-related manufacturing.
* Lean Six Sigma certification or other recognized continuous improvement credentials.
* APICS/ASCM certification, such as CPIM or CSCP, or equivalent supply chain management credentials.
* Experience leading operational transformations, facility expansions, production transfers, or significant manufacturing improvement initiatives.
* Experience utilizing business intelligence platforms, advanced reporting tools, and integrated manufacturing systems to monitor operational performance and support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Demonstrated success managing complex customer relationships, operational escalations, and cross-functional business challenges.

**Key Metrics and Focus Areas**

* Workplace safety performance and regulatory compliance.
* On-time delivery performance and production schedule attainment.
* Manufacturing efficiency, throughput, and capacity utilization.
* Product quality, first-pass yield, and cost of poor quality.
* Inventory accuracy, material availability, and inventory turns.
* Supplier delivery, quality, and overall performance.
* Operating cost performance, budget adherence, and profitability.
* Engineering responsiveness, manufacturing readiness, and successful new product introductions.
* Program execution support and fulfillment of customer commitments.
* Continuous improvement results, waste reduction, and operational efficiency.
* Quality management system effectiveness, audit performance, and corrective action closure.
* Workforce productivity, employee development, retention, and leadership effectiveness.
* Operational risk management, business continuity, and capacity readiness.

**Why This Role Matters**
As
**Director of Operations,**
you will play a critical role in shaping the performance, operational capabilities, and continued growth of our North Logan manufacturing facility. Your leadership will directly influence how effectively we deliver complex, high-reliability electronic products to customers operating in some of the world's most demanding industries. This is an opportunity to lead talented teams, strengthen operational performance, implement meaningful improvements, and contribute to the long-term success of a growing manufacturing organization.
 
 
**Benefits – Why Join Spartronics?**
At Spartronics, we recognize that our employees are essential to our success. We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, financial well-being, and professional development of our team members.
 
 
**Benefits May Include**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401(k) retirement savings plan.
* Paid time off and company-paid holidays.
* Company-paid life insurance and disability benefits.
* Employee assistance and wellness resources.
* Professional development and career growth opportunities.
* Opportunities to contribute to innovative products supporting mission-critical industries.

*Specific benefits and eligibility are subject to applicable plan documents and company policies.*
**Physical Requirements and Work Location**

* Ability to work in both office and manufacturing environments, including regular movement throughout production, warehouse, and operational areas.
* Ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods, with occasional bending and reaching.
* Ability to occasionally lift, carry, or move materials weighing up to 25 pounds.
* Ability to operate computers and standard office equipment.
* Ability to wear required personal protective equipment when entering designated manufacturing areas.
* Ability to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

**Work Authorization & ITAR Requirements**
Due to the nature of certain products, technologies, and customer requirements, this position may involve access to export-controlled technical data or defense-related information subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and other applicable export control laws. Candidates must meet applicable U.S. export control authorization requirements and be eligible to access controlled technical information as required by the position. For this position, additional U.S. Government security clearance eligibility requirements apply, as described above.
 
 
**Equal Employment Opportunity**
*Spartronics is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Veteran/Disabled 41 CFR 60-1.4. We comply with federal Affirmative Action guidelines in all employment opportunities for qualified employees and applicants.Employment at Spartronics is considered at-will, meaning that either the employee or Spartronics may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause, and with or without prior notification.*

records.description:
**Job Description**
The Director of Indium Phosphide (InP) Wafer Fab Operations is responsible for the overall leadership, startup, qualification, and operation of an Indium Phosphide wafer fabrication facility. This executive leadership role will oversee all aspects of manufacturing operations, including technology transfer, process qualification, production ramp, operational readiness, quality, engineering collaboration, workforce development, and continuous improvement.
 
 
Working closely with Engineering, Process Development, Supply Chain, Quality, Facilities, Product Management, and Executive Leadership, the Director will establish and scale world-class manufacturing capabilities while achieving exceptional performance in safety, quality, delivery, cost, yield, and customer satisfaction. This role requires a strategic leader with deep semiconductor wafer fabrication experience and a proven track record of successfully launching and operating advanced manufacturing facilities.
 
 
**Primary Duties & Responsibilities**

* Provide strategic and operational leadership for all wafer fabrication activities, ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality manufacturing operations.
* Lead the startup, commissioning, qualification, and operational readiness of a new Indium Phosphide wafer fabrication facility.
* Develop and execute the manufacturing roadmap to support business growth, customer commitments, and capacity expansion.
* Establish operational metrics, production targets, and performance objectives aligned with corporate goals.

**Production Ramp & Operational Excellence**
 
 

* Lead production ramp activities from development through high-volume manufacturing.
* Drive improvements in cycle time, throughput, equipment utilization, overall equipment effectiveness (OEE), yield, and cost of ownership.
* Implement Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Statistical Process Control (SPC), and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Monitor key manufacturing KPIs and implement corrective actions to ensure operational excellence.
* Quality & Compliance
* Foster a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure compliance with ISO standards, customer requirements, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
* Lead root cause investigations and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) activities.
* Maintain world-class product quality and manufacturing consistency.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Partner with Supply Chain to ensure material availability and production continuity.
* Collaborate with Facilities to maintain reliable manufacturing infrastructure and utilities.
* Work closely with Product Management, Sales, and Customer Quality to meet customer delivery expectations.
* Provide regular operational updates to executive leadership regarding production performance, risks, and strategic initiatives.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Master’s degree in engineering preferred, Business Administration (MBA), or related discipline.
* Minimum of 15 years of progressive leadership experience in semiconductor wafer fabrication or advanced manufacturing.
* Minimum of 8 years leading manufacturing operations, fab management, or operations engineering organizations.
* Demonstrated experience leading semiconductor fab startup, production ramp, or significant capacity expansion initiatives.
* Experience with compound semiconductor manufacturing, preferably Indium Phosphide (InP), Gallium Arsenide (GaAs), Silicon Photonics, or III-V semiconductor technologies.
* Proven experience managing cross-functional organizations and large manufacturing teams.

**Skills**
**Technical Competencies**

* Deep understanding of semiconductor wafer fabrication processes, equipment, and manufacturing systems.
* Knowledge of lithography, etch, deposition, diffusion, implant, CMP, metrology, wafer testing, and process integration.
* Experience with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), ERP systems, and factory automation.
* Strong knowledge of statistical process control (SPC), Design of Experiments (DOE), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), and yield improvement methodologies.

**Leadership Skills**
 
 

* Proven ability to lead through organizational growth, change, and transformation.
* Exceptional strategic planning and execution capabilities.
* Strong decision-making and problem-solving skills.

**Communication & Collaboration**
 
 

* Excellent coaching, mentoring, and talent development abilities.
* Ability to influence across all organizational levels, including executive leadership.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to communicate complex technical and operational information to executive leadership.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build effective cross-functional partnerships.
* Demonstrated success leading multidisciplinary teams in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

**Working Conditions**

* This role will be based on-site in Fremont, CA.
* Regular use of a computer and other office equipment is necessary.

**Physical Requirements**

* Occasional travel to other sites may be necessary.
* Sitting for extended periods while working on a computer or in meetings.
* Use of hands and fingers for typing, writing, and handling documents.
* Occasional lifting of objects or materials up to 20 pounds for administrative tasks.
* Ability to communicate verbally and in writing.

**Safety Requirements**
All employees are required to follow the site EHS procedures and Coherent Corp. Corporate EHS standards.
 
 
**Quality And Environmental Responsibilities**
Depending on location, this position may be responsible for the execution and maintenance of the ISO 9000, 9001, 14001 and/or other applicable standards that may apply to the relevant roles and responsibilities within the Quality Management System and Environmental Management System.
 
 
**Culture Commitment**
Ensure adherence to company’s values (ICARE) in all aspects of your position at Coherent Corp.:
 
 
**I**
ntegrity – Create an Environment of Trust
 
 
**C**
ollaboration – Innovate Through the Sharing of Ideas
 
 
**A**
ccountability – Own the Process and the Outcome
 
 
**R**
espect – Recognize the Value in Everyone
 
 
**E**
nthusiasm – Find a Sense of Purpose in Work
 
 
*Coherent Corp. is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.*
*If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at*
*talentacquisition@coherent.com*
*.*
**About Us**
Coherent is a global leader in lasers, engineered materials and networking components. We are a vertically integrated manufacturing company that develops innovative products for diversified applications in the industrial, optical communications, military, life sciences, semiconductor equipment, and consumer markets. Coherent provides a comprehensive career development platform within an environment that challenges employees to perform at their best, while rewarding excellence and hard-work through a competitive compensation program. It's an exciting opportunity to work for a company that offers stability, longevity and growth. Come Join Us!
 
 
**Note to recruiters and employment agencies:**
We will not pay for unsolicited resumes from recruiters and employment agencies unless we have a signed agreement and have required assistance, in writing, for a specific opening.

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
**Job Description**
The Plant Manager will oversee operations which include environmental, health & safety, quality, production, maintenance, capital planning and execution in a cost-effective manner while meeting all customer requirements.
 
 
**Essential Duties/Responsibilities**
Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.
 
 

* Support, mentor and develop plant management and supervisory personnel through regular coaching and formal development tools.
* Lead all safety improvement initiatives and create a safety-based culture.
* Ensure ongoing compliance with all regulatory agencies including, OSHA, EPA, HACCP and other local and regional agencies.
* Prepare monthly reports, analyze financial budgets and take corrective measures as needed.
* Maintain efficient and timely flow of all raw materials received and ingredients shipped.
* Lead continuous improvement efforts in all areas of responsibility.
* Review and lead local Capital Projects, planning process to ensure compliance and development of assets for ongoing success and improvement.
* Ensure all personnel properly trained and equipment is in good working order to meet ongoing and future business needs.
* Assure all finish product shipped is in accordance with all quality standards and specifications.
* Effectively manage and reduce energy use at facility.
* Manage local purchasing activities.
* All other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* High School diploma or GED equivalent.
* Minimum 3+ years of experience in a supervisory/ management position in an industrial or plant setting.
* Rendering industry experience is a definite plus.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree preferred; Engineering degree is an asset.
* Labor relations background and leadership preferred.
* Detail oriented; highly organized.
* Ability to work well with internal staff.
* Exceptional written and oral communication skills.
* Self-starter; self-motivated.
* Good math and computer skills.

**Working Environment**
Occasionally = up to 20% Frequently = up to 21% to 50% Constantly - at least 51%
 
 

* Exposed to unpleasant or disagreeable physical environments such as high noise level, strong odors, and/or exposure to heat and cold: Constantly
* Exposed to bio hazardous conditions: Constantly
* Exposed to toxic or caustic chemicals which mandate attention to safety considerations: Constantly
* Exposed to Electrical hazards; risk of electrical shock: Frequently
* Handles or works with potentially dangerous equipment: Constantly

**Physical Demands**
Occasionally = up to 20% Frequently = up to 21% to 50% Constantly - at least 51%
 
 

* Must be able to remain in a stationary position: Frequently
* Must be able to move about inside/outside office or work location: Frequently
* Operates a computer and other office machinery: Frequently
* Must be able to position oneself to maintain computers in the lab, including under desks and in the server closet: Frequently
* Must be able to ascend/descend on a ladder: Frequently
* Must be able to use senses to; effectively communicate with co-workers and clients and detect hazardous conditions: Frequently
* Must be able to occasionally lift up to 50lbs

**About Us**
We’re one of the world’s leading practitioners of circularity, transforming materials from the animal agriculture and food industries into valuable ingredients. Ingredients that nourish people, feed animals and crops, and fuel the world with renewable energy.

records.title: Manufacturing Ops Mgr / Plant Manager
records.description:
**What You Will Get**

* Competitive hourly pay
* Paid weekly
* Opportunity for annual performance increase
* 401K program with employer matching
* Room for growth and career advancement
* Health insurance
* Dental & vision Insurance
* Paid life Insurance
* Paid short term disability
* Paid vacation and sick time
* 11 paid holidays
* Health & Wellness Programs
* Employee Discount Programs

**What You'll Do**

* Own overall plant operations (production, material handling, inventory, and logistics) to meet throughput, quality, and profitability targets.
* Lead safety culture: conduct/oversee daily safety meetings, enforce ARC 100 and company safety programs, investigate incidents, and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal requirements, including environmental and labor regulations.
* Plan and direct daily operations; monitor workflow and KPIs; identify and implement operational improvements and cost savings.
* Oversee maintenance and reliability: ensure preventive maintenance programs are followed, coordinate repairs and downtime planning, and verify maintenance documentation.
* Supervise, coach, and develop plant personnel; manage scheduling, timekeeping, attendance, performance feedback, and disciplinary actions as needed.
* Communicate routinely with Area Manager, Sales, and Dispatch regarding inbound/outbound materials, quantities, trucking needs, and upcoming work.
* Support customer and vendor relationships; ensure product availability and service meet expectations.
* Maintain accurate reporting and documentation; stay current through training and industry best practices.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Requirements**

* Experience: 3+ years in aggregate recycling operations or other process/production environment (5+ years and crushing plant equipment experience preferred)
* Ability to work in all weather conditions.
* Ability to stand for extended periods of time at conveyor belt operation.
* Ability to climb heights of 20 feet on a regular basis.
* Ability to lift, carry, and/or pull 50 pounds on a regular basis.
* Ability to work in dusty, wet, and loud environment.
* Required to wear safety equipment including hard hat, safety glasses, goggles, steel toed boots, ear plugs, gloves and various other similar items as required or needed.

*The statements above describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Employees may be required to perform other job-related duties as requested by management. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and may be modified to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities.*

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
Job ID: 528020
 
 
Ash Grove family of companies is one of North America's leading cement manufacturers, with a legacy of innovation and excellence dating back to 1882. The company operates 12 world-class cement plants and a vast network of 41 terminals across the United States and Canada. Renowned for its forward-thinking approach, Ash Grove combines technical expertise, robust safety standards, and empowered talent to deliver high performance and better serve our customers. At Ash Grove, we stand together to reinvent the way our world is built.
 
 
To learn more about us go to www.ashgrove.com
 
 
\*\*At Ash Grove Cement, people are our first priority. We offer a complete benefits package to include:\*\*
 
 

* \*\*Health Insurance\*\*
* \*\*Dental Insurance\*\*
* \*\*Vision Insurance\*\*
* \*\*Retirement Plan\*\*
* \*\*Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays\*\*
* \*\*Tuition Reimbursement\*\*
* \*\*Employee Assistance Program\*\*
* \*\*Disability Pay\*\*
* \*\*Life Insurance\*\*
* \*\*Growth Opportunities and more!\*\*

**Summary**
The Plant Manager plans, coordinates, and supervises the production operations, hazardous waste fuel program, maintenance activities, quality and safety programs, and other related functions involved in plant operations. This position incorporates directives provided by corporate management into policies and procedures to maintain standards and schedules. The position exercises direct or indirect supervision over a large number of employees.
 
 
**What You'll Be Contributing**

* Promote and follow all plant safety guidelines
* Conducts meetings with plant staff personnel to communicate, coordinate and discuss plant operations.
* Monitors, inspects, and reviews all plant activities.
* Ensures production schedule corresponds with sales forecasts.
* Assists in investigating customer and quality problems and concerns.
* Meets with government agencies and community groups concerning plant activities to ensure compliance with environmental regulations, policies, and standards.
* Prepares regular reports regarding plant production operations.
* Attends Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) training for waste-derived fuel activities.
* Promotes effective job performance through motivation, goals, and providing feedback.
* Promotes the safety program, compliance with safety standards, and participates in safety meetings.
* Establishes plant standards, short-term goals, and long-term strategic plans for production, maintenance, and improvements.
* Discusses new products, equipment, and ideas with staff and vendors.
* Analyzes plant costs and explore methods to improve productivity cost-effectively.
* Uses technology to develop a continuous improvement plan for the plant.
* Troubleshoots various problems and performance barriers.
* Additional duties as assigned by supervisor.

**To Succeed In This Position, You Will Need**

* Ability to read, write, and understand warning labels, instructions, signs, etc.
* Minimum 4 Year Bachelor's Degree in engineering, chemistry, natural sciences, business administration, or closely related field.
* Professional Engineer (PE) preferred
* Minimum 10 years of experience in a cement or lime manufacturing facility with specific exposure to plant management responsibilities. Type of experience - cement or lime - depends on the specific type of plant with the position under consideration.
* Ability to develop and deliver effective presentations
* Ability to make decisions and solve problems with high attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to make sound independent judgments regularly
* Ability to effectively coach and deliver constructive feedback
* Ability to inspire and develop staff
* Proficient in effective negotiation skills in business and construction contracts
* Proficient in Microsoft Office365
* Ability to effectively use computers for general word processing, spreadsheets, presentations, e-mail, internet, and customized company programs.
* Ability to communicate the company's vision into actionable goals and contributions for plant personnel.
* Ability to network with industry professionals, consultants, vendors, suppliers, regulators, and the community.
* Knowledge of safety and environmental health regulations.
* Knowledge of cement chemistry, physical testing, and concrete performance.
* Knowledge of various systems for cement manufacturing (crushing, grinding, pyro processing, chemistry).
* Ability to work from general policies and procedures.
* Ability to refer to supervisor when clarification or interpretation of the organizational policy
* What's next for you?\*\*

We provide stability and advancement opportunities across North America. Use our tuition reimbursement program to help you meet your career goals.
 
 
\_The above duties and responsibilities are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive. The physical demands, working environment, and other conditions of employment listed in this document are representative of but are not intended to provide an exhaustive list of the requirements for positions in this classification. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.\_
 
 
\*\*What CRH Offers You\*\*
 
 

* Highly competitive base pay
* Comprehensive medical, dental and disability benefits programs
* Group retirement savings program
* Health and wellness programs
* An inclusive culture that values opportunity for growth, development, and internal promotion

\*\*About CRH\*\*
 
 
CRH has a long and proud heritage. We are a collection of hundreds of family businesses, regional companies and large enterprises that together form the CRH family. CRH operates in a decentralized, diversified structure that allows you to work in a small company environment while having the career opportunities of a large international organization.
 
 
If you're up for a rewarding challenge, we invite you to take the first step and apply today! Once you click apply now, you will be brought to our official employment application. Please complete your online profile and it will be sent to the hiring manager. Our system allows you to view and track your status 24 hours a day. Thank you for your interest!
 
 
Ash Grove Cement, a CRH Company, is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer.
 
 
EOE/Vet/Disability
 
 
CRH is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.
 
 
AI tools may be used in certain stages of the employment lifecycle, such as candidate review; however, all final employment decisions will be made by a person.

Working Safely

Engaging Fully

Profit-sharing plan, cash bonus programs and annual cost-of-living adjustments

Health, dental and vision insurance eligibility on day one
 
Paid parental leave
 
Continuing education reimbursement
 
Personalized career development and training programs

Fitness center for St. Louis office-based team members
 
Gym membership reimbursement for project-based team members
 
Corporate office cafeteria access
 
Employee Resource Group (ERG) opportunities
 
Philanthropy opportunities
 
 
 
**Job Details**
The Plant Manager directs and manages all plant operations with overall responsibilities for production, maintenance, quality and other production-related activities as a part of a premier structural steel fabricator and erector.
 
 
Essential Responsibilities & Duties include the following; however, other duties may be assigned. The Company provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with a disability, unless doing so poses an undue hardship on the Company. Directs and manages Responsible for labor relations and managing union issues associated with craft labor.
 
Manages capital asset maintenance.
 
Establishes and monitors overall plant performance for production and quality standards.
 
Controls and minimizes repair expenses.
 
Maintains existing plant facilities and equipment; replaces or makes adjustments to plant facilities and equipment when necessary.
 
Provides leadership and training to accomplish Company goals and objectives.
 
Implements and maintains preventative maintenance programs.
 
Incorporates shop floor organization and plant cleanliness among plant personnel.
 
Manages and directs non-supervisory administrative or union employees and is responsible for the overall direction and management of these employees.
 
Travels to Company and subsidiary offices; offsite client, subcontractor, and supplier meetings; and other locations across North America to fulfill the essential duties of the role as required.
 
Exhibits regular and reliable attendance in person as required by the Supervisor, Company guidelines, and/or project and office obligations.
 
Education and Experience
 
 
Bachelor's degree and 5 years’ plant/general management experience in a manufacturing environment, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
 
 
Experience managing in a union environment required.
 
Working knowledge of budgets and financials statements required.
 
Background with manufacturing methods, process improvement programs and procedures required.

records.description:
**Plant Manager**
**Why Byrne**
At Byrne, we foster a culture built on teamwork, excellence, and professionalism. Our greatest strength lies in the exceptional talent and dedication of our team members across every part of the organization. We value their contributions and ensure they’re recognized, rewarded, and compensated in ways that reflect their impact and expertise.
 
 
**Pay And Benefits**

* Salary Range – $125,000 - $152,500 per year
* Competitive bonus programs
* Medical, Dental, Vision benefits available day 1 of employment
* Supplemental benefits available on day 30 of employment
* Eligible for 401 (k) with a company match available on day 90 of employment
* Educational Support via tuition reimbursement and scholarship program

**Work Shift and Location**
3156 Byrne Hollow Crossing Cortland, NY 13045
 
 
Monday – Friday normal business hours. This may require evening, night and weekend availability based on business needs.
 
 
**Job Overview**
The Plant Manager plays a key role in executing assigned Production tasks. This includes leading various teams in production efforts in addition to performing the duties as needed to efficiently facilitate plant operations. The Plant Manager is also responsible for ensuring that the plant products manufactured conform to company-defined product quality standards, as well as Federal, State, and local standards of product identity, safety, and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs).
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of the plant; coordinate and direct plant operations in the achievement of production, cost, quality, and safety objectives.
* Ensure an appropriate volume of production and raw inventories for each product produced to maximize machine efficiencies and minimize down time and stock outs.
* Manage plant budget and expenses to fall within, or better than plan. Manage all plant variances to meet or exceed plan including, but not limited to, headcount, overtime, and spending.
* Ensure that the quality of products produced at the facility is consistent with intended design and desired image.
* Coordinate with Plant Production Scheduler, Warehouse Management and Supply Management to ensure needed dry goods are on-hand as required.
* Establish and administer mechanisms for being alerted when suppliers are going to be late for delivery or cut items on a delivery. Take action to minimize impact on production schedules and alert appropriate sales and logistics personnel.
* Provide planning assistance with physical inventories and provide staffing to perform these activities; ensure accuracy of all inventories at all times.
* Ensure reporting mechanism regarding KPI are in-place and functioning; ensure monthly reporting of critical KPI to company leadership and plant staff.
* Monitor intake procedures of raw dairy products to assure quality standards are met and production shortages are avoided.
* Contributes to the development of budgets and cost controls. Ensure direct reports analyze, budget, and control spending for their respective line accounts.
* Facilitate the development of strategies and corrective actions to resolve quality issues as necessary.
* Implements and maintains manufacturing policies, procedures, and production control programs.
* Must ensure full compliance with all quality assurance standards.
* Provide for the development, prioritization, and execution of capital improvement projects within the facility.
* Provide leadership for effective employee relations through positive communication, coaching, training, problem resolution/corrective actions, and floor time, work cooperatively with Human Resources.
* Coordinate production activities with purchasing, sales, warehousing, distribution, maintenance, and quality control activities to obtain optimum production and utilization of staff and equipment.
* Provide for the personal and professional growth of team through coaching, feedback, and opportunity.
* Foster participation of the workforce to enhance awareness and cooperation.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and all government regulations; Ensure compliance and enforcement of all work rules and regulations to plant operations and all applicable employees.
* Ensure proper GMP and sanitation procedures are followed plant-wide in collaboration with the quality unit.
* Communicate with Human Resource Department on needs of the facility.
* Rigorously assess your leadership and technical team in terms of values, adherence to SOPs/GMPs, and actual results.
* Foster an “open door” policy for all employees to maintain an open line of communication between direct reports and management staff.
* Promote and provide excellent customer service for all customers.
* Promote a safe and harmonious work environment and adherence to company policy and procedures.
* Responsible for ensuring direct reports assigned duties and responsibilities are covered during planned and unplanned absence from work, including acting as a backup as necessary.

**Min. Qualifications**

* BA/BS in Business Administration or related field, with an MBA preferred.
* Minimum 5-7 years in the role of Managing a Production facility.
* Related experience in the dairy food industry.
* Certifications to include but not limited to CPT, HACCP, OSHA 10-hour, First Aid, CPR and AED.

**Byrne**
Headquartered in LaFayette, Byrne is a Central New York-based dairy company with a legacy spanning over 90 years. Its operations include an extended shelf-life (ESL) and ultra-high temperature (UHT) pasteurization plant in DeWitt, as well as an ESL manufacturing facility in Cortlandville. Byrne also maintains warehouse facilities in Syracuse and East Syracuse, along with a dedicated ice cream center in Syracuse. As a recognized industry leader, Byrne continues to drive innovation at the forefront of dairy processing and product development.

records.description:
ResourceTek is the Human Capital division of Barge Design Solutions, a multi-discipline Engineering and Architecture firm. We specialize in providing technical recruitment and staffing services to industry and government in all areas of Engineering, Information Technology, and a broad range of other technical disciplines.

In partnership with our client, a leading U.S. manufacturer of copper and aluminum building wire and cable, ResourceTek is seeking an experienced, solutions-driven
**Plant Manager**
to join the team at their facility located near
**Jackson, MS**
.

The right candidate will be responsible and accountable for making decisions that affect employee health & safety, employee relations, employee growth & development, facility profitability, quality of products, customer satisfaction, and local/regional community relationships. Develops manufacturing budgets and plans to meet production goals within budget.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

· Lead all aspects of the manufacturing operations and development activities of the plant to achieve short and long-term goals to meet customer and company expectations.

· Drive world-class processes in the areas of EH&S, developing a solid safety culture within the plant in order to achieve an accident-free work environment, providing prompt and effective action to eliminate unsafe acts or conditions as they become apparent.

· Propose and execute plant operational budgets, capital budgets, sales forecasts and resource requirements.

· Lead the manufacturing functions in the plant on all shifts to ensure on-time production and shipment of conforming products and materials. Including: planning the production flow, troubleshooting manufacturing issues, handling staffing issues, and monitoring production orders and schedules.

· Develop and implement sustainable manufacturing processes needed to manufacture high-quality products on time.

· Identify opportunities for improvement across the plant in relation to process, equipment, facilities and staffing and drive implementation in a spirit of continuous improvement.

· Maintain and control plant inventories to inventory plan to meet anticipated customer demands without excess investment.

· Responsible for the integrity of all the plant-related data and information.

· Continually monitor results achieved in relation to planned goals and undertake necessary corrective action to achieve the desired results.

· Drive the implementation and execution of robust quality systems to ensure product quality meets and exceeds customer expectations.

· Manage plant project list to set priorities and ensure they are completed in a timely manner.

· Develop and engage with all employees in order to develop a favorable employee relations environment and work with staff members on their personal growth and development goals to ensure employees feel encouraged and motivated to contribute at their full potential.

· Provide leadership for problem resolution to facilitate faster improvements and improved working relations.

**REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS**

· Bachelor’s degree in business or engineering preferred

· 10+ years’ experience in manufacturing, including experience in a supervisory or managerial capacity, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

· 5+ years’ manufacturing experience in a process-based environment; wire and cable experience preferred.

· 5+ years manufacturing plant/general management experience

· Extensive and proven experience in Lean Manufacturing, strong track record of leading in a continuous improvement environment.

· Six Sigma / Lean Manufacturing Experience / Training

SKILLS & ABILITIES

· Strong leadership skills and presence

· Demonstrated history of hiring, retaining, and promoting team members

· Ability to build a safety-focused culture that is a great place to work

· Understand the financials of the plant and drive the necessary improvements to achieve and exceed financial and production targets

· Action and solution-oriented leader with strong sense of urgency

· Strong focus on understanding and meeting Customer needs

· Ability to manage multiple priorities

· Ability to build people’s capabilities – Coach and develop teams

· Results oriented with excellent organizational, problem solving, and interpersonal skills

· Seeks out information to understand root causes and drive effective decision-making

· Proven knowledge in budgeting, expense management, and capital equipment analysis

· Knowledge of plant manufacturing systems

· Demonstrated ability to lead people and get results through others

· Clear understanding of effective manufacturing practices in the areas of safety, quality, cost, productivity, and delivery

· Ability to effectively communicate verbally and in writing with customers and employees at all levels

· Computer proficiency (especially MS Office: Excel, PowerPoint, Word)

If you're looking for a stable career with an established manufacturer that values safety, teamwork, and continuous improvement, we encourage you to apply today!

Company offers a competitive salary with
**25% annual bonus**
and a comprehensive benefits package that includes tuition reimbursement, 401k/Roth with company match, and more. Equal Opportunity Employer.

records.description:
**Welcome to Cascades!**
Bring your expertise to a people-first, dynamic environment where your ideas come to life and excellence shapes everything we do.
 
 
Join CHRIS MARTIN EVERETT's team as a
**Plant Manager**
in
**Rockingham**
and help build a more sustainable future.
 
 
**What’s In It For You**
Taking care of our people is in our nature - so you’ll enjoy:
 
 

* Annual salary starting at $160,000
* Profit sharing and an employee share purchase plan
* A full range of benefits: group insurance, telemedicine, and an employer-supported retirement plan
* An annual allowance to spend on goods and services of your choice
* A yearly wellness program and employee assistance program
* A collaborative, respectful, and people-centered workplace

**Your Role**
As
**Plant Manager**
, you’ll take on real challenges that bring out your full potential.
 
 
**Your Scope Includes**

* Lead all plant operations to achieve safety, quality, production, and financial objectives.
* Drive a strong safety culture through visible leadership and accountability.
* Improve reliability through preventive/predictive maintenance, planning, scheduling, and root cause analysis.
* Optimize paper machine performance, equipment uptime, productivity, and product quality.
* Manage plant financial performance, including cost per ton, labor, maintenance, fiber, chemical, and energy costs.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives using data-driven problem-solving methods.
* Develop and strengthen leadership, technical, and hourly teams.
* Build and execute recovery plans for underperforming operations with measurable business impact

**What You Bring**
You're a natural fit for
**Plant Manager**
if you have:
 
 

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing, or related field preferred.
* 15+ years of manufacturing leadership experience in tissue, paper, pulp, or related process industries.
* Proven experience leading paper machine operations and driving performance improvements.
* Demonstrated success managing operational turnarounds and improving underperforming facilities.
* Strong knowledge of papermaking processes, maintenance and reliability systems, continuous improvement, and plant financial management.
* Proven ability to lead large teams, develop talent, and drive organizational change.
* Tissue manufacturing experience strongly preferred.
* Progressive leadership experience from Operations/Production Management into Plant or Mill Leadership.
* Track record of improving safety, OEE, uptime, quality, productivity, and cost performance.

If you bring the same care to who you are as to what you do, we’d love to meet you!
 
 
Apply now and join our team as
**Plant Manager**
in
**Rockingham.**
*Cascades values diversity and inclusion and considers all applications equitably. This posting is for an active vacancy within our organization.*
