records.title: Manufacturing Engineering Director
records.description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available
 
 
CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: No
 
 
CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret
 
 
TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time
 
 
**Description**
At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.
 
 
The
**Director, Manufacturing Engineering**
provides functional and strategic leadership for the manufacturing engineering organization, accountable for process capability, producibility, and product quality across production programs. This role leads a team of managers and engineers responsible for developing, deploying, and continuously improving manufacturing, test, and related industrial engineering processes to meet safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people objectives in
**Baltimore, MD**
.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 
 

* Functional & People Leadership

+ Lead and develop a high‑performing manufacturing engineering organization, including managers, engineers, and supporting staff.
+ Define and maintain functional standards, methods, tools, and best practices for manufacturing engineering across the site or business.
+ Recruit, develop, and retain talent; drive succession planning, leadership development, and engagement/inclusion activities.
+ Provide regular coaching, performance feedback, and career development for managers and engineers.

* Manufacturing Engineering Ownership

+ Own manufacturing engineering processes from new product introduction through sustainment, ensuring robust process controls, standard work, and documented work instructions.
+ Direct the creation and maintenance of MBOMs, routings, work instructions, tooling, and strategies that enable safe, efficient, and high‑quality production.
+ Drive producibility into designs by partnering with Design Engineering early in the lifecycle; ensure effective transition to production and rate readiness.
+ Establish and manage key performance indicators (yields, scrap, rework, cycle time, labor efficiency) and drive continuous improvement using data‑driven methods.

* Operations, Quality, and Continuous Improvement

+ Partner closely with Operations, Quality & Mission Excellence, and Supply Chain to ensure stable processes and timely resolution of production issues.
+ Oversee manufacturing engineering participation in MRB and nonconformance disposition; ensure effective root‑cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions.
+ Champion initiatives to improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost.
+ Lead manufacturing engineering support to factory readiness, capacity planning, and rate ramp‑ups.

* Program, Financial, and Strategic Management

+ Align functional objectives, resources, and priorities with program and business needs; balance near‑term execution with long‑term capability development.
+ Partner with Program Management and Business Management to support bids, proposals, and program execution, including manufacturing scope, risk, and cost/schedule inputs.
+ Own manufacturing engineering budgets (labor, capital, and expense) and apply sound financial management.
+ Develop and execute technology roadmaps and capital investment plans for manufacturing processes, equipment, and facilities.

* Compliance, Governance, and Stakeholder Management

+ Ensure manufacturing engineering processes comply with regulatory requirements, customer standards, and internal procedures.
+ Represent manufacturing engineering in internal and external reviews, audits, and customer engagements.
+ Build strong relationships with sector/site leadership, program teams, and functional peers to drive alignment and resolve cross‑functional constraints.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related discipline with 10 or more years of relevant experience; OR a Master’s degree in Engineering or a related discipline with 8 or more years of relevant experience.
* 3 or more years of functional management experience leading organizations of at least 100 employees.
* Progressive leadership experience in manufacturing/production, operations, program management, testing, or a related area, including direct leadership of engineers and/or first‑line managers.
* Demonstrated experience in manufacturing or production engineering supporting complex hardware (e.g., aerospace, defense, electronics, or similar).
* Proven track record of improving manufacturing and test processes, yields, cycle times, and product quality using data and metrics.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing process controls, quality systems, and relevant industry/regulatory standards.
* Demonstrated financial acumen including budgets, rates, and cost management
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly present technical and operational content to leadership and customers.
* U.S. citizenship and an ability to obtain U.S. Government Secret security clearance or greater; OR DoE equivalent or greater

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Engineering, Engineering Management, Business Administration, or related field.
* Experience in a Director or senior manager role leading a manufacturing engineering or test engineering organization in an aerospace/defense or similarly regulated environment.
* Experience working across multiple disciplines (design, manufacturing, and test engineering) with a strong focus on product development, producibility, and transition to production.
* Hands‑on experience with continuous improvement frameworks
* Experience managing capital equipment roadmaps and facilities upgrades to support long‑term manufacturing capacity and capability.
* Proven ability to build and develop high‑performing teams, including succession planning, leadership development, and engagement initiatives.
* Experience supporting proposals and customer reviews, including articulation of manufacturing engineering approaches, risks, and mitigations.
* Experience working in a matrixed organization, balancing program demands with functional standards and development needs.

Primary Level Salary Range: $194,600.00 - $292,000.00
 
 
The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.
 
 
Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.
 
 
The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.
 
 
Northrop Grumman is an Equal Opportunity Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class. For our complete EEO and pay transparency statement, please visit http://www.northropgrumman.com/EEO. U.S. Citizenship is required for all positions with a government clearance and certain other restricted positions.

records.title: Director, Continuous Improvement
records.description:
**Job Description**
The Director, Continuous Improvement leads the Supply Chain-wide capability for identifying, prioritizing, enabling, and sustaining improvements that increase business performance and organizational effectiveness across functions and end-to-end processes. This role establishes a culture of continuous improvement, advances operational and business process excellence, and enables measurable improvements in productivity, cost, quality, service, and capacity.
 
 
Working closely with cross-functional Supply Chain leaders, this position standardizes processes, uses data and insights to prioritize opportunities, and implements sustainable solutions aligned with strategic objectives. The Director maintains a strong connection to frontline operations by working directly in Supply Chain Centers and other functional environments to understand processes firsthand and translate observations into meaningful improvements.
 
 
**What You’ll Do**

* Develop and execute a comprehensive Continuous Improvement strategy and multi-year roadmap aligned with Supply Chain priorities, and advise Supply Chain leadership on opportunities that improve productivity, efficiency, cost, service, quality, capacity, and organizational effectiveness.
* Lead the deployment of consistent Continuous Improvement methodologies, tools, governance, performance expectations, and resource prioritization across Supply Chain functions.
* Work directly with Supply Chain Centers and functional teams to observe work at the point of execution, identify process variation and non-value-added activities, and implement standardized processes, operating practices, management systems, standard work, and process controls.
* Lead cross-functional transformation and productivity initiatives, including process redesign, technology-enabled improvement, automation, and new ways of working, in partnership with functional leaders, the PMO, Finance, and other stakeholders.
* Establish measurable outcomes, baselines, KPI definitions, reporting standards, dashboards, and processes for tracking, validating, and sustaining financial benefits, productivity improvements, and business value.
* Build organizational Continuous Improvement capability through training, coaching, structured problem-solving, knowledge sharing, and the development of CI team members and functional leaders.
* Lead change management and cross-functional alignment, manage risks and barriers, strengthen process integration, and communicate priorities, progress, results, and recommendations to Supply Chain leadership and key stakeholders.

**What You’ll Bring**
In addition to the technical and functional requirements of this role, successful candidates demonstrate Domino's Hungry for MORE Ways of Working:
 
 
Be Curious
 
 

* Seeks clarity, asks thoughtful questions, and uncovers root causes to solve problems effectively.
* Actively pursues learning opportunities, applies feedback, and continuously develops new skills.

Connect the Dots
 
 

* Uses information and insights to identify opportunities and drive informed decisions.
* Builds strong partnerships across teams and considers the broader organizational impact of decisions.

Aim High
 
 

* Sets ambitious goals, challenges the status quo, and focuses on work that drives meaningful business results.
* Uses feedback and data to continuously improve performance and outcomes.

Shift Fast
 
 

* Adapts quickly to changing priorities and business needs while maintaining focus on results.
* Demonstrates resilience, sound judgment, and the ability to learn from setbacks.

Deliver More
 
 

* Takes ownership, executes with discipline, and consistently produces measurable results.
* Identifies opportunities to create additional value for customers, team members, and the business.

Leadership Expectations
 
 

* Builds and develops high-performing teams aligned to Domino’s Ways of Working.
* Creates accountability, fosters collaboration, and delivers results through others.
* Leads confidently through change while maintaining team engagement and performance.
* Demonstrates enterprise thinking and drives cross-functional alignment to achieve business goals.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing, or a related discipline; an advanced degree or MBA is preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in Continuous Improvement, Supply Chain, business transformation, operational excellence, or related disciplines, including demonstrated leadership experience in complex, cross-functional organizations.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing Continuous Improvement strategies and delivering measurable business results across multiple functions or complex organizations.
* Strong knowledge and practical application of Lean Six Sigma, structured problem-solving, process optimization, standardization, and change management methodologies.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional improvement initiatives, influence stakeholders, and drive organizational change without direct authority.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience leading Continuous Improvement initiatives in manufacturing, distribution, logistics, or other complex operational environments, including the ability to engage frontline employees, site leaders, and senior executives to diagnose issues, implement solutions, and deliver measurable results.
* Strong business and financial acumen, including experience identifying, quantifying, and validating productivity improvements, cost savings, and business value.
* Well-developed team building and influencing skills, unquestioned integrity, and the experience and confidence to work effectively across multiple functions and levels of the organization.
* Experience developing performance management frameworks, leveraging data analytics, and translating insights into actionable business recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to build organizational capability through coaching, talent development, and deployment of Continuous Improvement methodologies.
* Strong strategic thinking, communication, collaboration, and executive presentation skills.
* Experience managing complex improvement portfolios, prioritizing competing business needs, and delivering sustainable outcomes.
* Lean Six Sigma certification or equivalent demonstrated Continuous Improvement expertise is preferred.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally, including Canada, as business needs require. Expected travel is up to 50%

Additional Information
 
 
Benefits:
 
 

* Paid Holidays and Vacation
* Medical, Dental & Vision benefits that start on the first day of employment
* No-cost mental health support for employee and dependents
* Childcare tuition discounts
* No-cost fitness, nutrition, and wellness programs
* Fertility benefits
* Adoption assistance
* 401k matching contributions
* 15% off the purchase price of stock
* Company bonus

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

records.description:
**Job Description**
**About the role**
As the Director of Continuous Improvement, you’ll be the senior strategic leader driving operational excellence, transformation, and sustainable performance improvement across the enterprise. You’ll own the development, deployment, and governance of TERREPOWER’s global continuous improvement (CI) strategy — aligning it with business objectives and building a culture of innovation, accountability, and measurable results. It’s a high-impact role for a visionary change agent with deep Lean and Six Sigma expertise who can influence at every level and deliver real impact across diverse regions and functions.
 
 
**What You’ll Do**

* Strategic leadership — Define and execute a global CI strategy aligned with corporate goals, partner with executive leadership to identify high-value transformation opportunities, and establish enterprise-wide CI governance, frameworks, and performance standards.
* Operational excellence — Lead global CI initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, and other methodologies, standardize processes and best practices across regions, and drive measurable improvements in cost, quality, delivery, safety, and customer satisfaction.

records.title: Director, Operational Excellence
records.description:
**Job Description**
**Company Overview**
Vertex is a global biotechnology company focused on investing in scientific innovation to create transformative medicines for people with serious diseases. Across our organization, we work with urgency, rigor, and collaboration to deliver therapies that improve patient outcomes and create long-term value.
 
 
**General Summary**
The Operational Excellence team serves as the process improvement and performance enablement backbone of CMTO, providing the improvement discipline, management systems, and change capabilities required to run, grow, and optimize Vertex’s commercial manufacturing network.
 
 
The Director, Operational Excellence leads the development and execution of CMTO’s Operational Excellence strategy and improvement portfolio. The role identifies and prioritizes performance improvement opportunities, leads structured problem-solving and transformation initiatives, and ensures improvements are implemented and sustained through effective change management, standard work, performance monitoring, and leadership accountability.
 
 
The Director also leads and develops the Operational Excellence team, building organizational capability, setting priorities, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and accountability. The role partners closely with Business Analytics, Network Performance, Manufacturing Operations, MS&T, Business Operations Leads, Quality, Supply Chain, and Finance to use performance insights to identify improvement priorities and deliver measurable business outcomes.
 
 
**Key Duties And Responsibilities**

* Operational Excellence Strategy & Initiative Execution
* Contribute to setting CMTO's operational excellence strategy, priorities, and success measures, aligned to enterprise and functional priorities
* Identify, prioritize, and drive execution of a portfolio of commercial manufacturing improvement and transformation initiatives — partnering with sites and functions while avoiding ownership of routine operations
* Lead initiatives targeting lead-time reduction, launch optimization, yield, and manufacturing success-rate improvements and COGM reduction through structured problem definition, root-cause analysis, options analysis, and ROI calculation
* Lead Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, and structured problem-solving initiatives across technical and business processes
* Develop clear business cases, recommendations, and implementation plans for Operational Excellence initiatives, including expected benefits, resource requirements, risks, and measures of success.
* Manage and Lead the Operational Excellence Team
* Establish and communicate a clear vision, mission, and strategic direction for the Operational Excellence team, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and stakeholder expectations
* Partner with senior leadership to define team priorities, continuously reassessing and adjusting focus based on evolving business needs, operational risks, and strategic objectives
* Set clear performance expectations, goals, and development plans for team members; monitor progress, provide timely feedback, and hold the team accountable for results
* Remove organizational barriers and resolve escalated issues that impede team performance or delivery of key initiatives
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, innovation, and accountability by coaching and mentoring team members in problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills
* Build organizational capability by identifying skill gaps, developing talent, and implementing training and succession plans that strengthen Operational Excellence competencies
* Communicate team objectives, progress, achievements, risks, and resource needs to senior leadership and key stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment across organization
* Promote cross-functional collaboration and strong stakeholder relationships to enable successful execution of Operational Excellence initiatives and sustainable business improvements
* Continuous Improvement & Change Execution
* Embed structured problem-solving, continuous improvement, and change execution into CMTO governance and operating rhythms, using performance insights provided by Business Analytics, Network Performance, and functional teams.
* Ensure improvements are implemented and sustained through effective change management, standard work, control plans, performance monitoring, and clear process ownership.
* Identify and deploy digital tools, automation, and process solutions that improve operational performance and the scalability of Operational Excellence practices.
* Community of Practice & Capability Building
* Operate as a community-of-practice leader for manufacturing operational excellence across internal manufacturing and supply chain, driving common standards, methods, and ways of working
* Mentor teams on Lean methods, structured problem-solving, and continuous improvement practices, and benchmark industry best practices to inform innovative approaches

**Knowledge And Skills**

* Strong leadership, communication, collaboration, and team building
* Proven ability to motivate teams and build team unity
* Demonstrated success implementing Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, FMEA, Hoshin Kanri, and Change Management methodologies in GMP environments
* Proven experience leading improvement initiatives targeting lead-time reduction, launch optimization, yield improvement and COGM/COGs reduction
* Experience using operational data and performance insights to identify, prioritize, and measure improvement opportunities.
* Hands-on proficiency in data analysis, root-cause analysis, process analysis, and structured problem-solving
* Ability to quantify the operational and financial benefits of improvement initiatives and communicate clear recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Experience implementing and sustaining performance management systems, visual management, Standard Work, and Leader Standard Work.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; experience with process mapping, statistical analysis, and Lean Six Sigma tools preferred.
* Ability to translate complex operational problems into clear improvement priorities, recommendations, and implementation plans.
* Ability to operate effectively in a matrixed environment with strong role clarity, partnering across Network Performance, Business Operations, Manufacturing Operations, MS&T, Finance, and Strategic Sourcing

**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Life Sciences, Business, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
* Typically requires 8–12 years of experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, regulated manufacturing, supply chain, MS&T, Operational Excellence, or business transformation environments.
* Minimum 5 years of experience leading Operational Excellence, transformation, continuous improvement, or complex process-improvement initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing teams.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt required

At Vertex, we embrace continuous learning and encourage employees to stay informed on advances in AI, technology, automation, and industry trends. We seek talent who bring an external perspective, demonstrate curiosity and sound judgment, and thoughtfully adopt new capabilities that improve decision-making, drive innovation, increase efficiency, and help deliver better outcomes for patients.
 
 
**Pay Range**
$181,900 - $272,900
 
 
**Disclosure Statement**
The range provided is based on what we believe is a reasonable estimate for the base salary pay range for this job at the time of posting. This role is eligible for an annual bonus and annual equity awards. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay, in accordance with federal and state requirements. Actual base salary pay will be based on a number of factors, including skills, competencies, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law.
 
 
At Vertex, our Total Rewards offerings also include inclusive market-leading benefits to meet our employees wherever they are in their career, financial, family and wellbeing journey while providing flexibility and resources to support their growth and aspirations. From medical, dental and vision benefits to generous paid time off (including a week-long company shutdown in the Summer and the Winter), educational assistance programs including student loan repayment, a generous commuting subsidy, matching charitable donations, 401(k) and so much more.
 
 
**Flex Designation**
Hybrid-Eligible Or On-Site Eligible
 
 
**Flex Eligibility Status**
In this Hybrid-Eligible role, you can choose to be designated as:
 
 

* Hybrid: work remotely up to two days per week; or select
* On-Site: work five days per week on-site with ad hoc flexibility.

Note: The Flex status for this position is subject to Vertex’s Policy on Flex @ Vertex Program and may be changed at any time.
 
 
**Company Information**
Vertex is a global biotechnology company that invests in scientific innovation.
 
 
Vertex is committed to equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person's race, color, sex, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. Vertex is an E-Verify Employer in the United States. Vertex will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities, in accordance with applicable law.
 
 
Any applicant requiring an accommodation in connection with the hiring process and/or to perform the essential functions of the position for which the applicant has applied should make a request to the recruiter or hiring manager, or contact Talent Acquisition at ApplicationAssistance@vrtx.com

records.title: Director, Continuous Improvement Business Partner
records.description:
**Life Unlimited.**
At Smith+Nephew we design and manufacture technology that takes the limits off living. This role does not currently have direct reports but works across the global matrixed teams (across functions and regions) to grow the adoption of 'Our Way to Win' Conitnuous Improvement Strategy for maximum impact and cultural transformation. This role works with leadership teams to align and execute against our strategy, and enables the leadership teams to create a continuous improvement culture that routinely achieves its business goals. This person will own the development of continuous improvement capabilities throughout the organization, driving all business KPIs aligned with revenue, SG&A expenses, marketing, R&D driving overall profitable growth.
 
 
**What will you be doing?**
Partners with Wound leadership team to identify/develop and deliver key performance indicators (KPIs) throughout the organization aligned to the overall functional objectives Respectfully cultivates an action-biased culture of continuous improvement to advance business and functional KPI’s aligned to Smith + Nephew’s corporate goals. Responsible for leading through facilitating/enabling the implementation of 'Our Way to Win' throughout all of the Wound business. Establish and mature a Lean Management System (Tiered Accountability, Visual Management, Gemba Walks, and Leader Standard Work) and other coaching tools to transform the culture. Works with teams to streamline processes to improve business and functional objectives, with a specific focus on customer experience and end-to-end optimization. Provides support to develop Continuous Improvement expertise and capability within the organization at all levels. Improves the decision-making model and problem-solving capabilities within high performance teams to increase the autonomy and pace of change. Provides regular, ongoing reporting and communications to Wound leadership regarding status of implementation and maturity. Collaborates with Continuous Improvement teammates to leverage and share standard methodologies, and drive improvements to the company level 'Way to Win' Roadmap, tools, and technology.
 
 
**What will you need to be successful?**

* Four-year university degree required (business, marketing, or engineering, preferred); Master’s Degree required.
* Leadership roles from disciplines such as Sales, Marketing, Strategy Development and Deployment, Lean/Operating System/Business System
* Proven track record for developing, training, and coaching teams across cultures
* 12 years in process improvement and/or lean related experience
* Minimum of 8+ years of experience and “hands on” track record of implementing successful lean based business systems including elements such as:

+ Strategy Deployment and A3 Thinking
+ Lean Management Systems (Tiered Accountability, Visual Management, Gemba Walks, Leader Standard Work)
+ Value-Stream Mapping
+ Kaizen events
+ Expertise in problem solving utilizing a formal program/process
+ Implementation of KPI Management across functions and businesses

* Med-Tech or Healthcare experience a plus
* Experience in Change Management, and able to act as an influential change agent
* Microsoft Office expertise

**KNOWLEDGE SKILLS & ABILITIES:**

* Broad knowledge of multi-functional, multi-site, global organizational processes and financial business methods
* Demonstrated skill and confidence in proactively building relationships with top tier partners/leaders both internally and externally
* Demonstrated experience and leadership in managing comprehensive continuous improvement approaches/methodologies to advance an organization’s strategy and goals
* Strong ability to anticipate future needs of the organization and make decisions in a changing environment
* Great communicator, demonstrated ability in solid written, oral, and presentation-giving skills
* Ability to effectively work with different cultures in a global, matrixed environment
* High ethical standards to support a professional business code of conduct
* Passion for driving improvement and leading change in complex environments
* A holistic thinker who can look enterprise-wide to integrate and streamline systems for optimal benefit
* Able to drive strategic thinking and continuous improvement in both operational and non-operational areas, including connecting cross-functional resources to remove waste along the extended value streams
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to connect with and positively influence leadership and all levels of the organization
* Energetic, flexible, collaborative and proactive leader who welcomes challenges
* Manages time and resources effectively through strong organization, multi-tasking, and time management skills
* Works independently as a self-starter committed to delivering performance results
* Analyzes information to make sound business decisions taking prudent business risks as appropriate
* Strong analytical skills
* Ability to work independently and as a part of a team to seek resolution to problems
* Acts as an influential change agent
* Able to travel domestically and internationally up to 50% as needed

**You Unlimited.**

* The anticipated base compensation range for this position is $181,500 - $213,500 USD annually. The actual base pay offered to the successful candidate will be based on multiple factors, including but not limited to job-related knowledge/skills, experience, and geographic location. Compensation decisions are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each position and candidate. In addition to base pay, we offer competitive bonus and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k), tuition reimbursement, medical leave programs, parental leave, generous PTO, paid company holidays, 8 hours of volunteer time annually, and a variety of wellness offerings such as EAP.
* Inclusion + Belonging: Committed to Welcoming, Celebrating and Thriving. Learn more about our Employee Inclusion Groups on our website https://www.smith-nephew.com/
* Your Future: 401k Matching Program, 401k Plus Program, Discounted Stock Options, Tuition Reimbursement
* Work/Life Balance: Flexible Personal/Vacation Time Off, Paid Holidays, Flex Holidays, Paid Community Service Day
* Your Wellbeing: Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account (Employer Contribution of $500+ annually), Employee Assistance Program, Parental Leave, Fertility and Adoption Assistance Program
* Flexibility: Hybrid Work Model (For most professional roles)
* Training: Hands-On, Team-Customized, Mentorship
* Extra Perks: Discounts on fitness clubs, travel and more!

Smith+Nephew provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability.
 
 
Stay connected by joining our Talent Community.
 
 
We're more than just a company - we're a community! Follow us on LinkedIn to see how we support and empower our employees and patients every day.
 
 
Check us out on Glassdoor for a glimpse behind the scenes and a sneak peek into
**You. Unlimited.**
, life, culture, and benefits at S+N.
 
 
Explore our website and learn more about our mission, our team, and the opportunities we offer.

records.title: Head of Quality
records.description:
**About Bora:**

Bora Biologics is a global biologics CDMO delivering integrated development and GMP manufacturing solutions from First‑in‑Human through licensed commercial supply. While many CDMOs are structured primarily for early clinical programs, Bora Biologics is purpose‑built for commercialization. Our inspection‑proven, bi‑coastal U.S. manufacturing platform and integrated development center provide the infrastructure, regulatory discipline, and operational precision required for sustained global market supply.

**Summary**

Reporting to the VP, Regional Head of Quality, the BBUL Site Head of Quality is responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing a comprehensive Quality Management strategy aligned with corporate policies, client expectations, and global regulatory requirements. This role ensures products from development through commercialization are safe, effective, and fully compliant with applicable CGMP/GxP standards. As a key member of the site leadership team, the Director/Sr. Director of Quality provides strategic and operational leadership for the Quality organization, which includes Quality Assurance and Quality Control. The role partners cross-functionally with all departments to foster a strong culture of quality, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement while ensuring regulatory compliance and client satisfaction. The Director/Sr. Director also directs day-to-day quality operations, drives operational excellence and process optimization, supports execution of strategic and tactical initiatives, and ensures timely resolution of quality and compliance issues to maintain business performance and inspection readiness.

 

**Essential Functions**

*Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

* P rovide strategic leadership and overall accountability for the site Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with global policies, procedures, CGMP/GxP standards, and applicable regulatory requirements across the U.S. and international markets including EU.
* Partner with the Site Leadership Team (SLT) to strengthen and sustain a proactive culture of quality, escalating significant compliance risks and driving timely, effective resolution of quality issues.
* Lead and oversee regulatory inspections and audits, ensuring inspection readiness, effective agency interactions, and timely, compliant responses to observations.
* Direct all core Quality functions, including batch record review, material and product disposition, deviations and change control, document control, QC, QA oversight of all GMP functions including validation, operations, and facility activities.
* Provide leadership to ensure uninterrupted support for successful product transfers through robust quality oversight and operational excellence.
* Serve as the senior Quality leader supporting development initiatives and phased clinical programs, ensuring appropriate compliance throughout product development activities.
* Lead the Quality organization in achieving operational and strategic objectives, including budget planning and management, workforce planning, project execution, and organizational effectiveness.
* Establish and monitor key quality metrics (e.g., deviations, CAPAs, change controls, product release) to foster accountability. Evaluate system effectiveness and drive corrective action.
* Oversee quality indicators and operational efficiencies, implementing action plans to mitigate risks and streamline quality processes.
* Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing Quality organization that operates as a trusted, collaborative business partner, while driving talent development, succession planning, and employee growth.
* Establish clear, consistent, and effective communication across the Quality organization and with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment on priorities, risks, and business objectives.
Perform additional responsibilities and strategic initiatives as assigned 

*The above statements are intended to describe the nature of work performed by those in this job and are not an exhaustive list of all duties. Nothing in this job description restricts managements right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time which reflects management’s assignment of essential functions.*

**Minimum Education, Experience and Skills**

Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or a related area of study

**Experience:**

* At minumum15 years of pharmaceutical industry experience with at least 10 years of Quality experience, both QC and QA in biopharma/biotech in a CGMP pharmaceutical manufacturing environment with early and late-stage products.
* 5+ years of senior leadership experience driving Quality strategy, compliance initiatives, continuous improvement and staff development.
* Extensive experience developing, implementing and improving quality systems directly related to biologics drug substance manufacturing CGMP
* Proven track record of successfully managing and leading regulatory inspections, audits, and remediation activities with global health authorities with demonstrated success in leading a company through cGMP pre-approval and post-approval inspections.
* Proven ability to build and sustain a transparent, collaborative, and quality-focused culture that promotes accountability, engagement, and operational performance.
* Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing organizational change within complex regulated environments.
* Demonstrated ability to develop staff at all levels.
Experience with developing and managing budgets. 

**Skills and Abilities**

* Strong working knowledge of global regulatory requirements and quality standards, including US FDA, EMA, PIC/S, and ICH guidelines.
* Demonstrated success in leading organizations through sound decision-making, strategic problem-solving, and effective communication at all levels of the business.
* Prior experience within a CDMO environment is strongly preferred
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and communicate complex quality and compliance matters clearly and effectively.
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and support teams through crisis management, organizational transformation, cultural change, and business growth initiatives.
* Highly adaptable and resilient, with the ability to perform effectively in fast-paced, high-pressure environments while maintaining focus on priorities and outcomes.
* Strong leadership capability with a demonstrated ability to empower teams, identify high-potential talent, and drive employee development and succession planning.
* Results-oriented leader with strong analytical and problem-solving skills focused on continuous improvement and operational excellence.
* Skilled at building trusted relationships and collaborating effectively with cross-functional peers, senior leadership, clients, and regulatory agencies.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in biological or chemical sciences
* Experience with US FDA, China FDA, Health Canada, EMEA, PMDA, and ANVISA is preferred
* Knowledge of and experience with GLP and/or GCP regulatory inspections a plus
Strong operational excellence experience or qualification 

Base Salary Range 192000-270000

 
 

**Compensation and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ wellbeing, including:

* Competitive salary and performance-based incentives
* Comprehensive health coverage including medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Retirement savings plans with employer matching contributions
* Paid time off
* Professional development opportunities
* Employee wellness programs and resources
* Employee Assistance Program and Mental Health Resources

**Core Values**

*At Bora, our values guide everything we do — from how we solve challenges to how we support our people. We lead with a solutions-first mindset, strive to do the right thing, stay proactive, and above all, respect everyone.*

Bora Pharmaceuticals is committed to providing equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees according to all applicable equal opportunity and affirmative action laws, directives and regulations of federal, state and local governing bodies and agencies. In keeping with this commitment, Bora Pharmaceuticals will recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles, without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex (including factors related to pregnancy or child birth), national origin, age, marital status, familial status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity status with regard to public assistance, employment status, local human rights commission activity, status as a protected veteran, genetic information, atypical hereditary cellular or blood trait, or any other protected category.

records.description:
**Director of Quality**

**Eldridge, IA – Direct Hire**

**Full time – On Site**

Productive Resources (www.productiveresources.com) is seeking a candidate to be part of our engineering team for our customer's facility in Eldridge, IA. As a member of our team, the selected candidate will be a Director of Quality who provides strategic and hands-on leadership for quality operations and is responsible for the planning, organization, direction, coordination, compliance, and control of the Company's Quality Management System. This role leads the Quality team and ensures the effectiveness of quality processes across the organization, including product and process quality, supplier quality, inspection activities, corrective actions, audit readiness, customer quality performance, and compliance with all applicable contractual, regulatory, and government requirements.

The Director of Quality is responsible for developing and leading employees, strengthening accountability, and partnering with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Program Management, and Executive Leadership to prevent defects, drive continuous improvement, and support the safe, compliant, and on-time delivery of mission-critical products. This position oversees departmental personnel and processes, providing coaching, direction, and support to ensure the safe and efficient execution of work while maintaining quality standards, meeting customer requirements, and effectively managing operational costs. Through strong leadership and oversight, the Director of Quality ensures quality objectives are achieved and organizational performance continuously improves.

This is a full-time position that is indefinite in duration with the opportunity of professional growth, and additional opportunities within our organization.

**Duties:**

* Lead, mentor, and develop Quality managers, engineers, inspectors, supplier quality personnel, and other assigned team members.
* Establish and execute a quality strategy aligned with Company goals, customer expectations, contractual requirements, and operational priorities.
* Maintain and continually improve the Quality Management System and ensure processes remain effective, documented, implemented, and audit-ready.
* Lead internal, external, customer, registrar, and government audits; ensure findings are contained, corrected, and closed with effective corrective action.
* Own quality performance metrics and executive reporting, including product conformity, customer complaints, supplier quality, corrective action, scrap, rework, cost of poor quality, first-pass yield, and audit performance.
* Drive disciplined nonconformance control, material review, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and verification of effectiveness.
* Partner with Manufacturing and Engineering to improve process capability, inspection planning, product acceptance methods, error prevention, and manufacturability.
* Oversee inspection and test activities, measurement-system controls, calibration coordination, and the integrity and retention of quality records.
* Lead supplier quality strategy, qualification, surveillance, performance review, development, and supplier corrective action.
* Ensure customer-specific, contractual, regulatory, and government quality requirements are identified, flowed down, implemented, and maintained.
* Support first article inspections, source inspections, customer returns, complaint investigations, configuration and change-control activities, and product or process validation as required.
* Build a quality culture focused on prevention, accountability, objective evidence, timely escalation, and continuous improvement.
* Develop departmental staffing, training, succession, budget, and resource plans necessary to support current operations and future growth.
* Collaborate with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Program Management, Sales, Finance, Human Resources, and executive leadership to resolve systemic issues and meet Company objectives.
* Any other duties assigned by Vice President of Operations.
 

 

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Industrial Technology, Operations, or a related field.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible leadership experience managing quality functions and teams within a manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading a multi-functional quality organization, including Quality Engineering, Inspection, Supplier Quality, Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), Internal Audits, and Regulatory/Customer Compliance activities.
* Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS), including the development, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of quality processes and standards.
* Experience with ISO 9001:2015 requirements, including coordinating and conducting internal audits and maintaining audit readiness.
* Proven ability to lead teams, develop talent, drive accountability, and collaborate cross-functionally to achieve quality and operational objectives.
* Strong working knowledge of NADCAP accreditation, its QMS, and quality requirements related to the special processes within Chemical Processing and Non-destructive Testing.
* Experience leading internal, customer, registrar, and government audits and responding effectively to findings.
* Experience with root cause analysis and corrective action methods such as 8D, 5 Why, fishbone analysis, A3, and DMAIC.
* Working knowledge of statistical process control, process capability, measurement systems, control plans, and risk-based quality planning.
* Experience with supplier qualification, supplier performance management, supplier corrective action, and supplier development.
* Familiarity with government contracting and customer quality requirements, including FAR/DFARS and DCMA oversight, is preferred.
* Ability to translate quality data into clear priorities, executive-level metrics, and sustainable improvements.
* Excellent leadership, communication, coaching, conflict-resolution, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to balance strategic planning with direct engagement on the manufacturing floor and timely resolution of customer or production issues.
* Professional certifications such as ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence, Certified Quality Engineer, or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt are preferred.
* Must have good written and verbal communication skills while being able to motivate and manage reporting personnel, collaboration with peers, and report up to executive leadership as needed.
* Must be able to professionally coach and direct activities of a diverse team while being fair and consistent.
 

 

**Preferred:**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Quality, Operations, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* ISO Auditor Certification, Lean Six Sigma Certification, or other relevant quality management certifications.
* Experience in defense, government contracting, firearms, ammunition, aerospace, weapons systems, or another highly regulated precision manufacturing environment.
* Knowledge of first article inspection, including AS9102.
 

 

**Compensation & Benefits:**

We offer competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and excellent growth opportunities.

If you are the right person, if you have the expertise we need, submit your resume now!

records.title: Director of Quality and Accreditation
records.description:
Overview:

**East Tennessee Behavioral Health** is seeking a dynamic and experienced **Director of Quality and Accreditation** to lead our facility’s efforts in ensuring the highest standards of patient care and safety. This leadership role is responsible for overseeing regulatory compliance, quality assurance programs, and continuous improvement initiatives across all clinical and operational areas. The Director will guide the development and implementation of quality protocols, manage accreditation processes, and lead the Quality Assurance and Process Improvement (QAPI) program. The ideal candidate will be a proactive, strategic thinker with a strong commitment to achieving excellence in care delivery and regulatory readiness.

**East Tennessee Behavioral Healt**h is a 90-bed inpatient treatment center serving Knoxville, Tennessee, and the surrounding communities. We provide the highest-quality care for people who have mental health concerns such as depression, anxiety disorders, and bipolar disorder and those who have co-occurring addictions. The acute inpatient treatment we offer supports adolescents, adults, and senior adults, while our outpatient programming serves adults age 18 and older.

**East TN Behavioral Health Hospital** offers an extensive array of benefits to our valued team members. Current offerings encompass:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance coverage
* Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options
* Company-paid Basic Life & AD&D insurance
* Disability benefits
* 401(k) Retirement Plan with a company match
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and Employee Discount Program
* Paid Holidays for work-life balance
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Tuition Reimbursement opportunities for career advancement

**PURPOSE STATEMENT:**

The Director of Quality and Accreditation is responsible for ensuring patient safety and superior quality of care as measured by survey readiness, treatment program fidelity, and compliance with state and federal laws and regulations and accreditation standards. As such, the Director is responsible for leading and overseeing all aspects of policy development; comprehensive implementation of Acadia’s prescribed clinical protocols, operational quality oversight standards, and programmatic expectations; critical incident reporting; regulatory engagement, including development and submission of plans of correction; certification achievement and maintenance; oversight of the quality assurance and process improvement (QAPI) program; and on-going regulatory readiness strategies at the facility. Through routine physical presence in patient care areas, data analysis and documentation monitoring, and intentional sharing of deep subject-matter expertise, the Director will ensure a proactive, multidisciplinary focus on quality and excellence within the facility.

Responsibilities:

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Lead and monitor day-to-day regulatory readiness, patient safety, and service excellence across the facility.
* QAPI program oversight and management – follow and develop processes for identification, collection, and analysis of quality performance data.
 + Utilize collected data regarding the outcome of activities for delivering continuously improving services.
 + Conduct annual preparation and evaluation of the facility QAPI Program.
 + Complete process improvement projects and incorporate the results into patient care improvements.
 + Submit quality scorecard data to Acadia corporate office as requested.
 + Coordinate the abstraction of clinical data according to Joint Commission specifications and data entry via vendor database for Inpatient Psychiatric Core Measures (ex. national quality measures such as HBIPS).
 + Identify key aspects of care relevant indicators and evaluation of data using formal and informal feedback from consumers of services and other collateral sources is aggregated and used to improve management strategies and service delivery practices.
 + Lead/coordinate data collection and analysis from all departments within the facility.
 + Prepare and present program data trends and action plans to the monthly Quality Council and quarterly to the Medical Executive Committee and the Governing Board.
* Regulatory preparedness – implement sustainable survey preparation and ongoing monitoring processes, including facility-wide auditing and early-issue identification, to maximize achievement of zero- or standard-level survey outcomes.
 + Facility-wide support – collaborate with other departments to sustainably implement best-practices in regulatory/accreditation compliance as evidenced by measurable results with regard to survey outcomes, patient safety metrics, patient experience results, HBIPS, etc.
 + Develop and maintain proficiency in regulatory planning strategy for all standards for all relevant regulatory and accrediting bodies at the local, state, and federal level.
 + Develop and maintain proficiency in the functionality and auditing within electronic platforms such as electronic patient observations and the electronic medical record, as applicable.
 + Lead Root-Cause Analyses and conduct timely and regular evaluation of serious incidents, complaints, grievances and related investigations to:
 - Identification of events, trends and patterns that may affect client health, safety and or treatment efficacy,
 - Committee evaluation findings and recommendations submitted to agency management for corrective action,
 - Implemented actions, outcomes, trends analyzed over time
 + Develop corrective action plans for the resolution of areas of regulatory vulnerability or those which could compromise patient safety in collaboration with other facility leaders.
 + Ensure proper reporting of violations or potential violations to duly authorized enforcement agencies as appropriate and/or required.
 + Ensure proper reporting of incidents and adverse clinical outcomes to duly authorized enforcement agencies or regulatory agencies as appropriate and/or required.
 + In conjunction with assigned corporate Division Quality Director, initiate and lead communications with regulatory agencies as appropriate.
 + Develop sustainable performance improvement practices through analysis of data and prioritization of efforts to improve survey readiness and consistency of care delivery using expected best-practices.
 + Ensure multidisciplinary ownership of best-practices in self-monitoring, auditing, and process improvement, escalating opportunities for improved engagement to the facility CEO as appropriate.
 + Ensures strategic and operational implementation of regulatory requirements, guidelines, and standards of federal, state, and local licensing agencies, accrediting and certifying organizations.
 + Collaborates with Division and Corporate entities and external parties to ensure strategic quality and patient safety initiatives are fully executed at the facility level. Facilitates effective communication with facility and division leadership regarding key clinical performance improvement activities and initiatives.
 + Serves as a technical advisor, educator and internal consultant to all hospital management, staff, and physicians on the use of performance improvement tools and techniques, analytical techniques, and statistical applications.
 + Ensure facility compliance with policies and applicable standards as required by regulatory/accrediting bodies.
 + Facility leader and subject matter expert on high reliability principles and strategies to achieve zero harm.

* Clinical program excellence – assess fidelity and identify root-causes for gaps/lapses in fidelity to Acadia standards. Support other departments in developing and implementing remediation and improvement plans to achieve fidelity to Acadia’s expected practices, including all elements of treatment program implementation.
* + Develop, review, and educate on internal clinical procedures and appropriate use of outcome evaluation tools and the associated results – including patient experience data and other quality scorecard metrics – to ensure continuous quality improvement and ongoing compliance with federal, state, and third-party regulatory requirements.
 + Translate standards, requirements, and policies into terms or processes meaningful to the facility.
* Leadership – serve as a visible, engaged, and dynamic member of the facility leadership team.
 + Chairs the monthly Quality Council
 + Complete safety rounds, participate in leadership rounding, and submit results/corrective actions to Acadia corporate office.
 + Review incident/safety concerns with the leadership team to identify systemic issues and facilitate the development of corrective actions.
 + Lead and facilitate Root Cause Analyses into all serious and/or sentinel events.
 + Invest in the facility staff through engagement in hiring, development, training, performance management, and communication to ensure effective and efficient operations.
 + Oversees the Culture of Safety Survey and follow-up action planning and sustainment processes.

records.title: Director, Quality
records.description:
At Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense Company (EBAD), we believe that our strengths are built on our most important resource - our people. Join EBAD and you'll be a part of a team who creates cutting edge technology that will blast us into the future. No other company can match the innovative energetic solutions that we provide. At EBAD you will actively contribute to successful missions putting men, women and satellites into space, and protecting our armed service men and women around the world. If this is the culture and work environment you are seeking, then EBAD is the place for you!

**Job Description**

**Location:** Simsbury, CT

**Reports to:** VP of Operations

**Industry:** Aerospace & Defense

**Experience Level:** Director (15+ years)

**Shape the Future. Deliver Excellence. Achieve Zero Failure.**

At **Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense (EBAD),** we’ve been innovating for nearly **200 years,** delivering mission-critical technologies that protect lives and advance exploration. As we prepare to double in size over the next 3–5 years, we’re investing in our people and culture to support this transformation.

We’re seeking a dynamic **Director of Quality** to lead a complex, multi-site quality organization and drive performance at scale. Based at our headquarters in Simsbury, Connecticut, this role is critical to ensure the highest levels of product integrity, compliance, and customer trust across a rapidly growing business. This is not just about maintaining standards but about building a future-state vision for quality that enables growth, safeguards mission success, and strengthens EBAD’s reputation as a trusted partner.

**The Opportunity:**

EBAD’s customers depend on us to deliver our products with zero failure in mission-critical environments. The Director of Quality will be responsible for developing and executing a strategic Quality Management System (QMS) while leading quality operations across multiple sites. This leader will be tasked with driving measurable quality improvement, while also championing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

This is an exciting opportunity for a leader to make an immediate impact by providing direction, driving the strategy for the business, and developing a problem-solving culture.

**Core Competencies for Success:**

* **Quality & Compliance Leadership:** Proven success leading complex, multi-site quality organizations in aerospace, defense, or other high-reliability industries, with expertise in zero-failure mission environments.

* **Continuous Improvement & Performance:** Skilled in EBOS, Lean, and Kaizen practices with the ability to drive metrics-based improvement and systemic problem-solving.
* **Team Development & Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and build strong teams while fostering engagement and accountability.
* **Collaboration & Influence:** Strong cross-functional partnership with credibility to influence senior leadership, customers, and suppliers.
* **Resilience & Adaptability:** Able to manage ambiguity, drive change, and motivate teams in a fast-scaling environment.

**The Candidate We Are Looking For:**

* BS in an engineering discipline (MS preferred)
* Minimum 10 years of experience in high-mix, low-volume operations and manufacturing environment
* Proven success leading complex, multi-site quality organizations in aerospace, defense, or other mission-critical industries
* Demonstrated expertise in leading audits and managing compliance across regulatory bodies, customers, and suppliers, with deep knowledge of standards such as AS9100, ISO9001, and DoD requirements
* Proven ability to enhance customer quality by partnering closely with engineering, operations, and supply chain teams to consistently meet customer demand
* Strong record of measurable quality improvements
* Skilled in continuous improvement, performance metrics, and problem-solving through EBOS, Lean, and Kaizen practices
* Track record of building and developing strong teams, fostering high engagement, and driving accountability

**A Defining Leadership Opportunity:**

* **Legacy:** Join a privately held, 188-year-old business that takes a long-term approach, free from the short-term pressures of quarterly-driven reporting.
* **Impact:** Lead a mission-critical function where zero failure is the standard and success is business-defining.
* **Partnership:** Work directly with the BU President, senior leadership, and enterprise HR leaders in a highly influential role at the intersection of people and business strategy.
* **Culture of Excellence:** Help shape a culture that values people, integrity, and mission-driven excellence, driven by a Kaizen mindset and a commitment to quality and continuous improvement.

**Ready to Make a Difference?**

If you’re a proven quality engineering leader with the vision, discipline, and drive to achieve zero failure in a complex and growing business, this is your opportunity.

**Compensation and Rewards:**

We recognize that world-class leaders deliver world-class impact, and we reward accordingly. This role offers a competitive executive package that includes:

**Base Salary:** $175k – $225k plus annual bonus

**Executive Relocation:** Comprehensive support for a seamless transition

**Additional Enhancements:** Potential sign-on incentives and tailored rewards based on experience

*We offer a competitive compensation package aligned with skills & experience, with flexibility to reward top talent and extraordinary qualifications.*

*Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, genetic information, national origin, or veteran status.*

records.title: Director, Digital Quality
records.description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.
 
 
**Job Description**

**EXAMPLE RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Set the global Digital Quality strategy and roadmap**
 + Define the target state, strategic themes, capability model, and multi-year roadmap for Digital Quality.
 + Maintain a portfolio of initiatives aligned with Quality objectives, regulatory priorities, enterprise architecture, and available investment.
 + Establish measurable outcomes, including compliance effectiveness, cycle-time reduction, right-first-time performance, user adoption, data quality, and realized benefits.
* **Lead end-to-end Quality process mapping and optimization**
 + Map current- and future-state processes across sites, regions, and GxP domains, including roles, decisions, controls, systems, data, handoffs, pain points, and performance measures.
 + Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, digitize, automate, or retire processes before selecting technology.
 + Maintain process, capability, system, and data maps to support investment decisions, integration planning, and global standardization.
 + Partner with process owners to define requirements, target operating models, controls, and adoption plans.
* **Assess and recommend new digital tools**
 + Establish a consistent intake and assessment method for digital tools, platforms, automation, analytics, and AI use cases.
 + Evaluate intended use, user need, business value, GxP impact, patient and product risk, data integrity, privacy, cybersecurity, interoperability, accessibility, scalability, supplier maturity, total cost, and support model.
 + Lead market scans, demonstrations, proofs of concept, pilots, supplier due diligence, and fit-gap assessments.
 + Recommend whether to adopt, configure, integrate, scale, defer, or reject proposed solutions based on documented evidence.
 + Prevent technology-led implementations by confirming that each tool addresses a defined process need and has measurable success criteria.
* **Establish Digital Quality governance and assurance**
 + Define decision rights, design principles, architecture guardrails, stage gates, risk criteria, and governance forums for the Digital Quality portfolio.
 + Apply risk-based lifecycle assurance based on intended use and process risk, including requirements, supplier evidence, testing, traceability, release, change control, periodic review, and retirement.
 + Set governance for AI-enabled Quality solutions, including approved use cases, human oversight, data provenance, model performance, explainability, monitoring, drift, retraining, and accountability for decisions.
 + Ensure electronic records, signatures, audit trails, integrations, master data, and reporting controls meet applicable regulatory and company expectations.
* **Drive implementation, adoption, and value realization**
 + Provide Quality leadership through product selection, design, configuration, testing, deployment, stabilization, and continuous improvement.
 + Lead stakeholder engagement, communications, training, readiness assessments, and adoption measurement across global functions and sites.
 + Monitor solution performance, incidents, compliance signals, user feedback, benefits, and emerging risks throughout the lifecycle.
 + Manage portfolio risks, dependencies, budgets, resource needs, suppliers, and executive reporting.
* **Develop organizational capability**
 + Build digital literacy, process-mapping capability, product-management practices, and risk-based assurance skills across Quality.
 + Lead and develop internal staff and cross-functional teams; engage external specialists when needed.
 + Represent Quality in enterprise digital, data, AI, architecture, cybersecurity, and investment forums.
 + Monitor evolving regulations, industry practices, and emerging technologies and translate them into practical Quality standards and roadmaps.

**REQUIREMENTS:**

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. Please see the following for the qualifications and skills we seek for this role.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree with at least 10 years of relevant experience in Digital Quality, Quality systems, digital transformation, computer system assurance or validation, process excellence, product management, or a related discipline.
* Experience in the biopharmaceutical, medical device, or another highly regulated life-sciences environment.
* Demonstrated experience defining strategy and delivering global digital programs across multiple functions, sites, or regions.
* Hands-on experience with process mapping, value-stream analysis, requirements definition, fit-gap assessment, and future-state design.
* Experience assessing and implementing digital platforms, SaaS solutions, workflow automation, analytics, data products, or AI-enabled tools.
* Knowledge of risk-based computer software assurance, computerized system validation, electronic records and signatures, data integrity, supplier assurance, and system lifecycle management.
* Experience establishing governance, prioritizing portfolios, preparing business cases, managing budgets, and measuring benefits.
* Strong analytical, facilitation, change-management, project, product, and vendor-management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and lead multidisciplinary teams without direct authority.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare concise recommendations and decision materials.
* Ability to travel as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Quality, life sciences, engineering, information systems, business, data science, or a related discipline.
* Experience leading an enterprise Digital Quality strategy, capability model, or multi-year transformation roadmap.
* Experience with electronic quality management, document and learning management, laboratory, manufacturing, clinical, regulatory, analytics, integration, or collaboration platforms.
* Experience conducting market scans, supplier due diligence, proofs of concept, pilots, and formal digital-tool evaluations.
* Experience applying product-management, enterprise-architecture, data-governance, or organizational change-management practices.
* Experience establishing governance for artificial intelligence or machine-learning solutions in a regulated environment.
* Knowledge of cloud services, cybersecurity, privacy, integration patterns, master data, metadata, and third-party risk.
* Experience rationalizing application portfolios and supporting global process and technology standardization.

**Required Knowledge and Skills**

* Expert understanding of global GxP Quality processes and the drug-development and product lifecycle, with the ability to connect process, data, technology, and control requirements.
* Strong knowledge of digital Quality platforms and how they support regulated business processes.
* Working knowledge of AI and machine-learning risks and controls, including intended-use definition, human oversight, data provenance, performance criteria, monitoring, drift, change, and retraining governance.
* Ability to distinguish business criticality, GxP impact, and process risk and translate the assessment into proportionate assurance activities.
* Ability to convert ambiguous business needs into clear problem statements, process maps, user requirements, evaluation criteria, roadmaps, and investment recommendations.
* Strong facilitation, critical-thinking, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Ability to communicate direction, trade-offs, risks, status, and value to executives, steering committees, process owners, technical teams, and end users.

Commitment to global standardization while accommodating justified regional or functional requirements.
