records.description:
**About Us:**

BW Design Group is a fully integrated architecture, engineering, construction, system integration, and consulting firm committed to helping our clients realize their most critical goals from Strategy to Commercialization. As the only firm born from a manufacturing technology company to become an independent and fully integrated firm, we combine deep domain expertise in the manufacturing environment with an approach that is built to serve the dynamic needs of our clients. Rooted in our distinct culture of Truly Human Leadership, we cultivate the leaders who will define tomorrow and partner with our clients in the food & beverage, life sciences, industrial, and advanced technology industries to build the future of manufacturing and technology. 
 
Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world. 
 

**Job Description:**

**Who You’ll Work With**

At BW Design Group, you'll collaborate with experienced leaders, technical specialists, and subject matter experts to solve complex challenges for some of the world's leading companies. You'll join a growing team of more than 2000 professionals across nearly 50 U.S. offices where you'll be empowered to make an impact, develop your expertise, and grow your career.

As Director, Quality for our Boston office, you will join our Regulatory Compliance Practice, leading the local quality team while serving as a trusted quality subject matter expert, industry thought leader, and client lead for life science clients across New England.

**What You’ll Do**

This role balances hands-on, billable project/service delivery with growing our Boston team, client relationships, and reputation in the industry.

* Lead a team of quality professionals and interface with clients
* Train, mentor, and recruit talent, championing the career growth of early-career professionals through Individual Development Plans and on-the-job coaching.
* Serve as the firm’s local quality SME across QMS maturity, supplier quality, CAPA and deviations, audit and inspection readiness, remediation, and product development, and advise clients on evolving regulatory guidance.
* Lead delivery of multiple concurrent projects, owning scope, budget, schedule, quality, risk, and client satisfaction.
* Drive thought leadership through publications, white papers, and industry conference presentations, and contribute to firmwide quality standards and best practices.
* Maintain a personal billable utilization target of approximately 60–70% while managing team staffing and utilization to meet billable hours goals.
Develop scopes, estimates, and proposals, and expand engagements with new and existing clients through your industry network. 

**What You’ll Bring**

* A minimum of fifteen years of increasing responsibility in quality services and project management for life sciences, biotech, medical device, or other FDA regulated projects.
* A minimum of five years of people leadership experience, including hiring, coaching, and developing quality professionals.
* Proven success in a consulting or professional services environment, including meeting billable utilization goals and leading client relationships
* Experience leading quality teams across capital project handover, QMS establishment, quality audits, root cause and deviation resolution, and remediation planning.
* Working knowledge of quality regulations for medical device, pharmaceuticals, biologics, C&GT, and aseptic/sterile manufacturing (21 CFR Parts 11, 210/211, and 820; ISO 13485; EU GMP), along with cGMP, good documentation practices, and risk management tools (ICH Q9, FMEA, PFMEA/DFMEA).
* Recognized industry expertise and thought leadership through publications, presentations, or professional associations such as ISPE, PDA, or ASQ; a Boston/New England life science network is preferred.
* Strong communication and technical writing skills, with experience developing proposals and estimates is preferred.
* A willingness to travel regionally to client sites throughout the Boston/New England area, as well as for company sponsored meetings, training, and industry events.
A Bachelor of Science in engineering or a related technical degree; an advanced degree or ASQ certification is preferred. 

 

Our culture and commitment to our people is what sets us apart. We foster an environment of mutual respect, integrity, and unconditional interest in the individual and collective success of our professionals. Our model and entrepreneurial mindset offer a rewarding, challenging, and highly flexible path.

 

As Director of Quality, you will build a meaningful and fulfilling career with the support of professional development resources and mentorships including our First Year Experience program, Individual Development Plans, and Career Path resources and tools. You will be surrounded by exceptional talent who will support your development as both a world-class professional and a highly effective leader.

 

*At Barry-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work—therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodations during the interview process.*

Barry-Wehmiller is an equal opportunity employer. M/F/D/V This organization uses E-Verify. 
 
Applicants may be subject to pre-employment screening which may include drug screening, reference checks, employment verifications, background screening and/or skills assessments. 
 

**Company:**

Design Group

records.description:
Req ID: 11287

**Working Location: Massachusetts, Westborough**

**Workplace Flexibility: Hybrid**

 

***For more than 100 years, Olympus has focused on making people’s lives healthier, safer and more fulfilling.***

Every day, we live by our philosophy, True to Life, by advancing medical technologies and elevating the standard of patient care so people everywhere can fulfill their desires, dreams, and lives.

Our five Core Values empower us to achieve Our Purpose:

**Patient Focus, Integrity, Innovation, Impact and Empathy.**

 

Learn more about Life at Olympus: https://www.olympusamerica.com/careers.

**Job Description**
-------------------

This position provides quality operations leadership to the global distribution operation. The Director of Quality role will provide Quality leadership for the Global Ship Hold process. This scope will include ownership, monitoring and communication of the Global Ship Hold process. In addition, this role will be responsible for managing global strategy and implementation for the quality requirements for inventory handling, segregation and reporting. This position partners closely with the Global Supply Chain Management.

**Job Duties**
--------------

* Serves as the global process owner (GPO) for the Global Ship Hold Process.
* Monitors and manages the initiation, progress and release of global ship holds.
* Develops and executes global communication on the status and action plan of existing global ship holds.
* Partners with the Field Corrective Action (FCA) team on inventory handling and reconciliation of open projects.
* Develops strategic priorities for the global control, disposition and resolution of quality processes for material control.
* Works with regional management and staff to ensure the successful execution of established policies and procedures for inventory management.
* Serves as a global leader to focus a matrixed network of Ship Hold Coordinators.
* Continued monitoring of staff performance to ensure quality and consistency.
* Performs all other duties as directed.

**Job Requirements**
--------------------

**Required:**

* BA/BS degree or equivalent in a Life Science, Engineering, or Supply Chain management. Advanced technical degree and/or MBA preferred.
* A minimum of 10 years of cGMP experience in quality management or operations within the MedTech industry.
* Experience with durable medical devices, and a strong understanding of supply chain processes and inventory controls (reverse logistics is a plus).
* Demonstrated experience influencing senior level management, key stakeholders and leveraging crossfunctional partnerships for successful execution of critical quality initiatives.
* Experience interpreting and applying business requirements and regulations (FDA and other applicable global authorities) into sustainable quality processes leveraging industry best practices.
* Experience with global inventory processes and systems (ERP) – including hold mechanisms.
* Experience with warehouse management processes and systems (WMS) including product segregation and control on non-conforming material.
* Proactive approach to quality and compliance, with a focus on innovation and adaptation in a fast -paced environment. Strong ability to think and act globally, be fearless change agent while managing risks, develop future visions and engage audiences to drive transformation.
* Capable of presenting clear and insightful thoughts based in facts and data gain trust, build confidence and to influence key stakeholders across the business.
* Persistence to continuously improve, never settling for status quo, while keeping customer satisfaction and customer value central.
* Must be a self -starter with high personal accountability and courage to always do the right thing.
* Driving cultural change in a complex and diverse Olympus organization.
* Will work with global teams, availability will include working across global time zones. Travel up to 25% possible.

**Why join Olympus?**

We offer a holistic employee experience supporting personal and professional well-being through meaningful work, equitable offerings, and a connected culture.

 

**Equitable Offerings you can count on:**

* Competitive salaries, annual bonus and 401(k)\* with company match
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision coverage effective on start date
* 24/7 Employee Assistance Program
* Free live and on-demand Wellbeing Programs
* Generous Paid Vacation and Sick Time
* Paid Parental Leave and Adoption Assistance\*
* 12 Paid Holidays
* On-Site Child Daycare, Café, Fitness Center\*\*

**Connected Culture you can embrace:**

* Work-life integrated culture that supports an employee centric mindset
* Offers onsite, hybrid and field work environments
* Paid volunteering and charitable donation/match programs
* Employee Resource Groups
* Dedicated Training Resources and Learning & Development Programs
* Paid Educational Assistance

* US Only

\*\*Center Valley, PA and Westborough, MA

 

**Are you ready to be a part of our team?**

Learn more about our benefits and incentives: https://www.olympusamerica.com/careers/benefits-perks.

 

The anticipated base pay range for this full-time position in this location is $154,866.00 - $216,812.00 / year, plus potential for annual bonus (subject to plan eligibility and other requirements).

 

Olympus considers a variety of factors when determining actual compensation for this position, including level of experience, working location, and relevant education and certifications.

 

At Olympus, we are committed to Our Purpose of making people’s lives healthier, safer and more fulfilling. As a global medical technology company, we partner with healthcare professionals to provide best-in-class solutions and services for early detection, diagnosis and minimally invasive treatment, aiming to improve patient outcomes by elevating the standard of care in targeted disease states.

 

For more than 100 years, Olympus has pursued a goal of contributing to society by producing products designed with the purpose of delivering optimal outcomes for its customers around the world.

 

Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Olympus employs more than 31,000 employees worldwide in nearly 40 countries and regions. Olympus Corporation of the Americas, a wholly owned subsidiary of Olympus Corporation, is headquartered in Center Valley, Pennsylvania, USA, and employs more than 5,200 employees throughout locations in North and South America. For more information, visit www.olympusamerica.com.

 

**You Belong at Olympus**

We are deeply committed to fostering a respectful, fair, and welcoming workplace for all individuals, perspectives, and lifestyles. We believe in fostering a non-discriminatory, inclusive work environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging, in full compliance with legal standards. Empathy and unity are core to our company culture, empowering employees to contribute fully and flourish. We warmly encourage all who wish to bring their talents to Olympus to apply.

 

***Applicants Requesting Accommodations:*** Olympus is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Olympus will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact OCAAccommodations@olympus.com. If your disability impairs your ability to email, you may call our HR Compliance Manager at 1-888-Olympus (1-888-659-6787).

 

**Let’s realize your potential, together.**

It is the policy of Olympus to extend equal employment and advancement opportunity to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship status, religious creed (including dress and grooming practices), age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth and/or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, marital status, disability (physical or mental) and/or a medical condition, genetic information, ancestry, veteran status or service in the uniformed services, and any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

records.title: Director of Quality Improvement Strategy
records.description:
**About CCNC:**

From the mountains to the coast, from large cities to small towns, Community Care of North Carolina is transforming health care. Informed by statewide data and predictive analytics, community-based care-managers work with local physicians and diverse teams of health professionals to develop whole-person plans of care that connect people to the right local resources and increase equity and access to high quality care.

**CCNC Mission Statement**

To improve the health and quality of life for all North Carolinians by building supporting better community-based healthcare delivery systems.

**Position Summary**
====================

The Director of Quality Improvement (QI) Strategy is responsible for setting the vision for the organization’s Quality Improvement strategy, in collaboration with the Population Health Division and aligned with CCNC’s mission and strategic goals. The aim of the QI strategy is to ensure the CCPN member practices deliver high - quality health care that drives successful performance of the Clinically Integrated Network (CIN).

The Director of Quality Improvement (QI) Strategy in coordination with the Clinical Performance and Practice Engagement teams, will direct, plan, implement, monitor, coordinate, and evaluate all aspects of the QI strategy and oversee daily operations to ensure that CCNC’s strategic plan is implemented. implements and informs process improvement to create standardized and streamlined processes, workflows, and education. The Director of QI Strategy provides direct supervision of the QI Specialist and the Value Based Care Program Specialist.

Responsibilities include outreach, education, training, hands-on participative leadership, and development of an increased capacity to successfully execute performance improvement across the organization. Working directly with others across the organization, The Director of Quality Improvement (QI) Strategy ensures that the elements of the QI strategy allow for coordination and collaboration of multifaceted initiatives with practices that serve our covered populations with consideration of resources, cost savings and quality. This includes providing strategic input on the development of organizational goals, to include measurement criteria and interventions for achieving the goals.

**Essential Functions**
=======================

**Operationalize QI Strategy**
------------------------------

* Direct the implementation of Quality Improvement efforts to support CCPN practices and CCNC programming in accordance with the strategic plan.
* Establish and implement the process for how PRRs utilize the QI plans to drive performance with CCPN practices.
* Facilitate the development of programs, systems, workflows, and integration efforts in alignment with CCNC and CCPN’s contractual, regulatory and quality requirements.
* Apply QI methodology, change management strategies, team facilitation, and coaching principles to achieve program effectiveness and efficiencies.
* Mentor and train on QI methodology, change management, and coaching principles (e.g. Model for Improvement, PDSA, Lean,).
* Demonstrate subject matter expertise and knowledge of payment models and their associated quality measures.
* Serve as the subject matter expert and lead for key projects and initiatives; including developing detailed work plans, assigning responsibilities, monitoring project progress and ensuring spread and sustainability.
* Assist CCPN and CCNC with future program development, creation or delegation of accountability and ownership for program roles and continuous process improvement.
* Develop annual Quality Plans with the Value Based Care Program practices in coordination with key focus areas identified by Clinical Performance.
* Represent and demonstrate our QI strategy in monthly Joint Operating Council meetings with the Value Based Care Program practices.
* Support the Practice Based Care Coordination (PBCC) program through data mining, identification of opportunities for improvement, regular practice monitoring, and ongoing training & support for the QIPS team.
* Engage and maintain collaborative relationships with the health care community, including but not limited to primary care providers, practice managers & practice team members, health departments, FQHCs and other community partners.
* Serve as Liaison on local, regional and state workgroups and collaborative efforts.
* Partner with the QI leaders for payers to establish collaborative and effective working relationships.
* Actively participate in payer meetings to represent and demonstrate our QI strategy

***Data Management, Analytics and Presentation***

* Lead QI efforts to positively impact performance and quality measures.
* Collaborate with the Clinical Performance team to use data to evaluate the effectiveness of projects across departments
* Advise leadership on project-specific data and information needs in support of staff.
* Identify areas of opportunity for CCPN practices through clinical data analysis, interpretation, & presentation.
* Lead the QI PS team to provide excellent training and support to member practices that facilitate effective use of the organization’s value-based care data platform
* In coordination with the Clinical Performance team, train on data definitions, data interpretation and data analysis
* Support all programs in achieving program goals through data analytics and quality improvement support.
* Adhere to CCNC privacy and security policies to ensure that patient and company data are properly safeguarded.

***Staff Management and Supervision***

* Provide effective leadership with respect to recruitment, selection, training, evaluation, compensation, staff development, and advocacy for the QI Strategy Team.
* Provide oversight and guidance to staff through a team approach that allows for coordinated handoffs, communication, and workflow across provider-facing staff
* Develop strategies for allocating QI resources to meet program goals and to control costs through effective use of personnel.
* Identify staff training needs and provide appropriate training opportunities.
* Complete performance evaluations.
* Utilize conflict resolution and problem-solving skills to manage issues in a timely manner.

**Qualifications**

* Registered Nurse (BSN required; MSN preferred); Social Worker (BSW required; MSW and LCSW preferred); or master's in public health or health care administration. If RN: Active, unrestricted RN license to practice in North Carolina.
* At least 5 years of Quality Improvement or relevant health care experience with responsibilities in the following areas: operational leadership, process improvement, project management, systems analysis, data analytics, and team facilitation.
* At least 3 years of supervisory or leadership experience in health care.
* NAHQ Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ)
* Lean / Six Sigma certification a plus.
* Maintain a valid NC driver’s license with current auto liability insurance.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

Excellent communication skills

* - oral, written and public speaking
* Knowledge of government, private sector and community resources
* Knowledge of and compliance with federal and state regulations applicable to the position
* Critical thinking skills, effective clinical judgment, independent decision making, and problem- solving abilities
* Skilled in establishing rapport with providers, community partners, and members
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Demonstrated leadership skills
* Ability to work independently and function as an integral part of the team
* Expertise with Microsoft Office suite of products and comfort with database software and the internet
* Strong competence in quality improvement methodologies, principles, and recognition programs
* Ability to take “deep dives” into multiple sources of data to drive improvement
* Ability to stimulate innovative thinking & serve as a change agent
* Able to shift strategy or approach in response to the demands of a situation

**Working Conditions**

* Multiple contacts are required with providers, members, health systems and community partners to ensure effectiveness of QI and PS work; exposure to general office conditions, as well as communicable disease could occur.
* Potential for minor physical inconveniences or discomforts in the work setting, including sitting for moderate periods of time.
* Repetitive wrist motion and occasional lifting/carrying of up to 25 pounds.
* Travel required within the region and/or the state.

**Why Join Us:**
----------------

* Make a meaningful impact on youth and families across North Carolina
* Work with a supportive and collaborative care team
* Competitive Benefits Package effective first day of employment
* Opportunities for growth, training, and bonus incentives\*

**Ready to improve the health and quality of life of all North Carolinians by building and supporting better community-based health care delivery systems?**

* **Apply today and join us in delivering compassionate care that makes a difference.**

**Ready to improve the health and quality of life of all North Carolinians by building and supporting better community-based health care delivery systems?**

**Apply today** and join us in delivering compassionate care that makes a difference.

#CCNC #HealthCare #NCHealth

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

records.title: Director of Quality
records.description:
Responsible to manage, promote, and continuously maintain a compliant quality management system by effectively managing the quality department that consist of validation, quality inspection, document control, change control, customer complaints, metrology, CAPA management, nonconforming product, calibration, receiving inspection and product release activities. As a quality manager you will ensure that the manufacturing site meets and applies the Global Quality Policies and Guidelines relating to, ISO 9001 & 13485 standards, FDA 21 CFR 820 regulations, customer requirements and comply with necessary local and international regulations.

**Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities****:**

* Responsible for , leading developing, implementing and manage an effective quality management systems that supports the company-wide quality policy, ISO 9000, ISO 13485 and FDA 21 CFR 820 regulations for medical devices with a continuous improvement programs.
* Lead, develop, implement and maintain quality systems for controlling product quality using process capability, inspection, auditing and statistical analysis.
* Lead, develop, implement and maintain an effective quality system for preventing nonconforming product and/or its recurrence using quality planning, material review, corrective action and quality reporting.
* Responsible for selection, interviewing and onboarding of new hires and develop a relevant training program and plan for all site personnel.
* Responsible for leading, driving and enforcing quality programs in collaboration with manufacturing team.
* Resolve customer concerns, complaints and provide feedback on quality issues.
* Analyze daily and monthly quality reports and develop tests to improve product quality.
* Manage day to day department activities.
* Support company quality policy and objectives.
* Ensure products produced meets customer expectations (approve quality specifications) and regulatory requirements
* Lead customer audits, ISO audits and Internal audits
* Achieve financial objectives (maintain department salaries within budget, prepare the Quality budget, schedule the expenditures)
* Follow and report of the site quality performances from a quality standpoint and ensure alignment with Business Unit and manage continuous improvement for product quality
* In cooperation with the Sites Quality Coordinator, develop and implement Quality Objectives in line with objectives of the business unit
* Lead and influence a quality mindset to quality and operations to maintain, improving and maintaining quality system requirements.
* Continually improve quality through analyzing, identifying, and eliminating root causes. Such improvements include reducing defects, decreasing scrap, reducing waste, and improving outputs.
* Apply and evaluate testing and inspection methods; including the identification of requirements for improvements.
* Develop and implement quality cost reduction concepts and techniques.
* Manage department resources, including work assignments, training, cross training, personnel issues, hiring decisions, performance appraisals, motivation, efficiency, capacity and accuracy of work.
* Ensure shift-to-shift communication.
* Provide a safe work environment and resolve any safety issues that arise.
* Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

**Core Competencies:**

* Facilitation
* Conflict Management
* Fostering Learning
* Information Gathering & Processing
* Interactive Communication
* Partnering
* Relationship Building
* Research
* Teamwork
* Writing Skills
* Attention to detail
* Adaptability
* Concern for Safety
* Proactive and self-motivated
* Strong time management with priority setting skills
* Client focused

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Expert knowledge and interpretation of ISO 13485, ISO 9000 standards, 21 CFR 820 and cGMP compliance.
* Ability to lead, implement quality management systems as applicable to ISO and 21 CFR regulations.
* Demonstrate understanding of industry standard validation tools and techniques.
* Demonstrated ability of metrology and basic inspection tools, metrology and injection molding workmanship standards.
* Ability to develop/conduct quality related training programs.
* Effectively communicate in both verbal and written.
* Good organizational skills.
* Excellent English communication skills (both written and verbal).
* Fluency in Spanish a plus.
* Understanding and use of metrology equipment.
* Ability to read drawings and good understanding of geometric tolerancing.
* Knowledge of processing engineering polymers is a plus.
* Exceptional leadership skills which include ability to prioritize, lead, direct, train, and motivate staff.
* Ability to influence peers.
* Excellent planning and organizational skills.
* Good analytical, problem-solving and math skills. Six Sigma and Lean knowledge a plus.
* Understanding and use of sampling plans, Gauge R&R, statistical techniques and SPC.
* Ability to use personal computer and Windows-based software (Outlook, Word and Excel preferred). Use of PC-DMIS metrology software, IQMS manufacturing software and Minitab a plus.

**Education and/or Experience**:

* Bachelor’s degree desirable, four-year college degree (preferably in a sciences chemical, pharmacy, plastics or engineering field) or equivalent combined college/work experience.
* At least 5 years of leading and implementing quality systems in a pharmaceutical or medical device environment
* Manufacturing experience in injection molding plastics industry (or equivalent industry) is a plus.

records.title: Director, Quality Engineering
records.description:
HHAeXchange is the leading technology platform for home and community-based care. Founded in 2008, HHAeXchange was born out of an idea to create a fully comprehensive end-to-end homecare solution to help people who are aging or have disabilities thrive in their homes and communities. Our employees are passionate about transforming the healthcare space by building the only homecare ecosystem that fully connects patients, personal care providers, managed care organizations, and states.

The Director, Quality Engineering will lead the enterprise-wide quality strategy and Quality Assurance (QA) program across HHAeXchange. This role is responsible for standardizing testing processes and tools, driving test automation, and ensuring our products meet high standards for reliability, performance, security, and accessibility. The Director, Quality Engineering will oversee functional and non-functional testing practices, including accessibility (WCAG) and security-related validation, and will own processes that support customer User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates located in the EST or CST time zones within the US only.**

### **Essential Job Duties**

* **Enterprise Quality Leadership:** Develop, implement, and lead the overall quality strategy and QA operating model across the organization.
* **Standardize Testing Processes:** Define and enforce consistent testing approaches including test planning, test cases, regression strategy, and release readiness criteria.
* **Tooling Ownership:** Select, implement, and manage enterprise testing tools for test management, automation, performance, accessibility, and security validation.
* **Automation Strategy:** Drive increased automated test coverage across UI, API, mobile, and services, reducing reliance on manual regression testing.
* **Compliance, Accessibility & VPAT Reporting:**
 + Lead accessibility testing programs aligned to WCAG 2.1+
 + Oversee creation and maintenance of Voluntary Product Accessibility Templates (VPATs) and Accessibility Conformance Reports
 + Partner with Product, Legal, and Compliance to respond to customer accessibility requirements and audits
* **Security & Compliance Testing Support:** Coordinate with Security teams on SAST/DAST, vulnerability validation, and remediation tracking.
* **Customer UAT Support:**
 + Define and support customer UAT strategies and environments
 + Provide test plans, data guidance, and defect triage support during customer acceptance testing cycles
 + Ensure feedback from UAT informs release decisions and product quality improvements
* **Quality Metrics & Reporting:** Establish KPIs to measure product quality, defect escape rate, automation coverage, UAT outcomes, and release readiness; communicate results to leadership.
* **Shift-Left Quality Practices:** Embed quality earlier in the development lifecycle through collaboration on requirements, acceptance criteria, and CI/CD integration.
* **Incident & Defect Management:** Oversee defect triage for high-priority production and pre-production issues and ensure timely resolution and root-cause prevention.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, DevOps, Security, and Compliance to ensure alignment of quality practices across releases.
* **Organizational Leadership**: Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of QA engineers, SDETs, automation engineers, and accessibility/compliance testers.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify quality gaps and drive process improvements that improve product reliability, reduce rework, and increase delivery confidence.
* **Release Governance:** Participate in release readiness reviews and serve as a key stakeholder in go/no-go decisions.
* **Coding agent advocacy:** **Help onboard team members to AI development tools. Share techniques, prompt patterns, and review practices that make AI-augmented development effective and safe in a regulated environment.**

### **Other Job Duties**

* Other duties as assigned by supervisor or HHAeXchange leader.

### **Travel Requirements**

* Travel up to 10%, including overnight travel

### **Required Education, Experience, Certifications and Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field required.
* 10+ years of experience in software engineering within a software product company, with a focus on developing scalable, high-performance systems.
* 4+ years leading QA organizations or enterprise quality programs.
* Proven experience designing and implementing standardized QA processes and test automation strategies in SaaS environments.
* Hands-on experience implementing automated testing frameworks integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with accessibility testing and standards such as WCAG 2.1+ and authoring VPATs/ACRs.
* Experience supporting security testing practices such as vulnerability scanning, SAST/DAST, and penetration test remediation validation.
* Experience supporting or running customer UAT processes.
* Strong understanding of quality metrics (defect rates, coverage, MTTR, escape rate, etc.) and how to operationalize them.
* Background working in cloud-based architectures and microservices environments.
* Demonstrated success collaborating across engineering, product, and security teams in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong leadership skills with experience managing and developing QA and automation teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex topics to technical and non-technical partners.
* **AI/ML fundamentals:** Familiarity with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and how generative AI can be applied in a product context. Direct project experience preferred.

The base salary range for this US-based, full-time, and exempt position is $175,000-195,000/yr, not including variable compensation. An employee’s exact starting salary will be based on various factors including but not limited to experience, education, training, merit, location, and the ability to exemplify the HHAeXchange core values.

This is a benefits-eligible position. HHAeXchange offers competitive health plans, paid time-off, company paid holidays, 401K retirement program with a Company elected match, including other company sponsored programs.

HHAeXchange is an equal-opportunity employer. The Company offers employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, citizenship, genetic information, hairstyles, or any other status protected by local or federal law.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

records.title: DIRECTOR OF QUALITY & COMPLIANCE
records.description:
**Director of Quality & Compliance**
====================================

**Southern Peaks, Canon City CO**

[Full-Time)

$95,000 To $120,000 Annually

DailyPay Available

**Looking for More Than Just a Job?**
-------------------------------------

At Abraxaswe believe every person deserves the opportunity to live a meaningful, fulfilling, and independent life.

We’re seeking compassionate, dedicated professionals who are looking for more than a paycheck. We’re looking for individuals who want to make a difference, build rewarding careers, and become part of a team committed to helping others succeed.

Whether you’re beginning your career, changing professions, or bringing years of experience, we provide the training, support, and opportunities needed to help you thrive.

**About Abraxas**
-----------------

For more than 50 years, Abraxas has been dedicated to improving lives through high-quality services and support.

Our employees play a vital role in helping individuals achieve greater independence, confidence, and success while promoting dignity, respect, inclusion, and personal choice.

Every day, our team members make a meaningful impact by supporting people in reaching their goals and living their best lives.

**Why Join Our Team?**
======================

**Competitive Pay & Benefits**
------------------------------

* Competitive Compensation
* DailyPay – Access Your Earned Wages Before Payday
* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance- AFTER 30 DAYS
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Paid Time Off
* Employee Assistance Program
* Wellness Programs
* Employee Referral Bonuses
* Company-Paid Training

**Career Growth & Development**
-------------------------------

* Paid Training Programs
* Professional Development Opportunities
* Certification Opportunities
* Leadership Development Programs
* Career Advancement Opportunities
* Opportunities Across Multiple Service Lines

**Meaningful Work That Matters**
--------------------------------

* Make a Difference Every Day
* Support Individuals and Families
* Build Meaningful Relationships
* Strengthen Communities
* Join a Mission-Driven Organization

**What You’ll Do**
==================

As the Director of Quality & Compliance, you will:

Oversees compliance with applicable Colorado Department of Human Services (CDHS) Volume 7 residential licensing rules, including 12 CCR 2509-8, Section 7.714, as well as payer contracts and Joint Commission standards.

* Reviews and approves corrective action plans for regulatory, payer, and accreditation findings before routing them for final approval. Verifies implementation and sustained compliance.
* Works with Quality and Compliance Specialist and Program Directors to prepare for licensing inspections, Medicaid and managed care reviews, and accreditation surveys.
* Serves as a compliance liaison with CDHS and applicable Regional Accountable Entities (RAEs) and other payers. Reviews provider manuals and contract changes and translates requirements into program procedures.
* Conducts program and follow-up audits, including reviews of admissions, assessments, treatment plans, service documentation, discharge planning, and continuity of care.
* Provides technical assistance to Quality and Compliance Specialists and trains program staff on licensing, payer, and accreditation requirements.
* Develops monitoring tools with Quality and Compliance Specialists to verify compliance and consistent implementation of program policies.
* Analyzes audit findings, incidents, grievances, clinical outcomes, and authorization or denial trends. Reports findings and tracks improvement actions with program leaders.
* Partners with Clinical, Admissions, and Billing to oversee utilization management, including prior authorization, concurrent and continued-stay review, medical necessity and level-of-care documentation, and responses to denials and appeals.
* Develops and reviews policies and procedures, supports the annual review process, and verifies that programs maintain current policy and procedure manuals.
* Participates on various internal and external committees as needed.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Who We’re Looking For**
=========================

You may be a great fit if you are:

✔ Compassionate

✔ Dependable

✔ Patient

✔ Team-Oriented

✔ Service-Focused

✔ Professional

✔ Positive

✔ Committed to Helping Others

**Qualifications**
==================

Master's degree in social sciences, healthcare or related field and five years of quality and compliance experience or bachelor’s degree in social sciences, healthcare or related field and seven years quality and compliance experience

* Ability to effectively supervise employees.
* Extensive hands-on experience with Colorado Volume 7 residential licensing requirements, Health First Colorado behavioral health managed care, and applicable accreditation standards is critical.
* Ability to interpret and teach the application of regulations, payer requirements, accreditation standards, and contractual language.
* Experience with behavioral health utilization management, including authorization, medical necessity and continued-stay documentation, and payer audits. Experience in youth residential mental health or psychiatric residential treatment facilities (PRTFs) is preferred.
* Experience with Prison Rape Elimination Act (PREA) compliance, including staff training, audit preparation, and corrective action follow-up, is preferred.
* Knowledge of adolescent residential mental health treatment, including trauma-informed care, co-occurring conditions, and the needs of youth involved in child welfare or juvenile justice.
* Proven ability to develop and revise policies that meet licensing, payer, contractual, and accreditation requirements.
* Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in written form, with a diverse group of people including regulatory agency representatives, employees, clients, governing body members, and the general public.
* Must be available for travel, to include overnight stays.
* Must have a valid driver’s license.
* Ability to work with computers and the necessary software typically used by the department.

**Physical Requirements (If Applicable)**
=========================================

* Ability to lift up to 25 pounds
* Ability to stand, walk, bend, and assist individuals as needed
* Ability to perform essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation

**Apply Today**
===============

Some jobs pay the bills. Some jobs build careers. This job changes lives.

If you’re looking for meaningful work where your compassion, dedication, and hard work make a real difference every day, we encourage you to apply today.

**Join our team and become the reason someone has a better day.**

### **About Our Organization**

**Abraxas** is part of the Inperium family of companies.

Employment for this position is administered through Apis Services, Inc.

### **Equal Opportunity Employer**

Apis Services, Inc., Inperium Inc., and affiliates provide equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants for employment in compliance with all federal and applicable state and local laws and regulations, including nondiscrimination in hiring and employment.

All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic information, marital status, pregnancy, childbirth, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

This policy of nondiscrimination and equal employment opportunity extends to every phase and aspect of hiring and employment

records.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

The Director, Supplier Quality – Operations & Compliance reports to the AVP, Supplier Quality and is responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimizing the Supplier Quality Assurance program across Agilent businesses and sites. This role is focused on improving product quality, process quality, supplier performance, and delivery throughout the supply base.

The Director will have direct responsibility for supplier quality processes, standard operating procedures (SOPs), tools, dashboards, key performance indicators (KPIs), and the Approved Supplier List (ASL).

A key priority for this role is developing and implementing a Supplier Quality Operations strategy that centralizes and standardizes processes while ensuring consistent compliance of all processes used in the Supplier Quality organization, including Agilent sites, SQ business leads, SQ category leads, and suppliers.

The successful candidate will be a proactive, self-directed leader who can build strong partnerships across Agilent and the external supply base while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**
---------------------------------------

* Own, improve, and standardize supplier quality processes, including supplier Audits, Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCARs), Supplier Change Management, Supplier Review Boards (SRBs), and Approved Supplier List (ASL) processes.
* Partner closely with Procurement, business and site leadership, Category teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders to ensure effective and consistent execution of supplier quality processes.
* Develop, improve, and continuously monitor a standardized KPI and metrics program, including executive-level dashboards that provide meaningful, actionable visibility into supplier performance and overall supply chain health.
* Present and support Supplier Quality metrics and performance discussions during Quality Management Review (QMR) and Supplier Review Board (SRB) meetings.
* Manage the quality aspects of the Approved Supplier List in partnership with Procurement.
* Identify opportunities for continuous improvement across the Supplier Quality function, establish project ownership, monitor progress, and ensure measurable results at project completion.
* Develop and manage the Supplier Quality outsourcing strategy, including evaluating outsourcing opportunities for audits, root cause analysis (RCA), and other Supplier Quality activities.
* Strengthen the culture of quality and compliance by identifying and implementing continuous improvement opportunities across Supplier Quality processes.
* Partner with Procurement to establish a consistent **"One-Voice Agilent"** approach when communicating with the supply base.
* Evaluate and implement a supplier portal in collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders.
* Engage key supplier management teams through structured business reviews to monitor performance metrics, identify trends, address risks, and implement programs that deliver measurable performance improvements.
* Lead, manage, coach, and develop a high-performing and diverse team of Supplier Quality professionals.
* Own and manage the budget for the Supplier Quality Operations function.
* Strengthen supplier and organizational quality culture through coaching, technical engagement, and collaborative problem-solving.

**Qualifications**
------------------

 

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or a related discipline preferred.

**Experience**
--------------

 

* 5+ years of direct or related experience in Supplier Quality.
* 3+ years of experience leading and managing teams.
* Experience owning or managing a Quality Management System (QMS), particularly Supplier Quality processes associated with **ISO 9001 and/or ISO 13485**.
* Significant experience with sourcing, supplier management, and quality execution within highly regulated or demanding industries such as medical devices, automotive, aerospace and defense, or similarly complex markets.
* Demonstrated experience working effectively within a matrixed organization.

**Essential Skills & Competencies**
-----------------------------------

 

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across organizational levels, functions, cultures, and external organizations.
* Proactive, self-directed leadership style with the ability to identify challenges, develop solutions, and drive implementation.
* Strong commitment to quality, compliance, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated ability to build effective systems and establish trust with suppliers, internal customers, and regulatory stakeholders.
* Proven ability to motivate, coach, and develop team members while fostering collaboration and teamwork.
* Ability to navigate and de-escalate challenging or high-pressure situations calmly and effectively.
* Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder-management capabilities.
* Ability to translate supplier and quality data into actionable insights for senior leadership.
* Ability to travel occasionally.

**Additional Details**

This job has a full time weekly schedule. Applications for this job will be accepted until at least November 19, 2026 or until the job is no longer posted.The full-time equivalent pay range for this position is $160,240.00 - $300,450.00/yr USD in the US, or $134,218.00 - $209,715.00/yr CAD in Canada, plus eligibility for bonus, stock and benefits. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. records.title: VP Global Supply chain and manufacturing

postedPay.title: VP Global Supply chain and manufacturing

records.description:
At UVeye, we're on a mission to redefine vehicle safety and reliability on a global scale. Founded in 2016, we pioneered the world's first fully automated suite of AI-powered vehicle inspection systems, combining computer vision, machine learning, and generative AI.

With over $380M in funding and strategic partnerships with Toyota, Amazon, General Motors, JLR, Volvo, and Hertz, our technology is deployed across manufacturing plants, dealerships, wholesale auctions, fleets, and seaports worldwide. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies of 2026, our 270+ global employees are solutions-oriented, accountable, and driven by one shared goal: making roads safer for everyone.

We are seeking an experienced Vice President, Global Supply Chain to lead the strategy and execution of our end-to-end global supply chain, including procurement, strategic sourcing, supplier management, inventory planning, logistics, and warehouse operations. This executive will build scalable capabilities that support company growth, successful installations, and reliable field service across multiple geographies, with accountability for delivery performance, cost, working capital, and supply continuity.

This role requires a strategic, hands-on leader who can set long-term direction while working directly with teams and suppliers to negotiate critical agreements, resolve material constraints, and improve operational performance. Partnering closely with the COO and executive leadership team, the VP will align supply chain priorities with business objectives, strengthen planning and operational visibility, and develop a high-performing organization with clear ownership and measurable results.

A day in the life and how you’ll make an impact:

* Set the global supply chain strategy. Develop and execute a multiyear roadmap aligned with growth plans, installation requirements, service commitments, and financial objectives.
* Own operational and financial performance. Establish accountability for total supply chain cost, inventory investment, delivery reliability, and warehouse productivity. Partner with Finance to develop budgets, evaluate investments, and deliver measurable improvements.
* Connect business demand with supply execution. Establish a cross-functional planning cadence that aligns forecasts, installation schedules, field service requirements, supplier capacity, and inventory availability. Surface constraints early and drive decisions that protect customer commitments.
* Lead strategic sourcing and supplier performance. Develop sourcing strategies, negotiate commercial agreements, and build supplier relationships that improve cost, quality, lead times, and capacity. Hold suppliers accountable through clear expectations and performance reviews.
* Build supply resilience. Identify critical dependencies and develop mitigation plans for supplier disruption, capacity constraints, long lead times, and cross-border risks.
* Optimize inventory and material availability. Establish inventory policies that balance installation and service readiness with working capital discipline, reducing shortages, excess stock, and obsolescence.
* Direct global logistics and warehouse operations. Design scalable distribution capabilities and oversee freight, import/export, fulfillment, and material flow to installation sites and field teams. Ensure safe, accurate, compliant, and efficient operations.
* Strengthen systems, data, and decision-making. Set standards for ERP data integrity, inventory visibility, and reporting. Prioritize improvements in systems and automation that support scale and better operational decisions.
* Build and develop the organization. Define the team structure, hire and develop strong leaders, establish succession plans, and create a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Serve as an executive business partner. Present performance, risks, tradeoffs, and investment recommendations to senior leadership. Align stakeholders around decisions that improve customer outcomes and support sustainable growth.

 
Requirements:
 

* 15+ years of progressive supply chain experience, including at least 7 years in senior leadership roles overseeing multidisciplinary teams across multiple geographies. Demonstrated accountability for enterprise supply chain strategy, financial performance, and organizational development is required; prior VP-level or equivalent executive leadership experience is strongly preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business, or a related field; an advanced degree is preferred.
* A hands-on leadership approach, with the ability to set strategic direction while directly engaging in critical supplier negotiations, resolving material shortages, improving warehouse and logistics processes, and supporting installation and field service readiness.
* Experience leading complex supply chains across multiple geographies, including procurement, supplier management, inventory, logistics, and warehouse operations.
* A track record of scaling operations and delivering measurable improvements in cost, delivery performance, inventory efficiency, and supply reliability.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including budget ownership, working capital management, supplier negotiations, and investment evaluation.
* Experience establishing cross-functional planning processes that align demand, supply, and operational execution.
* Working knowledge of international trade, import/export compliance, and cross-border logistics.
* Experience using ERP systems and operational analytics to improve visibility, controls, and performance, with the ability to work directly with data to diagnose issues and drive corrective action; NetSuite experience is preferred.
* Ability to influence executive stakeholders, make decisions amid uncertainty, and translate strategy into clear priorities and accountable execution.
* Ability to develop strong leaders, delegate effectively, and build team capability while remaining actively engaged in operational performance.
* Ability to travel approximately 10–15% to support installation sites, operational locations, and supplier visits, including locations in Indiana, Canada, and Mexico.

Ideally, we’re looking for:

* VP / Director-level or equivalent leadership experience in a high-growth business with complex installation, deployment, or field service requirements.
* Experience supporting both project-based material demand and ongoing service or spare-parts needs.
* Success transforming a supply chain organization through direct involvement in process improvements, stronger planning, leadership development, and systems implementation.
* Experience expanding supplier and distribution capabilities into new geographies.
* A strategic, hands-on leader who is comfortable working alongside teams in warehouses, at installation sites, and with suppliers to understand challenges, remove barriers, and deliver results.

Benefits we offer:

* Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision.
* Company 401k Match.
* 20 PTO days, company-paid holidays.
* Career growth as we scale across the US.

Compensation:

UVeye provides salary ranges that comply with the New Jersey State Law on salary transparency in job advertisements. Actual salaries depend on a variety of factors, including experience, qualifications, skills, location, education, and operational needs. The salary range or contractual rate listed does not include bonuses/incentives or other forms of compensation or benefits. The annual base salary range for this position is $250,000 – $280,000.

Physical Requirements & Travel:

This role may involve on-site or field-based activities. Depending on the position, tasks may include extended periods of sitting, standing, or walking; working in and around vehicle service areas, rental facilities, dealerships, manufacturing sites, or warehouse environments; The role may also require travel, working in varying environmental conditions, and the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) when appropriate. *Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

Why UVeye

 

* Tech-First Mindset: Join a team at the forefront of innovation, where cutting-edge technology is shaping the future of AI and redefining the automotive industry.
* Industry Leadership: Be part of a trailblazing company driving real change—backed by rapid growth, a track record of success, and strong partnerships with global industry leaders.
* People-Centered Culture: Thrive in a collaborative, inclusive environment that values initiative, supports growth, and provides unique opportunities for development through executive workshops and mentorship programs.

UVeye is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

records.title: VP of Operations – Appliance
records.description:
**Vice President of Operations – Appliance Segment**
----------------------------------------------------

**Company:** SSW Advanced Technologies, LLC 
**Location:** REMOTE, with regular travel to plants in the U.S., Canada and Mexico 
**Travel:** Approximately 30–50% 
**Employment type:** Full-time, exempt

### **About the Role**

SSW Advanced Technologies is a leading manufacturer of engineered components for major appliance OEMs. We’re looking for a **Vice President of Operations** to lead our Appliance Segment, a multi-plant operation that makes wire, glass and component products for some of the best-known names in home appliances.

You’ll be accountable for the safety, quality, delivery and financial performance of our appliance plants across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. That includes:

* San Luis Potosí, MX; Sweetwater, TN; Vincennes, IN; Midland, ON; Clinton, IA & Madison, TN

This is a hands-on executive role for a leader who can set the strategy, build strong plant teams and deliver results for demanding OEM customers.

### **What You’ll Do**

* **Own segment performance:** Drive end-to-end results across all appliance plants against targets for safety, quality, delivery, cost and EBITDA.
* **Set the operations strategy:** Develop and execute a multi-year plan that supports growth, margin expansion and footprint optimization across U.S., Canada and Mexico operations.
* **Lead the customer relationship on operations:** Serve as the senior operations contact for appliance OEM customers, and meet or exceed scorecard goals for quality (PPM), on-time delivery, responsiveness and cost.
* **Deliver launches and changeovers:** Partner with Engineering, Quality and Sales so that capacity, tooling, customer qualification and ramp-up are ready on schedule.
* **Match capacity to demand:** Align production plans with OEM schedules, including seasonal and promotional volume swings, build-ahead requirements and short-notice changes.
* **Partner on supply chain:** Work closely with Supply Chain leadership on commodity exposure, supplier performance, alternate sourcing, inventory, premium freight and cross-border logistics.
* **Drive productivity and cost reduction:** Deliver annual plans that offset customer price-downs and inflation through Lean, automation, scrap reduction and labor efficiency.
* **Manage the numbers:** Build and manage the segment operating budget, capital plan and staffing plan. Hold plant leaders accountable to budget, and lead weekly forecast and commitment reviews.
* **Champion safety and compliance:** Build a zero-harm safety culture and fully implement our integrated Quality, Safety and Environmental management system, 5S and EHS standards.
* **Develop leaders:** Lead, coach and develop Plant and General Managers and operations leaders, and build bench strength and succession for critical roles.
* **Standardize how we run:** Establish common best practices, KPIs and daily, weekly and monthly operating rhythms across all plants.
* **Lead change:** Guide restructuring, footprint and transfer-of-work initiatives, including workforce planning.

### **What You Bring**

**Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Business Administration or a related field
* 10+ years of progressive operations leadership in manufacturing, including multi-plant responsibility
* A proven record of delivering cost reduction, successful launches and EBITDA improvement
* Strong P&L, budgeting and capital planning skills
* Executive-level communication and decision-making
* Fluent English

**Preferred:**

* Experience supplying major appliance OEMs or other high-volume OEM customers
* Background in metal forming, wire, glass, coating/finishing or assembly operations
* Experience leading operations in Mexico and managing cross-border supply chains
* MBA or master’s degree
* Lean or Six Sigma certification
* Spanish fluency (strongly preferred)

### **Your Team**

* **Direct reports:** Plant Managers, Operations Managers and Maintenance Managers across the Appliance Segment
* **Dotted-line partners:** Segment Quality, Engineering and EHS leaders

### **Work Environment**

Office and manufacturing plant environments, with regular travel between U.S., Canadian and Mexican facilities and to customer sites.

### **Why SSW**

* Lead a growing, multi-national segment with real influence on strategy and results
* Work directly with senior leadership in a hands-on, fast-moving environment
* Competitive salary, annual bonus and comprehensive benefits

*SSW Advanced Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.*

records.title: Director of Operations - Industrial Manufacturing
records.description:
PSG® is the global pump, metering and dispensing-solution expert, enabling the safe and efficient transfer of critical and valuable fluids that require optimal performance and reliability in applications where it matters most. Additionally, PSG is a leading provider of flow meters designed to reduce waste and downtime while accurately measuring, monitoring and controlling the distribution of fluids. Headquartered in Downers Grove, IL, USA, PSG is comprised of several world-class brands, including Abaque®, All-Flo™, Almatec®, Blackmer®, Ebsray®, em-tec®, Griswold®, Hydro™, Malema™, Mouvex®, Neptune®, PSG® Biotech, Quantex™, Quattroflow®, and Wilden®. PSG products are manufactured on three continents – North America, Europe, and Asia – in state-of-the-art facilities that practice lean manufacturing and are ISO-certified. PSG is part of the Pumps & Process Solutions segment of Dover Corporation. For additional information on PSG, please visit psgdover.com.

We thrive on winning and being number one; and are always looking to add the best and brightest to our talented team of professionals. PSG offers a unique combination of the both small company atmosphere: with an ownership mindset that allows you to make close-to-the-customer decisions; an innovative approach in seeing beyond what is possible today and entrepreneurial spirit in the pursuit of new opportunities; combined with benefits of a large company’s scale, tools, expertise, and financial strength with Dover. Join PSG, a growing global company where your curiosity, hard work and ambition is rewarded with exceptional career opportunities in a friendly & fast paced environment.

PSG is part of the Pumps and Process Solutions segment of the Dover Corporation® (NYSE: DOV). Dover is a diversified global manufacturer and solutions provider with annual revenue of over $7 billion. We deliver innovative equipment and components, consumable supplies, aftermarket parts, software and digital solutions, and support services through five operating segments. Recognized for our entrepreneurial approach for over 65 years, our team of over 24,000 employees takes an ownership mindset, collaborating with customers to redefine what's possible.

**Position Summary:**

 

Reporting to the site General Manager, the Director of Operations will manage the daily production, inventory, and logistics to ensure save, efficient, cost-effective, and timely delivery to our customers. They are responsible for development and implementation of strategy, growth, and profitability targets for the PSG-Grand Rapids facility. They will have direct ownership for established safety, quality, delivery, inventory, productivity, and lean objectives. Additional areas of reasonability include but are not limited to the oversight of: Safety, Plant Management, Manufacturing Operations, Supply Chain, Capital Equipment, Facilities Planning, Workforce Development, and Operations Strategy Deployment. A successful individual will deploy and maintain strong operational processes, be data driven, drive continuous improvement, and empower his or her team to solve problems.

 

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

 

* Manage business to achieve/exceed agreed-upon growth, revenue, and operating income objectives
* Oversee end-to-end supply chain partnerships, warehousing, inventory management, and transportation
* Ensure products meet operations’ profitability goals
* Establish strategic direction, performance metrics, standards, and measurements for direct reports and the operation as a whole that support safety, quality, and delivery expectations
* Sets operational goals and objectives, and guides teams to meet monthly, quarterly and annual targets
* Partner with internal stakeholders to manage the P&L and continuously execute to achieve revenue and margin commitments
* Provide support and leadership to the supply chain, production planning, manufacturing, and continuous improvement teams by:
 + Supporting sales & operations planning (S&OP) process, and planning manufacturing capacity accordingly to ensure on time and efficient delivery
 + Identifying and responding to trends in the marketplace, anticipating and applying strategies to be ahead of the cost and quality curve
 + Planning and executing a best in class supply chain to ensure appropriate levels of inventory and turns as well as supplier quality and cost
 + Directing the continuous improvement program and supporting on site initiatives as required to ensure adoption of programs and achievement of desired results
 + Ensuring that products are delivered on-time to customers and that products meet all customer expectations regarding quality and performance
 + Planning and implementing capital improvements for the site and operations
* Work proactively with and effectively engaging functional counterparts to ensure overall organizational success and continuity of leadership
* Partner with union leadership to maintain compliance with the collective bargaining agreement while supporting operational goals
* Foster a positive employee relations environment through building a culture where employees are motivated and actively engaged in driving continuous improvement in the business
* Conducts performance evaluations, coaches and mentors, provides feedback, and takes action as needed to build a high-performing department
Embody the Company’s ethics and values; maintain the highest corporate governance principles 

**Qualifications** :

 

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, engineering, operations management, or a related field is required
* MBA/Master’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred
* Minimum of 10+ years of experience in manufacturing, supply chain, or other operational leadership role
* Experience in a build to order/high-mix manufacturing environment required
* Proven background in the application of production/inventory control, procurement procedures and techniques, and logistics

This position is eligible to earn a discretionary bonus based on performance metrics and other criteria outlined in our applicable bonus plan.We consider several job-related, non-discriminatory factors when determining the pay rate for a position, including, but not limited to, the position’s responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, a candidate’s education/training, the position’s location, and the key skills needed for the position. Pay is one of the Total Rewards that we provide to compensate and recognize employees for their work.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, genetic information, or any other factors prohibited by law.

Fraudulent Recruiting Disclaimer: Dover Corporation and our affiliated operating companies want to alert applicants to internet job posting fraud, where parties posing as Dover employees, recruiters, or other agents, try to engage with online candidates in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. We do not endorse or engage in any recruitment practices that involve payment or personal information outside of our official application and hiring process. Please verify the authenticity of an invitation to apply for a job, or for a job offer by contacting us directly through our Dover and affiliated operating company websites at https://careers.dovercorporation.com/ . To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice on our careers site.

Attention Applicants: If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, please let us know. Likewise, if you are limited in the ability to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, we will determine an alternate way for you to apply. Please contact accommodations@psgdover.com for assistance with an accommodation. Kindly specify Job Requisition Number / Job Title and Location in response.

records.title: Director, Instrument Manufacturing
records.description:
**Position Summary**
====================

The primary purpose of this position is to plan and direct departmental functions (Instrument Manufacturing, Engineering, Instrument Refurbishing) at the St. Louis Operations site to ensure achievement of the corporate goals and objectives of the worldwide bioMerieux organization. This position is responsible for the manufacture and maintenance of instrument production and refurbishment through oversight of multiple teams. In addition, this position: provides technical expertise and quality support through implementation of projects and continuous improvement activities; identifies and justifies projects for capital funding, and deliver the projects on time and budget. Also requires coordinating and overseeing the implementation of engineering projects related to cost improvements and new product introductions, ensuring cooperation within and outside the department at both the local and global levels. And finally, responsible for developing and maintaining an engaged, motivated and skilled production work force.

**Primary Duties**
==================

* Manage Manufacturing – Manage the manufacturing and refurbishment groups to ensure customer satisfaction. Deliver the forecasted product on schedule with no errors or nonconformities. Maintain the complex manufacturing process and minimize loss. Maintain high employee morale, drive cooperation between departments at both local and global levels, and drive employee career development.
* Manage and Maintain Production Equipment – Ensure that the manufacturing areas are maintained so that production can continuously manufacture and refurbish product. End result: Successfully manufacturer product to meet demand and improve efficiency to reduce the COGS.
* Product Transfer – Manage the transfer of new products from Research to Manufacturing. Validate the new processes to meet regulatory requirements and ensure the necessary procedures are in place to order parts / materials to meet market demand. End result: Successful market introduction of new, high quality products that meet all relevant and applicable regulatory requirements.
* CAPA Investigations – Manage and provide technical expertise to projects related to investigating failures in current product production or testing processes.
* Cost Improvement and Risk Management – Manage and provide technical expertise to justify and implement cost improvement projects in Operations.
* Finance – Ensure adherence to Departmental budgets.
* Personnel – hiring, maintenance, organization, engagement, and performance of qualified manufacturing, engineering, and other personnel.
* Perform all work in compliance with company quality procedures and standards.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
==================

* Bachelor’s degree required– Engineering, Supply Chain Management, R&D, Business, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience leading manufacturing operations, with budget oversight and demonstrated experience in cost reduction and operational efficiency.
* 3+ years experience managing operations in an ISO 13485 regulated manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading transformational change.
* Demonstrated experience in talent management and succession planning.
* Experience with capacity, automation, capital investments preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**
====================================

* Consistently upholds and reflects the core ethical principles and values that bioMérieux promotes.
* Comfortable giving clear, direct, and actionable feedback.
* Driving continuous improvement by evaluating processes and implementing necessary changes.
* Inspire and energize individuals to achieve their best performance.
* Drive for Results while successfully removing barriers.
* Communicates instructions clearly and effectively.
* Advanced Microsoft Suite Skills: demonstrates deep knowledge; manages complex tasks and integrates multiple tools independently.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
================================

* Direct supervision of approximately 1–5 employees.
* Indirect supervision of approximately 100+ employees.
* Required to make financial, manufacturing process, organizational changes, product and team development decisions.

**Working Conditions**
======================

* Domestic travel required: 10% of time
* International travel required: 5% of time
* Total travel: 15%

The estimated salary range for this role is between $155,000-$198,000. This role is eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and individual performance per bioMérieux’s bonus program. This range may differ from ranges offered for similar positions elsewhere in the country given differences in cost of living. Actual compensation within this range is determined based on the successful candidate’s experience and will be presented in writing at the time of the offer.

In addition, bioMérieux offers a competitive Total Rewards package that may include:

* A choice of medical (including prescription), dental, and vision plans providing nationwide coverage and telemedicine options

* Company-Provided Life and Accidental Death Insurance

* Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance

* Retirement Plan including a generous non-discretionary employer contribution and employer match.

* Adoption Assistance

* Wellness Programs

* Employee Assistance Program

* Commuter Benefits

* Various voluntary benefit offerings

* Discount programs

* Parental leaves
