records.title: Manufacturing Operations Director
records.description:
The Figeac Aero Group has multiple locations across the world. Figeac Aero North America, located in Wichita, Kansas in the heart of the country, is a leading aerospace partner for detailed parts and sub-assemblies with specialization in saturation shot peening, shot peen forming, chemical processing, painting, assembly, non-destructive testing, and machining.

At Figeac Aero North America, we place a high value on our employees. Employees are given the opportunity to be a part of something special while achieving their career goals. We offer competitive compensation as a smaller company in addition to an attractive benefits package for qualified employees.

***Manufacturing Operations Director***

***Salary:*** *$90,000 - $120,000*

***Shift:*** *Monday to Friday 1st shift*

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Manages and directs all manufacturing and production activities including shift quality and quality of work
* Monitors overall plant performance for production and comply with all quality standards
* Familiarity with AS9100, NADCAP & ISO9001 standards & audits
* Works with multiple cross functional groups (Quality, Scheduling, Assembly, Procurement, Supply Chain, Facilities/Maintenance, etc.)
* Reviews production and operating reports and resolves operational/manufacturing problems to ensure minimum costs and prevent operational delays and to meet future growth.
* Uses problem-solving skills and analytical abilities to develop innovative and expedient solutions
* Applies Lean principles and production metrics to make informed decisions and drive continuous improvement processes
* Lead and motivate team members to achieve company/department goals while providing direction, development and leadership to production management team
* Provides training, problem solving, and interpersonal skills to diminish conflict and handle employee issues
* Works overtime and occasional weekend shifts as required to support production needs.
* Ensure ITAR/EAR restriction and regulations are followed

**Education/Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent and 5 years management experience in manufacturing environment; or 8+ years related management experience and training in a manufacturing environment 2
* 2+ years’ experience in aerospace industry
* CNC machining experience required
* Knowledge of NDT, paint, and chemical processing required
* Strong business acumen with proven leadership skills
* Full knowledge and adherence to ITAR/EAR restrictions and responsibilities

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Ability to act with integrity, professionalism and confidentiality
* Mandatory background in an aerospace or manufacturing environment required.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including interpersonal, negotiation & conflict resolution.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate.
* Expert in all Microsoft Office 365 applications and knowledge of ERP programs preferred
* Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate.
* Self-motivated, innovative, practical, and adaptable
* Ability to speak, read, write, and understand English language
* Must be 18 years or older
* Must be a US citizen or legally authorized to work in the United States, not eligible for VISA sponsorship

**Working Conditions:**

* The essential duties job may require the ability to stoop; to reach; to stand,
* to walk and sit for extended periods of time;
* to push and/or pull objects weighing up to 30 pounds;
* to lift and carry objects weighing up to 15 pounds;
* to use finger dexterity to operate a computer and other office equipment and hand strength to grasp files and other objects;
* to perceive the attributes of objects by touch;
* to hear and verbally exchange ideas and information with the public, staff and others on the phone and in the office.
* Occasionally being on foot, bending, stooping, squatting, kneeling, climb stairs and kneeling and/or crouching to retrieve files and other items.
* Occasionally Lifting and carrying (with assistance) items weighing 20-50 lbs.

**Competitive Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance with competitive rates
* Company paid life & AD&D insurance
* Corporate YMCA memberships
* Paid Time Off
* Generous 401(k) with company match
* Life Insurance, AD&D, Disability & Voluntary options
* Employee Assistance Plan

Figeac Aero North America is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

records.title: Manufacturing Engineering Director
records.description:
The Figeac Aero Group has multiple locations across the world. Figeac Aero North America, located in Wichita, Kansas in the heart of the country, is a leading aerospace partner for detailed parts and sub-assemblies with specialization in saturation shot peening, shot peen forming, chemical processing, painting, assembly, non-destructive testing, and machining.

At Figeac Aero North America, we place a high value on our employees. Employees are given the opportunity to be a part of something special while achieving their career goals. We offer competitive compensation as a smaller company in addition to an attractive benefits package for qualified employees.

***Manufacturing Engineering Director***

***Salary****: $90,000 - $120,000*

**Experience:** 8+ years in Manufacturing Engineering discipline in Aerospace environment.

**Job Duties:**

* Responsible for coordinating and executing activities around the following: Leading technical teams in the improvement of current processes, transitioning new statements of work, being the focal point of communication between quality, operations, NC Programming and Planning.
* Monitor and enforce adherence to internal processes and standards to ensure a consistent product to the manufacturing floor.
* Collaborate with NC Programming, operations and Manufacturing Engineering on tool and fixture design.
* Review first part runs with Quality, Operations and NC Programming to verify a conforming part and acceptable manufacturing process.
* Mentoring and training of new Manufacturing Engineers/Planners.
* Interface with customer base to resolve engineering issues.
* Investigate and resolve manufacturing issues related to low profitability or excessive scrap.
* Engagement at the estimating stage on strategic packages to review engineering design and productivity concerns.
* Shop support and guidance on first article builds to ensure engineering compliance and manufacturing process design effectiveness.
* Provides planning, direction, and coordination for all technical activities while monitors performance to estimates, budgets and organization goals.
* Participates in developing organization and department goals and objectives.
* Manage and execute assigned projects to meet all project criteria on time and on budget.
* Transition Technical Phase of new work statements on time and achieve manufacturing targets.
* Be instrumental in reducing overall manufacturing costs of strategic work statements by reducing cycle times, setup, scrap, secondary operations content, raw material content and other process driven cost components.
* Enhance core competencies in complex machining and programming.
* Challenges others to develop as leaders while serving as a role model and mentor.
* Inspire coworkers to attain goals and pursue excellence.
* Recommend and implement process changes in order to improve cost, delivery, quality.
* Identifies opportunities for improvement and makes constructive suggestions for change.
* Analyze information and evaluate results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
* Leadership and Communications.
* Report progress and projects weekly to Leadership Team.
* Mitigate team conflict and communication problems.

**Education/Experience**

* A four-year Engineering degree and 8 years relative experience in an Aerospace Engineering discipline is required
* A minimum of 10 years’ experience in a Manufacturing Engineering discipline is preferred
* Extensive knowledge and experience in machining, inspection, tooling design, assembly, and lean manufacturing methodologies
* Familiarity with MRP systems and fundamentals
* Full knowledge and adherence to ITAR/EAR restrictions and responsibilities

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Ability to act with integrity, professionalism and confidentiality
* Mandatory background in an aerospace or manufacturing environment required.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including interpersonal, negotiation & conflict resolution.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate.
* Expert in all Microsoft Office 365 applications and knowledge of ERP programs preferred
* Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate.
* Self-motivated, innovative, practical, and adaptable
* Ability to speak, read, write, and understand English language
* Must be 18 years or older
* Must be a US citizen or legally authorized to work in the United States, not eligible for VISA sponsorship

**Working Conditions:**

* This position is 100% onsite (Wichita KS)
* Monday to Friday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm
* Some hours outside of office schedule may be required.
* Regular attendance is mandatory and must follow all work safety programs
* The essential duties job may require the ability to stoop; to reach; to stand, to walk and sit for extended periods of time; to push and/or pull objects weighing up to 30 pounds; to lift and carry objects weighing up to 15 pounds; to use finger dexterity to operate a computer and other office equipment and hand strength to grasp files and other objects; to perceive the attributes of objects by touch; to hear and verbally exchange ideas and information with the public, staff and others on the phone and in the office. Occasionally being on foot, bending, stooping, squatting, kneeling, climb stairs and kneeling and/or crouching to retrieve files and other items. Occasionally Lifting and carrying (with assistance) items weighing 20-50 lbs.

**Competitive Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance with competitive rates
* Company paid life & AD&D insurance
* Corporate YMCA memberships
* Paid Time Off
* Generous 401(k) with company match
* Life Insurance, AD&D, Disability & Voluntary options
* Employee Assistance Plan

Figeac Aero North America is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

records.title: Director of Operations
records.description:
**U C Coatings Director of Operations**

**Reports to** President

**Location** Based at a U-C Coatings facility; Buffalo, NY or Kenosha, WI preferred

**Travel** Approximately 25-35%, including regular travel to all four sites and 3PL partners

**Scope** Buffalo, Kenosha, Seattle and Portland manufacturing sites; 3PLs; supply chain and sourcing; customer service

**Position summary**

U-C Coatings manufactures specialty coatings, wood protection and repair products for industrial and consumer markets. The **Director of Operations** leads the people, processes and resources that turn customer demand into safe, reliable production and accurate, timely delivery.

Reporting to the President, this leader is accountable for operating performance across four sites and the supporting supply chain, sourcing, logistics and customer service functions. The role requires regular time on the production floor, strong financial judgment, and the ability to develop capable site and functional leaders in a lean organization.

**Manufacturing and site leadership**

* Lead site leaders in Buffalo, NY, Kenosha, WI, Seattle, WA, and Portland, OR; establish clear responsibilities, operating standards and performance expectations across the network.
* Translate demand into production, staffing and capacity plans; improve batch scheduling, filling, packaging, labor productivity and equipment utilization.
* Improve yield, reduce scrap and rework, and address recurring downtime through preventive maintenance, root cause analysis and practical process improvements.
* Evaluate production allocation, interplant transfers, capital investments and facility changes to improve service, cost and available capacity.

**Supply chain and sourcing**

* Own procurement and supplier performance for raw materials, packaging, purchased products and operating supplies; negotiate pricing, terms and service commitments.
* Lead monthly demand and supply planning with Sales and Finance; align forecasts, purchasing and production with service goals and working capital requirements.
* Set replenishment and inventory policies by item and site; improve inventory accuracy, reduce excess and obsolete stock, and prevent material shortages.
* Develop qualified alternate sources and continuity plans for critical inputs; coordinate supplier and material changes with Technical and Quality before implementation.

**Logistics and third party warehousing**

* Manage 3PL contracts, service standards and performance reviews, including inventory reconciliation, order accuracy, shipping performance, claims and invoice audits.
* Control inbound, outbound, parcel, LTL and interplant freight costs; improve packaging, carrier selection and routing while meeting customer requirements.

**Customer Service**

* Lead Customer Service from order receipt through fulfillment; improve order entry accuracy, acknowledgments, delivery commitments and response times.
* Connect Customer Service, Sales, planning, plants and 3PLs so customers receive reliable commitments and proactive updates on shortages or delays.
* Resolve escalated service issues, returns and credits with Sales, Finance and Technical; use complaint and shipping error trends to eliminate repeat failures.

**Safety quality and compliance**

* Hold site leaders accountable for safe operations, training, inspections, incident reporting and timely corrective action; maintain clear escalation and stop-work authority.
* Partner with internal specialists and outside advisers to meet applicable workplace safety, environmental, storage, waste and shipping requirements at each site.
* Ensure operating teams follow approved formulations, batch records, quality checks, labeling and lot traceability; support product launches and process changes with Technical and Quality.

**Financial management and people leadership**

* Own operating budgets and explain labor, material, freight and overhead variances with Finance; deliver verified savings and capital projects with clear returns.
* Coach and evaluate site and functional leaders; build staffing, cross-training and succession plans, and address performance issues promptly with HR support.
* Run weekly site and consolidated scorecard reviews covering service, cost, quality, inventory and people; assign owners and deadlines and verify corrective actions.

**Qualifications**

* Ten or more years of progressive manufacturing operations experience, including at least five years leading managers or major operating functions.
* Demonstrated success leading multiple manufacturing sites or a comparably complex manufacturing and distribution network; ability to lead dispersed teams.
* Practical experience with procurement, inventory planning, logistics, outsourced warehousing and customer fulfillment; strong cost and financial analysis skills.
* Experience with ERP and MRP systems, Excel, operating scorecards and continuous improvement; ability to turn data into decisions and sustained results.
* Bachelor's degree in operations, supply chain, engineering, business or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Coatings, chemicals, adhesives, sealants or other batch manufacturing experience is strongly preferred.

**Measures of success**

Accountable measures include safety controls; on-time, in-full delivery; labor efficiency; yield and cost of poor quality; inventory accuracy and turns; supplier and 3PL performance; freight costs; order accuracy; and leadership development. Agree on targets with the CEO after validating baselines.

**Initial priorities and working environment**

Within 90 days, assess the sites and key partners, validate scorecards, and agree on an improvement plan with owners, deadlines and financial impact. Work includes office, plant and warehouse activities, required PPE (company-provided), regular travel and occasional support outside business hours. Essential duties may be performed with reasonable accommodation.

**COMPANY DESCRIPTION:**

U-C Coatings is a leading manufacturer and supplier of premium wood protection products. For more than 50 years, our products have been used in a variety of industries, including hardwood and softwood logging and lumber production, wood products, manufacturing, woodworking, and wood decking markets.

Our products are used worldwide to protect, conserve, and enhance forest resources. Our goal is to help our customers achieve more with less waste and provide the highest level of protection for their products.

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

This role is an in-person role located within the company’s Kenosha, WI location. There is a moderate noise level within the work environment. Compliance with applicable Company policies including maintaining a drug-free workplace and adhering to all safety policies and procedures is required.

**DISCLAIMERS:**

UC Coatings, LLC reserves the right to revise, change or modify the duties and responsibilities of this position at any time to meet business needs. This job description may not list all duties for this position. This job description is not a contract of employment, and all UC Coatings, LLC employment unless otherwise disclosed is “at will” and either the incumbent or UC Coatings, LLC may terminate employment at any time for any reason.

UC Coatings, LLC is an Equal opportunity, inclusive employer and will consider all applicants for employment with the Company based on merit, competence, and qualifications without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Operations management: 5 years (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 50% (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

records.title: Production Strategy & Operations Director
records.description:
**Position Overview**

JHB Group, Inc. is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and forward-thinking Production Strategy & Operations Director to lead production planning, operational coordination, process development, and efficiency improvements within our specialty vehicle and trailer manufacturing facility.

**Successful production starts before the work begins—with planning, preparation, organization, and communication.** This leadership role focuses on creating the systems, schedules, workflows, and accountability that help teams execute complex custom manufacturing projects consistently and efficiently. Manufacturing experience is a strong advantage, but exceptional organizational and operational leadership skills are the priority.

**Key Responsibilities**

Strategic Production Planning & Scheduling

* Develop and maintain master production schedules across multiple custom projects.

* Translate project requirements and delivery commitments into actionable daily, weekly, and long-term plans.

* Coordinate labor, materials, equipment, and other resources to support production priorities.

* Anticipate scheduling conflicts, capacity limitations, and bottlenecks before they affect deadlines.

* Monitor milestones and adjust plans proactively as project requirements change.

**Operational Organization & Preparation**

* Ensure drawings, work instructions, tools, equipment, and materials are ready before work begins.

* Coordinate with purchasing, inventory, engineering, and production to confirm project readiness.

* Create clear systems for tracking tasks, outstanding issues, and production status.

* Improve material staging, work-area organization, and shop readiness.

* Reduce downtime caused by missing parts, unclear instructions, and inadequate preparation.

**Process Development & Continuous Improvement**

* Evaluate workflows and implement practical improvements to productivity and consistency.

* Develop, document, implement, and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs).

* Establish repeatable processes and performance-tracking systems across departments.

* Identify root causes of recurring delays, rework, and wasted labor; implement lasting solutions.

* Promote continuous improvement, operational discipline, and accountability.

**Production Execution & Coordination**

* Coordinate fabrication, welding, electrical, carpentry, cabinetry, assembly, and finishing activities.

* Align work assignments with production schedules and available resources.

* Facilitate timely communication and handoffs between departments.• Identify and resolve production constraints through planning and cross-functional coordination.

* Maintain accurate visibility into progress, priorities, and upcoming requirements.

Leadership, Communication & Accountability

* Set clear expectations and priorities for production personnel and department leaders.

* Lead concise daily production meetings and weekly planning reviews.

* Hold teams accountable for schedules, productivity, quality, safety, and procedures.

* Support training, staffing coordination, and constructive performance feedback.

* Model professionalism, organization, ownership, and follow-through.

Quality & Operational Performance

* Coordinate quality checkpoints and confirm work aligns with drawings and project specifications.

* Identify recurring workmanship issues and establish corrective processes.

* Track schedule adherence, labor utilization, milestones, and production performance.

* Provide management with accurate reporting on progress, risks, and resource needs.

* Establish measurable operational goals and evaluate results.

**Required Skills & Attributes**

* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.

* Strong strategic planning, scheduling, prioritization, and project coordination abilities.

* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities in a changing environment.

* Proactive approach to anticipating needs and preventing problems.

* Demonstrated ability to implement processes, communicate expectations, and drive follow-through.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, leadership, and interpersonal skills.

* Proficiency with spreadsheets, scheduling tools, and operational tracking systems.

* Ability to work independently and make sound operational decisions.

Preferred Experience

* Five or more years in operations management, production planning, project management, manufacturing, or a related

field.

* Experience coordinating teams and departments, developing SOPs, or improving workflows.

* Background in manufacturing, fabrication, automotive, specialty vehicles, or custom assembly.

* Familiarity with bills of materials, inventory, resource planning, and production drawings.

* Experience with Lean Manufacturing, 5S, or other continuous improvement practices.

Manufacturing experience is preferred, not required. Candidates from operations, logistics, or project planning

backgrounds with outstanding organizational and leadership capabilities are encouraged to apply.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Realistic schedules, clear project milestones, and well-defined responsibilities.

* People, parts, drawings, tools, and instructions ready before each production phase begins.• Fewer avoidable delays, bottlenecks, rework cycles, and interruptions.

* Documented processes that are consistently followed and improved.

* Clear cross-department communication and accurate management visibility.

* A more predictable, efficient, organized, and scalable production operation.

**The Ideal Candidate**

You naturally bring structure to complex environments. You enjoy organizing people and resources, creating effective systems, and thinking several steps ahead. You take ownership, follow through, and understand that successful execution depends on having the right Plan. Parts. People. in place before work begins. You are motivated not merely to keep production moving, but to make it work better every day.

**About JHB Group**

JHB Group, Inc. designs and manufactures custom mobile solutions for public safety, emergency management, government, military, and commercial customers. Our products include mobile command centers, emergency response vehicles, specialty trailers, and training simulators. In-house capabilities span engineering, metal fabrication, welding, carpentry, cabinetry, electrical systems, networking, graphics, finishing, and final assembly.

**Why Join JHB Group?**

This role offers the opportunity to shape how a specialty manufacturing operation plans, organizes, measures, and executes its work. We seek a leader who wants to build effective systems, implement improvements, and contribute directly to long-term success.

**If you are a strategic thinker, exceptional organizer, and results-driven leader who believes planning and preparation are the foundation of successful operations, we encourage you to apply.**

Pay: $74,000.00 - $84,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

records.title: Director of Quality Assurance
records.description:
Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development, and production of critical, next-generation system solutions that align with the U.S. Department of War and its allies' core mission priorities, and meet the accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.

The Director of Quality, Defense is responsible for overseeing all quality activities, personnel, systems, and performance associated with Defense programs across multiple Karman Space & Defense operating sites. This role provides strategic and operational leadership to ensure all Defense hardware, assemblies, and services meet or exceed contractual, regulatory, and customer requirements. 
 
This position will manage the Defense Quality Engineering organization, supports execution of Defense programs, and ensures consistent application of quality standards and tools across the sector. This leader works in close partnership with the Enterprise Director of Quality to align each site's AS9100 compliant QMS with the emerging enterprise quality architecture and to transition multiple Defense sites toward a unified enterprise certification. 
 
This role is critical in driving disciplined execution, continuous improvement, product integrity, and customer satisfaction within the Defense market segment.

Reports to Vice President, Defense. Functional Partnership with Enterprise Director of Quality (Karman Space & Defense). 
 
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** 

* Lead, develop, and manage the Quality Engineering team supporting all Defense programs and projects.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, proactive risk management, and continuous improvement across Defense Quality functions.
* Serve as the primary Defense quality leader to the VP of Defense and the Defense leadership team.
* Ensure the quality of all Defense hardware, assemblies, engineered systems, and services produced across multiple sites.
* Oversee program quality planning, including inspection strategies, qualification/verification plans, critical characteristics control, product safety considerations, and risk mitigation.
* Review and approve quality requirements for Defense proposals, contracts, and manufacturing plans.
* Drive effective root cause analysis, corrective action, and failure review processes for Defense programs.
* Ensure each Defense site maintains compliance to AS9100, customer requirements, and regulatory obligations.
* Provide direct guidance to site Quality Managers/Quality Engineers on QMS implementation, audit readiness, and procedural improvement.

records.title: Plant Manager - Metals Stamping
records.description:
**Are you a leader who sees opportunity where others see challenges?**

Lake Air Products is looking for an entrepreneurial-minded Plant Manager to lead our metal stamping operation in New Hope, MN. This is an opportunity for a driven, hands-on leader who thrives on challenges and has the vision and determination to transform an operation and drive it to the next level.

We are a growing manufacturing company with big opportunities ahead, and we're looking for someone who wants to play a critical role in that success. This isn't a position for someone who simply wants to maintain the status quo. We need a leader who takes ownership, drives accountability, embraces change, and knows how to turn opportunities into results.

At Lake Air Products, we are proud to live by our Core Values: **Customer Focus, Passion for Performance, and Right People – Best Teams.** If you're energized by building strong teams, improving performance, and creating a culture where people and operations thrive, we'd like to hear from you!

**What You'll Do**

As Plant Manager, you will have significant influence over the performance, culture, and future direction of the New Hope operation. You will lead a team of manufacturing departments, including scheduling, stamping, assembly, and shipping/receiving, with 3-5 direct reports.

* **Own the Results:** Take full accountability for plant performance, driving measurable improvements in Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC), productivity, output, and overall operational effectiveness.
* **Drive Change & Transformation:** Identify opportunities, challenge existing processes, and lead meaningful operational changes that improve performance and position the plant for long-term success.
* **Lead with an Entrepreneurial Mindset:** Think strategically, act decisively, take ownership, and approach challenges with a solutions-oriented mindset.
* **Build a High-Performing Team:** Develop, coach, and hold leaders accountable while creating an environment of engagement, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
* **Drive Operational Excellence:** Establish and execute continuous improvement initiatives, set clear objectives, and ensure projects deliver measurable results.
* **Manage Financial Performance:** Own plant spending and budget performance, make sound business decisions, and identify opportunities to improve profitability and efficiency.
* **Invest in the Future:** Identify and justify capital investments (CAPEX), clearly communicating anticipated benefits, business impact, and return on investment.
* **Lead Through Communication:** Establish effective tier meetings, maintain clear communication across all levels, and partner with Engineering, HR, Customer Support, and senior leadership.
* **Champion Customer Success:** Ensure production priorities and operational decisions support customer expectations for quality, delivery, and service.
* **Promote a Strong Culture:** Uphold Lake Air Products' Core Values, build productive employee relationships, and partner with HR to strengthen retention and employee satisfaction.
* **Maintain Compliance:** Ensure adherence to the company's ISO Quality Management System, departmental procedures, and work instructions.

Lake Air Products Offers:

* Competitive wage
* Full benefits package
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off (PTO) and Holiday Pay
* Gym reimbursement
* Tuition reimbursement

Qualifications

* Experience in Transition Leadership: Fast Growth > 15% per year, including operational turn arounds, fast expansions, etc.
* Ability to provide technical oversight, with the understanding of metal products and processes
* Proven success in contract manufacturing, producing 1000+ SKUs for 10+ customers
* Understanding and ability to pull data and analyze metrics related to budgets, KPI's, and efficiency reporting
* Cultural change agent, with strong leadership, influencing and mentoring skills.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems within a manufacturing environment, with Epicor experience preferred

*Please note that if this position may be subject to export control regulation. Unless an exemption applies, candidate(s) must be a U.S. Person\* within the meaning of the law OR obtain an export control license. Candidates who do not meet the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) requirements or choose not to pursue such positions are not disqualified from applying for other opportunities with Lake Air Products. Nothing in this posting should be interpreted as limiting applications based on nationality or citizenship status.* 
 

* *A U.S. Person under export control laws includes a U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or protected individual who has been lawfully admitted for temporary residence in the U.S. as a refugee or asylee under U.S. law.*

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
POSITION TITLE: Plant Manager 
CLASSIFICATION: Exempt 
REPORTS TO: Plant Manager I 
SUPERVISES: Yes

POSITION PURPOSE: 
Responsible for overseeing and supervising the manufacturing and distribution departments by establishing, monitoring and enforcing policies and procedures to ensure that departments run smoothly and are aligned to quality standards. Creates and executes on strategies and policies for company growth. 
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND BASIC DUTIES: 

* Oversee and supervise the Manufacturing and Distribution departments.
* Provide for the timely manufacture and distribution of product against customer orders.
* Anticipates and tracks operational and tactical risks and providing strategic solutions.
* Plays a significant role in long-term planning, project status reporting, and implementing change control processes.
* Maintain average workdays to manufacture and ship all published catalog items.
* Maintain average workdays to manufacture and ship all custom manufactured items (RCC label)
* Provide monthly responses to budget variance.
* Provide for utilization planning by weekly reporting of the average Work-in-Process.
* Perform physical inventories of raw materials, packaging components, and finished goods.
* Provide for an appropriate balance of inventory to meet performance and financial objectives.
* Implement plant safety programs and ensure compliance with GMP.
* Confirm that appropriate work instructions are developed and maintained and followed throughout the business.
* Ensure that all ISO quality systems are followed.
* Provide compliance to ISO quality systems (i.e. Corrective Action)
* Oversee facilities and grounds maintenance.
* Oversees and reports weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual metrics.
* Identifies trends and assess opportunities to improve processes and execution.
* Completes reasonability testing and information validation prior to circulating findings and recommendations to key stakeholders.
* Solicits and responds to feedback while gaining commitment and support.
* Stays up to date on industry regulations, trends, and technology.
* Manage and supervise employees, resolve problems, and make recommendations for staffing and interviewing candidates for employment.
* Responsible for annual personnel reviews.

records.description:
**Position Summary**

The Industrial Gases Plant Manager is responsible for the safe, reliable, and cost-effective operation of an industrial gases production facility, ensuring uninterrupted production and supply of products such as oxygen, nitrogen, argon, hydrogen, and CO₂. The role provides leadership for operations, maintenance, safety, quality, and continuous improvement while meeting business, customer, and regulatory requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead all plant operations to achieve safety, production, quality, and reliability targets.
* Ensure compliance with environmental, health, safety, and process safety management (PSM) standards.
* Drive operational excellence through continuous improvement, productivity, and energy-efficiency initiatives.
* Oversee maintenance and reliability programs to maximize plant uptime and asset performance.
* Manage plant budgets, operating costs, and capital improvement projects.
* Lead, coach, and develop plant personnel, fostering a culture of accountability and high performance.
* Ensure compliance with quality systems, customer specifications, and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate with supply chain, logistics, engineering, and commercial teams to ensure uninterrupted product supply.
* Lead root cause investigations and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Support plant expansions, upgrades, and commissioning activities.

**Management Responsibilities**

Directly manages plant leadership and operational personnel, including maintenance, operations, and technical staff. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with company policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, training, coaching, performance management, disciplinary action, succession planning, and employee development.

**Other Duties**

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the position. Duties and responsibilities may be modified at any time to meet the business needs of the organization.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in industrial gases, chemicals, petrochemicals, refining, or other continuous process industries.
* 5+ years of leadership experience managing industrial gases plant operations.
* Strong knowledge of cryogenic processes, compressors, rotating equipment, utilities, and process control systems.
* Experience with DCS/PLC systems, reliability practices, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Demonstrated leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

**Key Competencies**

* Safety Leadership
* Operational Excellence
* Team Development
* Financial & Business Acumen
* Reliability & Asset Management
* Strategic Thinking
* Communication & Stakeholder Management

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Safety performance and regulatory compliance
* Plant availability and reliability
* Production efficiency and energy consumption
* Product quality performance
* Budget and cost management
* Employee engagement and development
* Customer supply reliability

**Reports To**: President Plants and Operation Department

**Direct Reports**: Maintenance Manager and Plant Operations Team.

**Work Environment**

This position operates primarily within an industrial manufacturing environment and office setting. The Plant Manager regularly works in and around production equipment, compressors, cryogenic systems, utilities, and other industrial process operations. The role routinely uses standard office equipment, including computers, phones, scanners, and related technology. Frequent interaction with plant employees, contractors, customers, regulatory agencies, and corporate leadership is required. Occasional travel to company facilities, customer sites, industry meetings, and training programs may be required.

**Physical Demands**

This role requires a combination of office-based and plant-floor activities. The employee is frequently required to sit, stand, walk, climb stairs and ladders, communicate effectively, and use a computer for extended periods. The position may require working in varying environmental conditions, including exposure to industrial noise, temperature fluctuations, and process equipment. The ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE), including safety glasses, hard hats, hearing protection, steel-toed footwear, and other safety equipment as required, is essential. The employee may occasionally be required to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

**Position Type and Expected Hours of Work**

This is a full-time exempt position. The Plant Manager is expected to maintain a schedule sufficient to meet business and operational needs. Due to the nature of continuous industrial operations, the position may require availability outside normal business hours, including evenings, weekends, holidays, emergency response situations, planned maintenance outages, and on-call responsibilities as needed.

**Work Authorization**

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States and must maintain eligibility to work in the U.S. throughout their employment. Appropriate documentation authorizing employment in the United States is required upon hire.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**

Air Water America is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to attracting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce and fostering an inclusive work environment where all employees are treated with dignity and respect. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, military status, or any other status protected under applicable federal, state, or local laws. Air Water America complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity laws and regulations and provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and religious observances as required by law.

records.description:
### **Summary**

The Production Manager oversees the operations of the entire production facility (excluding purchasing, personnel, and non-production functions), with a focus on the Converting department. This role ensures adherence to company policies and procedures while driving optimal operational performance. The manager directly supervises Converting employees and supervisors.

**Perks of Pratt:**

* Medical/Dental/Vision Plans
* Short Term/Long Term Disability
* Supplemental Life Insurance Plans
* Child Bearing/Parental Leave
* 401K Plan with Company Match
* Paid Holidays/Paid Vacation
* Uniforms/Safety Shoes/Prescription Safety Glasses
* Healthy Lifestyles Program/ Virgin Pulse Fitness Tracker
* $500.0/Year Gym Membership Reimbursement100% Tuition Reimbursement/Assistance Program
* Income Protection Plans
* Legal & Travel Assistance Plans
* EAP/Home Auto Insurance Plans
* Wireless/Auto/Computer Discount Plans

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Production & Operations**

* Provide full production support, with a strong emphasis on converting machine performance.
* Maximize productivity and minimize downtime through effective resource management.
* Coordinate with Maintenance on PMs, MVP, and machine uptime goals.
* Oversee converting production, including equipment installation and major repairs.
* Support cost-reduction strategies and drive productivity improvements.
* Ensure compliance with all company policies, safety protocols, and quality standards.

#### **Quality & Safety**

* Ensure plant focus on quality processes and tools for each converting machine.
* Maintain plant housekeeping standards and ensure machine cleaning programs are current.
* Drive safety initiatives and uphold OSHA, EPA, and company regulations.
* Oversee all audit protocols (third-party, customer, and internal).

#### **Leadership & Supervision**

* Directly supervise Converting employees and supervisors.
* Set and communicate quality, efficiency, and production standards.
* Provide training, coaching, conflict resolution, performance evaluations, and disciplinary action as needed.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, teamwork, and high morale.

#### **Administrative & Strategic Support**

* Evaluate new methods, machinery, and safety programs; contribute to planning, budgeting, and purchasing.
* Maintain optimal staffing levels daily.
* Communicate issues to the General Manager in a timely manner.
* Remain on-call and available after hours to address urgent production issues.
* Perform additional duties as assigned by management.

### **Qualifications**

#### **Required**

* High school diploma or GED
* 10 years of experience in corrugated manufacturing
* 5 years of proven management experience in a production environment

#### **Preferred**

* College degree
* Experience with Ward Servo Pro Die Cutters, Bobst 8.2, and Gopfert Die-Cutters
* 5+ years in converting manufacturing operations
* 2+ years in a supervisory role
* Proficiency in Lean/5S, OSHA, EPA regulations
* Mechanically inclined with strong troubleshooting skills
* Strong project management and coaching abilities

### **Skills & Competencies**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Sound mathematical and analytical capabilities
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and lead effective meetings
* Emotional resilience and conflict resolution skills
* Positive leadership presence and professional demeanor

### **Performance Measurements**

* **Operating Standards:** Meets/exceeds performance goals for production and customer service
* **Personal Growth:** Achieves annual professional development goals
* **Employee Relations:** Demonstrates effective team development, coaching, and motivation
* **Creativity:** Contributes innovative ideas to improve business operations

### **Physical & Work Environment Requirements**

* Regular walking, talking, hearing; frequent standing and reaching; occasional sitting
* Visual requirements include close, distance, color, peripheral vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment
* Exposure to wet/humid conditions, mechanical parts, fumes/particles, and high noise levels

Pratt Industries is America's 5th largest paper and packaging company with more than 10,000 highly skilled employees dedicated to the environment and sustainability. Pratt Industries is one of the largest corrugated packaging companies in America, with sophisticated manufacturing facilities in more than a dozen states. The company operates three of the most modern, cost effective paper mills in the country, as well as a series of sheet and box plants strategically placed throughout the United States offering a wide range of creative packaging solutions. Pratt Industries is committed to recycling and the environment by “harvesting the urban forest." 
Pratt Industries offers competitive compensation plans with incentive opportunities, full benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, FSA, All State, Pre-Paid Legal, and 401(k) with company match, paid vacation, and paid holidays.

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
**Plant Manager.**

**Wichita, Kansas.**

**Full-time.**

**PSC INDUSTRIES.**

**Job Summary:** 
The Plant Manager will be working for a Progressive and Growing Manufacturing Organization. The Plant Manager is responsible for general supervision of all phases of plant operations including production, materials, quality control, maintenance, receiving & shipping, daily P&L, R&D, purchasing/procurement, finance/accounting, and customer-related sales along with business development. 
 
**Main Duties & Responsibilities:** 
**Production:**

* Tracking operating efficiencies.
* Managing labor expenditures.
* Reducing scrap.
* Continuously improving production thru Kaizen events, Kanban systems, SMED workshops.
* Strong adherence to 5-S principles.
* Define, research and specify any new equipment needs.
* Specify layouts for all new tooling requirements with a focus on material utilization and profitability.

**Quality/Service:**

* Instill a facility-wide commitment to 100% on-time delivery of all products.
* Implement, follow and continuously improve corporate and facility QMS.
* Consistently reduce annual PPM rate.

**Sales:**

* Identifying new business, both organically and through new contacts.
* Visit existing customers on a regular basis to maintain positive communication with OEM buyers, production leaders, design engineers and quality engineers.
* Provide return of all requested quotes in less than 24 hours of receipt.

**Finance:**

* Create cost and payback analysis for new capital asset requests.
* Maintain facility asset list.

**Safety:**

* Demonstrate the leadership required to maintain an accident-free facility.
* Facilitate monthly safety training for all employees per corporate and OSHA requirements.

**Materials/Inventory:**

* Ensure inventory is maintained with a focus on 8 turns annually.
* Ensure all BOM are up to date and accurate per the costing process.
* Specifying new material requirements.
* Negotiating with raw material suppliers to maintain a positive costing position.

**Required Qualification & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* 5+ years’ management experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience and/or understanding of the Aerospace supply industry preferred.
* Experience working within a documented quality system.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel.
* Experience with Lean Application Methodologies.
* CAD experience preferred.
* Understanding of the OEM market drivers and pressures preferred.
* Knowledge of converting processes and techniques preferred.
* Operational understanding of ISO/AS9100.
* Travel up to 25%.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

* Directly supervises all department heads in the facility**.** Responsibilities include **i**nterviewing, hiring, training, planning, directing work, appraising performance, addressing complaints and resolving problems.

**Physical Demands:**

* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, and climb or balance.

records.title: Power Plant Manager - Homer City
records.description:
Joining Kyuden Energy Partners means you’ll be joining a team in which employees are recognized as the backbone of the company. We offer a competitive benefits package that includes a 401K and provides a range of benefit options covering your wellness needs.
 
 
At Kyuden Energy Partners, diversity, respect, and inclusion are not simply initiatives, they are a commitment from the entire organization, treating everyone with respect, valuing people’s differences, and empowering everyone to have a voice.
 
 
Kyuden Energy Partners provides operations, maintenance, management, and power support services to the US Power Generation Industry across the United States. Our team is comprised of experts from diverse backgrounds of technical fields, including power operations, engineering, asset management, as well as finance, human resources, administration, safety and environmental. With this diverse background coupled with extensive years of employee experience, we provide exceptional operations, maintenance, management, and development expertise to a variety of power assets.
 
 
Kyuden Energy Partners Corporation (KEPC) has a career opportunity for a Power Plant Manager in Homer City, PA. The successful candidate will oversee all plant operations, maintenance, and facility functions, ensuring the safe, reliable, and efficient operation while meeting performance, uptime, and client requirements.
 
 
Job Summary
 
The Plant Manager is responsible for directing all Operations and Maintenance (O&M) activities at the plant. The Plant Manager assures that an adequate supply of manpower, tools, equipment, and spare parts are always available to provide for the safe and efficient operation of the plant. The Plant Manager assures that the plant is operated in compliance with applicable safety, environmental, and power generating requirements.
 
 
The Plant Manager determines own practices and procedures, contributing to the development of new concepts, and performing duties independently with only general directions given. Decisions are made within policy constraints. The Plant Manager encounters new and varied work situations, extremely complex in nature. This is in conjunction with Kyuden Energy Partners Corporation (KEPC) and Owner policies and with the approval of the KEPC Chief Operating Officer or KEPC Director of Ops and the Owner's site representative.
 
 
The Plant Manager is accountable for the plant's long-range planning. The Plant Manager must effectively communicate information to the Director of Operations, Plant Supervisors, and client representatives relative to the overall operations of the plant. The Plant Manager must perform duties and ensure all plant personnel are performing duties in a safe manner resulting in no accidents, in compliance with all environmental permits at all times and in compliance with the applicable NERC Standards. The Plant Manager must perform duties, and ensure all plant personnel are performing duties, in such a way to result in an optimum cost-benefit ratio.
 
 
All employees have the responsibility to both the customer and their co-workers to do the job right the first time and to ensure the customer's needs are met.
 
 
Job Functions
 

* Responsible for ensuring that all plant personnel and plant objectives are aligned with client requirements.
* Administration and compliance with plant Safety, Operations, NERC, Maintenance, Administrative, Training, Chemistry and Environmental programs and ensure the safe, efficient, and reliable operation of the plant.
* Manage and oversee the performance of planned and unplanned plant outages.
* Implement training and qualification programs to assure that plant personnel are fully qualified to operate and maintain the facility and plant procedures are understood and properly followed by all plant personnel.
* Conduct periodic reviews of plant policies and procedures to ensure that they reflect current plant operating requirements.
* Direct the sourcing, screening, and hiring of new or replacement personnel as needed.
* Verify that the certification status of affected operation and maintenance personnel is maintained current.
* Provide leadership, coaching, mentoring, and development opportunities to plant personnel and ensure that the morale and motivation of plant personnel is always maintained at a high level.
* Develop a succession plan for key positions.
* Oversee the preparation of required client and utility reports, budgets, environmental compliance reports, etc.
* The Plant Manager supervises all site staff and has oversight responsibility for all contract work performed on behalf of the site (remote/on-site).
* The Plant Manager is the single point of contact between KEPC and the Owner on all matters pertaining to the operation and maintenance of the plant. The Plant Manager cooperates with other KEPC division managers as needed.
* The statements contained in this job description are not necessarily all inclusive; additional duties may be assigned, and requirements may vary from time to time.

Education and Experience – An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience will be considered.
 

* Bachelor of Science degree in engineering or equivalent field required.
* 10+ years of power plant or similar industry experience required.
* At least 10 years of experience supervising technical, supervisory, and administrative personnel.
* Must have 5 years’ experience in Gas Turbines or as a Power Plant Manager in another generation source.
* Strong leadership and motivational skills required.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities - which may be representative, but not all-inclusive of those commonly associated with this position.
 

* Must possess basic math skills, good verbal communications skills, and be proficient with the use of power and precision tools.
* Must be cooperative with those he/she contacts in this work and have the ability to work without direct supervision.
* Must know the hazards involved and the safety precautions to be practiced in the operation and maintenance of power plant equipment and machinery.
* Work within and insure strict adherence to all safety practices and procedures.
* Must be able to respond to audio alarms and variations of sound.
* Proficient data entry/computer skills.
* Work as a team. Must be able to pool our knowledge and energy to work in tandem to completely understand and productively respond to all business challenges.

Work Environment – Environmental or atmospheric conditions commonly associated with the performance of the functions of this job.
 

* Protective equipment such as hard hats, safety glasses, air masks, ear protection, chemical suits, hot gloves, high voltage protective equipment and other equipment must be worn in the performance of some duties.
* Work with hazardous materials may be required.
* Requires working extended working hours with weekend and holiday work as required by workload and plant conditions. On call status (day and night).
* Includes working indoors and outdoors.

Physical Abilities - that are commonly associated with the performance of the functions of this job. The physical demands described below represent those that an employee must meet to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.
 

* Physical requirements include possibility of working on foot for extensive periods, requiring stairs and ladder climbing; and routinely lifting 50 pounds.
* All employees will participate in the Fitness for Duty Program. This program includes a post offer physical examination and drug screening and post-employment random drug screening.
* There are extensive smoking restrictions in and around the facility.
* Must be able to work in elevated areas, confined spaces and in extreme heat and cold conditions.
* This role is not open to receiving agency candidates or 3rd Party recruiters; no contingency candidate submissions will be accepted.

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying this position. Employees may be required to follow other job-related instructions and to perform other job-related duties as requested, subject to all applicable state and federal laws. Certain job functions described herein may be subject to possible modification in accordance with applicable state and federal laws.
 
 
Kyuden Energy Partners is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating a diverse, inclusive environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, marital status, age, sex, or any other status protected by applicable law.

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
As a leader and innovator in the snack food industry for over 50 years, J&J Snack Foods provides branded snack foods to foodservice and retail supermarket outlets across the U.S. Its products include such icons as SUPERPRETZEL, ICEE, and Dippin' Dots along with other key brands like LUIGI'S Real Italian Ice, The Funnel Cake Factory Funnel Cakes, and Hola Churros. J&J also has a strong presence in bakery providing cakes, cookies, and pies to some of the largest grocery and convenience retailers in industry. Our company continues to deliver record sales led by a talented team and a commitment to "Fun Served Here".

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

Reporting to the Senior Director of Plant Operations, the Plant Manager serves as the senior leader responsible for the overall operational performance of a high-volume snack food manufacturing plant. This role oversees all day-to-day plant activities and is accountable for safety, quality, service, cost, people, and culture. The Plant Manager leads cross-functional teams across production, maintenance, quality, warehouse, planning, and sanitation to ensure the efficient production of high-quality products in alignment with company standards and financial targets. This position combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution, translating company objectives into daily plant operations while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement. The Plant Manager plays a critical role in delivering the production plan, enhancing productivity and profitability, and fostering a safe, engaged, and high-performing workforce.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS****:**

* Leads and manages all aspects of plant operations, including production, maintenance, quality, warehouse, planning, and sanitation, to ensure the safe, efficient, and timely manufacturing of high-quality products.

* Establishes and sustains a strong safety culture by promoting a zero-injury mindset; ensure full compliance with all OSHA, FDA, GMP, HACCP, and environmental regulations through proactive programs, audits, and corrective actions.

* Delivers the production plan on time and in full by optimizing operational performance, including OEE, labor efficiency, yield, and waste reduction, while identifying and eliminating constraints and bottlenecks.

* Partners with Quality to uphold the highest food safety and product standards; ensure adherence to all quality systems, maintain audit readiness, and lead root cause analysis and corrective actions for quality deviations.

* Builds, leads, and develops a high-performing team by recruiting, training, and coaching supervisors and frontline employees; fosters a culture of accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement, while supporting succession planning and positive employee/labor relations.

* Owns and manages the plant's financial performance, including the operating budget, labor and overtime costs, waste, and conversion costs; monitor expenditures and drive cost-effective operations aligned with business objectives.

* Champions continuous improvement initiatives by implementing Lean manufacturing principles, 5S, and structured problem-solving methodologies; lead kaizen events and leverage data and KPIs to drive performance and decision-making.

* Ensures equipment reliability and optimal facility performance through strong partnership with maintenance; oversee preventive maintenance programs and manage capital improvement projects to support operational efficiency and long-term growth.

* Collaborates cross-functionally with Planning, Procurement, Engineering, Quality, and Distribution to align materials, staffing, and maintenance plans with production needs, including support for new product introductions and process changes.

* Tracks, analyzes, and reports key performance indicators related to safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people; communicate performance and improvement plans effectively to senior leadership.

* Performs other duties and special projects assigned to support plant operations and organizational objectives.

**COMPETENCIES:**

To perform this job successfully, the Plant Manager must be self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to solve problems while staying focused on priorities. The following knowledge, skills, and abilities are required:

* Excellent planning, organizational, and time-management skills, with the ability to balance production and maintenance priorities.

* Proven leadership and team-building abilities, including advanced coaching, employee development, and motivation skills.

* Exceptional interpersonal, communication, and active listening skills.

* Adaptable and flexible, able to navigate change and respond to evolving operational needs.

* Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving capabilities.

* Collaborative, with the ability to lead team-based decision-making processes.

* Highly motivated, results-oriented, and driven to achieve operational excellence.

* Alignment with and passion for the company's mission, vision, values, and operating principles.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business Management, or a related field; Master's degree preferred. Equivalent experience will also be considered.

* Minimum of 7–10+ years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing, preferably in CPG or food production, with prior experience leading a plant or large production operation.

* Proven track record in safety management, including implementing and enforcing safety systems and ensuring compliance with OSHA and other regulatory standards.

* Extensive experience managing food quality systems and adhering to GMP and other industry requirements.

* Strong operational knowledge of manufacturing processes, maintenance, and engineering principles, with demonstrated practical application.

* Experience managing budgets, expenses, and cost performance, with solid financial and accounting understanding.

* Hands-on experience with continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean, 5S, Six Sigma (Green or Black Belt preferred), or similar process improvement frameworks.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with enterprise systems such as SAP or JD Edwards is a plus.

Disclaimer: This position description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the team member. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

EEO Statement: J&J Snack Foods Corp.is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discriminatory employment actions against, and treatment of, employees and applicants for employment based on actual or perceived Federal, State and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination on the basis of race, color, age, national origin, ethnicity, alienage, religion or creed, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship, genetic disposition or characteristics, disability or veteran's status, sex offenses, prior record of arrest or conviction, genetic information or predisposing genetic characteristic, status as a victim or witness of domestic violence, sex offenses or stalking and unemployment status.

records.description:
**Job Description:** We are seeking a hands-on Plant Manager to lead all plant operations at Gates Washer. If you are a production manager, operations manager, or senior supervisor who understands the production and financial side of manufacturing and is ready to step up and run a plant, this is the right fit for you. This is the senior operations role at our facility, for someone who spends time on the floor, sets clear expectations, and builds a strong team. You will be responsible for quality, on-time delivery, productivity, and manufacturing costs.

**About our Company:**

**Who we are:** Gates Washer and Manufacturing Company, located right next to Chicago O’Hare and established in 1927, is a prominent name in specialty washers and light stampings. Our customers in the automotive, industrial, and aerospace sectors trust us for reliable products. With advanced automatic punch presses and our own tool room, we produce a wide range of parts from various metals and materials.

**Responsibilities:**

**Lead the Plant:** Manage all plant departments: punch presses, tool room, maintenance, tumbling, secondary operations, packaging, quality, shipping and receiving, and inventory.

**Run Daily Production:** Own the production schedule and daily priorities, balance labor and machine capacity, and keep work flowing to ship on time.

**Quality:** Serve as head of quality. Reduce scrap, rework, and customer returns, and make sure every job meets specification.

**People:** Hire, train, review, and when necessary let go of staff. Build cross-training and a bench of people for key positions.

**Cost and Budget:** Be responsible for parts of the P&L, including manufacturing expenses, labor, and productivity.

**Safety and Facility:** Own plant safety and compliance, keep equipment and the building maintained, and recommend equipment investments.

**Customers and Teamwork:** Work with sales and purchasing on quoting, material, and delivery dates, and deal directly with customers on quality and delivery issues.

**Reporting:** Report plant performance to ownership: on-time delivery, quality, productivity, and cost against budget.

**Continuous Improvement:** Write and maintain procedures, improve changeovers and uptime, and get the most out of our equipment.

**Skills and Qualifications:**

* 10 or more years in metal manufacturing, stamping, and fabrication. Machine shop or automotive supplier experience also considered.
* 5 or more years leading people, including at least 2 to 3 years managing a team of 10 or more.
* Working knowledge of tooling, dies, and tool room practices.
* Hands-on quality experience under a formal system such as ISO 9001.
* Experience managing budget or manufacturing costs.
* Experience hiring, reviewing, and managing performance.
* Comfortable with production metrics and an ERP or scheduling system.
* Stamping or punch press experience is preferred but not required.
* A degree is preferred but not required.
* Applicants must be legally eligible to work in the country.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

**Base Salary:** $125,000–$130,000 per year.

**Annual Performance Bonus: $15,000–$20,000**

.

**Long-Term Incentive Bonus:**

Share in the company's growth and success. If Gates increases in value over the next five years, you receive a share of that increase, with the potential for a six-figure payout.

Pay: $125,000.00 - $130,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* Plant management: 3 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

records.description:
Select Milk Producers is one of the nation’s largest and most progressive dairy cooperatives, with 32 wholly owned subsidiaries, 8 processing plants, and 8 joint ventures including Continental Dairy Facilities, Continental Dairy Facilities Southwest, Mill Haven Foods, Select Custom Solutions, GreenLink and Select Services. With over 800 employees, the Select Milk family of companies impacts all aspects of the dairy farm business and at the heart of our family of companies, is you.

"We strive to go above and beyond what’s expected in providing for our families, leading our employees, caring for our land and animals, serving our customers, producing quality milk, and serving one another. This commitment is more than our business, it’s in our culture and our character. We believe in being accountable, in doing what’s right, in performing at our best, in setting a higher standard."

Select Milk Producers and its subsidiaries offer an attractive compensation and a best-in-class benefits package that includes but is not limited medical, vision, dental, life insurance and more that can be tailored for you and your family. Other benefits for eligible employees include 401(k) up to 6% company match, life and disability insurance, and paid holidays & vacation. We are proud to promote an equal employment opportunity workplace.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Plant Operations: Review daily inventories and plan daily production. Conduct daily staff meetings to coordinate daily plant activities. Review daily load out schedule and coordinate with staff and milk movement personnel. Review daily production efficiencies and production reports. Review companies KPI’s, plant loss and assist in setting goals. Reports directly to the Director of Operations.
* Plant Quality: Review microbiology test results daily and direct further investigation of high counts. Review list of any out-of-spec. product with Food Safety Quality Assurance (FSQA) Manager. Review all product C of A's.
* Plant Audits: Check each department daily. Check employee GMP’s. Review daily report of audits. Assist Quality Assurance with all plant audits.
* Industrial Wastewater: Check wastewater facility daily. Review daily reports as required.
* Sanitation: Review CIP records daily. Review random equipment checks with chemical account representative.
* Plant Employees: Audit sampling techniques and sanitation practices. Monitor production departments throughout shift and assure employee compliance with GMP’s, sanitation and safety. Provide training as needed. Provide annual GMP and HACCP training.
* Purchasing: Review and approve order supplies. Track purchases and prepare appropriate paperwork.
* Equipment: Verify that all plant equipment is in good working condition and all preventative maintenance is being performed on a scheduled basis. Review and approve all work orders. Review all daily maintenance activity reports. Develop capital justifications to update equipment as needed.
* Environmental: Review of Air Quality annual reports. Review and coordinate completion of Annual Form R for EPA/Health Department. Review and coordinate completion of Annual Hazardous Materials Inventory and Business Plan. Perform other duties, as necessary.
* Safety: Review Safety program and training with EHS management. Daily observation during plant audit will include safety. Check each department and observe employee safety procedures. Member of the Food Safety Team and Food Quality Team.
* Leadership: Utilize Code of Conduct and core values to drive development and growth opportunities for all team members.
* Support a company culture of continuous improvement by participating in efficiency and improvement efforts.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**:

* This position has management and employee supervisory responsibilities for the entire facility in the area of discipline, hiring, and firing.
* Review on the job training reviews.
* Coordinate on the job training.
* Oversee adherence to company policies and procedures.
* Oversee scheduling of management, employees, and temporary labor.
* Have the responsibility of reviewing timesheets, overtime and approve payroll.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES REQUIRED:**

* An individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* Must have the ability to trouble shoot problems and be persistent until a solution is found.
* Must work in a safe manner and follow all safety procedures including use of safety equipment.
* Must be willing to ask for assistance when the process is unclear.
* Proficient in verbal and written communication skills. Must be able to communicate with upper management on a daily basis.
* Leadership, team development, coaching, and / or teaching experience.
* Good math and statistical skills.
* Excellent computer skills for data input, report writing, program tracking.
* Excellent organizational and follow through skills.

**EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Dairy or Food Science and four years of experience in a Plant leadership role in a Dairy or Food Manufacturing facility is strongly desired.

records.title: Sand Plant Manager
records.description:
**Job Description:** 
Responsible for the management of all aspects of a sand mining and production facility. This position will utilize budgets, production goals, and effective communication. Safety must be a top priority. 
 
**Job Requirements:** 
**ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** 
 
Direct the following department personnel to ensure safety and productivity is achieved. 
1. Mine Team 
2. Wash Operators 
3. Dry Plant Operators 
4. Quality/Lab 
5. Maintenance

* Efficiently schedule and supervise hourly personnel for weekly operations, monitor timecards, vacations, and control overtime.
* Work with corporate HR department on staffing needs and employee issues.
* Handle discipline and grievances, as required, while maintaining acceptable labor and employee relations.
* Accurately collect, review, and forward operating data, such as mine, wash, and dry plant production reports.
* Assist HSE Coordinator in collecting the necessary data for MSHA and DNR reports.
* Communicate effectively and timely with owners, corporate directors, and/or other management of problems or potential problems that affect the proper operation of the plant. Problems may include personnel, equipment, transportation, quality, or raw materials.
* Direct activities safely to achieve optimum rates of productivity consistent with long/short range goals
* Direct and coordinate plant/mine related projects with Director of Mining
* Assisting in the preparation of capital projects and plan, and their completion • Direct and oversee activities performed by subcontractors.
* Monitor the mine operation to ensure compliance with all regulations concerning air emissions, water discharge, erosion and sedimentation control.
* Assist, implement, and comply with ISO 9001 quality program.
* Review quality reports daily and ensure quality standards are being followed.
* Evaluate with the EHS Coordinator the company’s training program and conditions in the plant, creating a culture of safety that exceeds MSHA guidelines and regulations.
* Ensure safety and good housekeeping by being active in all programs.
* Recommend and/or purchase materials and supplies as necessary, utilizing corporate purchasing department. Recommend equipment and process modifications to improve efficiencies.
* Ensure work standards, policies, plans, and procedures are enforced. Support management’s policies and programs.

**ADDITIONAL REQUIRMENTS**

* Team-oriented, an effective communicator (verbal and written), able to offer technical expertise and guidance, and have the ability and willingness to build rapport with department team members and external departments.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and set priorities appropriately.
* Understanding our company functions as a cohesive operation, and often employees serve in many roles and various functions or capacities.
* Develop working relationships with other corporate personnel and plants.
* Maintain open communications with subordinates, peers, and superiors.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s Degree, in Business Management or related field
* 3 to 5 years of related experience in a position of leadership, Surface Mining Experience preferred
* Valid driver’s license required.
* Advanced experience working with MSHA Safety and Environmental competency
* Supervisory skills
* Budgetary skills - Capital planning and projects
* Short and long-term planning and scheduling
* Leadership Skills

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Pass toxicity test.
* Medical clearance to wear respiratory protection.
* Team?oriented, effective communicator (verbal and written), able to offer technical expertise and guidance, and
* have the ability and willingness to build rapport with team members and external agencies.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and set priorities appropriately.
* Willingness to further training or education, if requested.
