records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
**Company Description**

Sirtex Medical is a global leader in healthcare, with offices in the U.S., Australia, Germany, and Singapore, dedicated to improving patient outcomes.

Our mission is to be at the forefront of minimally invasive cancer and embolization therapies. By partnering with physicians, we aim to provide innovative products that enhance patient outcomes and simplify treatments. Achieving this ambitious goal requires passionate and talented individuals who are committed to making a difference. Our flagship product, SIR-Spheres® Y-90 resin microspheres, is a targeted radiation therapy for liver cancer. To date, we have delivered over >150K doses across 50+ countries, significantly impacting patients' lives worldwide. Our success is fueled by our dedication to serving the medical community, maintaining professionalism, fostering a collaborative work culture, nurturing an entrepreneurial spirit, and continuously pursuing innovation and improvement.

At Sirtex, we are committed to creating a great workplace. We offer a range of benefits, programs, and services to support our employees, ensuring they have opportunities to contribute to our success and advance their careers. Join our inclusive community, where you can collaborate with talented colleagues, bring your ideas to life, and advance your career, all while delivering innovative healthcare solutions to patients.

 **Job Description**

**SCOPE:**

The Wilmington plant is the largest of 3 global Sirtex manufacturing site and serves as the principal production site of both SIR-Spheres microspheres and Lava product lines. The Plant Manager is responsible for leading the sites manufacturing operations, engineering, warehouse and product distribution.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

 

* Develop and lead execution of the site manufacturing strategy for both the SIR-Spheres and Lava value streams. Align site goals with Senior Leadership and Corporate objectives.
* Team Performance Management: lead, develop and mentor manufacturing team members.
* Manage production schedules, ensuring resource availability and capacity to meet demand, working closely with the Supply Chain team, using optimal schedules to minimize overall costs.
* Lead Continuous Improvement efforts, identifying process, equipment, product, and other opportunities, that reduce cost, improve quality and safety at the site.
* Full responsibility for developing and managing to site budget.
* Ensure resource and equipment capacity to ensure efficient and reliable manufacturing.
* Set site target KPI’s managing OEE, Labor Efficiency, Scrap, Equipment Utilization, etc.
* Ensure product is built to specification and in compliance with all Quality System requirements.
* Manage the site engineering team to ensure equipment and processes are robust and meet all manufacturing requirements. Manage PM strategy and ensure that execution is completed on time.
* Support the Quality Department, working with on site Quality team members to ensure that compliance with all areas of the Sirtex QMS are being followed. Identify opportunities for improvement and work to implement them directly in the QMS.
* Work in conjunction with HSE/Facilities Department to ensure a safe working environment for all employees and that the facilities is maintained, and compliant with regulatory requirements for both the handling of radioactive materials and medical device manufacturing.
* Manage all shipping, receiving and warehousing activities. Ensure timely material receipt, inventory accuracy is maintained, and products are shipped on time.

 
**Qualifications**

**EDUCATIONAL PREREQUISITES AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related discipline such as Chemistry or Biomedical field
* 5+ Years experience working in medical device or pharmaceutical industry preferred.
* Prior experience working with radioisotopes preferred.
* 3+ years of site management experience, with 10+ years of leadership experience.
* 6 Sigma Green belt preferred. Experience using 5S and Lean principles is preferred.

The anticipated annual base salary range and target bonus opportunity is $136,000 to $171,000 annually, plus a 15% target annual bonus.

The final position level and compensation will be determined based on non-discriminatory, job-related factors, including geographic location, skills, experience, education, and alignment with the position requirements. In addition to base salary and bonus eligibility, Sirtex offers a comprehensive benefits package, including paid sick and vacation time, medical, dental, vision and life insurance, and a generous 401(k) matching program and other benefits, subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.

 **Additional Information**

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines

Do you want to be part of something bigger? A team whose impact stretches across the globe making a real difference to the quality of people’s lives. Sirtex recognizes that well-being, financial health, and work-life balance are crucial for our employees to achieve personal success.

Sirtex offers qualified candidates:

* Diverse and flexible work arrangements to achieve the optimum balance between work and personal responsibilities.
* A culture of respect, diversity, collaboration, and innovation fostering inclusiveness and superior performance.
* Attractive compensation and benefit packages which are practical, robust and equitable.
* A commitment to support ongoing professional growth through career development, on the job experiences and training opportunities.
* Challenging work which supports the development of new and better ways to improve clinical outcomes for oncology treatment around the world.
* An unwavering commitment to company values, employee safety and excellence in everything we do.

Diversity drives innovation; inclusion fosters belonging, growth and success. Sirtex believes that it takes multiple perspectives and voices to create a culture and workplace which fosters engagement, teamwork, and employee satisfaction to perform our best and deliver on commitments. We are dedicated to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, included, and can share their ideas so that we can exceed even our own expectations.

Sirtex is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Sirtex will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities, in accordance with applicable law.

records.title: Plant Manager - Little Chute
records.description:
Description:

**POSITION SUMMARY & KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY:**

The Plant Manager is responsible for leading all operational and financial activities and directly interacting and collaborating with all internal/external stakeholders and support departments. The Plant Manager will develop and execute long and short-term initiatives aligned to our broader business goals as an innovative label solutions partner.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Ensure compliance and engagement with all Environmental, Health and Safety (EHS) policies and procedures.
* Drive site performance by monitoring and managing key business metrics, including Safety, Quality, Delivery, Productivity, Cost, Inventory, and Employee Engagement.
* Actively lead in EHS, training, safety observations, hazard identification, and safety committees
* Foster, develop, and implement Continuous Improvement (CI) activities through all facets of the business
* Full Profit & Loss (P&L) statement responsibility
* Strategic planning including capital investments, budgets, staffing, and capacity. Additional support to Sales, Estimating, and R&D on strategic planning
* Lead daily production activities by monitoring performance against targets and provide support in attaining levels of expected performance
* Lead and develop leaders to achieve established goals of safety, quality, service, production, and cost
* Ensure the plant has the necessary tools and training to successfully and efficiently meet their goals
* Provide direction and guidance to the team through coaching and counseling; motivate, empower, develop and recognize individual and team achievements
* Develop & implement best in class training programs
* Support development and roll out of Standard Work including Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Work Instructions (WI), One Point Lessons, (OPL) and Training Documentation
* Works closely with Planning, Quality, HR, Logistics, Engineering, Maintenance, and EHS to ensure proper production planning and utilization of resources on the right priorities to meet customer requirements
* Reviews daily production schedule to plan work and coworker’s assignments. Rebalance based on utilization of assets and resources.
* Provides proactive leadership, actions, and results on safety, quality, and CI topics
* Develop and implement workflow practices & policies that enhance speed and efficiency without compromising safety or product quality
* Lead the CI process utilizing operational tool sets (i.e Lean, Six Sigma, 6S, TPS, TPM.) to provide high levels of performance
* Lead coworkers in performing operations according to sound operating principles and company policies and procedures
* Provides support regarding the manufacturing process and makes recommendations regarding safety, quality, tools, equipment, costs/expenses
* Analyzes, supports, and presents results on operational and financial business goals and outcomes
* Recruit, hire, train, motivate, and develop coworkers in line with our core values and company policies and practices.
* Support our commercial teams on customer related matters
* Maintains a high standard of professional knowledge, ethics, and practices when dealing with customers, suppliers, peers, coworkers, and leadership
* Other duties as requested

Requirements:

**REQUIRED SKILLS/ABILITIES:**

* Familiar with CI, Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma and other current manufacturing concepts, practices, and procedures
* Effective verbal and written communication skills including ability to effectively train and develop others
* Ability to coordinate plant activities and create material, manufacturing and communication flow throughout the facility
* Must demonstrate excellent leadership, communication, and team building skills across direct reports as well as support departments
* Strong business acumen (leadership principles, strategic planning, critical thinking, budgeting, resource allocation, human resources, etc.)
* Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
* Experience with ERP systems

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Finance, Operations or relevant experience
* 7-15 years manufacturing experience with at least 5 years of relevant experience

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Ability to lift products up to 50 lbs.
* Ability to work in a standing position for long periods of time
* Other physical demands may include climbing, crouching, bending, reaching, stooping, etc.

**Reasonable Accommodations Statement**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable Accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Heartland Label Printers is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.**

**We participate in the federal E-Verify program to confirm the work eligibility of all new hires following an accepted job offer.**

Location:
 
DCO Operations

Address:
 
Atlantic City, NJ

Organization:
 
DCO Energy, LLC

Job Type:
 
Full-Time

Posting Date:
 
11/13/2026

SUMMARY
 

* Reporting to the Vice President of Operations, the Plant Manager is responsible for providing management direction and leadership to ensure that the energy facility is operated in a safe, reliable, and economic manner consistent with site contracts, permits, and rules and regulations.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 
 

* Operates the facility in a safe manner and ensures that a safe work environment is provided to minimize the risk of accidents and injuries.
* Compliance with all company policies, procedures, and commercial commitments
* Implement programs and activities that provide a work environment that promotes effective goal accomplishment, productivity, and morale
* Optimize plant performance through appropriate utilization manpower, equipment, supplies and external support.
* Provide coaching, training, and development opportunities for the team to ensure appropriate skill sets are maintained
* Establish procedures and controls to manage all expense activities to conform to established budgets
* Communicate effectively with the site staff, management, customers, vendors, and outside agencies
* Demonstrate effective management skills in meeting or exceeding facility goals and objectives

 
QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS

* A four-year degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering or commensurate experience is required as well demonstrated track record of successful goal achievement
* A minimum of ten (10) to fifteen (15) year’s relevant experience, with a minimum of ten years in a management position.
* A through, demonstrated knowledge of energy facility operations and maintenance as well as management methods necessary to control and improve facility performance.
* Experience managing and supervising employees operating Gas Turbine, Plant Auxiliary Equipment, and Emergency Generators.
* Experience in tracking and reporting Individuals for this position must have good verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to do reaching, climbing, lifting (up to 50 pounds), walking, and stooping.
* Ability to manage a schedule in a timely and accurate manner
* Ability to handle other administrative duties as assigned by management
* Moderate to advanced MS Outlook Excel, Powerpoint, and Word

 
PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS
 

* GOLD STEAM AND RED REFRIGERATION
* NJ STEAM AND CHILLED WATER LICENSES

 
JOB REQUIREMENTS
 
 
Demonstrated knowledge of all facets of power plant operations. Demonstrated ability to make competent decisions in emergency situations, writing operating procedures and training of other personnel. Demonstrate good verbal and written communication skills. Ability to do reaching, climbing, lifting (up to 75 pounds), walking, and stooping.

Salary Range: 140K-175K annually

records.title: Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering
records.description:
Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering

White Bear Lake, MN

**About Heraeus**

Making displays foldable? Help hearts beat with micro-particles? Work on solutions involving precious metals? As a family-owned global technology group we help our customers to always being one step ahead.

 

**About Heraeus Medevio**

Heraeus Medevio combines medical technology expertise with collaborative partnerships. Together with medical device manufacturers, we develop and implement solutions for defined applications. As part of the Heraeus Group, we support the professional development of our employees and offer opportunities for career development, depending on the role, location and operational conditions.

To reach our vision of improving 100 million lives every year, we foster a culture of curiosity that thrives on challenge, continuous learning, growth, and the opportunity to try new things. With sites in the United States, European Union, and Asia, and over 2,200 employees worldwide, together, we will meet tomorrow's challenges today.

 
**Position Summary**
 
The Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering leads the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of advanced manufacturing technology across the Americas manufacturing network, including automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing. This role owns the design, development, validation, implementation, and maintenance of automated manufacturing equipment, assembly systems, robotics, vision inspection technologies, digital manufacturing solutions, and additive manufacturing processes and equipment that support the production of medical devices. The Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering role builds and leads a team of engineering professionals across these disciplines, sets technical direction and standards, and partners closely with Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, and Supply Chain to advance productivity, quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence across multiple sites.
 
**This is an onsite position at the White Bear Lake, MN location with travel to other global manufacturing sites.**
 
**What You’ll Do Every Day:**
 

* Develop and execute the advanced manufacturing engineering roadmap (including automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing) aligned with business objectives.
* Establish long-term technology strategies to support manufacturing capacity expansion, cost reduction, and product quality improvement across the manufacturing network.
* Identify emerging technologies and evaluate opportunities for implementation, including robotics, AI-enabled inspection systems, Industry 4.0/digital manufacturing applications, advanced controls, and additive manufacturing processes and equipment.
* Lead capital equipment planning and investment strategy across automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing initiatives.
* Collaborate with Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Supply Chain, and external technology partners to enhance productivity, quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence.
* Direct a team responsible for automation engineering, controls engineering, robotics, machine vision, electrical engineering, digital manufacturing/manufacturing systems integration, and additive manufacturing.
* Build and mentor high-performing engineering teams through coaching, performance management, and talent development, while establishing engineering standards, best practices, and design methodologies across advanced manufacturing disciplines.
* Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with company policies and applicable laws, including selection, training and development, assigning work, and performance management of employees.
* Manage complex, multidisciplinary engineering projects from concept through implementation, delivering on time and within budget while meeting technical and quality requirements, and communicate progress and issues clearly to leadership to support project and site objectives.
* Manage external automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing integrators, contractors, and equipment suppliers.
* Develop and control departmental operating and capital budgets; establish project schedules, resource plans, and cost controls.
* Other duties may be assigned as required.

 
**What We’re Looking For:**
 

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, or Industrial Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field required; Master’s degree in Engineering, MBA, or related discipline preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in automated manufacturing environments; experience in digital manufacturing and/or additive manufacturing strongly preferred.
* Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing engineering teams.
* Experience within medical device, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or other highly regulated manufacturing industries.
* Proven success leading large-scale automation, digital manufacturing, and/or additive manufacturing projects and capital equipment installations.
* Experience with equipment validation and regulatory compliance in FDA-regulated environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams across multiple sites and drive continuous improvement and digitalization initiatives.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, project management, and organizational skills.
* Ability and willingness to travel across the Americas manufacturing network (White Bear Lake, MN; Costa Rica; Puerto Rico), approximately 25-50% of the time.

 
*Medevio is committed to providing competitive total compensation and benefits packages. The expected hiring range for this position is between $160,000 and $190,000 based upon a full-time schedule. This is a good faith estimate on the applicable range. Base salaries are determined by taking a variety of factors in account, including, but not limited to, candidate qualifications, geographic locations, market conditions and internal equity. This position is bonus eligible, with a target bonus of 20%. Our total compensation package includes eligibility for comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with company match, education reimbursement, paid parental leave and paid time off.*

records.title: Director of Operations - Aiken, SC
records.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

The Director of Operations is responsible for the activities of manufacturing, purchasing, quality, planning (supply chain), and project management of the organization and aids in formulating and administering organization policies.

#LI-SL1

**A Day In The Life**
---------------------

Every day at Hubbell is different and you’ll contribute in many ways. On any given day, you’ll make a difference by:

* Participating in formulating/administering company policies and developing long range goals/objectives.
* Directing/coordinating activities of the responsible departments on a day-to-day basis to ensure that daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual objectives are met.
* Ensuring internal auditing for compliance with the ISO standards applicable.
* Driving cost reduction (productivity) planning and execution in accordance with the financial plan.
* Providing authorization for funds to ensure responsible fiduciary spending in accordance with financial policies.
* Reviewing/analyzing activities related to costs, operations, CAPEX, and forecast data to determine progress toward financial goals and objectives and considering the long-range impact of growing the business and adjusting actions to ensure compliance.
* Overseeing the budget/forecast processes as well as ongoing monitoring to ensure compliance.
* Conferring with other senior personnel to review achievements and discuss required changes in goals or objectives resulting from current status/conditions.
* Developing plans and executing actions to meet the decision upon actions.
* Providing oversight and coordination to other business in Operations related matters to drive consistency among the businesses.
* Participating in due diligence process as requested.
* Developing succession planning strategies in coordination with HR to ensure continuation of leadership/individual contributor roles going forward.

**What will help you thrive in this role?**
-------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Management, Industrial Engineering, or related field
* Master’s Degree in Business Administration (required)
* 20+ years of relevant operations experience (required)
* 20+ years of experience as a Senior Plant Manager, Operations Manager, or a similar role, preferably in a heavy manufacturing environment with multi-site responsibility
* 10+ years of experience with TPM and SAP
* Welding, Fabricating, Warehouse & Logistics experience
* Operational Excellence or Lean Certification
* Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing
* Staff development and engagement skills
* Bi-lingual Spanish/English preferred

**Hubbell Incorporated**

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

**Hubbell Utility Solutions**

Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible.

Hubbell Incorporated, its subsidiaries and affiliates, is an EO Employer AA: M/F/Veteran/Disability. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other protected class.

The above summary of position responsibilities and requirements is not intended, and should not be construed, to be an exhaustive list of duties, skills, efforts, physical requirements, or working conditions associated with the position. It is intended to be an accurate reflection of those principal position elements essential for making decisions related to position performance, employee development, and compensation.

records.description:
**NORESCO, an OPTERRA Company**, helps customers modernize aging building systems and upgrade energy and water infrastructure to meet evolving demands. We implement innovative energy efficiency, distributed generation, energy storage, and renewable energy solutions that optimize the operational efficiency and improve resilience of buildings, campuses, military installations, and communities.

We are seeking an on-site Project Manager to oversee all preventive, corrective, and major maintenance activities (including repair and replacement work) at NORESCO’s 40 MW electric and thermal production facility at Yokosuka Naval Base, Japan. The cogeneration plant (CGS) is a critical asset for the base and daily operations are conducted by Navy personnel in partnership with NORESCO and our subcontractors.

NORESCO constructed the plant, which generates 50Hz and 60Hz power as well as a combination of Soft and Pure Steam, in 2008 under a Federal Energy Savings Performance Contract (ESPC). The plant pays for itself out of energy savings which NORESCO has guaranteed for the past 18 years. In order to meet our savings and availability guarantees, we employ a robust preventive maintenance program which relies heavily on Long Term Service Agreements (LTSAs) for all major pieces of equipment.

This is a Senior level position reporting to NORESCO’s Operations Manager and is administered through a 3 to 5 year International Assignment Agreement (IAA). This agreement is negotiated with each of our employees working Outside of the Continental Unites States (OCONUS). The agreement includes consideration for overseas pay, benefits, healthcare, housing, food, travel, vacation, stateside visits, relocation, etc., and is customized to the unique requirements of each new hire.

You will be the primary liaison between our NAVY customers, Japanese operators and subcontractors, as well as NORESCO team to ensure contractual obligations are met. While many of the team members in Japan speak English or are Bi-Lingual, some are not. Translators are available to facilitate conversations or process written correspondence as necessary. Japan is an amazing culture with many unique customs and protocols, a willingness to learn and adapt to their approach is an important part of your success.

It is of utmost importance for you to possess good listening, communication, and computer skills in addition to being proactive, organized, and having a bias for action. The Yokosuka Project Manager is supported by (and in-turn supports) many other NORESCO departments; Development, Engineering, Commissioning, O&M, M&V, Accounting, Legal, etc. Cross-functional technical skills, adaptability, versatility, and a quest for continuous learning and integration of advances are key in this position.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Overall contractual responsibility for plant maintenance and repair activities through careful management of Long-Term Service Agreements (LTSAs) and work orders.
* Ensuring subcontractor work is performed in a safe and professional manner with materials that meet or exceed applicable Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and Regulatory standards.
* Participate in scheduled operations meetings and coordinate upcoming maintenance activities within the defined expectations and constraints of the customer and subcontractor availability.
* Prepare and distribute standard monthly reports (that summarize operations, maintenance, and repair activities) to NORESCO management, key customer contacts, and other stakeholders.
* Review plant operations logs, alarms, and performance data on a regular basis to evaluate equipment condition, collaborate with NORESCO team to identify potential issues.
* Perform plant inspections and safety walkthroughs during regular operations, confirm changes in equipment line-up, and subcontractor compliance with typical maintenance activities.
* Support Profit and Loss (P&L) management; assist with generating and maintaining the annual budget; capital expenditure planning; monthly forecasts, accruals, and variance analysis with development of recovery plans as needed to deliver the target revenue and profit.
* Review service agreements/proposals with manager; generate purchase orders as required; provide initial review and approval of invoices for materials and services.
* Collaborate with LTSA contractors to plan work and identify resources required for shutdown tasks such as parts, tooling, equipment, materials, and work procedures. Review and confirm subcontractors’ detailed work plans meet the customer and project needs.
* Maintain NORESCO’s Computer Maintenance Management System (CMMS) to generate reports for maintenance schedules, completion status reports, equipment histories, and forecasts.
* Coordinate with subcontractors, visitors and customers to ensure protocols are followed on matters related to site access, security clearance, safety measures, and work permits.
* Monitor warranty programs to ensure the planned and required coverage is maintained by complying with all warranty requirements. Ensure warranty work is claimed in a timely manner, and all warranty issues are resolved to minimize out of pocket expenses.
* Monitor and analyze facility performance and host data for equipment and systems condition assessments. Review finings with Operations Manger and adjust maintenance plans accordingly.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelors degree, Associates degree, or equivalent Technical Training (ex; Navy Nuclear)
* 5+ years of experience in one of the following fields; electric power generation, cogeneration, industrial utility, or district energy industry with strong working knowledge of equipment
* Ability to obtain a Federal Security Clearance for work at Government facilities.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**:

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, project management discipline or equivalent experience
* High level communication, leadership, technical, and project management skills.
* Strong sense of ownership and focus on maintaining; a Safe work environment, Uninterrupted Plant operations, Quality control, Project schedule, Resolving issues in a timely manner, and consistently meeting deadlines and commitments.
* Graduate degree in engineering or business administration
* Strong interest in engaging operators, customers, and partners to grow relationships.
* Advanced knowledge of one or more facets of Engineering or Central Plants operations; design principles, technologies, equipment maintenance and troubleshooting.
* Energy optimization, utility rates, energy costs, applicable codes, design guides, and standards.
* Robust combination of business acumen, risk management, and strategic thinking skills.
* US military or DOD project management experience, Japanese language skills, and international work experience are a plus.

**Physical requirements include:**

* Ability to climb stairs and fixed ladders.
* Ability to access rooftops and elevated work areas while following safety protocols.
* Ability to work at heights and in confined or industrial environments as required.
* Ability to maintain balance and mobility while navigating mechanical, utility, and production areas.

**Compensation:**

* $130,000 – $150,000 per year, depending on experience + bonuses

**Benefits:**

* HSA Medical insurance, with a choice of 2 buy-up options
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* 100% Safe Harbor 401(k) match
* 100% company paid Life insurance
* 100% company paid Long-term Disability insurance
* Short-term Disability insurance
* Flexible Spending Account
* Commuter Benefits
* Legal and Identity Protection
* Pet Insurance Coverage
* Fertility and Reproductive Health
* Generous Paid Time Off, including Holiday, Vacation, and Sick Pay

records.title: Senior Manager Quality
records.description:
**We believe that great healthcare is an essential safeguard of human dignity.**

At Laborie, we know the work we do matters – it’s what fuels our motivation and contributes to our success. If you’re ready to make a positive impact in the lives of patients across the globe, we’d like to meet you.

We support and empower our employees to grow their careers in an environment that encourages a sense of belonging and a connection to doing good. We’re not afraid to roll up our sleeves to make our goals a reality and work together to solve for our customers. We reward and recognize our employees based on our values of **Aspire to Greatness, Respect All, Own It, Working Together, Persist with Passion.**

**Who We’re Looking For:**

To ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and the Laborie Medical Quality Systems in the development, manufacturing, and marketing of Laborie Medical products. The position supports corporate wide process improvement initiatives relating to Quality and Regulatory.

**About the Role:**

* Develop and direct quality strategies, objectives, policies and procedures for assigned sites and Quality Management Systems.
* Directly responsible for the CAPA, Internal Audit, Complaint Handling and Training Systems for assigned sites and Quality Management Systems, including results against Quality Objectives related to these areas.
* Provide team leadership, development, and talent management activities including coaching, resource forecasting, hiring, performance management, training, and budgeting for the Quality Assurance and Quality Engineering functions to meet the company's objectives.
* Maintain quality standards set forth in the Laborie Medical Quality Manual(s) and those of its subsidiaries.
* Influence management and staff to encourage continuous improvement of quality and compliance.
* Proactively identify/resolve compliance risks.
* Fulfill the duties of back-up Management Representative.
* Play prominent role in acquisition due diligence and integration efforts.
* Prioritize and manage continuous improvement activities for Laborie
* Provide technical recommendations based on trend analysis to eliminate future problems and execute changes as necessary.
* Maintain compliance to all applicable regulations for the marketing of medical devices.
* Manage the CAPA process for all the company QMS’s.
* Lead auditee and serves as escort during inspections and audits performed by external regulatory bodies and internal auditors.
* Execute miscellaneous tasks, as assigned.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* BS or BA in Business Administration/Computer Sciences/Engineering or related degree
* Experience in a leadership position with direct supervision of Quality/Regulatory professionals
* Minimum 8 years’ experience working in a medically regulated industry in a Quality or Regulatory position.
* Experience with ISO13485, MDSAP, MDR, CFR820
* Experience with Project Management, Problem Solving, Six Sigma, Lean Management Systems, Root Cause Analysis, and other standard Quality tools
* Strong project management skills and attention to detail
* Excellent communication skills, cross department collaboration and leadership skills

**Why Laborie:**

Our Mission every day is to operate as a world-class specialist medical company making and advancing technologies that preserve and restore human dignity. We do that today by helping people with pelvic and gastrointestinal conditions live normal lives, and by helping mothers and babies have safe deliveries.

* Paid time off and paid volunteer time
* Medical, Dental, Vision and Flexible Spending Account
* Health Savings Account with Company Funded Contributions
* 401k Retirement Plan with Company Match
* Parental Leave and Adoption Services
* Health and Wellness Programs and Events

We are interested in a qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we will not be sponsoring work visas for this position, at this time.

*Laborie* *provides equal employment opportunities and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person’s race, color, gender, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. Laborie is committed to providing access and reasonable accommodation in our services, activities, education, and employment for individuals with disabilities.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**Position Role Type:**

Onsite

The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance

**Security Clearance Type:**

**Security Clearance Status:**

Active and existing security clearance required after day 1

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

**Raytheon Company, Managed by Collins Aerospace**

We are seeking a dedicated professional to join our team as a Senior Manager, Program Quality Leader. This onsite role, based in El Segundo, CA will support Positioning, Navigation and Timing (PNT) Avionics within Mission Systems. In this role, you will lead efforts and develop teams to effectively implement Quality & Mission Assurance (QMA) requirements across all program phases. You will serve as the primary Quality interface for customers, suppliers, and programs.

**What You Will Do**:

* Develop and lead a team of Program Quality Leads (PQLs) and Customer Quality Engineers (CQEs) to support program execution and deliverables.
* Engage with internal and external stakeholders to establish effective relationships and influence decision-making across multiple levels within a cross-functional environment at multiple sites.
* Ensure quality requirements are integrated into program estimates and proposals and oversee their consistent application.
* Lead and oversee the implementation of Quality & Mission Assurance (QMA) requirements across all phases of assigned programs.
* Serve as the primary QMA interface for customers, suppliers, and internal program teams, ensuring alignment with customer requirements and expectations.
* Drive strategic improvements to enhance quality processes, reduce defects, and improve overall program performance.
* Oversee the development and application of quality metrics to identify root causes and implement long-term corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with industry and regulatory quality standards, including ISO 9001, AS9100, and AS9102.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including program management, operations, and engineering, to ensure process capability, product conformance, and on-time delivery.
* Manage customer interface activities, including interactions with Acquisitioned Customers and Defense Contract Management Agency (DCMA).
* Support manufacturing processes by interpreting drawings, work instructions, and Bills of Materials (BOMs).
* Promote continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, reduce costs, and improve customer satisfaction.
* Must be willing and able to travel up to 10% of the time.

**Qualifications You Must Have**:

* Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and minimum 10 years of relevant experience, or an Advanced degree and minimum 7 years of relevant experience.
* Experience reviewing customer proposals and part orders for compliance risk to quality requirements, and establishing cost estimates for quality support.
* Experience leading teams in program management, quality management, operations management, or an engineering capacity.
* Experience as the direct interface to external customers.
* Experience with manufacturing processes, including quality systems and industry technical standards (ISO 9001 or AS9100), as well as interpreting drawings, work instructions, and Bills of Materials (BOMs).

**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Direct experience working with Defense Contract Management Agency (DCMA).
* Certification in Customer Oriented Results and Excellence (CORE) or similar.
* American Society for Quality (ASQ) certification.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Experience leading initiatives that result in reduced operating costs, improved quality, and enhanced customer satisfaction.
* Experience with SAP (or similar ERP systems) and with Power Apps (or similar tools).

**What We Offer Benefits**

This position may offer relocation.

Some of our competitive benefits packages include:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Three weeks of vacation for newly hired employees
* Generous 401(k) plan that includes employer matching funds and separate employer retirement contribution, including a Lifetime Income Strategy option
* Tuition reimbursement program
* Student Loan Repayment Program
* Life insurance and disability coverage
* Optional coverages you can buy pet insurance, home and auto insurance, additional life and accident insurance, critical illness insurance, group legal, ID theft protection
* Birth, adoption, parental leave benefits
* Ovia Health, fertility, and family planning
* Adoption Assistance
* Autism Benefit
* Employee Assistance Plan, including up to 10 free counseling sessions
* Healthy You Incentives, wellness rewards program
* Doctor on Demand, virtual doctor visits
* Bright Horizons, child and elder care services
* Teladoc Medical Experts, second opinion program
* And more!

**Learn More & Apply Now!**

Do you want to be a part of something bigger? A team whose impact stretches across the world, and even beyond? At Collins Aerospace, our Mission Systems team helps civilian, military and government customers complete their most complex missions — whatever and wherever they may be. Our customers depend on us for intelligent and secure communications, missionized systems for specialized aircraft and spacecraft and collaborative space solutions. By joining our team, you’ll have your own critical part to play in ensuring our customers succeed today while anticipating their needs for tomorrow. Are you up for the challenge? Join our mission today.

The next chapter of our future as an aerospace company is here, and we are excited about what this means for our employees and customers! Get onboard the Collins Aerospace Operations team and play a part in managing our innovative products from inception to delivery. The Operations team continues to grow and aims to strengthen the connection of Manufacturing Operations, Supply Chain and Environment, Health & Safety (EH&S) across Collins Aerospace. In this dynamic environment, you will have the opportunity to network across our businesses and functions, all while improving the productivity, quality and efficiency of our operations worldwide.

* Please ensure the role type (defined below) is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role.
* **Onsite:** Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.

At Collins, the paths we pave together lead to limitless possibilities. And the bonds we form – with our customers and with each other - propel us all higher, again and again.

 

Apply now and be part of the team that’s redefining aerospace, every day.

#LI-JC4

The salary range for this role is 145,600 USD - 276,800 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Specific benefits are dependent upon the specific business unit as well as whether or not the position is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement.Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance.This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply.RTX anticipates the application window closing approximately 40 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require RTX to shorten or extend the application window.

*RTX is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. RTX provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.*

records.title: Sr. Manager - Continuous Improvement
records.description:
Lead continuous improvement at our Battle Creek, Michigan manufacturing facility, where your work will shape performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost and growth. As a key member of the plant leadership team, you will set the CI vision, advise site leaders on strategy and lead a team of continuous improvement professionals.

You will own the plant's management operating system and annual cost-out process while building the capabilities that sustain results. This role combines enterprise-level thinking with daily visibility on the plant floor, giving you the opportunity to turn data, Lean methods and cross-functional partnership into measurable operational gains.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Set and execute the plant's continuous improvement strategy, creating the behaviors, systems and culture needed to achieve plant goals.
* Lead, coach and develop the salaried continuous improvement team while building Lean problem-solving capability across functions.
* Own the plant management operating system, annual cost-out process and A3 strategy documents, including daily, weekly and monthly performance tracking.
* Identify, scope and prioritize breakthrough and incremental improvement opportunities using plant data and operational metrics.
* Teach and model root-cause analysis, DMAIC, standard work, waste reduction, recurrence prevention and structured follow-up.
* Facilitate Kaizen events and cross-functional improvement efforts that strengthen safety, quality, delivery, cost, yield and equipment effectiveness.
* Maintain the plant continuous improvement project docket, track savings and communicate project status and results to operations leadership.
* Partner with operations, engineering and technical teams to implement sustainable solutions and share best practices across PCB facilities.
* Serve as a change leader who constructively challenges non-value-added work and helps teams navigate resistance to change.

**Why You'll Love This Role**

* A visible seat on the plant leadership team with direct influence on site strategy and operational performance.
* The opportunity to build CI capability across the organization and leave a clear handprint on how the plant works.
* Broad collaboration with operations, engineering and CI leaders across Post Consumer Brands.
* A role where big company resources meet a practical, hands-on plant environment.

**Location & Travel Requirements**

* This role is based at the Battle Creek, Michigan manufacturing facility.

**Education**

* A bachelor's degree in science, engineering, management or a related field is preferred.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5 or more years of related experience in a manufacturing environment.
* 3 or more years of successful leadership experience guiding teams that execute continuous improvement or Lean Six Sigma work.
* Demonstrated experience delivering measurable efficiency, effectiveness and financial benefits through continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience operating in a large manufacturing plant environment.
* Deep working knowledge of Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement methods, including root-cause analysis, DMAIC, Kaizen and waste reduction.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects, use operational data to set priorities and sustain improvements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in food manufacturing.
* Experience working in a union manufacturing environment.
* Experience in food or automotive manufacturing settings.
* Experience leading Black Belt-level or transformational cost-out initiatives.

**Success in This Role**

* Builds trust and strong working relationships across plant leadership, operations, engineering and frontline teams.
* Influences, coaches and develops others while setting clear expectations and maintaining accountability for results.
* Communicates a compelling improvement vision and translates complex problems into organized, practical action plans.
* Uses sound analytical and business judgment to solve complex problems and prioritize actions quickly.
* Leads change with candor, optimism and respect, including in environments where established ways of working may be challenged.
* Demonstrates a consistent commitment to a safe, respectful workplace.

**Ready to Make an Impact?**

If you are ready to lead transformational improvement, develop strong teams and help a large manufacturing operation perform at its best, bring your experience and big ambitions to Post Consumer Brands.

records.title: Sr. Manager, Manufacturing Engineering
records.description:
**Hyve Company Overview**
-------------------------

Hyve Solutions transforms complex engineering challenges into production reality for technology innovators building AI, cloud, and connected infrastructure. As a US-based manufacturing partner, the company rapidly delivers fast, agile execution through dep technical partnerships and co-innovation, and supply chain clarity. Hyve’s integrated ODM, CM, and SI capabilities eliminate vendor complexity while accelerating time-to-market with single-partner accountability from design through scale. The company co-innovates with deep engineering expertise, treating customer success as its own while building tomorrow's digital infrastructure.

 
 

Hyve Solutions is seeking a highly technical, hands-on Manufacturing Engineering Manager to lead engineering operations within our fast-paced, high-volume PCBA manufacturing environment. This position is responsible for driving manufacturing process development, equipment performance, automation, and continuous improvement while ensuring the successful transition of new products from introduction (NPI) into stable, scalable mass production. The ideal candidate combines strong SMT/PCBA technical expertise with proven leadership capabilities, a passion for solving complex manufacturing challenges, and a proactive, floor-oriented approach to engineering. We are looking for a leader who takes ownership of manufacturing performance, develops strong engineering teams, and drives practical, sustainable solutions that improve quality, throughput, efficiency, and operational scalability.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead, develop, and manage the Manufacturing Engineering team, establishing clear priorities, technical accountability, and performance expectations
* Own manufacturing process development, optimization, and technical support across SMT, automated assembly, soldering, inspection, and related PCBA manufacturing operations
* Lead the transition of new products from NPI into high-volume production, ensuring manufacturing readiness, process capability, equipment qualification, and sustainable production performance
* Partner with NPI, Product Engineering, Test Engineering, Quality, and Operations to identify manufacturability risks, resolve technical challenges, and establish robust production processes
* Drive equipment programming, process parameter optimization, machine capability improvements, and automation initiatives to maximize manufacturing efficiency and reliability
* Provide hands-on technical leadership in troubleshooting complex equipment failures, process defects, yield losses, and recurring production issues
* Establish and improve manufacturing process controls, validation methods, and standardized engineering practices to ensure consistent product quality and repeatability
* Lead root cause investigations and corrective actions for manufacturing-related defects, equipment issues, and process instability
* Evaluate and implement new manufacturing technologies, equipment, tooling, and automation solutions to improve production capability and support business growth
* Support manufacturing capacity expansion, equipment installation, production line integration, and facility transitions while minimizing operational disruptions
* Analyze manufacturing performance metrics, including yield, cycle time, throughput, downtime, and process capability, to identify improvement opportunities and drive measurable results
* Collaborate with Operations, Quality, Maintenance, and Materials teams to establish manufacturing priorities, resolve production constraints, and improve overall operational performance
* Develop and maintain manufacturing engineering standards, process documentation, work instructions, and change control processes to support consistent execution
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on defect reduction, equipment utilization, labor efficiency, cost reduction, and manufacturing scalability
* Develop engineering talent through technical mentorship, structured problem-solving, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement of team capabilities

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent experience may be considered
* Minimum of 7 years of progressive manufacturing engineering experience, including 3 years in an engineering leadership or management role, preferred
* Preferred hands-on experience in SMT and PCBA manufacturing processes, including pick and place equipment, solder paste printing, reflow soldering, AOI, AXI, selective soldering, and related manufacturing processes
* Demonstrated success transitioning products from NPI through production qualification, ramp-up, and sustained high-volume manufacturing
* Experience with industrial automation, equipment integration, machine programming, and manufacturing process controls
* Proven ability to lead technical teams, establish accountability, develop engineering talent, and manage competing priorities in a dynamic manufacturing environment
* Strong understanding of manufacturing process validation, root cause analysis, defect reduction, yield improvement, and equipment reliability
* Familiarity with IPC standards, DFM/DFT principles, PFMEA, SPC, and structured problem-solving methodologies
* Familiarity with ISO9001 and ISO14001

**What’s in it for you**
------------------------

Benefit Insurance

* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Health Savings Account (HSA)
* Mental Health Care
* 401K with match
* Paid Holidays, Vacation & Sick Days
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Perks at Work
* LEAP Program
* MyFlexPay

***We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.***
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

records.title: Senior Manager of Production
records.description:
Gwynedd Manufacturing is seeking a hands-on Senior Manager of Production with a strong CNC machining background to lead day-to-day operations in a high-precision environment. This role is ideal for someone who has progressed through the ranks—from the shop floor into leadership—and is ready to step into a broader operational role.

The ideal candidate brings deep, practical knowledge of CNC machining (mills, lathes, EDM) and thrives in a fast-paced, high-tolerance manufacturing setting. This is not a purely strategic role—this leader will be actively engaged on the floor, driving performance, mentoring teams, and continuously improving processes.

Key Responsibilities:

* Lead daily plant operations with a strong presence on the manufacturing floor, ensuring output, quality, and efficiency targets are met
* Direct oversight of machining operations including CNC mills, lathes, and EDM, ensuring optimal machine utilization and performance
* Manage and develop a team of supervisors, leads, and machinists (50–100+ employees)
* Serve as a technical resource and mentor, supporting setup, programming, and troubleshooting when needed
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on cycle time reduction, scrap reduction, and process standardization
* Partner closely with Engineering and Quality to ensure tight tolerance requirements and manufacturability of parts
* Own production scheduling, workflow optimization, and labor planning to meet customer demand
* Establish and reinforce shop floor accountability, KPIs, and standard work practices
* Maintain a safe, compliant, and disciplined manufacturing environment
* Support new product introductions and prototype builds with a strong understanding of machining constraints
* Overseeing multiple departments withing the manufacturing space.

Qualifications:

* 5+ years of progressive manufacturing experience, with clear growth from hands-on machining into leadership
* Strong CNC background required (setup, programming, and/or machining experience with mills, lathes, EDM)
* Prior experience in roles such as Machine Shop Manager, Manufacturing Manager, or Plant Manager
* Proven ability to lead teams in a high-precision, tight-tolerance environment
* Deep understanding of machining processes, tooling, fixturing, and production workflows
* Experience driving continuous improvement on the shop floor (Lean, process optimization, etc.)
* Comfortable being hands-on and highly visible in daily operations, not just managing from an office
* Strong leadership and communication skills with the ability to develop talent from within
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field preferred, but equivalent hands-on experience strongly valued

Physical and Work Environment Requirements: 
This position is based in a manufacturing environment and may require the following over extended periods of time up to a full 8-hour work shift (excluding lunch and breaks): stand, walk, sit, squat or bend, kneel and rise, lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to — and occasionally exceeding — 50 pounds, view a computer or other digital screen, work on a computer, workstation or comparable system, and make accurate entries in such systems. Manual dexterity and fine motor skills are required for detailed assembly and precision work. Work may take place in areas with varying temperatures or no climate control, varying noise levels, and production equipment in motion. Proper personal protective equipment (PPE) must be worn in designated areas at all times as required by company policy. Reasonable accommodations may be available to enable individuals with disabilities but are always subject to safety concerns for the employee and all team members. Employer may require a physical assessment of the candidate’s ability to perform these tasks as a condition of an offer letter. Any assessment will be performed by a third party vendor and will be reported on a pass/fail basis with no other medical information conveyed to employer.

*Equal Opportunity Employer:*

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

*Note: This job description reflects general duties and responsibilities and is not intended to be an exhaustive list. Management may modify or assign other responsibilities as needed.*

records.title: Senior Manager, Warehouse Operations
records.description:
**Who We Are**

Stored Energy Systems (SENS) is an award-winning manufacturer of premium quality power conversion products located in Longmont, CO. In business for over 50 years, SENS is the market leader with a proven track record of providing highly reliable battery chargers, DC power systems, and related products to industrial markets. For more information on our company please see our web site at www.sens-usa.com.

**View the SENS Product Catalog**

**Summary**

The Senior Manager, Warehouse Operations leads the people, processes, and systems that maintain accurate inventory and reliable material flow across Stored Energy Systems (SENS) manufacturing operations. Based at Disc Drive headquarters, this role leads teams and team members across all SENS locations on first shift (days) and second shift (evenings). The role oversees receiving, warehousing, inventory control, material handling, production replenishment, kitting, inter-factory transportation, shipping, and freight coordination, while developing teams and operating capacity to support production continuity, customer deliveries, and growth.

**Responsibilities**

Leadership and Operating Performance

* Establish consistent material handling and inventory management standards, performance expectations, and accountability across all locations.
* Develop supervisors and team leaders through coaching, training, performance management, and succession planning.
* Own Warehouse Operations staffing plans and coordinate coverage, priorities, and escalation processes across all locations and both shifts to support production needs.
* Promote safe material handling and consistent workplace practices in partnership with the Environmental Health and Safety team.

Inventory Accuracy and Control

* Own inventory accuracy and control standards across SENS inventory locations, including inventory held at partner locations.
* Establish consistent receiving, put-away, picking, transfer, issue, return, and reconciliation processes in Infor SyteLine. Oversee receipt processing for non-inventory purchases.
* Lead cycle counting, inventory discrepancy investigations, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Maintain material identification, traceability, first-in, first-out practices, and segregation of restricted or nonconforming inventory.
* Partner with Procurement and Finance on inventory reconciliation and actions to improve inventory health, supporting Procurement’s ownership of inventory turns, safety stock levels, and excess and obsolete inventory.
* Lead preparation and execution of annual physical inventories at all SENS locations.

Production Material Flow

* Lead production material delivery, including stock picking, replenishment of point-of-use inventory areas, scheduled material delivery routes, and kanban replenishment parameters. Align execution with sales, inventory, and operations planning (SIOP) and production schedules.
* Develop and implement scalable assembly-phase kitting processes for configure-to-order and engineer-to-order products. Ensure kit accuracy, completeness, alignment with current revisions, staging, and return of unused materials.
* Coordinate material priorities, shortage escalations, and decisions about incomplete kits with Planning, Production, and Procurement.
* Establish visual management and kanban replenishment processes from kitting through delivery to production lines.

Transportation, Shipping, and Freight

* Own inter-factory transportation and inventory transfers, movement of finished products to shipping, and return flows for empty bins, carts, and protective packing materials.
* Lead local shipping operations and centralized inbound and outbound freight execution, coordinating with Planning & Fulfillment and Order Management to support on-time, complete customer shipments.
* Manage freight and premium freight costs against budget and maintain transportation contingency plans to support production continuity and customer deliveries.

Capacity and Continuous Improvement

* Translate production forecasts into logistics capacity plans. Lead warehouse and material-flow readiness for factory expansions and production ramps, including space, staffing, and training.
* Improve productivity through standard work, waste reduction, daily performance management, process automation, and enterprise resource planning (ERP) system improvements, in partnership with IT, Manufacturing Engineering, and Continuous Improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in manufacturing inventory, warehousing, and logistics, including 5+ years leading supervisors and teams across multiple sites and shifts.
* Demonstrated success scaling warehouse operations in a high-growth manufacturing environment.
* Strong knowledge of inventory controls, ERP transactions, cycle counting, kanban, supermarkets, production replenishment, and order kitting.
* Experience managing shipping operations, transportation providers, and freight costs.
* Experience supporting repetitive manufacturing production.
* Demonstrated ability to improve inventory accuracy, establish consistent operating practices, and develop effective supervisors and team leaders.
* Ability to analyze operational and financial data, resolve problems, and communicate priorities and issues across functions.
* Experience implementing Lean or continuous improvement initiatives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, logistics, operations, engineering, or a related field
* Relevant supply chain, logistics, or Lean certification.
* Experience with Infor SyteLine, barcode scanning, and warehouse management systems.
* Experience in electrical equipment, industrial products, or similarly complex manufacturing environments.
* Experience supporting configure-to-order or engineer-to-order production.

**Location:** Longmont, CO

**Base Compensation:** $135,000 - $165,000 is the projected range of annual base salary for this role depending on the candidate’s overall qualifications and experience.

**Bonus:** This position is eligible for an annual bonus based on individual and company performance.

**Closing Date:** December 1st. While we expect to keep the position open through this date, the posting may be extended or closed early based on applicant volume and hiring needs.

**Onsite Perks**

* Free gym with 24/7 access
* Free Electric Vehicle charging
* Breakfast and Lunch Café
* After hours Grab & Go snacks
* Basketball court
* Walking paths

**Benefits**

* Paid Time Off
* Paid holidays
* Medical insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability
* Life insurance
* 401(k) plan with immediate vesting
* Employee referral program
* Tuition reimbursement
* Professional development

At SENS, our culture is rooted in a set of core values that reflect who we are and how we work. In a recent 2025 poll, our employees identified the values that best define us: *“Innovative”, “Respectful”, “Inviting”, “Flexible”, “Collaborative”, and “Growth Driven”.* Our team describes us as a dynamic, forward-thinking company where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

We pride ourselves on being an equal opportunity employer, fully dedicated to fostering inclusion and diversity. We welcome all applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

We hope you're interested in making a difference with us. Even if you don't feel that you meet every qualification listed in this job description, we still encourage you to apply.

records.title: Food Safety Quality Assurance (FSQA) Senior Manager

postedPay.title: Food Safety Quality Assurance (FSQA) Senior Manager

records.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The **Senior Manager, Food Safety & Quality Assurance (FSQA)**, is responsible for leading and continuously improving all food safety, quality assurance, regulatory compliance, and quality management programs within a food manufacturing facility. This role ensures compliance with federal, state, customer, and third-party requirements, including Safe Quality Food (SQF) standards, while driving a culture of food safety, quality excellence, and continuous improvement across the organization.

As the site’s food safety and quality leader, the Senior Manager provides strategic oversight of food safety systems, audit readiness, risk management, and quality performance. Working cross-functionally with Operations, Supply Chain, and Product Development teams, this position ensures the consistent production of safe, high-quality products from raw materials through finished goods.

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Quality Systems & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead the site's quality management systems, overseeing quality control activities across raw materials, in-process production, and finished products.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives through cross-functional collaboration with Operations, Supply Chain, R&D, and Commercial teams.
* Provide strategic oversight of product traceability, stock recovery, recall readiness, and crisis management programs.
* Establish, interpret, and continuously improve Quality Assurance and Quality Control standards, procedures, KPIs, SOPs, and GMP programs.

**Food Safety & Quality Program Leadership**

* Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of food safety and quality programs, including SQF, HACCP, HARPC, and GMP systems.
* Maintain GFSI-recognized certifications, including SQF, ensuring ongoing audit readiness and compliance.
* Ensure all food safety, quality, and regulatory documentation, procedures, and records are accurate, current, and compliant.

**Team Leadership & Culture**

* Lead, mentor, and develop the FSQA team, including talent acquisition, succession planning, performance management, and professional development.
* Champion a strong food safety and quality culture by providing training and coaching to employees at all levels of the organization.

**Audit, Compliance & Risk Management**

* Serve as the primary lead for all regulatory, customer, and third-party audits, inspections, and certification activities.
* Direct internal audit programs and oversee corrective and preventive action plans to address non-conformances.
* Manage customer and consumer complaint programs, including root cause investigations and continuous improvement initiatives

**Regulatory & Customer Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory, customer, and certification requirements, including HACCP, FSMA, CFIA, FDA, GFSI, and SQF standards.
* Monitor emerging regulatory and industry developments and implement changes to maintain compliance and operational excellence.

**Supplier Quality Management**

* Oversee supplier approval and performance management programs to ensure all materials meet food safety and quality requirements.
* Lead supplier audits, risk assessments, and improvement initiatives to strengthen supply chain quality and compliance.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Chemistry, Biology, or a related scientific discipline required; Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum of 8-10 years of progressive Food Safety and Quality Assurance experience within a food manufacturing environment, including at least 3-5 years in a leadership role.
* Demonstrated success leading and maintaining SQF and other GFSI-recognized food safety systems within a complex manufacturing operation.
* Proven experience leading, developing, and coaching high-performing teams while building a strong food safety and quality culture.
* Strong knowledge of HACCP, HARPC, GMPs, FSMA, CFIA, FDA, GFSI, and SQF requirements and their practical application in food manufacturing.
* Experience leading regulatory, customer, and third-party audits, including successful management of corrective and preventive action programs.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint) and quality management systems.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to influence decision-making at all levels of the organization.

**KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS**

* Expert knowledge of food safety, quality assurance, and regulatory requirements, including FDA, CFIA, FSMA, HACCP, GMP, GFSI, and SQF standards.
* Strong understanding of food safety systems, risk assessment, hygienic zoning, sanitation, environmental monitoring, allergen management, and preventive controls.
* Proven ability to lead food safety and quality strategy within a manufacturing environment while driving a culture of compliance, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment across all levels of the organization.
* Advanced problem-solving and analytical capabilities, including expertise in root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), trend analysis, and risk mitigation.
* Strong knowledge of quality management systems, data analysis, and performance metrics, with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights.
* Demonstrated project management and change management skills, with experience leading cross-functional initiatives and implementing sustainable process improvements.
* Strong customer and regulatory audit management experience, including interactions with customers, certification bodies, and regulatory agencies.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

* Must be comfortable working in a bakery manufacturing environment with exposure to elevated temperatures and production equipment.
* Frequent walking and standing throughout the production facility to conduct inspections, audits, observations, and support operational activities.
* Prolonged periods of standing, walking, and sitting may be required.
* Occasional lifting, carrying, or moving of product samples, ingredients, materials, or equipment up to 25-50 lbs.
* Manual dexterity required to operate testing equipment, utilize computer systems, document findings, and review records.
* Occasional bending, reaching, climbing, and accessing equipment or storage areas during inspections, audits, and investigations.
* Exposure to varying environmental conditions, including hot production areas, cool storage environments, and refrigerated spaces.
* Strong visual acuity required to identify product defects, verify compliance standards, and review documentation.
* Ability to use sensory evaluation techniques, including sight, smell, and taste, when assessing ingredients, products, and quality attributes.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: From $85,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
