records.description:
At Bloom Energy, our vision for a world powered by clean, reliable, and affordable energy is more than just a dream—we’re making it reality.

 

For over two decades, we’ve been at the forefront of the global energy transition, pioneering solutions that empower critical industries to thrive in a rapidly digitizing, energy-intensive world. From revolutionizing power for AI-driven data centers to ensuring resilience for hospitals, electric grids, manufacturing facilities, and utilities, our solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) and solid oxide electrolyzer (SOEC) technologies are redefining what’s possible by delivering energy abundance for all. With more than 30,000 fuel cell modules deployed worldwide, we are the trusted partner for Fortune 100 companies and innovators alike. Our cutting-edge solutions enable unparalleled “time-to-power” capabilities, reliability, and sustainability, ensuring our customers remain ahead in a world where soaring energy demand and intensifying energy scarcity are rapidly becoming the new norm.

At Bloom, we thrive on collaboration, bold thinking, and relentless innovation. We believe that, together, we can create a brighter, more sustainable future while tackling the most pressing challenges of the 21st century.

 

We are looking for a S **r. Manager, Quality** to join our team in one of today’s most exciting technologies. This role will report to **Director of Quality** and based in **Newark, Delaware. This is a fully on-site, in office role 5 days a week** .

 

**Role and Responsibilities:**

* Ensure 100% Quality assurance at the Skid line manufacturing through inspection, testing, and sub-component testing/inspection. Assist in hiring personnel needed to support this effort.

* Partner with Install Quality team (field) to understand real time (daily) what items are escaping the plant and instituting immediate mitigation plans including addressing any inventory in the pipeline not yet installed.

* Implement permanent corrective actions working with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply chain, or SQE as per relevance on each issue.

* Provide quality input into the new equipment being purchased for the scaling of Delaware manufacturing. Include inputs for quality assurance into equipment design, and verification of process steps. Understand and provide input into the planned operation, what can be bypassed, maintenance plans, calibration or drift of the equipment, automation that can fail and be undetected leading to quality escapes.

* Participate and understand results from testing in the plant; Functional test, Tommy test, FIT, etc. Drive pareto of failures to help cross functional problem solving of test failures.

* Implement a 100% functional test (new) on skid final product assembly; electrical continuity, communications integrity, piping assurance, start up simulation, etc. to assure 100% QA prior to shipping to customer.

* Ensure skid components and systems have latest FW revision prior to shipping to the W/H, or out of W/H to field.

* Work with CIG and Manufacturing Engr, and NPI to implement workload being removed from the customer install side and being moved into skid assembly. Provide oversight to ensure best quality achievement; ensure work instructions are clear, operators trained, workstations have proper tools, and judgement criteria.

* Collaborate with Supplier Quality / Suppliers to achieve zero-defect flow (“dock-to-stock”) for all purchased, contract manufacture parts, materials, and Bloom Energy manufactured parts.

* Drive component and design failures back to the earliest point of detection in the process.

* Ensure manufacturing process have Control plans with CTQ, and POA built in to each station.

* Work collaboratively with Design teams to DFM, through a “registration system”, and Pokeyoke assembly methods for highest quality assurance.

* Drive test excellence in the manufacturing plan to ensure that equipment and test stations are certified with robust qualification programs, that are documented and controlled for changes with proper accuracy and gage R&R techniques.

* Drive yield task forces to achieve company wide targets at each manufacturing point under this scope, with cross functional teams driving top pareto issues to RCCA.

* Ensure early engagement with the product engineering team to teach and perform early stage risk assessments (DFMEA et.al.)

* Design for manufacturability and reliability improvements during the early design stages of product development.

* Work with Engineering NPI and the manufacturing engineering teams to perform PFMEA, write work instructions, and establish quality check-points to guarantee zero-defect quality in production.

* Develop and implement formal, comprehensive process documentation including process flow diagrams, Process FMEAs, process control plans, operations method Sheets, manufacturing quality charts (MQCs) and etc.

* Lead critical problem solving task forces with emphasis on cross functional inputs, accountability, time to RCCA, and ensurance of mitigation of inventory, or field units at risk.

* Troubleshoot product issues by reviewing engineering drawings and design requirements. Drive a rigorous resolution process for product quality, reliability and design issues.

* Perform data-driven root cause failure analyses for design, manufacturing, and administrative problems.

* Perform process audits to monitor, continuously improve, and sustain superior product quality.

* Demonstrate the ability to interface and work collaboratively across departments internally and with suppliers and customers, (including Purchasing, Quality, R&D, Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Marketing and Finance), while building strong and cooperative working relationships.

* Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) Reduction: Establish and govern site COPQ metrics (scrap, rework, sorting, and warranty risk); lead cross-functional yield-improvement blitzes targeting measurable cost reductions and scrap minimization.

* Process Capability & Zero-Defect Mentality: Drive process capability (C\_p / C\_{pk} \ge 1.33) across critical-to-quality (CTQ) operations (welding, brazing, ceramic stack assembly, plumbing/gas-delivery, and electrical integration).

 

**Skills and Experience:**

* More than 10 years of increasing responsibility in the areas of Quality, and Manufacturing .

* Experience implementing company-wide ISO 9001 procedures and TS16949 standards and related process documentation. Possess working knowledge of process capability and control requirements, methods and systems.

* Demonstrated track record of building, restructuring, or significantly scaling a manufacturing quality team during rapid production ramp-up

* Proven successful application of multi-discipline engineering problem solving techniques.

* Understand the critical elements of modern Manufacturing Statistical Process Control, (e.g., practical working knowledge and experience with SPC, Process Capability, Cp, Cpk, etc.)

* Understand the critical elements of modern Reliability Engineering, (e.g., MCF, MTBF, MTT, etc.)

* Certification in a recognized problem-solving methodology such as six-sigma Black Belt, 8D, or Global Problem Solving.

* Strong verbal/active listening/written communications.

* Demonstrate planning and leadership skills.

* Expert with metrology, calibration, and Gage R & R’s.

* Ability to train in Quality System Auditing.

* Fluent in product phase-gate, NPI and technology transfer.

* Expertise in applying PPAP, First Article Inspections (FAI) and Reports).

* Strong critical thinking, analytical skills, and problem solving.

* Ability to effectively work within a very intense, dynamic, fast-paced, and demanding work environment.

* Familiarity with industry codes and quality standards applicable to clean power systems (ISO 9001:2015 required; working knowledge of ASME, NFPA, or UL standards preferred).

* ASQ Certified Manager of Quality / Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE) and ASQ Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE) alongside CQE and Six Sigma Black Belt.

* Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office Suite and statistical software.

* Possess a passion for excellence.

* Unrestricted willingness to travel to all regions. Travel may be up to 25% of time.

* BS, MS or PhD in Mechanical/Material Science/Chemical/Electrical/Systems Engineering.

* Direct experience managing high-temperature fluidics/gas delivery, welding/brazing, ceramic integration, power electronics, or structural enclosures is a strong plus.

 

Bloom Energy is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We are committed to compliance with all applicable laws providing equal employment opportunities. All qualified applicants, will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability. Bloom Energy makes reasonable accommodations, consistent with applicable laws, for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified applicant or employee with a disability, who can perform the essential job functions, unless undue hardship would result.

 

At Bloom Energy, we are committed to supporting the well-being of our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits package for eligible employees includes competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans with a large employer contribution, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with company match, generous Mental Health Support services, Legal services, virtual Physical Therapy access, and Fertility & Family Forming benefits.

Bloom Energy is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The total compensation for this position includes standard company benefits and is based on various factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience.

records.title: Sr. Director Quality & Regulatory Compliance
records.description:
If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact.

With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you.

**SCOPE OF ROLE:**

The Senior Director of Quality and Regulatory Compliance is responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive quality strategy supporting both the Optics and Fluidics business segments across multiple sites. This leader will drive a high-performing quality organization that delivers best-in-class product quality, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction.

This role provides oversight of the Quality Management System (QMS), Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, Document Control, and Inspection functions. The Senior Director will champion a culture of continuous improvement, proactive risk management, and customer-centric quality while aligning quality strategies with broader business goals.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**
---------------------------------------

### **Leadership & Strategy**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for the global Idex Health & Science Quality organization, including talent development, performance management, and organizational design (6 international locations)
* Serve as the designated Management Representative, ensuring the effectiveness of the QMS and alignment with business objectives
* Establish and communicate a clear quality vision and strategy across Optics and Fluidics operations

### **Quality Systems & Governance**

* Oversee and continuously improve the Quality Management System in compliance with ISO 9001, ISO 13485, and applicable regulatory requirements
* Ensure quality objectives are defined, tracked, and communicated to leadership with clear visibility into performance and risk
* Lead internal and external audit readiness and execution, ensuring timely and effective resolution of findings

### **Performance Metrics & Continuous Improvement**

* Define, implement, and monitor key quality metrics and KPIs to measure internal performance and customer outcomes
* Present quality performance insights to executive leadership and external stakeholders
* Drive a culture of Root Cause Problem Solving (RCPS) and Continuous Improvement (CI) across all functions and product lifecycles
* Lead Cost of Quality (COQ) initiatives to improve operational and financial performance

### **Operational Quality & Engineering Support**

* Partner with Operations and Manufacturing Engineering to ensure quality is embedded across production processes
* Provide leadership for Quality Engineering support, addressing non-conformances through the NCMR system and driving escalation when appropriate
* Lead and oversee Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) processes, ensuring sustainable solutions to systemic issues
* Support Design for Manufacturability, Testability, and Reliability in new product introductions, transfers, and sustaining initiatives

### **Supplier & Customer Quality**

* Oversee supplier qualification and audit programs, ensuring supplier performance meets quality expectations
* Partner with Incoming Quality Assurance (IQA) to resolve non-conforming materials and drive supplier corrective actions
* Support customer-facing quality activities, including RMAs, complaint investigations, and corrective action programs
* Drive a customer-centric quality approach aligned with performance expectations

### **Inspection, MRB, and Compliance**

* Oversee Inspection and Document Control functions to ensure product and process compliance
* Lead the Material Review Board (MRB) process, managing non-conforming materials including incoming, WIP, and finished goods
* Ensure timely disposition, containment, and systemic resolution of quality issues

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and Regulatory teams to drive quality across the value stream
* Lead and participate in cross-functional initiatives and special projects as assigned
* Act as a change agent to challenge the status quo and drive cultural transformation toward proactive quality

**Education & Experience**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline strongly preferred; advanced degree a plus
* Minimum 15+ years of progressive quality leadership experience
* At least 5 years leading quality across multiple manufacturing sites (or equivalent complexity) required
* Demonstrated success in regulated manufacturing environments

**Technical Expertise**
-----------------------

* Deep knowledge of Quality Management Systems and regulatory standards (ISO 9001, ISO 13485)
* Strong background in quality assurance within manufacturing/operations environments
* Experience with internal auditing and continuous improvement methodologies
* Proficiency in Six Sigma, Lean, and/or Total Quality Management (preferred)
* Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills

**Leadership & Behavioral Competencies**
----------------------------------------

* Exceptional leadership, coaching, and talent development capabilities
* Strong ability to influence at all organizational levels and build cross-functional partnerships

Are you ready to join a different kind of company where our people, our culture, and our commitments are centered around providing trusted solutions that improve lives around the world?

**Total Rewards**

The compensation range for this position is $158,600.00 - $237,800.00, depending on experience. This position may be eligible for performance based bonus plan.

**Benefits Package**

Our comprehensive U.S. benefit offerings include: Health benefits, 401(k) retirement savings program with company match, PTO, and more. More information on our benefits and rewards can be found on our career page: https://www.idexcorp.com/careers/our-benefits-and-rewards/

**IDEX is an Equal Opportunity Employer**. IDEX gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other consideration or protected category made unlawful by federal, state or local laws.

**Attention Applicants:** If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, please let us know. Likewise, if you are limited in the ability to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, we will determine an alternate way for you to apply. Please contact our Talent Acquisition Team at lfcareers@idexcorp.com for assistance with an accommodation. These contact tools may be used only by individuals with a disability for accommodation requests. Do not inquire as to the status of an application.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

‌

Artificial intelligence is not used to screen, assess or select applicants.

records.description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

**Environmental Conditions**

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards

**Job Description**

**Title: Senior Manager Quality Sterility Assurance**
-----------------------------------------------------

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

**Division/Site Specific Information**

Role reports to the Ridgefield, NJ site and reports to the Drug Product Division within the Pharma Services Group.

 

**Discover Impactful Work:** 
As a Senior Manager of Quality at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will guide strategic quality initiatives and support a culture of continuous improvement across our organization. You'll oversee quality management systems, ensure regulatory compliance, and enhance customer experience through excellent quality standards. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you'll develop and implement quality strategies that support our mission of enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.

**A Day in the Life:**
----------------------

* In this role, you'll manage quality assurance and quality control teams while building strong partnerships with operations, R&D, commercial teams, and customers.
* You'll guide process improvements through Practical Process Improvement (PPI) methodologies and risk-based approaches.
* Your leadership will be essential in maintaining inspection readiness, managing customer relationships, and ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements.
* As a member of the Quality Leadership Team, you'll support quality initiatives that deliver consistent product excellence while meeting business objectives.
* You'll develop quality professionals, lead investigations, and implement data-driven solutions that enhance our quality systems and customer satisfaction.

**Keys to Success:**

**Education/Experience**
------------------------

* Advanced Degree plus 6 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 8 years of experience in pharmaceutical, medical device, or regulated life sciences industry required.
* Preferred Fields of Study: Science, Engineering, Chemistry, or related technical field
* Professional certifications desired (ASQ, Lean Six Sigma, etc.)
* 5+ years of quality management/leadership experience
* Experience hosting regulatory inspections and customer audits
* Experience implementing continuous improvement initiatives
* Experience with quality tools including FMEA, Risk Analysis, and Root Cause Analysis

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities**

 

* Expert knowledge of global quality standards (ISO 13485, ISO 9001, FDA 21 CFR 820, EU MDR/IVDR)
* Strong understanding of quality management systems and GMP requirements
* Demonstrated experience leading quality investigations, CAPA, and change control processes
* Excellent project management and cross-functional leadership abilities
* Strong data analysis and problem-solving capabilities
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to build collaborative relationships at all levels
* Proficiency with quality management software systems

**Benefits**

We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus scheme, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits! Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation.

**Compensation and Benefits**

The salary range estimated for this position based in New Jersey is $143,200.00–$214,900.00.

This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short- and long-term disability in accordance with company policy
* Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
* Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount

For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total-rewards

records.title: Senior Director, Product Quality
records.description:
»

**Date:** Nov 12, 2026

**Location:** North Reading, MA, US

**Company:** Teradyne

We are the global test and automation specialists, powering next-generation technologies through sophisticated solutions. Behind every electronic device you use, Teradyne's test technology ensures your device works right the first time, every time! Our portfolio of automation solutions help manufacturers to develop and deliver products quickly, efficiently and cost-effectively. Together, Teradyne companies deliver manufacturing automation across industries and applications around the world!

 

We attract, develop, and retain a high-performance workforce, comprised of people with diverse backgrounds and a shared drive for excellence. We strive to foster a positive and inclusive work environment that helps employees, and communities, thrive.

**Our Purpose**

TERADYNE, where experience meets innovation and driving excellence in every connection. We are fueled by creativity and diversity of thought and in our workforce. Our employees are supported to innovate and learn something new every day.

We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation and delivers better business results.

 

**Opportunity Overview**

The Senior Director, Product Quality & Customer Excellence owns customer-perceived quality for Teradyne’s Compute Test Division, from design through the field. Reporting to the division’s VP of Engineering, this high-visibility role leads Software Quality Engineering and drives quality across hardware, software, FPGA, ASIC, applications, manufacturing, and service engineering. You will work with our executive team and largest customers to build the quality organization and reputation of the division.

* Lead customer escalations from first call to closure, driving Severity 1 and 2 escalations down 20 to 30% every year.
* Develop design reviews, risk analysis, and release gates that engineering respects and that stop a bad release.
* Collaborate with engineering leaders across organizations you do not manage, earning their commitment through credibility, data, and follow-through.
* Build trusted relationships with top customers, and cut field defect escapes every year while shipping every major launch clean through its first six months.
* Partner with leadership to show the cost of poor quality and the margin benefit of reducing it, and close more than 95% of corrective actions on time.
* Mentor and retain exceptional quality engineers, and develop the next generation of quality leaders.
 

**All About You**

We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you’re ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position.

* BS in Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience (MS a plus)
* Typically 15+ years in quality, engineering, product development, or applications, including 10+ years leading cross-functional teams on complex technical products
* A measured, visible quality turnaround or product launch you can point to
* Strong command of product development, verification and validation, reliability, and field operations
* Proven success building and leading teams, including managers
* Direct experience working with executive-level customers
* Ability to take a big, ambiguous, high-stakes problem and drive it to done without waiting to be pushed
* Accountability for outcomes, not activity: you set targets publicly, then hit them or own the miss, and you tell the truth early
* A customer-first mindset, leading and influencing across organizations by earning commitment
* Preferred: experience in semiconductor test equipment (ATE), test and measurement, capital equipment, networking, or enterprise infrastructure
* Preferred: product quality leadership in mission critical, complex hardware and software systems
* Preferred: a track record of using AI, automation, and data to measurably speed up root-cause analysis and problem closure
 

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

You’ll know you’re succeeding when:

* Customer escalations fall every year, and the ones that happen close fast and stay closed.
* Launches ship clean and release gates hold.
* Engineering leaders bring you in early, not after the problem.

records.title: Senior Manager, Demand Side Management Quality Assurance & Engineering
records.description:
**Join the Clean Energy Revolution**

 

Become a **Senior Manager, Demand Side Management Quality Assurance & Engineering** at Southern California Edison (SCE) and build a better tomorrow. In this role, you’ll lead a regulatory (policy) engineering team that conducts technical reviews, researches and develops new technologies, and works closely with the CPUC and industry experts to advance energy efficiency. Because you’ll oversee the quality control of program implementations and ensure their compliance, ideally your background would include Demand Side Management (DSM), such as Energy Efficiency, Demand Response, Integrated Demand Side Management, and Distributed Energy Resources.

 

As a **Senior Manager, Demand Side Management Quality Assurance & Engineering**, your work will help power our planet, reduce carbon emissions and create cleaner air for everyone. Are you ready to take on the challenge to help us build the future?

 

**Incident Management Team Expected Participation**: Employees are expected to support emergency response and/or business continuity efforts, including readiness to serve on an Incident Management Team (IMT) when needed. Employees will participate in an on-call rotation (approximately every four to six weeks), to support IMT activations during emergency events. IMT assignments may differ from an individual’s regular responsibilities.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Leads a variety of engineering and business initiatives to develop grid strategies, determine how the grid is planned, designed, operated and maintained to operationalize company's strategy
* Manages and prioritizes the engineering roadmap in collaboration with other departments; develops and implements strategies for improving execution efficiency
* Leads, manages and supports the project engineering group and remains responsible and accountable for their team's delivery of small to large scale projects
* Manages execution performance of their teams, identifying barriers, and prioritizing work for their teams to ensure projects are delivered on-time, within scope and within budgets
* Reviews and makes decisions on project plans, resource allocation, risk assessment, mitigation strategies, budgets, and resources to ensure timely and successful delivery of capital and strategic projects Oversee the development and implementation of a comprehensive project management framework to ensure efficient project execution, reporting, and delivery of goals within budget
* Drives the adoption of digitalization and automation technologies to improve engineering processes, reduce manual effort, and enhance project outcomes
* Leads the development and maintains a robust risk management strategy to identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with engineering projects
* Develops goals and assigns projects/roles to employees that translate corporate strategic vision into actionable initiatives to delegate.
* Leads the development and implementation of cross organizational strategy, technology and safety program to ensure company advancement toward future vision and the well-being of employees and contractors involved in engineering projects
* A material job duty of all positions within the Company is ensuring the protection of all its physical, financial and cybersecurity assets, and properly accessing and managing private customer data, proprietary information, confidential medical records, and other types of highly sensitive information and data with the highest standards of conduct and integrity.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* Five or more years of experience supervising a team of direct reports and/or project management.
* Experience performing engineering work in operations, production, construction or maintenance environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

 

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in business administration, engineering (mechanical, electrical, or environmental), or a related scientific or technical field.
* Five or more years of experience managing an organization and/or complex DSM policy and regulatory projects involving multiple stakeholders, including the CPUC.
* Three or more years of experience leading engineering or technical projects.
* Three or more years of experience managing vendors and coordinating with technical staff and consultants.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative approach to problem-solving.
* Experience with DSM programs, including Energy Efficiency, Demand Response, Integrated Demand Side Management, or Distributed Energy Resources.

 

**Additional Information**

 

* This position’s work mode is **hybrid.** The employee will report to an SCE facility for a set number of days with the option to work remotely on the remaining days. Unless otherwise noted, employees are required to work and reside in the state of California. Further details of this work mode will be discussed at the interview stage. The work mode can be changed based on business needs.
* Visit our Candidate Resource page to get meaningful information related to benefits, perks, resources, testing information, hiring process, and more!
* Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.
* Position will require up to 10% traveling and being out in the field throughout the SCE service territory.
* Relocation does not apply to this position.

 

**About Southern California Edison**

 

The people at SCE don't just keep the lights on. Our mission is so much bigger. We’re fueling the kind of innovation that’s changing an entire industry, and quite possibly the planet. Join us and create a future with cleaner energy, while providing our customers with the safety and reliability they demand. At SCE, you’ll have a chance to grow personally and professionally, making a real impact in Southern California and around the world.

 

Southern California Edison is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

 

We are committed to ensuring that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodations at AskHR@sce.com or (626) 302-3456 and select option 2.

 

**Nearest Major Market:** Los Angeles

records.title: Senior Manager - Process Engineering - Walker, MI Plant
records.description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world.A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.

**Job Summary**
---------------





**General Purpose** **:**

Responsible for leading and developing a team of process engineers and technicians responsible for SMT manufacturing processes and continuous improvement. Provides technical and organizational leadership to establish and improve manufacturing process capabilities, increase capacity and throughput, reduce cost, improve quality and reliability, and support successful introduction of new products. Partners closely with Operations, Quality, Product Engineering, NPI, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and other functional teams to ensure manufacturing processes meet customer, quality, delivery, cost, and capacity requirements.

* Lead, coach, develop, and manage a team of process engineers and technicians supporting SMT manufacturing, including board printing, SPI, pick and place, reflow, AOI, X-ray, and other back-end operations, excluding Box Assembly.

records.title: Senior Manager, Pilot Manufacturing Operations
records.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are looking for an operational leader for our prototyping and development facility, which brings product and manufacturing engineering together under one roof to accelerate development. This is a high-mix, fast-changing environment where the product is in active development, and you will thrive in ambiguity while building robust systems that scale as we grow. 
 
In this role, you will serve as the operational backbone of our pilot builds across three core areas: (1) owning and executing build campaigns for successive product builds, (2) running a rapid prototyping and test shop that supports our engineering teams, and (3) operating manufacturing prototype lines to accelerate manufacturing process development. You will be the design-for-manufacturing (DFM) voice, translating engineering intent into build reality and feeding insights back to influence design. 
 
You will work closely with product design, supply chain and manufacturing engineering to ensure seamless handoffs and rapid iteration. This role requires a leader who combines an engineering mindset with the ability to build and manage a technician workforce, and who excels at creating effective operational systems such as build planning, warehouse management and operational efficiency metrics, all grounded in data. You will use data to drive manufacturing recommendations, identify bottlenecks and continuously improve operational performance. 
 
Key job responsibilities 
Build Operations
 

* Own the end-to-end operation for multiple concurrent build campaigns across product iterations. Develop, maintain, and deliver on the build plan.
* Build and maintain effective operational systems for build planning, resource allocation, traceability, yield, industrial analytics, and progress tracking. Establish clear metrics and reporting mechanisms for the team’s visibility.
* Manage integration between product design, supply chain, testing and manufacturing to ensure material availability, design-for-assembly feedback, and smooth production flow in a high-mix environment.
* Ensure alignment with the vendors ecosystem supplying the required parts for the builds.
* Coordinate with the test engineering team to ensure product builds and testing plans are aligned.
* Partner with the factory software team to implement and pilot the various manufacturing software systems.

 
Rapid Prototyping Shop
 

* Staff, manage, and operate the rapid prototyping shop (CNC machining, 3D printing/additive manufacturing, and other fabrication capabilities, metrology lab, and testing capabilities) in service of the various engineering teams.
* Prioritize and manage job queues across multiple concurrent programs to maximize throughput and accelerate development timelines.
* Ensure equipment uptime, capacity planning, and continuous improvement of shop capabilities to meet evolving engineering needs.

 
Manufacturing Prototype Line Operations
 

* Operate the manufacturing prototype lines to support and accelerate manufacturing process development in partnership with manufacturing and process engineers.
* Provide the operational environment, workforce, and data to enable process engineers to develop, validate, and refine manufacturing processes.
* Serve as the voice of manufacturing in product and process design reviews — providing data-driven feedback on manufacturability, assembly sequence, and process feasibility to influence upstream design decisions.

 
Leadership & Operational Excellence
 

* Recruit, hire, develop, and manage a high-performing team of manufacturing leads, technicians, machinists, and operations associates. Foster a culture of safety, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Build effective operational systems for warehouse management, inventory control, material flow, and facility operations. Drive operational efficiency through data, metrics, and mechanisms.
* Use data to support manufacturing recommendations, identify bottlenecks, track operational performance, and drive continuous improvement across all three operational domains.
* Act as the primary operational interface to product engineering teams (your customer) — ensuring their development velocity is enabled by world-class operational support.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or an equivalent field
* 10+ years of experience in manufacturing operations, pilot production, or prototyping environments for complex electromechanical products.
* Demonstrated experience hiring, building, and leading operational teams including technicians, machinists, and production associates.
* Experience managing build campaigns or production runs across multiple concurrent product configurations (high-mix environments).
* Proven ability to build and implement operational systems (build planning, scheduling, inventory management, metrics/reporting).
* Track record of using data and metrics to drive operational decisions and manufacturing recommendations.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with demonstrated ability to serve as the operational interface to product design and engineering organizations.
* Experience implementing and maintaining safety programs (EHS) in a manufacturing or prototyping environment, with a demonstrated commitment to workforce safety.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 15+ years of experience in manufacturing or pilot operations with progressive leadership responsibilities in high-mix, fast-evolving product environments.
* Experience in robotics, automotive, aerospace, medical devices, or other advanced hardware development environments where product is in active development.
* Expertise in CNC machining, additive manufacturing (metal and polymer), and assembly processes for precision electromechanical systems.
* Experience building operational systems in manufacturing environments.
* Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles, Six Sigma, or similar data-driven continuous improvement methodologies.
* Master's degree in Engineering or Operations Management.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present data-driven operational insights, risks, and resource needs to senior leadership.
* A proven track record of delivering results in a high-growth, ambiguous environment while demonstrating strong ownership and bias for action (aligned with Amazon Leadership Principles).
* Experience with MES (Manufacturing Execution Systems), ERP, or other manufacturing software platforms used to manage production operations and traceability

 
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. 
 
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

records.title: Senior Manager, Engineering Continuous Improvement
records.description:
**Logistics at full potential.**

At GXO, we’re constantly looking for talented individuals at all levels who can deliver the caliber of service our company requires. You know that a positive work environment creates happy employees, which boosts productivity and dedication. On our team, you’ll have the support to excel at work and the resources to build a career you can be proud of.

 

As the **Senior Manager, Solutions Engineering**, you will lead a team that connects Solution Design, Implementation, and Operations across GXO's OmniChannel Retail and Ecommerce divisions. You will provide operational expertise throughout the customer lifecycle, from early-stage RFPs and solution assessments through implementation, site launch, go-live, and operational stabilization. You will lead teams in evaluating facility designs, process flows, staffing requirements, automation strategies, and operational risks while driving continuous improvement, cost savings, and productivity initiatives across the network.

**Pay, benefits and more.** 
We are eager to attract the best, so we offer competitive compensation and a generous benefits package, including full health insurance (medical, dental and vision), 401(k), life insurance, disability and more.

**What you'll do on a typical day:**

* Lead Solutions Engineering activities throughout the RFP, implementation, and operational lifecycle, providing Operations input on facility design, productivity rates, automation strategies, staffing requirements, and other key solution elements
* Provide subject-matter expertise on warehouse operations, labor requirements, WMS, automation capabilities, and operational constraints to ensure solutions are practical and executable
* Review proposed KPIs, SLAs, contractual requirements, solution assumptions, and cost models while identifying and escalating risks that could impact operational performance
* Partner with Implementations, Operations, HR, Analytics, and customers during joint planning and implementation to validate assumptions, develop volume and headcount ramp plans, and ensure the solution delivered matches the solution designed
* Lead Production Readiness Testing, develop solution-specific test cases, support User Acceptance Testing, and ensure KPI reporting is established prior to go-live
* Provide on-site support through site launch, go-live, and hypercare, helping Operations teams stabilize performance and transition to full operational ownership
* Identify and lead Continuous Improvement initiatives that deliver cost savings, productivity improvements, process optimization, and other business improvements across the network
* Develop business cases, conduct root-cause analysis, time studies, simulations, pilots, and process improvement activities, and present recommendations and validated results to leadership and Finance
* Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team while establishing clear expectations, accountability, performance goals, and career development opportunities

**What you need to succeed at GXO:**

**At a minimum, you'll need:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or equivalent related work or military experience
* 8+ years of related work experience
* Strong knowledge and experience in Lean Manufacturing and/or Continuous Improvement
* Advanced analytical skills with the ability to analyze complex data, processes, systems, and procedures
* Extensive knowledge of warehouse operations, supply chain management, and warehouse production environments
* Expertise in Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), supply chain automation, warehousing solutions, and production planning methodologies
* Strong knowledge of Lean Warehousing and warehouse/supply chain processes
* Experience using analytical and process improvement tools, including flow charts, Pareto charts, cause-and-effect diagrams, and run charts
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present complex information clearly to various audiences
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite

**It'd be great if you also have:**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field
* 2+ years of leadership experience
* Experience owning the development, enhancement, and maintenance of end-to-end solutions and deliverables
* Experience using AutoCAD to develop facility layouts and detailed work areas
* Lean or Six Sigma Black Belt certification
* Expert data management and SQL skills

**We engineer faster, smarter, leaner supply chains.**

GXO is a leading provider of cutting-edge supply chain solutions to the most successful companies in the world. We help our customers manage their goods most efficiently using our technology and services. Our greatest strength is our global team – energetic, innovative people of all experience levels and talents who make GXO a great place to work.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer including Disabled/Veterans.

GXO adheres to CDC, OSHA and state and local requirements regarding COVID safety. All employees and visitors are expected to comply with GXO policies which are in place to safeguard our employees and customers.

All applicants who receive a conditional offer of employment may be required to take and pass a pre-employment drug test.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified. All employees may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed. Review GXO's candidate privacy statement here.

records.title: Sr. Manager Accounting Operations
records.description:
Nova Biomedical: One Global Brand. One Vision. Together under one name.

Advanced Instruments and Nova Biomedical are now united under one brand, Nova Biomedical, marking a major milestone in our journey to deliver greater value to our customers. By combining our strengths, we're accelerating innovation, supporting critical workflows, and delivering world-class service across the biopharmaceutical and clinical markets.

**Job Summary:**

The Sr. Manager Accounting Operations leads the organization’s payables and receivables functions, ensuring accurate and timely transaction processing, effective cash management, strong internal controls, and excellent service to internal and external stakeholders. This role manages daily operations, develops team capability, drives process improvements, and partners across Finance, Procurement, Sales, Customer Service, and other functions to resolve issues and support business objectives.

**Responsibilities:**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Leadership and team management:** Lead, coach, and develop Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable staff; establish priorities, clarify responsibilities, monitor performance, and foster a collaborative, accountable, and service-oriented culture.
* **Accounts Payable:** Oversee invoice processing, approval workflows, vendor maintenance, payment runs, employee expense reimbursements, and issue resolution while ensuring payments are accurate, timely, properly authorized, and compliant with company policies.
* **Accounts Receivable:** Oversee customer invoicing, cash application, account reconciliation, collections, credit administration, dispute resolution, and aging review to support timely cash conversion and minimize past-due balances.
* **Travel Management:** Lead global adoption and upkeep of SAP Concur, manage global travel policy, partner with global travel management vendor, liaise with Treasury on credit card solutions and integrations to Concur and ERP, and reconcile related balance sheet balances and accruals.
* **Close and reconciliation:** Ensure timely completion of monthly, quarterly, and year-end close activities, including subledger reconciliations, accrual support, aging analysis, and resolution of reconciling items.
* **Controls and compliance:** Maintain strong internal controls, segregation of duties, and complete documentation; support internal and external audits and ensure adherence to applicable accounting standards, tax requirements, and company policies.
* **Cash flow and reporting:** Monitor payables and receivables trends, prepare cash requirement and collection forecasts, and provide accurate metrics and analysis to Finance leadership.
* **Process improvement:** Identify and implement opportunities to standardize, automate, and streamline processes; strengthen data quality, cycle time, scalability, and the stakeholder experience.
* **Systems and master data:** Support effective use of ERP, banking, expense, and workflow systems; maintain accurate vendor and customer master data and participate in system implementations or enhancements.
* **Business partnership:** Collaborate with Procurement, Operations, Sales, Customer Service, Treasury, Tax, and other partners to address root causes, resolve escalated issues, and improve end-to-end processes.
* **Risk management:** Implement controls that reduce fraud, duplicate payments, unauthorized transactions, bad debt, and credit exposure; escalate significant risks promptly.
* Develop, document, and maintain policies, procedures, service standards, and business continuity plans for both functions.
* Perform other responsibilities and special projects as assigned.

**Experience Requirements:**

* Seven or more years of progressive experience in accounts payable, accounts receivable, accounting operations, or a related field, including at least three years of people leadership experience.
* Demonstrated knowledge of invoice-to-pay and order-to-cash processes, general ledger interfaces, reconciliations, month-end close, internal controls, and audit support.
* Experience with ERP and financial systems; advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and comfort using reporting and workflow tools.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and project management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to build effective relationships across functions and with customers and vendors.
* High degree of accuracy, integrity, discretion, and sound judgment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* CPA, CMA, CAPP, CICP, or other relevant professional certification preferred.
* Experience in a multi-entity, multi-currency, manufacturing, life sciences, or similarly complex operating environment preferred.
* Experience with shared services, system implementation, process automation, or continuous improvement methodologies preferred.
* Experience in SAP S/4HANA, SAP Concur preferred.

**Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:**

* Comfort with working at a computer for extended periods.

* Capacity to lift and carry up to [25–50] pounds as required

* Able to communicate effectively via phone, video, and written communication.

* Occasional need to move about the office to access meetings or resources.

**Why Work for Nova Biomedical**

* Flexible Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage
* Competitive 401k company match
* Bonus Program, Generous PTO and paid holidays
* Generous Tuition reimbursement
* Hybrid and flexible work arrangements
* Professional development, engagement and events
* Company marketplace for lunch and snacks in our Norwood, MA, Billerica, MA and Westbrook, ME offices
* Company subsidized cafeteria in our Waltham, MA office

**Work Location:** Hybrid in **Waltham, MA**

**Targeted Salary Range:** **$180,000-$220,000/yr**

Nova Biomedical believes in transparency and integrity throughout all we do, including compensation. The provided salary range for this role represents the expected base salary or hourly rate for this opening. Actual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate’s experience and may vary based on individual factors such as location, skills, and education.
 
 
About the company

At Nova Biomedical, we’re not just building instruments, we’re powering breakthroughs that improve lives. Our smart, science-driven solutions are trusted in over 100 countries to speed drug development and enhance patient care.

Our integration brings together more than 70 years of scientific excellence with Nova’s cutting-edge innovation, forming a powerhouse of precision, purpose, and possibility. With FDA-registered, ISO-certified manufacturing, more than 125 FDA approvals, and industry-trusted diagnostics, we’re setting new standards in quality and reliability. Nova Biomedical is proud to be a global leader in osmolality testing and biotechnology and in vitro diagnostic (IVD) instrumentation, dedicated to advancing patient care and scientific discovery with a legacy that continues to shape the future of life sciences.

With headquarters in Norwood and Waltham, Massachusetts, and a global team of nearly 2,000 employees, we’re building a collaborative, empowered culture grounded in shared values: Customer Centricity, Ingenuity, Ownership & Accountability, Collaboration, and Integrity.

Working at Nova Biomedical means joining a mission-driven organization where your contributions matter. Whether you're in engineering, science, manufacturing, or support, you’ll be part of a team that values innovation, invests in your growth, and is committed to making a real-world impact on global health.

Explore what’s next with us at novabiomedical.com

records.title: Director, Practice Operations Quincy and Middleton

postedPay.title: Director, Practice Operations Quincy and Middleton

records.description:
**About Tufts Medicine**

Tufts Medicine brings together the best of academic and community medicine to deliver exceptional, connected and accessible care. Comprised of Tufts Medical Center, the principal teaching hospital of Tufts University and the Tufts University School of Medicine, Lowell General Hospital, MelroseWakefield Hospital, Lawrence Memorial Hospital of Medford, Care at Home, and an integrated network of 2,300 physicians, we treat the most complex conditions, keep our communities healthy and bring research breakthroughs to life.

**Job Overview**

This position reports to the Vice President of the Community Practice Operations (South and West) & Network Integration and serves as a key leader within Ambulatory at Tufts Medicine. The role provides operational and strategic oversight across the South region and in alignment with Ambulatory within the broader Tufts network.

In addition, this leader will oversee the Tufts Medicine Multi-Specialty location in Quincy, as well as Middleton, including not only operations, but also growth within these practices. Operating within a collaborative leadership model and with a focus on service excellence in the ambulatory environment, this position is accountable for:

* Ensuring high-quality patient access and experience
* Driving financial performance and profitability
* Optimizing all revenue cycle processes
* Advancing strategic initiatives across the region and potentially across Ambulatory as a whole, when designated

This role plays a critical part in shaping the Tufts Medicine ambulatory strategy, enhancing operational effectiveness, and supporting the delivery and expansion of exceptional care within the community.

Location: Hybrid and at sites within the designated region (e.g., Quincy & Middleton)

**Job Description**

**Minimum Qualifications:**

1. Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare, or a related field or equivalent combination of education and experience such as Associate’s degree in business, healthcare, or a related field and two (2) years of relevant business experience or High School Diploma or GED and four (4) years of relevant business experience.

2. Seven (7) years of healthcare management or practice management experience working directly with physicians and practice members.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

1. Master’s degree in business, healthcare, or a related field.

2. Ten (10) years of healthcare management or practice management experience working directly with physicians and practice members.

**Duties and Responsibilities:** The duties and responsibilities listed below are intended to describe the general nature of work and are not intended to be an all-inclusive list. Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned.

1. Directs the practice operations managers in the day-to-day operations of their employed outpatient physician practices to ensure each practice is meeting optimal operational efficiency, fiscal stability and patient/employee satisfaction.

2. Collaborates with the practice operations managers in the implementation of best practice models in all areas of practices operations. Develops guidelines for prioritizing work activities, evaluating effectiveness and modifying activities as necessary.

3. Evaluates practice efficiency including all personnel (physicians, clinical and administrative support staff) utilizing accepted quality measures, productivity standards, skill mix comparisons, and patient satisfaction survey data. Implements new operational models and structures to reduce cost, improve efficiency and quality, and enhance services to patients.

4. Participates in the development of and oversees budgets for the practices. Reviews monthly P&L reports in detail, determines opportunities for improvements, and creates and implements action plans with practice operations managers as necessary.

5. Conducts monthly operations team meetings to review new policies and procedures, processes, quality measures, etc., and monthly one-on-one meetings with each practice manager at each practice location to provide individual support and leadership.

6. Initiates and maintains all policy and procedure manuals. Develops and implements standardized processes for practices to ensure consistency throughout the physician network. Works with practice operations managers to ensure practices meet required compliance and clinical competency thresholds.

7. Works collaboratively with the physician recruitment team on the provider enrollment onboarding activities related to new practice acquisitions or new employed providers. Works closely with the provider recruitment team, practice operations manager and provider(s) throughout the onboarding life cycle to ensure timeliness and deliverables are met for a seamless transition and successful implementation.

8. In collaboration with the Vice President of Physician Services, implements the transition plan for newly acquired physician practices. Acts as liaison to physicians, support staff, operations team, hospital departments, and hospital administration. Responsible for the human resources, payroll, finance, and purchasing components of the acquisitions.

9. Works collaboratively with representatives from the physician organizations to ensure that our practices and providers are achieving a high level of performance under managed risk contracts as we transition to a value-based model. Commitment to transformation and innovation in care delivery through the Practice of the Future work will also be a measure of success.

**Physical Requirements:**

1. Work environment: professional office environment with typical office requirements such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets, etc.

2. Frequently required to speak, hear, communicate and exchange information.

3. Able to see and read computers displays, read fine print, and/or normal type size print and distinguish letters, numbers and symbols.

4. Occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

5. Ability to work in confined or open environments.

6. Ability to work independently or in a team environment.

7. Ability to travel to various locations both within the state and outside the state.

**Skills & Abilities:**

1. Demonstrates leadership style that emphasizes openness, visibility and connectivity.

2. Ability to convey the organization’s enthusiasm, confidence, goals, and mission and inspire those things in others.

3. Ability to connect with people in a meaningful way at all levels within the organization in keeping with the culture of the senior leadership team.

4. Demonstrates forward thinking and creativity with high ethical standards and an appropriate professional image while fostering collaboration and building consensus to achieve collective objectives.

5. Ability to make tough choices that serve the best interests of the organization. Proven creative problem-solving skills with the willingness to take the initiative in leading change as well as the ability to effectively manage change.

6. Ability to build consensus with strong negotiation, persuasion and communication skills to propose enhancements to operational processes to improve efficiency and/or effectiveness.

7. Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills necessary to engage effectively at all levels for effecting timely progress.

8. Ability to be an innovative problem solver with excellent critical thinking skills.

9. Demonstrates exemplary leadership and stakeholder management expertise.

10. Ability to hold self and others accountable to meet deadlines and achieve business goals.

**Job Profile Summary**

This role focuses on providing administrative and business support to the organization in order to achieve operational goals. In addition, this role focuses on performing the following Clinical Administration duties: Long-term strategic planning, determines strategic issues and opportunities that could affect practice success, prioritizes and tracks investments across practices, allocates resources and makes decisions regarding practice growth, and develops need to accomplish the practice's vision. A management role that supervises employees focusing on tactical, operational activities within a specified area, with the majority of time spent overseeing area of responsibility, planning, prioritizing and/or directing the responsibilities of employees. Goal achievement is typically accomplished through performance of direct and/or indirect reports. A role that directs a department or small unit that includes multiple teams led by managers and/or team Leaders. Responsibilities typically include: ownership of short to mid-term (1-3 years) execution of functional strategy and the operational direction of the Department, problems faced are often complex and require extensive investigation and analysis, and requires ability to influence others to accept practices and approaches, and ability to communicate and influence executive leadership.

At Tufts Medicine, we want every individual to feel valued for the skills and experience they bring. Our compensation philosophy is designed to offer fair, competitive pay that attracts, retains, and motivates highly talented individuals, while rewarding the important work you do every day.

The base pay ranges reflect the minimum qualifications for the role. Individual offers are determined using a comprehensive approach that considers relevant experience, certifications, education, skills, and internal equity to ensure compensation is fair, consistent, and aligned with our business goals.

Beyond base pay, Tufts Medicine provides a comprehensive Total Rewards package that supports your health, financial security, and career growth—one of the many ways we invest in you so you can thrive both at work and outside of it.

**Pay Range****:**

 
$134,525.66 - $171,524.44

*based on full-time equivalent*

records.title: FM Global Account and Operations Director

postedPay.title: FM Global Account and Operations Director

records.description:
**Job Overview**

Flexim Group is seeking an experienced Global Account Operations Manager to provide senior operational leadership for a strategic international account operating across complex sites and manufacturing environments.

Based in Jersey City, you will hold global accountability for operational performance across the account, leading regional and site teams to deliver consistent FM and technical services, safety, compliance and business continuity.

This is a management operations role requiring strong experience, technical credibility and the ability to lead through senior regional and site operations teams. You will set operational standards, challenge performance, manage critical escalations and translate global client priorities into disciplined execution across countries and facilities.

**Duties**

* Lead global operational performance across a complex, multi-country manufacturing account.
* Lead and challenge regional and site Operations Managers, ensuring clear accountability and consistent execution.
* Drive services excellence, with a strong focus on asset reliability, maintenance, utilities and critical infrastructure.
* Establish and enforce global operational standards, while ensuring effective implementation at regional and site level.
* Monitor and challenge operational performance through KPIs, SLAs, CMMS/BMS data, maintenance completion, backlog and asset uptime.
* Lead critical operational escalations.

records.title: Operations Director
records.description:
Job Overview

The Operations Director will oversee the company's day to day operations and work closely with leadership to ensure that business objectives are being met. This role is responsible for managing operational performance, supporting department managers, improving internal processes, and making sure teams have the direction and resources they need to do their jobs effectively.

You will work across finance, sales, customer service, and project management to keep business activities organized and running smoothly. The right person understands how to manage people and resources, keep an eye on financial performance, and address operational problems before they affect the business.

Responsibilities

Oversee daily business operations and work with department managers to establish priorities, assign responsibilities, and maintain consistent performance across teams.

Monitor profit and loss performance, review operating expenses, and work with finance to manage budgets and improve financial results.

Use financial reports, operational data, and Microsoft Excel to evaluate performance, identify problems, and support day to day business decisions.

Manage operational projects and process improvement initiatives, looking for practical ways to reduce unnecessary costs, improve efficiency, and strengthen service delivery.

Work with sales, business development, and customer service teams to coordinate activities and ensure that operational priorities support the company's business goals.

Review existing procedures and introduce improvements where needed, including the use of lean management principles to improve workflow and resource utilization.

Manage and support department managers, provide clear direction, and follow up on operational responsibilities and performance.

Work with senior leadership on business planning, resource allocation, and decisions that affect the company's operations and long term development.

Address operational challenges, resolve internal coordination issues, and ensure that important projects and business activities stay on track.

Experience and Qualifications

Demonstrated experience in operations management, business management, or a related management position, with a strong record of supervising teams and overseeing daily business activities.

Experience managing department managers, coordinating multiple business functions, and maintaining accountability across an organization.

Strong understanding of financial management, profit and loss oversight, operating budgets, and financial performance analysis.

Ability to interpret financial reports, analyze operational data, and use Microsoft Excel to support business decisions.

Experience with strategic planning, project management, process improvement, and operational performance management.

Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to guide managers, develop employees, and address business challenges.

A practical understanding of sales operations, business development, and customer service.

Familiarity with lean management principles and continuous improvement practices is valuable.

Good organizational skills, sound business judgment, and the ability to manage competing priorities while keeping teams focused on results.

Pay: $158,200.00 - $222,200.00 per year

Benefits:

* Employee assistance program

* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account

records.title: Director, Operational Excellence
records.description:
The Director, Operational Excellence will focus on delivery excellence, process optimization, resource management, and stakeholder management. The Director will be an operational leader who develops frameworks and effective ways of working on which our organization can build in the coming years. This includes ownership of organizational resource tracking, resource planning, hiring process support, and staff augmentation vendor management, so the organization has the right talent in the right roles at the right time in line with funds planning. The Director and team will ensure that the organization develops and fully integrates a continuous improvement culture, with the ultimate goal of ensuring team efficiency, and financial effectiveness.

 

* Leads priorities focused on service delivery and capability alignment, resource management, budget/financial management, vendor and technology management, communications, and training
* Partners with the Leadership Team in short- and long-term planning activities that align with the organization’s strategy, vision, operational plan, and goals
* Establishes and maintains organization-wide resource tracking, providing visibility into headcount, allocation, capacity, utilization, and cost across colleagues and contingent workers
* Leads resource planning in partnership with the Leadership Team and Finance, forecasting demand, identifying capability and capacity gaps, and recommending the right mix of full-time and augmented staff
* Supports hiring processes in partnership with Talent Acquisition and PX, including position requests and approvals, job description development, requisition tracking, interview coordination, and onboarding readiness
* Manages processes related to staff augmentation vendors, including vendor selection, rate and contract negotiation, performance management, and spend oversight
* Drives innovative thinking and planning, leveraging new technologies as needed, to address the needs of the organization and its individual capabilities
* Challenges the status quo and drives continuous improvement by establishing a solid foundation and implementing standard ways of working, systems, processes, and frameworks.
* Works closely with cross-functional peers and team members to consolidate efforts for org processes improvements, but also applies independent decision making to ensure best possible approach is being implemented.
* Promotes a continuous improvement mindset and process improvement initiatives through communication, training, and best practices, ensuring accountability through governance.
* Has critical impact on significant reduction of administrative and redundant tasks across Engineering & Technology organization through applying most efficient and suitable AI tools and bringing in innovative ways of working.
* Builds, develops, and grows relationships with internal and external stakeholders and vendors at every level
* Serves as strategic program/project manager for key organizational projects. Has direct accountability for budget assigned to these projects and management of related vendors, supports oversight processes for organizational budget.
* Coaches, mentors, and supports the professional growth of direct reports. Responsible for efficient resource and funds allocation within the team.

**Basic Qualifications**

Bachelors degree and 8+ years relevant work experience

Strong written and verbal communication skills and interpersonal, collaboration, and facilitation skills

Proven analytical and critical thinking skills, and strong background in process improvement

Practical experience with operational, process improvement, gaining efficiencies and project management methodologies and ability to lead project teams

Ability to multi-task and handle multiple priorities while managing aggressive deadlines

Strong ability for independent decision making while working closely with cross-functional peers

Demonstrated ability to manage/lead complex projects, including resource and budget management for assigned projects

**Preferred Qualifications**

Masters degree in related field

Pharmaceutical or Healthcare industry experience

Practical experience with organization setup processes that include job descriptions creation, managing hiring processes with human resources, sourcing contracted resources.

Project Management Professional (PMP) and/or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt (LSSBB)

Knowledge of or expertise in Digital product development and/or Design Thinking

Experience driving change in a global, matrixed organization

Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

**NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS**

National and International travel may be necessary

Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

Last Date to Apply for Job: 11/30/2026

 
The annual base salary for this position ranges from $176,600.00 to $294,300.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 20.0% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Learn more at Pfizer Candidate Site – U.S. Benefits | (uscandidates.mypfizerbenefits.com). Pfizer compensation structures and benefit packages are aligned based on the location of hire. The United States salary range provided does not apply to Tampa, FL or any location outside of the United States. 
This role is posted in multiple locations. If you are applying for the role in an secondary job posting location where pay transparency regulations apply, your Talent Advisor will share the local pay information with you during the first interview.

Relocation assistance may be available based on business needs and/or eligibility.

**Sunshine Act**

Pfizer reports payments and other transfers of value to health care providers as required by federal and state transparency laws and implementing regulations. These laws and regulations require Pfizer to provide government agencies with information such as a health care provider’s name, address and the type of payments or other value received, generally for public disclosure. Subject to further legal review and statutory or regulatory clarification, which Pfizer intends to pursue, reimbursement of recruiting expenses for licensed physicians may constitute a reportable transfer of value under the federal transparency law commonly known as the Sunshine Act. Therefore, if you are a licensed physician who incurs recruiting expenses as a result of interviewing with Pfizer that we pay or reimburse, your name, address and the amount of payments made currently will be reported to the government. If you have questions regarding this matter, please do not hesitate to contact your Talent Acquisition representative.
