records.title: Director of Strategic Operations
records.description:
Who We Are
 
 
Chesapeake Employers’ Insurance Company is a purpose-driven organization dedicated to improving the lives and livelihoods of our policyholders, injured workers, team members, and the community. As a leading workers' compensation specialty insurer in the mid-Atlantic region, we take pride in being a force for good. Our 350 team members are committed to making a positive impact every day in the lives of all our stakeholders. Join our motivated, professional team as we foster a culture of values, teamwork, innovation, and collaboration. Established in 1914, Chesapeake Employers Insurance, headquartered in Towson, Maryland, has over a century of experience, a strong financial foundation, and an "A" rating from AM Best.
 
 
Why This Role Matters
 
This is a unique opportunity to join an organization as the leader responsible for shaping Chesapeake's operating model. This role sits at the center of how Chesapeake sustainably translates strategic and operational intent into focused action and impact.
 
At Chesapeake Employers, we believe great strategy only creates value when it is consistently translated into focused execution. We are seeking a Director of Strategic Operations to serve as the enterprise steward of Chesapeake's Growth System; our Four Disciplines of Execution-based (4DX) operating model.
 
Reporting directly to the President & CEO, this highly visible leadership role is responsible for owning, sustaining, and maturing Chesapeake’s operating model (The Growth System) enabling focused, enterprise-side strategic and operational execution. The Director of Strategic Operations will work closely with executive leaders and teams across the company to ensure priorities are clear, resources are aligned, and the organization's most important work moves forward.
 
This is an opportunity for a systems designer, disciplined operator, and influential leader who thrives on creating clarity, building alignment, and driving execution in a collaborative environment. This leader will influence not only what Chesapeake achieves, but how it achieves it; helping make the Growth System the Chesapeake Way of working.
 
What Success Looks Like
 
A successful Director of Strategic Operations will help Chesapeake mature a disciplined, sustainable operating system for execution. Over time, success in this role will look like:
 

* Maintaining Growth System Standard Operating Procedures: playbooks, templates, tools, processes and communication materials.
* Ensuring the Growth System is understood, consistently applied, and continuously improved across the enterprise.
* Supporting leaders’ understanding of how the elements of the Growth System work together within Chesapeake’s operating model.
* Guiding the senior leadership team to prioritize Strategic Execution Wildly Important Goals (WIGs) aligned to enterprise strategy and scope WIGs into executable programs and projects within the 4DX model.
* Orchestrating delivery across the Strategic Execution WIG portfolio.
* Coaching leaders on 4DX operating model disciplines, including WIG design, scoreboard development, team kickoffs and syncs, and celebration rituals.
* Supporting team leaders in identifying, creating a backlog, prioritizing, and launching Focused Improvement WIGs that deliver targeted, measurable growth and improvement outcomes.
* Designing, maturing and running Chesapeake’s Enterprise Project Portfolio Council (EPPC) and overarching governance model that supports Growth System WIG capacity assessment, prioritization decisioning and execution coordination.
* Helping leaders assess team capacity, authority, resources, and focus needed to execute WIGs successfully.
* Providing executive leaders with clear visibility into progress, blockers, and capacity concerns.
* Helping teams see how their work connects to Chesapeake’s purpose and strategy.
* The Growth System becomes a trusted way of working.

Be a Part of Inspiring Chesapeake’s Values-Based Leadership Mindset:
 
Purpose Driven
 
Connects goals, priorities, and execution to a larger mission and helps others understand the impact of their work.
 
People First
 
Builds trust, listens with curiosity, and helps teams navigate change with empathy and clarity.
 
Committed to Winning Together
 
Breaks down silos, fosters collaboration, and creates environments where teams succeed together.
 
A Risk Taker at Heart
 
Fosters curiosity, encourages experimentation and guides the organization to turn bold ideas into meaningful progress.
 
Join us and shape how Chesapeake sustainably translates strategic and operational intent into focused action and impact.
 
 
**Position Summary:** 
The Director of Strategic Operations is an enterprise-wide systems design and execution leader responsible for owning, sustaining and maturing the company’s operating model. Chesapeake Employers’ Growth System is the company’s Four Disciplines of Execution (4DX)-based operating model enabling Strategic and Focused Improvement (operational-level) execution to continuously and sustainably grow stakeholder value.
 
This role sits at the center of how Chesapeake sustainably translates strategic and operational intent into focused action and impact. The Director of Strategic Operations ensures that Wildly Important Goals (WIGs) are well-formed, appropriately prioritized and resourced, actively managed, and connected to the company’s strategic direction, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and annual business plan. They ensure the Growth System is not treated as an additional layer of work but becomes The Chesapeake Way of working to focus capacity, surface and address blockers, and achieve desired outcomes to continuously elevate tangible delivery of Chesapeake’s purpose to stakeholders.
 
The Director of Strategic Operations does not primarily lead through formal authority. Instead, this person must lead through influence, clarity, structure, trust, and disciplined follow-through. They can constructively challenge thinking, influence senior leaders, facilitate challenging prioritization discussions, and establish alignment across varying priorities. They must be able to inspire and motivate others, help leaders understand the “why” and “how” behind the Growth System, and create the conditions for teams to sustainably improve the business solving important, challenging problems together.
 
 
**Duties and Responsibilities:** 
Growth System Leadership
 

* Serve as the enterprise owner and steward of Chesapeake’s Growth System.
* Maintain fidelity to the 4DX operating model, including WIG selection, lead and lag measures, scoreboards, team syncs, accountability rhythms, and celebrations.
* Ensure the Growth System is understood, consistently applied, and continuously improved across the enterprise
* Support leaders in understanding how the elements of the Growth System work together within Chesapeake’s operating model.
* Coordinate periodic refreshes of corporate-level KPIs and facilitate team-level KPIs development enterprise-wide via process management.
* Ensure that team-level KPIs and Focused Improvement WIGs are aligned with corporate-level KPIs.
* Monitor and ensure consistent reporting of KPIs and WIGs within Growth System channels.
* Maintain and update Growth System Standard Operating Procedures: playbooks, templates, tools, processes and communication materials.

Strategic Execution
 

* Manage the Strategic Execution practices of the Growth System.
* Facilitate executive level decisioning to align priorities, resources, capacity and planning with enterprise strategy and operational targets.
* Manage the Strategic Execution portfolio and backlog scope and structure WIGs into executable programs and projects within the 4Dx model.
* Orchestrate delivery across the Strategic Execution WIG portfolio.
* Surface and guide resolution of risks, blockers, capacity constraints, and decision-making through the company’s governance framework.

Operational Excellence & Focused Improvement
 

* Ensure leaders’ consistent adoption of Standard Operating Procedures.
* Coach leaders on 4DX operating model disciplines, including WIG design, scoreboard development, team kickoff, team syncs, and celebration rituals.
* Support team leaders in identifying, creating a backlog, prioritizing, and launching WIGs that deliver targeted, measurable growth and improvement outcomes.
* Guide leaders on identifying and moving appropriate Focused Improvement WIGs to and through the governance model.
* Maintain visibility of Focused Improvement WIGs, priority and capacity decisioning across the enterprise.
* Monitor the health of Focused Improvement WIGs without over-centralizing ownership of team-level work.

Governance & Enterprise Alignment
 

* Design, mature, and run Chesapeake’s Enterprise Project Portfolio Council (EPPC) and overarching governance model that supports Growth System WIG capacity assessment, prioritization decisioning and execution coordination.
* Manage the enterprise-wide backlog of prioritized Strategic Execution and Focused Improvement WIG opportunities, ensuring they are aligned with and responsive to existing backlogs across governance bodies.
* Clarify enterprise-wide priority and capacity decision ownership and create feedback loops.
* Prepare materials for Enterprise Project and Portfolio Council (EPPC) meetings, including WIG prioritization decisions, in-flight WIG status, risks, blockers, capacity considerations, recommended decisions and measurement of return-on-investment.
* Ensure the right leaders have the right level of visibility into the right work at the right time.
* Create practices to minimize duplication, overcommitment, and misalignment across enterprise priorities.

Assess Organizational Capacity
 

* Support leaders in distinguishing between availability and true capacity.
* Help leaders assess whether teams have the capacity, authority, resources, and focus needed to execute WIGs successfully.
* Identify where the organization may be overcommitted or where WIGs need to be narrowed, sequenced, paused, or escalated.
* Encourage disciplined prioritization so the Growth System strengthens focus rather than adding unmanageable work on top of the whirlwind.

Change Leadership & Adoption
 

* Serve as a champion and translator of the Growth System across the organization.
* Help leaders and teams understand why the Growth System matters and how it enables the organization to continuously and sustainably grow stakeholder value.
* Own, sustain, and mature enterprise-wide change management practices.
* Communicate in ways that are credible with executives, useful to team leaders, and accessible to team members.
* Facilitate conversations that surface resistance, clarify concerns, and move teams toward action.
* Surface learnings, recognize progress, and help teams celebrate wins.
* Build confidence and consistency in the Growth System over time.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:** 

* Enterprise operating system frameworks’ design and execution
* Enterprise program management and execution discipline
* Familiarity with and capable of applying change management techniques
* Governance design and facilitation
* Ability to manage complex, cross-functional work
* Strong meeting facilitation and operating rhythm design
* Ability to coach leaders without relying on positional authority
* Strong communication with executives, managers, and frontline staff
* Ability to translate strategy into clear goals, measures, and actions
* Understanding of lead measures, lag measures, dashboards, and scoreboards
* Backlog management and prioritization
* Broad stakeholder engagement
* Continuous improvement mindset and process improvement experience
* Ability to identify risks, blockers, dependencies, and capacity constraints
* Strong documentation skills, including SOPs, playbooks, templates, and status reporting
* Comfort working in ambiguity while creating clarity for others

**Minimum Qualifications:** 

* Bachelor’s degree in business, management, organizational leadership or related field required
* 5 to 8 years of hands-on experience in leading complex management systems design and execution
* Experience supporting management operating systems such as 4DX, Objectives & Key Results (OKRs), Hoshin Kanri, Lean, Agile, or similar strategy execution frameworks
* Experience creating repeatable management system SOPs, operating rhythms, playbooks, templates, and communications
* Experience program and project managing enterprise-wide strategic initiatives with executive engagement
* Experience facilitating governance bodies, meetings, and operating rhythms
* Experience coaching leaders and teams through change
* Experience building dashboards, scoreboards, status reports, or executive visibility tools
* Experience managing backlogs, prioritization processes, and cross-functional dependencies
* Familiarity with Microsoft tools and enterprise collaboration platforms

**Preferred Qualifications:** 

* Deep knowledge of the 4 Disciplines of Execution is a plus
* Certification in Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, change management, project management or related disciplines is a plus

**Physical Demands:** 
This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
 
While performing the duties of the job, the teammate is regularly required to sit, use hands to fingers, handle or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms. The teammate is occasionally required to stand, walk, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. The teammate may occasionally lift up-to 30 pounds. Specific vision abilities are required, which include, close vision, peripheral vision and the ability to adjust focus.
 
When in office, able to work in an office environment where the noise level is moderate.
 
**Work Designation:** Hybrid
 
 
What We Offer
 
 
We offer a competitive benefits package that includes health, vision, and dental coverage, a robust PTO plan, an 8% employer contribution to retirement regardless of team member contribution, educational assistance, and opportunities to participate in team member appreciation events. Additionally, we provide STD, LTD and group life insurance 1X a team members salary. You'll also enjoy free tickets to community attractions, all part of our commitment to providing a high quality of work life. You will have the flexibility to thrive in a hybrid work environment and an opportunity to participate in development and volunteer programs.

records.title: Director of Operations
records.description:
**About Us** 
Ten Five Hospitality is a growing collective of restaurants, bars, and entertainment venues known for concept-driven experiences and standout hospitality. Headquartered between Los Angeles and Miami, Ten Five holds a history of working with and crafting some of the most sought after brands in the world. Ten Five represents the organizational, operational and creative excellence to bring original and authentic visions to life while outperforming the market on the bottom-line.

**Position Summary**

The Director of Operations – Restaurants is responsible for overseeing effective operating procedures within the restaurant while developing a successful management team.

**Daily Responsibilities**

* Plan and direct administration and planning functions of the Food & Beverage department to meet the daily needs of the operation.
* Clearly describe, assign, and delegate responsibility and authority for the operation of the various food & beverage positions.
* Possesses knowledge of all front-of-house job duties.
* Provides financial oversight and prepares and presents financial and operations reports.
* Possesses in-depth knowledge of all operational systems in use including but not limited to payroll, inventory and purchasing.
* Ensures that all mechanical systems are in good working order and compliant with all federal, state and local ordinances.
* Regulates all executive-level POS functions.
* Oversee and supervise the execution of front-of-house operations to ensure quality, safety, efficiency, and profitability.
* Assists managers in establishing and achieving predetermined profit objectives and desired standards of quality of food, service, cleanliness and promotion.
* Responsible, with the Executive Chef and General Manager, for maintaining the venue’s monthly Profit & Loss statement standards while meeting or exceeding budget expectations through controlling P&L items.
* Oversees that training programs are in place for employees to update their knowledge on relevant industry practices.
* Oversees that the venue is compliant with all federal, state, and local laws and regulations and company policies.
* Possesses in-depth knowledge of all food and beverage menus.
* Oversees that all guest and employee concerns are resolved in a way that promotes guest retention.
* Oversees the replacement or repair of all breakage or damage of equipment, furniture, or other company property.
* Ensures front-of-house employees follow all policies and procedures by providing clear guidelines and expectations.
* Maintain professional appearance standards as directed in the Employee Handbook.
* Anticipates and accommodates needs of guests while providing professional and exceptional service to ensure guest satisfaction.
* Protects establishment, guests, and employees by adhering to and overseeing that the Department of Health and company sanitation standards are followed.
* Responsible for management interviewing, hiring, and training process decisions.
* Coaches front-of-house managers as needed and assists in their professional development.

**Physical Requirements**

* Must be able to stand, walk, lift, and bend for extended periods of time.
* Must be able to bend and lift up to 50 lbs.
* Role may include job duties or tasks requiring repetitive motions.
* Exposure to hot kitchen elements or cleaning materials.

**Skills/Experience**

* Minimum five (5) years’ experience working in a general management role in hospitality/nightlife/ bars.
* Passionate about hospitality, food and beverage and morale/culture.
* Ability to think proactively and creatively, have decision making and analytical skills and be effective in written and verbal communication.
* Self-motivated with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, effectively multi-task, and drive results.
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays when required.

*We are an equal opportunity employer.*

records.title: Director of Operations
records.description:
**Job Overview**

The Director of Operations leads business operations and operations management, turning strategic plans into clear priorities and effective execution. You’ll guide executive-level teams, manage budgets and financial performance, and strengthen processes across the organization. This role calls for confident leadership, sound judgment, and a practical, data-driven approach to change and growth.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead operational excellence initiatives, process improvement, and operational analysis to improve business performance.
* Direct strategic planning, project management, and program management, aligning work with organizational priorities.
* Oversee executive-level budget management, financial management, budgeting, forecasting, and profit and loss analysis.
* Manage business development and business development management, identifying opportunities and coordinating execution.
* Lead change management, including large-scale organizational change, and communicate plans and progress clearly to executives. Your impact: Clear priorities and disciplined execution help teams deliver reliable operations and better serve customers.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience in operations management, business management, strategic management, and operational management.
* Experience in senior leadership, executive leadership, executive-level team management, management, and supervising experience.
* Strong budget management, financial management, forecasting, and profit and loss analysis skills.
* Proven ability to lead process improvement, project management, business development, and organizational change.
* Excellent verbal communication with executives and a record of data-driven decision making and strategic planning.

Pay: $45.00 - $95.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Parental leave
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement

Work Location: Hybrid remote in North Chicago, IL 60064

records.title: VP, Operations/Regional Director
records.description:
**About Us:**

One of the reasons why we are the nation’s leading parking management expert is because we recognize that “people” are what makes our company successful. It is this recognition that serves as the foundation and building block for our continued growth and success. Having been in business for over 75 years, we understand what it means to earn “Every Thank You,” which is treating our clients, partners, guests, and team members with utmost respect and courtesy. As one of the largest privately held management companies, we have the experience, passion, and the know-how to withstand the test of time and to disrupt the new marketplace with exploding new technologies.

**Culture:**

We have a strong, distinctive culture – a culture that is heavily influenced by a shared vision, style, and values. Our company values are the glue that binds our business, clients, and team members. There are some common traits that contribute to our unique culture. Clear values, caring, loyalty, humility, and a deep commitment to community are just a few of them. These characteristics often steer our decision-making and define the way we treat our customers, clients, suppliers, and team members. We guard these values and attributes fiercely.

**About the Position:**

The Regional Director [Vice President of Operations] is a high-impact leadership role responsible for new business development and operations.

**New Business Development: 70%**

* Develop new client relationships by identifying opportunities in key service areas, establishing, and building a base of Company contacts within those organizations, and positioning the Company to obtain and close on those opportunities.
* Build existing client base revenues by presenting new business opportunities beyond existing project scopes, up-selling, and seeking out new sources of revenue from existing clients. Perform strategic account reviews to identify specific areas for opportunities to clients.
* Implement and execute with excellence all business development strategies, programs, and services to further enhance the organization’s position in the marketplace.
* Utilize corporate and regional marketing programs to develop and generate leads, to include cold calling, networking, and development of contacts.

postedPay.title: Director of Operations / Multi-Unit General Manager

records.description:
Multi-Unit General Manager

**District Kitchen & Bar + PUBLIC eat+drink** 
Berkshire County, Massachusetts

Compensation

**$130,000–$160,000 total compensation** (base salary + performance bonus)

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced, results-driven Multi-Unit General Manager to oversee two established, high-volume independent restaurants in the Berkshires. This is a senior leadership role for someone who thrives on building strong teams, driving profitability, implementing systems, and creating operational excellence.

The ideal candidate is equal parts operator, coach, and business strategist. You'll work directly with ownership to improve performance across both locations while ensuring exceptional guest experiences and a strong workplace culture.

Key Objectives

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Growing top-line revenue
* Increasing restaurant profitability
* Reducing controllable costs
* Implementing scalable systems and procedures
* Developing and retaining high-performing managers
* Improving accountability and operational consistency
* Strengthening guest satisfaction and online reputation

ResponsibilitiesBusiness Performance

* Own P&L performance for both restaurants
* Analyze financial results and identify opportunities for revenue growth and margin improvement
* Develop and execute plans to increase sales, traffic, and guest frequency
* Monitor labor, food, beverage, and operating costs
* Establish measurable KPIs and hold management teams accountable

Leadership & Team Development

* Recruit, hire, train, and develop management staff as needed
* Create a culture of accountability, professionalism, and hospitality
* Conduct regular performance reviews and coaching sessions
* Build leadership depth within both organizations
* Resolve employee issues quickly and professionally

Operations

* Ensure consistent execution of service, food quality, and hospitality standards
* Standardize systems and procedures across both locations where appropriate
* Oversee scheduling, staffing levels, inventory controls, and purchasing
* Improve efficiency and eliminate operational bottlenecks
* Maintain compliance with all health, safety, labor, and licensing requirements

Revenue Growth

* Partner with ownership on marketing and promotional initiatives
* Identify opportunities to increase guest counts, check averages, and repeat business
* Oversee private events, catering opportunities, and community partnerships
* Evaluate menu performance and pricing strategies alongside culinary leadership

Qualifications

* 5+ years of senior restaurant management experience
* Multi-unit management experience strongly preferred
* Demonstrated success improving restaurant profitability
* Strong financial acumen with deep understanding of P&L management
* Experience managing managers and building leadership teams
* Proven ability to create systems, processes, and accountability structures
* Strong communication and organizational skills
* Hospitality-first mindset combined with strong business discipline

Ideal Candidate

You are:

* Highly accountable and results-oriented
* Comfortable making difficult decisions
* Analytical and data-driven
* Skilled at motivating teams and developing leaders
* Focused on continuous improvement
* Equally comfortable in the dining room, the kitchen, and the financial statements

What We Offer

* Competitive compensation package of $130,000–$160,000 annually
* Significant performance-based bonus opportunity
* High level of autonomy and decision-making authority
* Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on two well-established restaurants
* Direct partnership with ownership on strategy and growth initiatives

To Apply

Please submit your resume along with a brief note outlining:

* Your multi-unit management experience
* A specific example of improving profitability at a restaurant operation
* Why this opportunity interests you

Pay: $130,000.00 - $160,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

records.title: Director Quality Assurance
records.description:
**Obsessed by Science. Entrepreneurial by Nature. United by Purpose.**
Diasorin is a global leader in immunodiagnostic and molecular diagnostic solutions, advancing science to improve patient outcomes worldwide. For more than 50 years, we have combined scientific rigor with an entrepreneurial mindset, operating with a strong commitment to innovation, accountability, and results to deliver trusted diagnostic solutions.
  
  
As the Diagnostics Specialist, Diasorin continuously invests in research, technology, and people. Guided by our values of operational excellence, customer focus, and teamwork, we empower teams to think boldly, act decisively, and transform ideas into meaningful impact across one of the industry’s broadest specialty diagnostic portfolios.
  
  
When you join Diasorin, you are not just filling a role. You are helping build what comes next.
  
  
**Why Join Diasorin**

* Build What Matters Take ownership, challenge the status quo, and contribute directly to solutions that improve patient care worldwide.
* Innovate with Agility at a Global Scale Work in an entrepreneurial environment that enables speed, collaboration, and global impact.
* Grow in a People-Centered Culture Thrive in a culture that values accountability, inclusion, and continuous development.

**Job Scope:**
The Director, Quality Assurance for Austin will lead, establish, implement and maintain quality assurance systems and activities ensuring compliance with domestic and international quality system standards and regulations for commercial medical devices designed, produced and marketed by Luminex. Partner with Manufacturing, Design/Development, Systems Engineering, Quality Control and others across functions to deliver the highest quality instruments, and reagents. This position is responsible for the oversight, control and release of instruments and reagents, quality organizational management, budget preparation, personnel management, organizational goals and metrics, and Executive Level presentations. The Director, Quality Assurance for Austin is a leader and a mentor.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities And Duties**

* Ensures that the Austin site demonstrates regulatory compliance per GLP/GCP/cGMP/GXP, ISO, and other applicable regulations.
* Support instrument new product development and manufacturing changes, provides guidance to the core teams and participate in the process.
* Leader in process optimization by Identifying and analyzing opportunities for continual improvements in product/service quality, customer satisfaction, and company profitability.
* Leads the strategy and improvements for the manufacturing and service depot of Instruments for our customers and partners in compliance with regulations and standards.
* Participates and manage activities for external audits such as ISO, FDA or other regulatory bodies for the Austin site. Acts in Audits - as co-host, SME or escort
* Responds to alleged QMS violations of regulations, policies, procedures as the result of both external and external audits by evaluating and recommending the initiation of investigative activities, immediate corrections and risk analysis processes. Coordinates responses to external audits and manages corrective actions to close.
* Interacts with various internal and external groups to facilitate the completion of internal audits, handling of non-conformances, performing Risk Assessments, CAPA, investigation and support, manufacturing validation as well as Design Transfer.
* QMS improvements and enhancements and is a leading member of the Quality Management Team. Works across the corporation to align and define quality approach for molecular diagnostic products.
* Partners with Site Leadership and Field Quality to conduct, manage, and evaluate investigations related to customer complaints, nonconformances, audits, corrective/preventive action concerns, deviations, recalls, and potential injuries
* Appropriately escalate Quality issues to the Vice President Quality Assurance Molecular Division
* Provide leadership in the application of Quality Tools such as Risk Management, Root Cause Investigations, Designs of Experiments, Capability Studies, in the establishment and investigation of process and products failures and implement lasting solutions of such failures.
* May act as IVDR Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC) for Luminex sites to ensure: the conformity of the devices is appropriately checked before a device is released, the post-market surveillance and reporting obligations are fulfilled and all requirements established between Luminex and Authorized representative are met.
* May act as Management Representative for the site. In this capacity, ensure that product meets label claims and customer satisfaction, any quality or regulatory issue is elevated to the President and/or Vice President Quality Assurance Compliance North America and oversee and drive continuous improvement.
* Develops and releases Change Plans and actions to support the changing needs and requirements of the organization as the result of strategic changes in business direction
* Provide other Quality related technical training as necessary
* Directs activities of employees or through managers who exercise full supervision for daily operations. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws.
* Maintains talent through recruiting and development opportunities. Continually develops internal candidates through succession planning and career development.
* Responsible for enforcing all EHS policies in their span of control
* Be part of any the new key and strategic projects and due diligence process if required
* Ensure all site-level activities and related documentation are aligned with corporate procedures and conducted in accordance with DiaSorin’s established Corporate and Quality Assurance governance requirements.

**Education, Experience And Qualifications**

* Minimum Bachelor degree in a science or engineering discipline with 8+ years of relevant experience/training
* 10+ Years of Experience in Quality Assurance or Regulatory Affairs activities in a cGMP Medical Device or Pharmaceutical environment
* 5+ years of Demonstrated knowledge of current industry quality practices under ISO 13485, ISO 14971, CFR 820 and CFR 806 and international regulations preferred
* 2+ years of Management experience in a complex quality assurance/quality systems field
* 2+ years of Ability to provide leadership to others in the organization through influence, innovative practices and coaching skills to foster a corporate culture of responsiveness, compliance awareness, self-regulation, quality system ownership, challenge of status quo, and continuous improvement in order to achieve the highest level of compliance.
* 5+ years of Excellent problem solving methodology, using industry accepted concepts and tools to solve complex problems in creative and effective ways as they apply to compliance issues.
* 5+ years of Hands-on ability to sort through technical complexities and work in a flexible changing environment.
* 5+ years of Possesses a strong scientific and technical background, sufficient to establish creditability with senior management as well as the manufacturing and product development teams.
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills
* Thorough knowledge of standards and regulations (cGMP, ISO 13485)
* Highly organized with proven time management and prioritization skills
* Ability to work independently and with minimal supervision
* High degree of problem solving, attention to detail, and analytical skills.
* Experience working independently in a fast-paced environment with rapidly changing priorities
* Ability to handle the pressure of meeting tight deadlines

**What We Offer**
Diasorin offers a competitive rewards package focused on your overall well-being. We are proud to offer a comprehensive plan of health benefits, retirement and financial wellbeing, time off programs, wellbeing support and perks. Benefits may vary by role, country, region, union status, and other employment status factors. You may also be eligible to participate in an annual incentive program. An incentive award, if any, depends on various factors, including, individual and organizational performance.
  
  
Diasorin is committed to building a workplace where people feel empowered to contribute ideas, take ownership, and grow their careers. We believe diverse perspectives strengthen innovation and help us deliver meaningful impact for patients and customers worldwide.
  
  
Diasorin is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
  
  
This posting and recruitment process are subject to applicable local laws and regulations in the country where the position is located. Additional employment disclosures, candidate rights, and employment conditions may apply based on local jurisdiction.
  
  
Individuals hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work and may be subject to a background check and drug screening where permitted by law. Diasorin is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities during the application process. If assistance is required, please contact hr@diasorin.com.
  
  
Recruitment Fraud Notice
  
  
Diasorin never requests payment, financial information, or personal banking details from candidates at any stage of the recruitment process. Official communications from Diasorin recruiters will only come from a verified
**@diasorin.com**
email address. If you have questions about the legitimacy of a recruitment communication, please contact hr@diasorin.com for verification.
  
  
Unauthorized third-party recruiting agencies may not submit candidates for this position without prior written authorization from the Diasorin Human Resources Department.

records.title: Director of Quality
records.description:
**Director of Quality – Aerospace Manufacturing**
**Oklahoma City, OK**
**Extremely Competitive Pay**
-
*Dependent on Experience*
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced quality leader to oversee and advance our quality management program within a growing aerospace manufacturing organization. This position plays a critical role in ensuring product integrity, maintaining customer and regulatory compliance, and driving continuous improvement throughout the company. Working closely with manufacturing, engineering, and executive leadership, the Director of Quality will lead quality initiatives, develop high-performing teams, strengthen organizational processes, and promote a culture of accountability and operational excellence. The ideal candidate combines strong technical knowledge with proven leadership skills and a commitment to delivering consistent, high-quality results.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Implement and maintain the company quality system in coordination with the Management Representative.
* Report on the performance of the quality system for review and as a basis for improvement of the quality system.
* Have knowledge and understanding of the standards and customer requirements against which the quality system is developed, maintained, and implemented.
* Provide leadership to subordinates, establishing goals and development plans to meet the strategic direction of the organization.
* Determine and enforce -- through functional groups - quality requirements in accordance with real company needs, based on current regulations and state-of-the art product development.
* Develop audit plans, select, and evaluate auditors, document non-conformance(s) and report non-conformances to management.
* Manage subordinate personnel and ensure proper documentation and methods used are according to the Quality Management System.
* Ensure employees are properly trained to perform their job duties in the manner expected, according to their specific job description.
* Establishes and maintains an effective system of communications throughout the organization.
* Represents the organization with major customers, shareholders, the financial community, and the public.
* Monitor and evaluate subordinate personnel updating the Management Representative and Human Resources to have the Employee Skills Matrix reflect accurately the training and skills of subordinates.
* Administer the company quality program in accordance with customer and company requirements.
* Ensure corrective and preventive actions are issued, responded, and completed.
* Promote continuous improvement initiatives for scrap reduction, reducing variation and waste, increasing profit and to improve product quality.
* Organize and promote companywide quality improvement efforts.
* Liaison with external parties on matters relating to the quality management system.
* Maintain the system for calibration of inspection, tools, and equipment for conformance to product specifications.
* Research and analyze data such as customer design proposals, specifications, quality requirements, and manuals to determine feasibility or processes or application and company’s ability to inspect product at the required stages of manufacture.
* Plan and direct quality activities and establishes QA priorities for keeping effective production operations and cost factors.
* Assist engineering in organizing and planning Quality Planning Meetings.
* Read and understand technical and non-technical documents that relate to contracts, purchasing, product design, manufacturing, and test. This includes the ability to interface with both technical and non-technical personnel.
* Evaluate, study, standardize and improve procedures for the assurance of quality, reliability, safety, and efficiency.
* Assess techniques for examining, questioning, evaluating, and reporting.
* Analyze inspection data to determine product conformance and process capability.
* Prepare composite reports from individual reports of subordinates.
* Maintain training records, coordinate with upper management to determine training requirements.
* Issue written and oral instructions.
* Assign duties and examine work for exactness, neatness, and conformance product specifications, policies and procedures.
* Coordinate and plan meetings with departments to develop documentation to support compliance to the applicable standards.
* Ensure nonconforming product is controlled in accordance with the company's quality requirements.
* Monitor metrics associated with the Cost of Quality.
* Initiate NMR’s and DMR's for product found to be nonconforming.
* Ensure employees are properly trained to perform their job duties in the manner expected, according to their specific job description.
* Ensure employees observe the safety rules and regulations and wear the required safety equipment (PPE).
* Assist employees in using the proper tools and equipment to monitor conformance to specifications and ensure equipment is calibrated and maintained.
* Ensure proper documentation and methods used are according to the Quality Management System.
* Support the Quality Management System to assure compliance to quality, industrial and government standards and regulations and customer requirements.
* Adhere to all Quality Management System procedures and instructions.
* Maintain a safe, clean, and orderly work environment.
* Observe the safety rules and regulations and wear the required safety equipment.

**Additional Benefits We Offer**

* Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* 401(k) with Company Match
* Company Sponsored Life-Insurance
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Holidays

**Qualifications**
**Job Qualifications**
**Physical Requirements**
While performing the duties of the job, the employee is required to stand; walk; sit; use hands/fingers to handle/feel; reach with hands and arms; climb; balance; stoop; kneel; crouch; crawl; reach; pull; balance; carry; handle. The employee may occasionally lift or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to focus.
  
  
**Education And/or Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 4-10 years of related experience in manufacturing.
* Previous experience working with Lockheed Martin is required

**Work Authorization Requirement**
This position is subject to
**ITAR regulations.**
Candidates must qualify as a
**U.S. Person**
(U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee)
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Omada International is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with all applicable civil rights and disability laws.

records.title: Corporate Director of Quality
records.description:
**Summit Polymers is a leading, global supplier of automotive interior systems including consoles, door panels, and instrument panels. With over 50 years serving the industry, we deliver engineering and product excellence to our customers, on time, in budget, with the latest innovations.**
JOIN A TEAM WHERE YOU’LL BE CHALLENGED AND valued.
  
  
A career with Summit Polymers means working with smart people in a culture that thrives on challenging, meaningful work. At Summit, we look for growth potential with every hire. We don’t just fill seats, we set people on career paths. We’re always on the lookout for smart people who are committed to continuous improvement, customer service and quality.
  
  
**Job Description**
**JOB TITLE:**
Director, Corporate Quality
**FLSA STATUS:**
Exempt
  
  
**REPORTS TO:**
Regional Director of Manufacturing (Corporate)
  
  
**Summary**
This management position is responsible for developing, implementing and continually improving the company’s standardized manufacturing quality systems globally. The Director, Corporate Quality works collaboratively with plant quality managers, general managers and other company resources to achieve world class quality performance as measured by customer quality scorecards. The Director, Corporate Quality interfaces with key customer personnel to build customer confidence in Summit Polymers, ensure Summit Polymers meets customer expectations and requirements, and to resolve significant customer quality concerns.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Duties**
Is responsible for the following major tasks:
  
  

* Exhibits positive leadership and acts with highest levels of integrity and ethics
* Champions corporate wide manufacturing quality system standardization

+ Leads and collaborates with plant quality managers, general managers and RDMs to determine best practices and develop standardized quality system and procedures applicable to all manufacturing facilities
+ Administers, trains, and communicates the company’s standardized quality system and procedures to ensure they are effectively implemented and maintained throughout the company
+ Performs plant quality system standards compliance audits and leads follow up action plan reviews with each plant
+ Lead continuous improvement of quality systems

* Champions overall quality scorecard performance for all customers

+ Develops deep knowledge of every customer quality scorecard
+ Leads specific customer scorecard training for plant quality managers, materials managers and general managers to ensure these leaders understand scoring methodology and act to ensure scorecard success
+ Monitors customer scorecard methodology and scoring changes, and ensures corporate procedures, metrics and personnel proactively adapt to changes to ensure customer scorecard success
+ Engages with other functional departments to ensure all aspects of customer scorecards are understood and actions are taken to ensure scorecard success (examples Sales – cost reductions, materials – minority sourcing)
+ Assists in developing internal performance metrics that support successful customer scorecard results

* Interfaces with key customer personnel & engages customer quality events

+ Develops constructive relationships with key customer contacts
+ Builds customer’s confidence in SPI’s performance, capabilities, systems, and integrity
+ Represents the company at customer “quality roundtable” events
+ Reviews customer quality system requirements and specifications and ensure they are effectively communicated and implemented at all levels of the organization

* Engages in significant customer quality concerns and warranty issues

+ Participates in problem solving and customer response preparation for significant customer quality issues
+ Represents the company at critical customer quality concern reviews, leading company response and negotiation to achieve successful resolution
+ Acts as point of contact for customer warranty concerns and engages plant and engineering resources to solve warranty concerns

* Provides quality expertise as a corporate resource

+ Champions Practical Problem Solving activities across the company, including improving effectiveness of management team leadership of the process
+ Key leader for development, update, training and compliance to corporate IATF-16949 compliant systems and procedures
+ Supports new business initiatives and projects with data, metrics, support plans, and technical expertise as related to quality
+ Provide support in developing and performing training plans for quality managers and quality engineers at manufacturing plants
+ Provides additional support at manufacturing plants as needed

* Other tasks and duties as assigned

**Education And Experience**

* 4-year college degree in technical or management field preferred
* 5 years’ experience in role of Quality Manager at automotive supplier preferred

**Skills And Abilities**

* Broad knowledge of quality systems and management practices in automotive plastics manufacturing operations

facility.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
  
  

* Leadership & Strategy

+ Develop and execute a strategic quality plan in alignment with business unit goals.
+ Lead, mentor, and develop a team of quality professionals across two locations, ensuring consistency in processes and objectives.
+ Champion a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

* Quality Management Systems (QMS)

+ Oversee the implementation, maintenance, and improvement of the QAD Elements QMS and other relevant Quality Management Systems at both locations. Ensure compliance with customer, regulatory, and industry-specific quality standards (e.g., FDA, ISO, AS9100, etc.).
+ Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of quality management systems and propose enhancements to improve overall performance.

* Process & Product Quality

+ Collaborate with sales, operations, engineering, and supply chain teams to identify drive resolution of quality issues, ensuring process and product integrity.
+ Support root cause analysis and drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) for internal and external quality issues.
+ Oversee first article inspections, process capability studies, and validation/qualification activities to ensure robust manufacturing processes.

* Continuous Improvement

+ Lead Lean Six Sigma or other continuous improvement initiatives aimed at reducing defects, enhancing efficiency, and improving overall quality.
+ Implement data-driven decision-making tools (e.g., SPC, FMEA, Control Plans) to monitor and improve process capabilities.
+ Facilitate cross-functional value stream mapping sessions and quality workshops to drive process improvements.

* Customer & Supplier Relations

+ Serve as the main point of contact for customer quality issues, audits, and feedback, ensuring timely and effective resolution.
+ Oversee supplier quality management, including audits, performance monitoring, and supplier development initiatives.

* Metrics & Reporting

+ Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to quality performance, including scrap/rework, defect rates, customer complaints, and audit findings.
+ Regularly report quality performance metrics to senior leadership, highlighting trends and recommending corrective actions.

* Regulatory Compliance & Audits

+ Lead internal and external audits, ensuring the sites comply with relevant standards and certifications.
+ Ensure the manufacturing facilities are audit-ready at all times and coordinate responses to audit findings.

Airbus Helicopters is seeking a visionary, results-oriented
**Site Quality Director**

In this high-visibility leadership role, you will direct a team of quality professionals across logistics, assembly, component repair, and final conformity. We are looking for a strategic change-maker who can embed a "First Time Right" mindset, harmonize site practices with global Airbus standards, and bridge the gap between engineering, regulatory bodies, and frontline operations.
  
  
**Your working environment:**
On the eastern border of Mississippi you’ll find Columbus, home to our Helicopter manufacturing and assembly lines and Center of Excellence for the entire North America region. It’s here that we produce the UH-72A Lakota Helicopters for the U.S. Army in addition to the H-125 aircraft for civil and commercial customers.
  
  
**How we care for you:**

* Financial Rewards: Competitive base salary, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”)
* Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a generous paid parental leave program.
* Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical (traditional and high-deductible health plans), prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages.
* Individual Development: Upskilling and development opportunities through our global Leadership University, including unlimited access to 10,000+ e-learning courses focusing on ways to develop your employability, certifications, career path as well as the opportunity to participate in accelerated development programmes and both national and international mobility.

**Your Challenges:**

* Sustain Regulatory & Quality Certifications: Maintain, uphold, and expand site compliance for FAA, EASA, and TCCA repair station and production certificates, certified personnel, and AS9100 QMS credentials.
* Drive Executive QMS Governance: Administer the site Quality Management System, collaborating directly with the Executive Committee to embed strategic quality objectives into the business planning cycle.
* Standardize Operational Inspections: Supervise and enforce rigorous inspection standards across supply chain, logistics, receiving, in-process assembly, quality gates, and final aircraft conformity for components, aerostructures, and rotorcraft.
* Mitigate Quality Escapes & Risk: Identify and eliminate operational and airworthiness risks to safeguard customer flight safety, business continuity, delivery schedules, and operating costs.
* Lead and Develop Personnel: Directly manage, mentor, and evaluate a team of 3-5 exempt supervisors/engineers and 10-25 non-exempt inspectors, directing career progression, staffing, and technical competence.
* Establish & Track SQCDP KPIs: Implement robust enterprise metrics tracking Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery, and People (SQCDP) to systematically capture non-conformances, process capability, and customer complaints.
* Manage Financials & Quality Budget: Direct departmental budgeting, manage financial forecasts, analyze cost variances, and allocate capital for advanced measurement tools, calibration, and ergonomic work environments.
* Execute Root Cause & Corrective Action (RCCA): Drive practical problem solving (PPS), Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA), and structured RCCA workflows to resolve manufacturing anomalies and prevent recurrence.
* Harmonize Global Airbus Standards: Coordinate with international Airbus Helicopters facilities to standardize quality procedures, digital architectures, and enterprise systems (including SAP, MES, and non-conformance portals).
* Champion Safety and "First Time Right" Culture: Spearhead a proactive, psychological safety culture anchored by "First Time Right" execution and a robust "Speak Up / Listen Up" mindset across all shifts and departments.
* Direct Internal & External Audits: Lead preparation, execution, and reporting for internal, regulatory (FAA/EASA/TCCA), and customer audits, ensuring all corrective action milestones are closed transparently.
* Collaborate on Design & New Product Introduction (NPI): Partner with design engineering and certification teams to support new product development, configuration integrity, obsolescence management, and manufacturing build cycles.
* Reduce Cost of Non-Quality (CoNQ): Lead enterprise continuous improvement, Lean, and Kaizen initiatives to eliminate scrap, minimize rework, reduce the Cost of Non-Quality, and improve delivery reliability.
* Optimize Workload & Production Flow: Coordinate with operations and program management to balance inspection staffing and shift priorities against critical flightline and customer delivery schedules.
* Oversee Technical Training & Qualifications: Build and finance comprehensive onboarding and recurrent training programs covering aviation safety, specialized processes (NDI, composites, dynamic components), and regulatory requirements.

**Your Boarding Pass:**

* Must possess a Bachelor’s Degree in Aerospace/Aviation/Industrial Engineer/Engineering related field or equivalent experience (4 years)
* Have ten (10) + years of Aerospace/Aviation Industry, Military or Quality experience and three (3) + years in a Leadership role, Civilian and/or Military
* Able to support functions in multiple areas such as repair station, manufacturing, composites, electrical/avionics Backshop, warehousing/logistics, dynamic component repair, blades and tail boom
* Knowledge of Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Regulations 14 CFR Parts 21, 43 and 145 in addition the related sections for Transport Canada and EASA
* Knowledge of AS9100 Quality Requirements and Systems
* Knowledge of aircraft design, maintenance, and manufacturing processes and build cycles
* Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Access), Onbase, Orion eTechPub, Adobe Acrobat , SAP, Smartsheet, G Suite. OCE/ARAS/Bflow T.I.P.I.

**Company Overview**
Red 6 is an innovative Augmented Reality (AR) technology startup leading the way in synthetic air combat training. Our primary technology, supporting our ATARS product, enables pilots to simulate the cognitive challenges of flying while accessing realistic, scalable training in dynamic outdoor environments.
  
  
**Director of Quality**
Lead Red 6 into a scalable aerospace product organization.
  
  
Red 6 develops advanced augmented reality capabilities for aerospace and defense applications. We seek a hands-on, strategic Director of Quality to lead the next phase of our evolution into disciplined, repeatable product qualification and production. This leader will strengthen existing foundations while guiding the processes, evidence, and behaviors needed to meet customer, regulatory, safety, and aerospace industry expectations.
  
  
Success requires more than maintaining certifications. The Director will embed quality planning into product development, improve manufacturing and supplier readiness, and create a culture in which teams jointly solve problems before they become defects, delays, or compliance findings. Key results are building practical, auditable quality processes with Quality as a trusted partner across Engineering, Operations, Programs, and the supplier base.
  
  
**What You Will Lead**

* Own the enterprise Quality strategy and roadmap, scaling the Quality Management System (QMS) to match product maturity, production volume, and customer commitments.
* Maintain and continuously improve AS9100 certification and audit readiness. Lead management reviews, internal audits, corrective action effectiveness, risk based thinking, and process ownership.
* Lead ISO 45001 occupational health and safety management system maturation and certification readiness, in coordination with accountable safety and operations leaders.
* Deploy practical Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) disciplines aligned to AS9145 where applicable, including quality planning, process flow, PFMEA, control plans, measurement system analysis, first article inspection, and production readiness reviews.
* Integrate Quality into design inputs, reviews, verification and validation, configuration control, design changes, manufacturing transitions, and product release criteria.
* Establish scalable document and record controls, product pedigree, serial level traceability, inspection and test evidence, nonconformance controls, material review, CAPA, and calibration systems.
* Develop supplier qualification, surveillance, performance scorecards, supplier corrective actions, and risk based oversight of contract manufacturers and critical suppliers.
* Partner with Engineering and Operations to strengthen hardware quality, reliability, manufacturability, process validation, FOD/ESD controls, and handling of nonconforming material.
* Improve the connection between Windchill PLM, Epsilon3 MES, Unanet ERP, and existing compliance tools to support controlled, usable, auditable data across design, build, and delivery.
* Lead customer quality engagement, audits, contractual quality deliverables, and coordination with defense and aerospace stakeholders as applicable.

**LEAD A COLLABORATIVE QUALITY CULTURE**

* Build a capable Quality team with clear roles, coaching, succession planning, and cross functional influence.
* Act as a constructive partner to Engineering. Translate standards and contractual obligations into design intent, risk, and measurable acceptance criteria rather than relying on clause citations alone.
* Distinguish nonnegotiable compliance outcomes from implementation choices. Invite Engineering and Operations to co-design efficient solutions.
* Create early quality engagement in program planning and design reviews. Resolve disagreements using evidence, risk, cost, schedule, and accountable decision ownership.
* Establish shared performance measures and a regular Quality–Engineering working cadence to reduce late surprises and unproductive escalation.
* Promote a just, learning oriented culture that encourages timely issue reporting, root cause analysis, and effective preventive action.

**Qualifications Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Significant progressive aerospace or defense quality leadership experience, including building or scaling an AS9100 QMS and leading certification or surveillance audits.
* Demonstrated success moving products from prototype or development environments into qualified, controlled, repeatable production.
* Working knowledge of APQP per AS9145, AS9102 first article inspection, supplier quality, configuration management, CAPA, and risk based process control.
* Ability to influence senior technical leaders without defaulting to authority or unnecessary bureaucracy. Strong facilitation, coaching, and conflict resolution skills.
* Experience with customer and supplier quality requirements, quality metrics, and cross functional improvement programs.
* Ability to work on site in Denver and travel periodically to suppliers and other Red 6 locations.
* Must be US Citizen to have the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Security Clearance.

**Preferred Experience**

* ISO 45001 implementation or certification leadership; AS9115 awareness for deliverable software where relevant.
* DoD prime contractor interfaces, DCMA, DFARS, and applicable government customer quality requirements.
* Experience with PLM, MES, ERP, and integrated digital quality workflows, especially Windchill, Epsilon3, and Unanet.
* Lean Six Sigma, ASQ quality credentials, GD&T, hardware reliability, and complex electromechanical systems.
* Experience developing small teams into mature, business enabling quality organizations.

**What Success Looks Like In The First 12 Months**

* Publish an agreed risk based Quality maturity roadmap with clear process owners and milestones.
* Sustain AS9100 compliance and close systemic audit or corrective action gaps with evidence of effectiveness.
* Introduce an appropriate APQP and production readiness framework for priority product lines.
* Improve supplier quality visibility, product traceability, and readiness of controlled manufacturing documentation.
* Demonstrate stronger Quality–Engineering collaboration through earlier issue resolution and fewer late stage quality surprises.
* Provide leadership with a concise scorecard covering escapes, rework, supplier performance, CAPA aging, audit findings, and readiness milestones.

records.description:
**Pulse Biosciences (Nasdaq: PLSE): Join the Future of Bioelectric Medicine**

Pulse Biosciences is a novel bioelectric medicine company committed to health innovation that has the potential to improve the quality of life for patients. The Company’s proprietary CellFX® nsPFA™ (nanosecond Pulsed Field Ablation) technology delivers nanosecond pulses of electrical energy to non-thermally ablate cells while sparing adjacent noncellular tissue.

The Company is actively pursuing the development of its CellFX nsPFA technology for use in the surgical treatment of atrial fibrillation and percutaneously in a select few other markets where it could have a profound positive impact on healthcare for both patients and providers. Visit pulsebiosciences.com to learn more.

**Why Join Us?**

At Pulse Biosciences, we are driven by purpose and innovation.

* Our Mission: To build a viable Company that designs, produces, and commercializes nano-pulse technology to improve and extend the lives of patients. To solve the needs of patients, physicians, and healthcare providers with high quality and high reliability products and services, developed in accordance with rigorous scientific, engineering, and clinical standards. We exist to make a positive difference in the lives of patients, physicians, healthcare providers, shareholders and our Pulse Biosciences team members.
* Our Culture: A community of creative, forward-thinking individuals tackling challenges with ingenuity and collaboration.
* Our Commitment: Hiring the best and brightest minds to advance our world-class organization.

**What You Will Experience**

* Culture and Purpose - Purposeful and rewarding work collaborating with bright and curious minds brings us together!
* Innovative Environment - An environment that fosters innovation to take products from concept to human use quickly!
* Growth Opportunities - Learning culture focusing on professional and personal growth and development that you can only get in a startup-like environment!
* Comprehensive Benefits - A variety of health insurance plans and supplemental insurance options, and 401k retirement savings plan.
* Ownership and Rewards - Stock options awards and Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) to share in our success.
* Work-Life Balance - Enjoy paid time off, paid holidays, flexible work schedule and wellness program, including onsite gym and mindfulness classes.
* Diversity & Inclusion - A commitment to providing a respectful work environment to our diverse workforce.

**About The Role**

The Vice President/Senior Vice President of Electrophysiology (EP) Catheter Manufacturing will lead the development, production transition, and global scale-up of a next-generation EP catheter manufacturing organization. This executive leader will be responsible for defining and executing the end-to-end manufacturing strategy, building a high-performing team, and ensuring successful commercialization through scalable, cost-effective, and reliable manufacturing operations. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in cardiac catheter or EP device manufacturing, demonstrated success scaling production from launch to high-volume commercialization, and extensive experience managing contract manufacturers and manufacturing transfers across global regions.

**To Make An Impact, You Will**

* Develop and execute the long-term manufacturing strategy for EP catheter products from product launch through high-volume commercialization.
* Build, lead, and mentor a world-class manufacturing, operations, supply chain, and quality organization.
* Serve as the executive leader responsible for manufacturing readiness, production scale-up, operational excellence, and capacity planning.
* Partner closely with R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Clinical, and Commercial teams to support product development and market expansion.
* Define and implement a manufacturing scale-up roadmap supporting growth from approximately 50,000 units annually to 500,000+ units annually.
* Evaluate, establish, and optimize the appropriate manufacturing model, including:
* Strategic partnerships with Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs)
* Hybrid manufacturing approaches
* Internal manufacturing capabilities
* Drive manufacturing process development, validation, and continuous improvement initiatives to improve efficiency, yield, and quality.
* Select, qualify, and manage global contract manufacturing partners.
* Establish robust supplier and supply chain strategies to support commercial growth and business continuity.
* Build and qualify a scalable supply network for critical components, materials, and assemblies.
* Negotiate and manage key manufacturing and supplier relationships to achieve operational, quality, and cost objectives.
* Own product cost strategy and achieve planned reductions in COGS from launch pricing to mature commercial targets.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Develop manufacturing KPIs and operating metrics to ensure predictable execution and performance.
* Lead manufacturing transfers and site expansions, including transfers between domestic and international manufacturing locations.
* Establish manufacturing capabilities that support global commercialization requirements while maintaining regulatory compliance and product quality.
* Ensure successful technology transfer, process validation, and operational readiness at receiving sites.

**To Excel, You Will Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, or a related technical field; advanced degree preferred.
* 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in medical device manufacturing and operations.
* Experience at the Vice President or Senior Vice President level leading manufacturing organizations.
* Proven success scaling complex catheter-based or electrophysiology medical device manufacturing from development through high-volume commercialization.
* Demonstrated expertise in cardiac catheter, EP catheter, or related interventional medical device manufacturing.
* Direct experience with electrophysiology (EP) catheters, cardiac mapping catheters, ablation catheters, or related cardiovascular devices.
* Experience scaling manufacturing through multiple commercialization phases, including launch, growth, and mature production.
* Track record of delivering substantial COGS reductions through process optimization, automation, and supply chain strategy.
* Experience supporting commercial volumes exceeding 500,000 units annually.
* Deep knowledge of catheter manufacturing processes, assembly, automation, testing, and production scale-up.
* Significant experience managing Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) at commercial volumes.
* Proven track record developing and executing manufacturing transfer strategies, including domestic-to-international (OUS) transfers.
* Experience building global supply chains and qualifying suppliers for commercial-scale production.
* Strong understanding of medical device quality systems, process validation, and regulatory requirements.
* Strategic executive capable of building organizations and leading transformational growth.
* Strong business acumen with demonstrated success balancing cost, quality, capacity, and speed-to-market objectives.
* Exceptional cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills.
* Results-oriented leader with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
* Ability to travel up to 15% of the time. Overnight and/or international travel may be required.
* Ability to lift 10-15 pounds.

**Ready to Shape the Future of Healthcare?**

Apply today to join Pulse Biosciences and help us redefine the boundaries of medicine with bioelectric innovation. To learn more about us, visit our website at www.pulsebiosciences.com.

records.description:
At CompoSecure, we are redefining the future of payment card technology. As a global leader in premium metal payment cards and fintech solutions, we combine innovation with craftsmanship to deliver exceptional products for the world's leading financial institutions.
  
  
We're looking for talented individuals who share our passion for excellence and innovation.
  
  
**Position Overview**
This role provides senior leadership and ownership of the functions that safeguard product integrity and the operating environment: Quality, Compliance (Quality Control, Quality Assurance, Safety and regulatory conformance), Security, and Facilities. The position is accountable for ensuring that products consistently meet quality specifications, that operations remain fully compliant with regulatory and safety standards, that the site and its products are secure, and that facilities are maintained to support a reliable 24/7 manufacturing environment. The role establishes clear metrics and ownership across these areas and reports performance to senior leadership.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Quality: Establish and maintain quality control protocols for raw materials, components, and finished products. Design inspection and testing processes and provide guidance on maintaining consistent quality from the beginning of production through final release. Lead Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams, monitor quality metrics, and drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to eliminate root causes of defects. Ensure conformance to customer, product, and industry specifications.
* Compliance: Ensure full compliance of operations with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and applicable safety standards in accordance with New Jersey law. Own audits, certifications, and documentation, and serve as the primary liaison with regulatory bodies, auditors, and customers on compliance matters. Identify potential risks and pitfalls (e.g., equipment failures or other disruptions) and develop strategies to mitigate these issues through process improvement, alternative suppliers of materials, or altered equipment.
* Security: Oversee physical and product security programs consistent with the company's trust and authentication mission. Establish and enforce protocols to protect raw materials, work-in-process, finished goods, and sensitive assets throughout the facility and supply chain. Ensure operations meet payment-industry and customer security requirements, and manage security personnel and access controls across all shifts.
* Accountability: Own the key performance indicators and reporting for quality, compliance, security, and facilities. Establish clear ownership, metrics, and dashboards, report performance to senior management, and foster a culture of accountability across the organization. Manage a team of approximately 35 people across 7 shifts supporting QA, Safety & Security.
* Facilities: Oversee facility operations, maintenance, and environmental health and safety of the buildings, grounds, and utilities. Ensure facilities are maintained to support a reliable 24/7 manufacturing environment, manage facility vendors and contractors, and lead facility-related capital projects, space planning, and safe-workplace initiatives.

* Deep knowledge of quality management systems (ISO 9001, IATF 16949 for automotive, AS9100 for aerospace, etc.)
* Six Sigma / Lean methodologies (typically Black Belt or Master Black Belt level)
* Root cause analysis and CAPA (corrective and preventive action) processes
* Statistical process control (SPC) and data-driven decision making
* Supplier quality management and audit experience

is looking for a
**Vice President of Quality & Regulatory**
! The VP, Quality & Regulatory is responsible for establishing, leading, and continuously improving the organization's enterprise-wide quality, regulatory affairs, and compliance programs. As the organization's primary authority on quality systems, regulatory strategy, and compliance integrity, they ensure that all operations meet or exceed applicable regulatory requirements, industry standards, and internal policies.
  
  
**Essential Functions:**
Other duties, responsibilities, and activities may change or be assigned at any time.
  
  

* Develop, implement, and continuously improve an enterprise-wide Quality Management System aligned with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
* Establish quality standards, policies, and procedures that drive consistency, accountability, and operational excellence across all business units and functions.
* Champion a culture of quality throughout the organization through visible leadership, targeted training programs, and clear performance accountability frameworks.
* Oversee internal audit programs, corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes, root cause analysis, and management review activities to identify, address and prevent recurrence of quality issues while driving measurable, systematic improvement.
* Serve as the organization's primary liaison with regulatory agencies (e.g., FDA, State Agencies and industry-specific authorities), accreditation organizations, and industry trade associations, cultivating credible relationships and maintaining organizational awareness of evolving regulatory and industry expectations.
* Monitor, interpret, and proactively communicate evolving regulatory requirements and their organizational impact to senior leadership and operational teams. Ensure all regulatory registrations, licenses, certifications, and required filings, ensuring timely renewal and full compliance.
* Design and oversee a comprehensive, risk-based enterprise compliance program encompassing regulatory, legal, and ethical compliance obligations across all operational areas.
* Ensure organizational adherence to applicable federal and state laws, regulations, standards, and internal policies through effective program design, monitoring, and enforcement mechanisms.
* Lead company’s Sustainability initiatives to ensure effectiveness and compliance for certifications, reporting, Extended Producer Responsibility, and Social Accountability programs. * Align the quality, regulatory, and compliance strategy with overall organizational objectives, ensuring that QRC is positioned as a strategic enabler rather than a compliance overhead.
