records.description:
**Director, New Product Introduction (NPI) & Product Lifecycle Management (PLM)**

Round Rock, Texas | Onsite | Full-Time

**Reports to:** CFO/CEO

**Works closely with:** Director of Operations/Engineering/R&D, Quality, Purchasing, Production, Program Management and external suppliers

**Travel:** Approximately 25%-35%, primarily to supplier locations

**Role structure:** Hands-on director role; initially an individual contributor leading cross-functional work

**Role Summary**

The Director of NPI & PLM leads the transition of new and modified products from development into stable production. The role coordinates product documentation, supplier readiness, pilot builds, production handoff and lifecycle changes across Ametrine and its manufacturing partners.

This position is focused on practical execution. The Director will work directly with cut-and-sew partners and other suppliers to ensure products can be produced repeatedly at the required quality, capacity and schedule. The role also helps develop alternate sources and contingency plans across fabric, metallization, printing, DWR treatment and cut-and-sew operations.

**Primary Responsibilities**

**New Product Introduction**

* Maintain the NPI schedule for new products, product changes and manufacturing transfers.
* Coordinate requirements, design release, sourcing, prototype builds, pilot production, validation and production handoff.
* Use clear stage gates, owners, due dates and readiness checklists.
* Identify schedule, supplier, material, quality and capacity risks early and drive actions to closure.
* Provide concise status updates covering progress, open decisions, risks and next steps.

**Prototype-to-Production Transfer**

* Work with Engineering and R&D to review designs for manufacturability and production readiness.
* Prepare or coordinate BOMs, routings, work instructions, technical packages, inspection points and packaging requirements.
* Lead prototype, pilot and first-production builds at Ametrine and supplier locations.
* Capture lessons learned and ensure changes are reflected in released documentation.
* Confirm that Operations and suppliers are ready before a product is released to routine production.

**Cut-and-Sew and Supplier Readiness**

* Work onsite with cut-and-sew partners to establish and improve production methods.
* Review patterns, sewing specifications, fixtures, templates, work instructions and inspection requirements.
* Assess supplier labor, equipment, training, floor space, quality controls and available capacity.
* Develop practical ramp plans and verify production rates through actual builds.
* Support supplier training and resolve manufacturability, throughput and quality issues during launch.
* Track supplier actions and escalate missed commitments or unsupported plans.

**Product Lifecycle Management**

* Maintain control of released BOMs, specifications, approved materials, suppliers, routings and product revisions.
* Coordinate engineering changes and assess their impact on inventory, suppliers, schedule, testing and customer requirements.
* Ensure the correct product configuration is used for each order and customer.
* Support PLM process and system improvements, including appropriate integration with ERP/MRP.
* Maintain orderly lifecycle records from product introduction through sustainment and retirement.

**Supply-Chain Resilience**

* Maintain a process-level supply-chain map covering fabric, metallization, printing, DWR, cut and sew, accessories and final delivery.
* Identify bottlenecks, long-lead items, single-source dependencies and supplier-capacity risks.
* Develop and qualify alternate sources where practical.
* Create contingency plans for specialized processes that cannot be economically dual-sourced.
* Coordinate source qualification with Operations, Purchasing, Engineering and Quality.
  

**Quality and Process Control**

* Partner with Quality to define process controls, inspection requirements and first-article expectations.
* Support supplier qualification, process reviews, root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Monitor first-pass yield, defects, rework and launch-related issues.
* Ensure production methods remain consistent with approved documentation and customer requirements.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Lead NPI work through influence across Engineering, Operations, Quality, Purchasing and suppliers.
* Maintain clear owners, deadlines and escalation paths.
* Coordinate with the Director of Operations so new-product timelines and supplier readiness are aligned with the production plan.
* Support communication and coordination between Ametrine Inc. and Ametrine Ltd. where product development activities overlap.

**Success Measures**

* NPI milestones completed on schedule
* Prototype-to-pilot and pilot-to-production cycle time
* Supplier readiness and capacity verification completed before launch
* Percentage of critical supply-chain nodes with an alternate source or documented contingency
* Launch first-pass yield, rework and defect performance
* Completeness and accuracy of BOMs, routings, work instructions and product revisions
* Timely closure of supplier, manufacturing-readiness and lifecycle risks

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, industrial technology, textiles, supply chain or a related field; equivalent directly relevant experience may be considered.
* Eight or more years of relevant experience in NPI, manufacturing engineering, supplier development, PLM, product transfer or contract manufacturing.
* Demonstrated experience moving physical products from prototype through pilot and into production.
* Experience working directly with external manufacturers or suppliers.
* Working knowledge of BOMs, routings, work instructions, engineering changes and configuration control.
* Experience with ERP/MRP and PLM or related product-data systems.
* Strong project planning, follow-through, problem-solving and written communication skills.
* Ability to work onsite in Round Rock and travel approximately 25%-35%.
* U.S. citizenship required due to the defense-related nature of the company’s work.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with technical textiles, sewn products, outdoor equipment, military products, automotive soft goods, medical textiles, inflatables or related manufacturing.
* Experience with cut-and-sew production methods, patterns, line balancing or labor standards.
* Experience with coated, laminated, printed or metallized fabrics.
* Defense, aerospace or government-contract manufacturing experience.
* Experience qualifying secondary suppliers or developing business-continuity plans.
* PMP, Lean Six Sigma, APICS or similar certification.

**Working Style**

* Hands-on and comfortable working at supplier facilities and on production floors
* Organized, practical and attentive to manufacturing details
* Able to communicate effectively with engineers, operators, supplier managers and company leadership
* Persistent in following actions through completion
* Comfortable balancing several product introductions and production issues at the same time
* Focused on building useful processes without unnecessary bureaucracy

records.title: Director of Manufacturing Launch
records.description:
Description:

BLOX designs, manufactures, and constructs buildings and delivers them as products across the country. DesignManufactureConstruct is the system we use. DMC moves complexity to the left: work the industry solves in the field, we move to the factory; work the factory struggles with, we eliminate at design. Manufacturing runs as a visually controlled, continuous-flow pull system, managed to takt with the minimal buffers required to stabilize flow. The BLOX system works, proven through multiple products and launches. Our next step is to encode that experience into a manufacturing launch system that is repeatable, teachable, and capable of supporting the scale ahead of us. That means converting what our best people know into standard work, tooling, interfaces, controls, and training. It also means knowing which parts of the system are load-bearing, where volume creates pressure, and having the judgment to strengthen or replace what no longer serves the work. Growth will test every system. Our job is to be ready first.

The Director of Manufacturing Launch owns manufacturing setup in Launch, from design and first-of-a-kind production through ramp to stabilization, until a building can be consistently produced as a Product. Launch runs as a horizontal through the verticals, and it has three leaders: design, manufacturing, and program management. You are manufacturing. You control line setup, standard work, tooling, takt, and training. You do not control product design, supply chain, construction, or the customer, but you work with and influence all. Each of the three launch leaders builds a team beneath them, all held to one goal. You build the manufacturing launch team, and you resolve manufacturability while the work is still in design. Then you document the baseline, train the operations team, transfer the role, and repeat. Nothing gets thrown over a wall. A line is not finished until the people running it can run it without you.

Requirements:

We are completing the launch and stabilization of a major product, with a strong pipeline behind it. Current-line attainment and new-product launch are distinct jobs, and this role exists so both can be done well. Your mandate is to build on what BLOX has already learned and make launch repeatable. We are looking for:

* A manufacturing expert. Layout, flow, takt, tooling, line-side setup. Has built lines, not just improved them.
* A process expert. Standard work, first-pass yield, the discipline to prove a method before scaling it and to replace it when the evidence says you should.
* A systems thinker. Understands design, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and field installation, and resolves problems where they are best eliminated.
* A team builder. Hires, teaches, and promotes engineers who outgrow the org chart.
* A simplifier. Drives to the simple answer on the far side of the complex one, and does the work to get there.

Our team is strong. They built this system and accomplished more, faster, than most teams ever attempt, and they are accountable for attainment on the line running today. Our growth now supports separating manufacturing launch leadership from steady-state operational leadership.

We build like a startup and operate like a manufacturer: if you have only worked where the plant, the budget, and the org chart already existed, this will be uncomfortable. Five years out: a billion dollars, the same system running across multiple factories, DMC at meaningful scale, and a system capable of helping reshape the fastest-growing sector in building. DMC belongs to the industry, not to us, so what you encode here does not stay here. This is not a place to move a thousandth in a decade. Here, you matter.

The seat: Director of Manufacturing Launch, reporting to the COO in close partnership with the CEO. Based in Birmingham, Alabama, with occasional travel to launch sites.

Benefits:

BLOX offers the full spectrum of comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision insurance. We also offer flexible spending accounts, paid time off, short term disability, long term disability, life insurance and a 401k plan.

It is the policy of BLOX LLC to use ability and willingness to contribute to our team effort as the criteria for making employment related decisions, regardless of an individual’s race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or other protected status. In addition, we strictly prohibit the harassment of any employee because of his/her race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation and gender identity), disability, or other protected status.

records.description:
Kentucky Trailer

As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best.

Job Title: Director of Operations
  
Division: Kentucky Trailer  
Location: Louisville, KY- 3 site locations  
Reports to: President, Kentucky Trailer  
FLSA: Exempt  
  
This position has multiple direct reports across 3 sites. Current direct reports include Operations Manager, 7 Team Leaders, and a Manufacturing Engineer/Facilities Manager. This position requires local travel between the 3 sites in Louisville.  
  
Kentucky Trailer has been building in Louisville since 1879, when it was founded as the Kentucky Wagon Manufacturing Company. Today it designs and builds custom trailers and truck bodies for moving and storage, snack food distribution, package delivery, and specialty markets such as mobile medical, government, and motorsports. Most of what we build is engineered to order rather than off the shelf, which makes our operations both challenging and rewarding to lead.  
  
The Director of Operations leads all day-to-day manufacturing operations and is accountable for Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, People, and Productivity results. The role owns the manufacturing operating budget, develops frontline leaders, and builds a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. Works closely with Materials, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, Human Resources, and Commercial Sales to make sure production plans are executable and customer commitments are met. The workforce is non-union.

**Position Key Accountabilities:**

### **Safety**

* Create and sustain a Safety First and Always culture, with every employee understanding their personal responsibility for a safe workplace.
* Enforce safety policies, procedures and safe work practices at every level of the organization.
* Make sure hazards, near misses and incidents are addressed promptly, with root causes corrected.
* Ensure compliance with OSHA and environmental requirements and lead continuous improvement toward an incident-free workplace.

### **Manufacturing performance and planning**

* Lead daily manufacturing activities to meet production schedules and customer delivery commitments.
* Set clear daily, weekly and monthly expectations for each production area, and align labor and resources to requirements.
* Identify production constraints and implement corrective actions to improve throughput.
* Partner with Supply Chain and Materials so schedules are executable and escalate shortages before they affect production.
* Support point-of-use inventory, Kanban, vendor-managed inventory and other Lean material strategies where appropriate.

### **Quality**

* Build a culture where quality is owned at the point of manufacture and the next operation is treated as the customer.
* Ensure compliance with manufacturing standards, specifications, work instructions and quality procedures.
* Partner with Engineering to drive root-cause corrective action and reduce defects, rework, warranty exposure and cost of poor quality.

### **Lean and operational excellence**

* Champion Lean Manufacturing using 5S, Standard Work, Visual Management, Kaizen and structured problem solving.
* Establish a disciplined management cadence of daily production meetings, visual boards, KPI reviews and structured follow-up.
* Ensure standard work is documented, followed and continuously improved.
* Drive measurable improvement in labor productivity, cycle time, throughput, material flow, space utilization and manufacturing cost.
* Lead automation and capital initiatives that improve safety, quality, productivity and cost.

### **Financial performance and cost**

* Own the manufacturing operating budget and take part in the annual budget and monthly forecasts.
* Manage to labor, overhead and operating cost targets, including direct labor productivity, overtime and indirect labor.
* Ensure accuracy in both labor reporting and BOM usages
* WIP accuracy, and operational support for cycle counts and physical inventories.
* Partner with Finance to analyze manufacturing variances and carry out corrective actions.
* Prepare ROI justifications for capital requests and track whether completed projects deliver the promised return.

### **Maintenance and facilities**

* Ensure preventive maintenance programs maximize equipment uptime and extend asset life.
* Improve utilization of equipment, facilities and manufacturing capacity.

### **Leadership and people development**

* Lead, coach and develop managers, team leaders and employees across the operation.
* Set annual performance goals and development plans and hold leaders accountable for results.
* Build frontline leaders' capability in problem solving, waste elimination and employee accountability.
* Build organizational depth through hiring, succession planning and cross-training.
* Communicate regularly with employees about performance, company expectations, policies and priorities.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Manufacturing or another technical discipline, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 10 years in manufacturing with a proven record of success and increasing responsibility.
* Minimum 5 years leading multi-site operations through managers and leaders.
* Demonstrated record of improving safety performance
* Lean Manufacturing experience or certification, with measurable results in efficiency improvement and cost reduction.
* Demonstrated P&L or operating budget accountability.
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities at once.
* Willingness to live and work in the greater Louisville, KY area.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Trailer, truck body or similar fabrication, welding and assembly experience.
* Experience in high-mix, custom build-to-order manufacturing.
* MBA or other financial education.

**Working conditions**
----------------------

This role works in both office and manufacturing plant settings, with exposure to noise, welding, painting and moving equipment. Required PPE must be worn on the production floor. The role regularly requires walking and standing for extended periods.

Employment is contingent on successful completion of a background check and drug screen.

Following receipt of a conditional offer of employment, candidates will be required to complete additional job-related screening processes as permitted or required by applicable law.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to their membership in any protected class. If you require any reasonable accommodation to complete your application or any part of the recruiting process, please email your request to careers@marmon.com, and please be sure to include the title and the location of the position for which you are applying.

This individual will combine strong technical knowledge of cement manufacturing with business and financial acumen, including experience managing operating and capital budgets, improving equipment reliability and plant efficiency, and controlling manufacturing costs. We are looking for a visible, hands-on leader who develops strong teams, drives accountability, and has a demonstrated ability to improve safety, reliability, quality, production, and overall plant performance.
  
  
**Who we are:**  
GCC is a world-class company that produces, distributes and markets cement, ready-mixed concrete, aggregates, and innovative products related to the construction industries in Mexico and the United States. We take pride in being a market leader with a culture of innovation, high performance and safety. GCC offers a very competitive benefits program including paid time off, medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability insurance plans, and a 401K.
  
  
**What you will do:**  
Directs, coordinates and administers all production, quality control, maintenance, engineering, purchasing and process control activities required in meeting the operations budget objectives and maintains alignment with the strategic plans of GCCA for the preservation of the plant's physical assets and to meet projected sales goals. Directs and coordinates activities to obtain optimum efficiency and economy of operations and maximize profits by performing the following duties personally or through subordinate managers and supervisors.
  
  

* Responsible for planning, directing, organizing and scheduling all manufacturing and quality control activities for the effective operation of the plant.
* Plans and direct the plant machinery and mobile equipment preventive maintenance program and all major maintenance projects and activities.
* Plans and directs the expenditures of the capital program.
* Directs the engineering program involving technical support to production and maintenance, operational cost studies, construction and environmental controls.
* Conducts final reviews of and approves all plant budget forecasts, standards, staffing schedules and capital programs.
* Directs the inventory control of all materials, parts and supplies needed to support the operational activities.
* Investigates kiln output to fuel consumption; finish grinding production to power consumption; equipment failures and effects of repair recommendations; expenditures and return on investment; studies manufacturing costs in relation to budget; initiates and reviews studies, analyzes data interpretations concerned with the production, engineering technical service, purchasing, employment costs and other operations support activities.
* Plans the annual operation and capital budgets; the overall manufacturing capabilities of the plant; and the manufacturing schedule.
* Develops long-range plans for plant operations, capital programs, and raw material reserves and personnel requirements.
* Establishes performance standards for the operational departments including all cost and man-hour standards; policy governing control of product quality standards; the maintenance, repairs and construction budgets; and the necessary quantity and quality levels of all raw materials and fuels used by the plant.
* Hires, counsels, and trains assigned personnel, set individual goals, evaluates performance, recommends salary adjustments, promotion or transfer, approves time-off, and accomplishes objectives through the qualities of strong leadership.
* Directs the efforts to maintain compliance with all city, county, state and federal regulations; maintains a cordial working relationship with the surrounding community.
* Cooperates with the Senior Staff of GCCA in advising of company policies and procedures, safety rules, disciplinary actions and grievance procedures.
* Coordinates activities of departments such as operating, quality control, engineering, and maintenance with GCCA planning, sales, process, or research and development, to effect operational efficiency and economy.
* Analyzes plant budget requests to identify areas in which reductions can be made, and allocates operating budget.
* Confers with administrative personnel and reviews activity, operating, and sales reports to determine changes in programs or operations required.
* Promotes organization in industry, manufacturing or trade associations, Chamber of Commerce and community charities and agencies.

**Experience & abilities you will need:**  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Chemical, Mechanical, or Electromechanical Engineering.
* Master’s in Business Administration.
* Ten years’ experience in cement processes and business practices in the cement industry as well as ten years’ experience in maintenance, production, and quality control management.

**You will love working here because:**  
At GCC, employees are our most important resource. As a part of the GCC family, you'll be welcomed into a culture that promotes the company vision and internal career growth. Our company vision is to have our customers recognize us as a business partner that generates the most value to their construction projects. We're a sustainable growing company, a great place to work and a solid investment for our shareholders. GCC is an enterprise with a global and sustainable approach. Our production is mainly devoted to the manufacture and sale of gray Portland cement, mortar, premixed concrete, concrete blocks, plaster, aggregates and other construction materials. Join the family!

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
**PLANT MANAGER**

**Icon Fixtures | Multi-Facility Manufacturing Operations | St. Louis Area (Hazelwood, MO)**

About Icon

Icon Fixtures designs and builds custom fixtures, millwork, and full environments for retail, restaurant, hospitality, banking, and museum clients across North America and internationally, from single-store orders to 100+ location rollouts. Our in-house production centers on custom wood cabinetry and architectural millwork, along with metal fabrication and solid surface components.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Plant Manager to lead manufacturing, warehouse, and assembly operations across three local facilities. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, you will oversee approximately 30 employees through supervisors and team leaders, with significant room to grow the organization as we expand.

This is a role for a builder. The right leader will establish the scheduling systems, standards, and leadership structure that allow Icon to scale without sacrificing quality.

What You Will Do

* Lead manufacturing across all three facilities, including woodworking, cabinetry, millwork, metal, solid surface, finishing, and assembly.

* Build and own production schedules that reflect project deadlines, material availability, labor capacity, and equipment, and identify problems before they affect delivery.

* Run warehouse and assembly operations: receiving, inventory control, material flow between facilities, and preparation for shipment and installation.

* Coordinate material purchasing and production priorities with project management, engineering, and logistics.

* Develop supervisors and team leaders into a management team that runs daily operations independently; recruit, train, and retain skilled employees.

* Set and enforce quality standards against shop drawings and specifications, and reduce defects, rework, and waste.

* Manage labor costs, overtime, and operating budgets; track KPIs and report on performance, capacity, and staffing.

* Lead lean and continuous improvement initiatives, including facility layouts, workflows, and equipment utilization.

* Own safety and facilities: OSHA compliance, combustible dust and dust collection (NFPA 652/664), finishing and spray booth compliance, and preventive maintenance.

What You Bring

* 7+ years of manufacturing leadership, preferably in custom manufacturing, cabinetry, millwork, architectural woodworking, or commercial fixture production.

* Experience managing multiple departments or facilities and 30+ employees through supervisors and team leaders.

* Strong command of project-based production scheduling, labor planning, and manufacturing costs.

* Experience overseeing warehouse, inventory, material handling, and assembly operations.

* Ability to read and interpret shop drawings, production drawings, and specifications.

* Familiarity with ERP systems and production tracking tools.

* A proven record of developing people and building accountability.

Preferred Qualifications

* Retail store fixture manufacturing experience.

* Knowledge of CNC panel processing, edgebanding, and cabinet construction; familiarity with metal fabrication and solid surface.

* Experience implementing lean manufacturing.

* Experience scaling operations during periods of rapid growth.

What Success Looks Like

* Consistent, efficient operations across all three facilities.

* Projects delivered on schedule and within production budgets.

* Reliable schedules and predictable workflow.

* Reduced waste, rework, and unnecessary overtime.

* Strong department leaders and an accountable workforce.

* High standards of workmanship, quality, and workplace safety.

Why Icon

You will have significant influence over Icon’s manufacturing operations, workforce development, and future growth, with the opportunity to grow into a Director-level role. We are looking for a hands-on, results-oriented leader who understands custom manufacturing, develops people, and takes ownership of operational performance.

Pay: $105,000.00 - $140,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Relocation assistance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

records.description:
Job Summary:
  
Owns the assigned plant, including the plant’s operating budget, and leads production activities for assigned manufacturing facilities and/or value streams with direct accountability for safety, quality, cost, schedule attainment, and on-time delivery. Provides site-level leadership to ensure daily execution aligns with production plans, customer requirements, standard work, and business objectives. Partners cross functionally with Planning, Materials, Engineering, Quality, HR, and Manufacturing leadership to remove constraints, improve process discipline, and drive continuous improvement throughout the operation.

**Minimum Qualifications: (Education, Experience, Knowledge, and Skills):**

* Bachelor’s degree with 3–5 years of supervisory or site leadership experience and 5–7 years of manufacturing experience preferred. In lieu of a degree, a high school diploma/GED with a minimum of 8 years of supervisory or relevant manufacturing leadership experience will be considered.
* Demonstrated ability to lead a manufacturing site, department, or value stream with accountability for safety, quality, schedule, cost, labor planning, and daily execution.
* Experience leading production managers or production teams through daily management routines, KPI reviews, structured escalation, and continuous improvement activities.
* Strong understanding of production scheduling, capacity planning, labor utilization, material readiness, ERP/MRP discipline, and schedule attainment in a complex manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated competency with ERP systems used in manufacturing environments; IFS, SAP, Oracle, or similar systems preferred.
* Working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, 5S, visual management, standard work, root cause problem solving, and Corrective Action/Preventive Action practices; Six Sigma and/or Lean certification preferred or actively pursuing.
* Ability to use operational data, reports, and KPIs to communicate performance versus goals and drive improvement in safety, quality, cost, schedule, productivity, and on-time delivery.
* Knowledge of safe work practices, OSHA requirements, incident prevention, corrective action closure, and operational organization standards.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and documentation, including schematics, assembly drawings, operational manuals, safety rules, Methods of Manufacture, and standardized work instructions.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional issue resolution with Engineering, Quality, Materials, Planning, Purchasing, Inventory, HR, and other manufacturing groups to minimize delays and improve execution.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, attention to detail, and leadership skills with the ability to engage peers, leaders, and employees at all levels of the organization.
* Must be proficient in Microsoft Office and scheduling software.

**Job Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Owns the assigned plant, including the plant’s operating budget, and site/value stream performance across safety, site security, quality, schedule, cost, productivity, and on time delivery.
* Maintains a safe and healthy work environment by ensuring standards, procedures, legal regulations, OSHA requirements, local regulations and company safety practices are followed.
* Leads safety culture, 5S, operational organization, corrective actions, and incident prevention activities across assigned production areas.
* Maintains a positive and accountable culture where safety, quality, schedule adherence, cost control, and customer requirements are treated as core operating priorities.
* Leads value stream team through daily management routines, KPI reviews, structured escalation, and disciplined execution of the operating plan.
* Owns daily and weekly production attainment by aligning labor, material readiness, equipment availability, engineering support, and production priorities to meet schedule commitments.
* Drives constraint resolution and escalates issues that impact scope, schedule, quality, cost, or customer delivery commitments.
* Identifies, contains, and follows proper procedures for non-conforming material; supports accurate tracking, timely disposition, corrective action, and closure of NCRs.
* Ensures alignment cross-functionally with Engineering, Quality, Planning, Materials, Purchasing, Inventory, HR, and other manufacturing groups to resolve issues, reduce delays, improve process discipline, and support continual product improvement.
* Manages controllable operating costs, labor productivity, overtime, indirect labor utilization, rework, scrap, tools, equipment, and other cost drivers within assigned areas.
* Identifies cost savings opportunities and leads continuous improvement efforts that improve safety, quality, flow, productivity, throughput, and resource utilization.
* Leverages metrics and KPIs to identify performance gaps, establish priorities, communicate progress, and promote a culture of continuous improvement across assigned departments.
* Addresses employee performance, attendance, and standards-of-work issues in partnership with HR and Manufacturing leadership.
* Works with HR and Manufacturing leadership to support personnel development, establish career paths, and maintain a sound performance evaluation process.
* Leads manufacturing-driven projects and cross-functional initiatives based on KPI performance, data review, customer feedback, field quality concerns, or operational needs.

**Working Conditions:**

* This position is on-site 5 days per week.
* Occasional travel may be required for training or meetings.
* Must be able to work flexible hours to accommodate different business needs.

records.description:
**SUMMARY:** Directs production, distribution, maintenance, receiving, and supervision operations for the Plant, by performing the following duties personally or through subordinate supervisors.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Leads all departments in the plant with department supervisors (or production manager) to maintain safety, quality, and efficient production.
* Coordinates production, distribution, and warehousing in accordance with policies, principles, and established procedures.
* Develops and implements plans for efficient use of materials, machines, and employees.
* Reviews production costs and product quality and modifies production and inventory control programs to maintain and enhance profitable operation of plant.
* Directs preparation of production, human resources, and labor/costs records.
* Recommends budgets to management. Assists management in negotiation of employee contracts.
* Maintains positive working relationship with sales management and customer service management.
* Systematically reviews financial performance of the plant to recommend to management opportunities for sales growth and cost savings.
* Coordinates plant safety, environmental and training activities in cooperation with the Human Resources Department.
* Comply with company policies and procedures.
* Additional duties as assigned by management.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Manages subordinate supervisors and/or production manager who supervise all plant employees. Is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of these units.
* Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws.
* Responsibilities include training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE**:

* High school diploma or GED plus college and/or appropriate technical courses.
* Five years experience as a proven manager
* Ten years corrugated manufacturing experience
* Candidates are PREFERRED who offer the following:
* College degree

**LANGUAGE SKILLS:**

* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
* Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.

**MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:**

* Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry.
* Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

**REASONING ABILITY:**

* Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
* Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS:**

The individual must have a working knowledge of the following:

* Equipment design and capabilities that can be translated into efficient operation. This also supports the supervisor's role of teacher and trainer for his/her personnel.
* Cost issues in order to make daily decisions that will reduce overall costs and will help the supervisor find areas that require improvement.
* Budget development, adherence and analysis.
* Quality standards.
* Regulatory requirements including but not limited to wage and hour requirements, environmental and waste minimization, company policies, and personnel requirements including OSHA, DEQ and EEO.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**:

* The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the functions of this job.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear.
* The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, and sit.
* The employee is occasionally required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
* The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

* The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the functions of this job.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts.
* The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions.
* The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration.
* The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

**LEADERSHIP ATTRIBUTES**:

The individual must posses the following:

* Superior time management skills including the ability to manage multiple issues concurrently and the ability to lead an effective and efficient meeting.
* Teaching skills in order to function effectively as a teacher for his personnel both in the technical and administrative parts of the position.
* Excellent crisis manager who demonstrates that he/she has a high emotional control under adverse conditions and can lead his/her personnel to a successful resolution.
* Excellent employee relations skills including being an active listener, understanding how to appraise personnel, applying both positive and corrective feedback, being able to resolve conflicts either involving the supervisor directly or as a third party, understands and demonstrates positive motivational skills including coaching and delegation techniques.
* Demonstrated confidence including providing a consistent leadership style with an acceptable level of professional assertiveness.
* Professional appearance to support his/her role as a managerial representative of the company.

**PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS**:

The performance of the supervisor will be measured as follows:

* **Operating standards** - the Plant Manager will need to see that all reporting staff meet or exceed the Operating Standards in the areas of quality, cost, safety, customer satisfaction and productivity. Such standards will be set annually and communicated to the supervisor.
* **Personal growth** - while the company will provide the tools to assist the supervisor to grow professionally the responsibility for moving forward lies with the individual. Each year there will be goals developed and agreed to by the supervisor and his/her superior.

**Employee relations** - through observations the Plant Manager will be evaluated regarding his/her and his/her reporting staff's skills and advancements in the areas of motivational techniques and results, positive and corrective/constructive feedback, subordinate development and creating a positive work environment.

**Carolina Container Company is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.**

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
CAMS is looking for a Plant Manager at the Kings Mountain Energy Center in Kings Mountain, NC. The incumbent will have 19 direct and indirect employees. The Plant Manager is responsible for the safe, reliable, compliant, and financially responsible operation and maintenance of the Kings Mountain Energy Center.

Kings Mountain Energy Center is a 475MW natural gas-fired combined-cycle power plant. The facility features an advanced 276MW Mitsubishi M501GAC gas turbine, a Vogt Power heat recovery steam generator (HRSG), a 225MW Toshiba steam turbine generator, and a Thermal Engineering International surface condenser.

The position provides overall leadership for plant operations, maintenance, engineering support, environmental and regulatory compliance, administration, workforce development, budgeting, outage execution, and continuous improvement. The Plant Manager serves as the primary site representative to CAMS leadership, facility ownership and asset management, and is accountable for developing a high-performing organization that maximizes plant availability, reliability, efficiency, and long-term asset value. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong leadership, sound technical and business judgment, and the ability to manage a complex combined-cycle generating facility in a competitive power-market environment.

### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for the safe, reliable, environmentally compliant, and cost-effective operation and maintenance of the facility.
* Establish and maintain a strong safety culture in which employees and contractors actively identify hazards, stop unsafe work, and demonstrate personal ownership of safety performance.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local environmental permits, laws, regulations, NERC requirements, OSHA requirements, company policies, and facility procedures.
* Lead and develop the plant management team and workforce, including recruiting, coaching, performance management, succession planning, qualification programs, and workforce development.
* Maintain effective working relationships with facility ownership, Asset Management, CAMS leadership, regulatory agencies, the system operator, utilities, OEMs, contractors, and other key stakeholders.
* Develop and execute annual operating plans, O&M budgets, capital plans, forecasts, and long-term maintenance strategies consistent with owner objectives and contractual requirements.
* Monitor plant financial performance and control expenditures while ensuring that short-term budget objectives do not create unacceptable safety, environmental, reliability, or long-term asset risk.
* Direct plant operations to achieve availability, reliability, heat-rate, start-reliability, capacity, and other performance objectives while meeting dispatch and commercial obligations.
* Provide leadership for maintenance strategies, preventive and predictive maintenance, corrective-maintenance backlog management, equipment reliability, root-cause analysis, and elimination of recurring failures.
* Direct planning and execution of combustion turbine, steam turbine, HRSG, generator, electrical, and balance-of-plant outages and major maintenance activities, including scope, budget, schedule, contractor performance, quality, and risk management.
* Develop and maintain multi-year outage, major-maintenance, and capital improvement plans based on equipment condition, OEM recommendations, operating profile, commercial requirements, and risk.
* Identify significant plant risks and provide CAMS leadership and ownership with timely information, alternatives, consequences, and clear recommendations for decision-making.
* Ensure appropriate critical-spares strategy, inventory controls, long-lead component planning, and equipment-obsolescence management.
* Oversee plant engineering and technical support activities, including equipment modifications, controls and logic changes, performance monitoring, capital projects, and technical problem solving.
* Ensure plant procedures, drawings, technical documentation, training materials, emergency plans, and operating records are accurate and maintained.
* Oversee administration of applicable plant contracts and agreements and ensure operational compliance with owner requirements, O&M obligations, OEM/LTSA requirements, fuel and utility agreements, and other commercial commitments.
* Maintain effective communication with Asset Management and ownership, including prompt escalation of significant safety, environmental, operational, equipment, financial, contractual, or regulatory events.
* Lead emergency response and business-continuity activities and ensure the facility is prepared for severe weather, grid emergencies, fuel interruptions, cyber events, and major equipment failures.
* Promote a culture of accountability, teamwork, continuous improvement, and open communication across Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Compliance, and Administration.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve plant performance, reduce operating risk, optimize costs, and increase long-term asset value.
* Support CAMS fleet initiatives, peer reviews, lessons learned, workforce-development efforts, and cross-facility technical support as requested.

Other duties as assigned.

### **Qualifications and Skills**

* 10+ years of progressively responsible experience in power generation operations and maintenance, including significant leadership experience in a power plant environment.
* Prior Plant Manager, Operations Manager, Maintenance Manager, or comparable senior power-generation leadership experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated knowledge of combined-cycle power plant operations, maintenance, reliability, and major equipment systems. Experience with combustion turbines, steam turbines, HRSGs, generators, electrical systems, and balance-of-plant equipment is preferred.
* Experience with Mitsubishi M501GAC combustion turbines is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience planning and executing major outages, managing contractors and OEMs, controlling outage scope and cost, and resolving emergent technical issues.
* Working knowledge of environmental, health and safety, and electric-generation regulatory requirements applicable to power plant operations.
* Demonstrated experience developing and managing O&M budgets, forecasts, capital projects, and long-term maintenance plans.
* Proven ability to lead, coach, develop, and hold accountable a multidisciplinary workforce.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, planning, and organizational skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with employees, executives, owners, regulators, contractors, and technical personnel.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred. Significant relevant power-generation leadership experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and familiarity with computerized maintenance management systems, plant historians, performance-monitoring systems, and other power-plant business systems.
* Ability to respond to plant emergencies and significant operating events outside normal business hours as required.

Other Desirable Skills

* Demonstrates visible leadership and a strong personal commitment to safety and environmental compliance.
* Balances technical, operational, financial, and commercial considerations when making decisions.
* Communicates significant risks and problems early and avoids surprises for ownership and senior leadership.
* Demonstrates strong customer service skills and the ability to build trusted relationships with facility ownership and Asset Management.
* Effectively prioritizes competing demands in a fast-changing operating environment.
* Develop people and create clear succession paths for key positions.
* Demonstrates a high degree of integrity, accountability, sound judgment, and ownership mentality.
* Ability to represent the facility and CAMS professionally with owners, regulators, industry organizations, and external stakeholders

Applicants must possess a **valid driver's license** and maintain a clean driving record, as this position requires occasional travel for company business. Candidates should be comfortable operating a vehicle as part of their job responsibilities and must meet any applicable company and insurance requirements.

CAMS offers a variety of excellent benefits. Full-time employees are offered the following: medical, dental, vision, LTD, STD, and Life insurance plans. You can even select additional “al la carte” benefits to meet all your needs. You can also enroll in our 401k, flex spending accounts for medical and childcare needs, and participate in our employee referral and tuition reimbursement programs.

Qualified Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States. Qualified Applicants will not require employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United States.

We believe in transparency and providing candidates with important information to make informed decisions. The salary range for this position will be commensurate with experience, qualifications, and location. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to skills, experience, and relevant qualifications.

This range represents the base salary and does not include other forms of compensation, such as bonuses, benefits, or equity, which may be offered in addition to the base pay. The company reserves the right to modify.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
The Plant Manager will work closely with other departments and managers to ensure
  
all in-process production metrics as deliverables are being met. This team member will be focused
  
on overall safety, production deliverables and continuous improvement as we continue our growth.  
Job Duties & Responsibilities:  

* Establishing and maintaining production and shipping schedules and ensuring that quality

product is consistently delivered to customers on time and within budget for labor hours,
  
machine hours and material costs  

* Managing production operations such that equipment and employee resources are

utilized efficiently, productivity is high and product quality requirements are met and
  
exceeded  

* Ensuring that process and equipment capabilities meet or exceed company and industry

standards and requirements; implementing operations-related initiatives that result in
  
increased efficiency, improved productivity and reduced job-related costs  

* Full participation in weekly production meetings and daily work-related meetings is

expected  

* Maintaining company policies and procedures with respect to production, materials, and

equipment-related activities, ensuring that employees report labor hours, machine hours,
  
material usage and activities in accordance with company policies and procedures and
  
within the current operations management and control systems  

* Implementing operations and function-related budgeting goals and objectives;

establishing benchmarks for monthly, quarterly, and annual case production and
  
shipments, material receipts, production work-in-process completed and inventory levels
  
within the Plant Level of Operations  

* Preparing and presenting to Director of Operations, the weekly executive summary that

includes production, purchasing, shipping, receiving and inventory numbers as part of the
  
system of infernal checks and balances  

* Recruiting, selecting, training, motivating and evaluating all operations employees in

accordance with company human relations policies and procedures  

* Helping to build and manage within a team-based production environment and developing

and maintaining good working relationships between production, materials, and
  
equipment maintenance  

* Interfacing between the employees in the department and the Director of Operations, the

Executive Vice-President and President of the Company and supporting company policies,
  
goals, objectives, and initiatives  

* Ensuring that all product produced meets quality requirements in accordance with

company policy, procedures and requirements and in accordance with industry standards  

* Keeping the Management abreast of successes, progress and potential problems and

offering appropriate solutions for those problems  

* Simultaneously handling, prioritizing and resolving problems effectively
* Ensuring that shipment deadlines and budget and profitability objectives (i.e. gross margin

and operating profit) are met and exceeded on a quarterly and annual basis as established
  
by Director of Operations  

* Ensuring achievement of production metrics and shipment objectives, including labor

hours per case, machine time per case, quality and cost per case; ensure that labor and
  
machine efficiency is within company guidelines; ensuring that periodic maintenance,
  
repair, rework hours and waste are within company guidelines  

* Ascertaining that purchasing, production support, shipping and receiving performance

metrics and objectives and inventory units and balance objectives are achieved or
  
exceeded on a quarterly and annual basis while ensuring on-time delivery of quality
  
product to customers at budgeted cost per case  

* Ensuring quality products are produced and quality relationships are established and

maintained between production, materials and equipment maintenance personnel, with
  
engineering and sales, customers, subcontractors and others in the area and in the
  
industry  

* Ensuring customer complaints are fewer and of less seriousness than company targets and

objectives  

* Ensuring that reporting and supporting documentation is completed on time and in

accordance with company procedures  

* Achieving Company goals to produce quality product on time and within budget hours are

supported in theory and followed in practice

Job Qualifications:
  

* 5+ year’s relevant industrial and manufacturing experience
* Associates degree in industrial, mechanical, or electrical engineering or equivalent

experience. Manufacturing engineering and operations management an added plus  

* Relevant and current technical knowledge concerning products, materials and equipment
* Knowledge, skills and ability to understand and manage food processing activities and

production lines to provide expertise and technical support to all plant employees, to
  
make equipment, production and materials related decisions  

* Ability to maintain production planning and scheduling, shop loading, expediting and

dispatching, purchasing, shipping and receiving and inventory control functions using
  
manufacturing systems in place  

* Ability to lead and motivate teams to produce quality product, on schedule and within

budget and participate in and facilitate operations-related team meetings  

* Outstanding communication skills with proven ability to successfully lead and develop a

team  

* Excellent team leadership skills and an ability to set goals, accomplish objectives, coach

and counsel while adding to the organizational climate and culture  

* Personal characteristics reflective of a fast paced industry: high energy, self-motivated,

positive attitude, service oriented, flexible, ethical, loyal and with high degree of integrity  

* Business maturity, team orientation and proven ability to positively influence change and

ensure business discipline through periods of growth while simultaneously protecting the
  
company’s operating principles and underlying entrepreneurial culture  

* Demonstrated good judgment in prioritizing, expediting, investigating and resolving

problems and issues and fosters harmonious relations with other company employees
  
while meeting and exceeding customer requirements  

* Respect for the confidentiality of company, customer, and employee information

Competencies:  

* Managing People - Includes staff in planning, decision-making, facilitating and process

improvement; Takes responsibility for subordinates' activities; Makes self-available to staff;
  
Provides regular performance feedback; Develops subordinates' skills and encourages
  
growth; Solicits and applies customer feedback (internal and external); Fosters quality focus
  
in others; Improves processes, products, and services.; Continually works to improve
  
supervisory skills.  

* Organizational Support - Follows policies and procedures; Completes administrative tasks

correctly and on time; Supports organization's goals and values; Benefits organization
  
through outside activities; Supports affirmative action and respects diversity.  

* Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; Gathers and

analyzes information skillfully; Develops alternative solutions; Works well in group problem
  
solving situations; Uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics.  

* Quality Management - Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Demonstrates

accuracy and thoroughness.  

* Safety and Security - Observes safety and security procedures; Determines appropriate

action beyond guidelines; Reports potentially unsafe conditions; Uses equipment and
  
materials properly.  

* Strategic Thinking - Develops strategies to achieve organizational goals; Understands

organization's strengths & weaknesses; Analyzes market and competition; Identifies
  
external threats and opportunities; Adapts strategy to changing conditions.  

* Technical Skills - Assesses own strengths and weaknesses; Pursues training and

development opportunities; Strives to continuously build knowledge and skills; Shares
  
expertise with others.  
PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT: Work is performed indoors in a manufacturing  
setting with regular exposure to cold, heat, noise, and moving machines and equipment. Must be
  
able to lift to 50 lbs, push and pull up to 40 lbs, lift, stand and carry consistently, have proper hearing,
  
vision and speech capabilities. Can wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) (Hearing protection,
  
safety glasses, goggles, or shields).  
The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of
  
this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or physical
  
requirements. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign
  
duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Reasonable accommodations may be made to
  
enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

With a legacy spanning over 35 years, Harris Spice has been a trusted partner and leading supplier of high-quality spices, herbs, and innovative seasoning blends. With international facilities and a global supply chain, we proudly serve multiple channels of trade—including industrial bulk, food service, and retail. Our commitment to excellence, quality and consistency has earned us the trust of some of the nation’s largest and most recognized brands. As Harris Spice continues to grow, we are dedicated to cultivating a dynamic, inclusive workplace where innovation thrives. We're looking for diverse, talented individuals who are ready to grow with us and help strengthen a brand known for trust, quality, and bold flavor solutions.

**Position Overview/Job Summary:**

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall leadership and performance of the manufacturing facility, overseeing Production and Maintenance, and Planning & Scheduling as assigned. This role ensures safe, efficient, and cost-effective operations while meeting production targets, customer demand, quality standards, and food safety requirements. The Plant Manager drives operational excellence, equipment reliability, continuous improvement, and cost control while developing a strong, accountable team to achieve the company's business objectives.

**Essential Job Functions:**

· Provide overall leadership and direction for plant operations to achieve production, quality, safety, service, and financial objectives.

· Oversee Production and Maintenance, and Planning & Scheduling as assigned.

· Establish departmental goals, KPIs, and performance expectations aligned with company objectives.

· Ensure adequate staffing, equipment, materials, and resources to meet operational demands.

· Monitor plant performance, address operational challenges, and drive improvements in productivity, efficiency, and capacity.

· Ensure effective coordination between departments and hold managers and supervisors accountable for results.

· Oversee production activities to ensure products are manufactured safely, on schedule, within quality standards, and at standard cost.

· Support internal and external audits and ensure timely resolution of findings and corrective actions.

· Promote a proactive safety culture through hazard identification, employee training, incident prevention, and accountability.

· Lead, develop, and coach department managers and supervisors to achieve operational goals.

records.description:
### **Description**

At Pacific Seafood, we do more than just provide the world with the healthiest proteins on the planet. We are a family-owned, excellence-driven organization committed to being the brand of choice in the marketplace and the employer of choice in the community. We believe in servant leadership, investing in our team members’ personal and professional growth, and rewarding performance. We live by the core values of our Diamond Philosophy: Teamwork, Productivity, Quality, and Excellence—which means consistently doing your best and *always* striving to do better.
  
  
**Summary:**

We are seeking a dynamic, solutions-oriented **Director of Technology Operations** to lead, scale, and optimize IT operations for our enterprise. Serving as a strategic partner to leadership and business unit heads across geographies, this role is accountable for the reliability, agility, and continuous evolution of our enterprise technology ecosystem.

The ideal candidate is a transformative, hands-on leader who blends deep technical fluency with strong financial stewardship and operational maturity. Rather than introducing rigid bureaucracy, this leader takes a pragmatic, evolutionary approach—fine-tuning existing workflows, aligning IT service delivery with measurable business outcomes, and fostering an empowering, "Best in Class" culture across Service Desk, Project Management Office (PMO), Infrastructure, and Enterprise Applications.

Because our team members are our greatest asset and strength, this role directly assesses the VP’s direct reports and the next level of leaders, identifies strengths and gaps, and ensures each leader has a practical development plan. The Director also evaluates reporting relationships, spans of control, role clarity, and succession depth, and uses a working knowledge of income statements and balance sheets to connect people decisions to business results.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Enterprise IT Service Delivery & Service Desk Operations**

* **Support Leadership:** Direct the strategy and daily execution of end-user support, including the IT Service Desk, Desktop Support, Field Services, Depot/Procurement, and VIP/Executive Support across multiple time zones.
* **SLA & Throughput Excellence:** Establish, monitor, and enforce aggressive Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to ensure consistent, predictable service throughput—even during critical end-of-month, end-of-quarter, or high-volume operational periods.
* **End-to-End Lifecycle Management:** Oversee the complete IT lifecycle of internal and customer-facing systems, including enterprise workstations, telephony, infrastructure, and specialized operational/manufacturing hardware.
* **Operational Readiness & Business Continuity:** Lead contingency planning, risk surfacing, and operational readiness initiatives to protect business continuity and minimize disruptions during organizational transitions or major system cutovers.

**2. ITSM, ITIL Frameworks & IT Governance**

* **ITSM & ITIL Maturity:** Own, design, and continuously optimize core ITIL processes—including Incident, Problem, Request, Change, Escalation, and Knowledge Management—within enterprise platforms.
* **IT Intake & Demand Management:** Architect and govern a centralized IT Intake process to evaluate, prioritize, and route incoming business requests, ensuring resource allocation aligns with strategic corporate objectives and operational capacity.
* **Enterprise Governance & Compliance:** Establish pragmatic IT governance models, internal controls, and compliance frameworks that safeguard enterprise data and infrastructure without impeding business agility.
* **Knowledge & Self-Service Enablement:** Drive continuous improvement in knowledge base creation, documentation standards, and automated self-service tools to empower end-users and accelerate first-contact resolution.

**3. Project Management Office (PMO) & Digital Transformation**

* **PMO Leadership & Tollgate Governance:** Develop, deploy, and oversee formalized project management methodologies and tools. Serve as the executive tollgate for technology initiatives to ensure requirements are rigorously defined, scoped, and aligned with strategic goals.
* **Enterprise System Implementations:** Lead cross-functional execution for major digital transformation initiatives, including ERP migrations, CRM rollouts, and M&A technology integrations.
* **AI & Automation Readiness:** Champion the pragmatic adoption of emerging technologies and AI-driven workflows across IT operations to automate routine tasks, enhance reporting accuracy, and elevate enterprise productivity.

**4. Continuous Improvement & Lean Operations**

* **Lean Six Sigma Execution:** Embed Lean and Continuous Improvement methodologies into daily IT operations to eliminate waste, reduce turnaround times, and streamline cross-departmental workflows.
* **Root Cause & Corrective Action:** Partner closely with all IT Operations teams on deep failure-mode analysis and root-cause corrective actions to permanently resolve recurring technical issues and business impacts.
* **Asset & Inventory Optimization:** Reframe IT hardware, spare parts, and demo/recon pools as actively managed operational assets—optimizing space utilization, procurement costing, redistribution, and lifecycle disposition.

**5. Customer Satisfaction & Cross-Functional Partnership**

* **Customer-Centric Culture:** Champion an unwavering focus on internal and external customer satisfaction, transforming IT from a transactional support function into a proactive, trusted business enabler.
* **Executive & Departmental Alignment:** Foster transparent, collaborative partnerships with Finance, Manufacturing, Distribution, Quality, Engineering, and Sales leadership to ensure technology roadmaps directly support revenue and operational goals.
* **Voice of the Customer:** Implement regular satisfaction tracking, feedback loops, and executive business reviews to measure stakeholder sentiment and drive targeted service enhancements.

**6. Financial Stewardship & Resource Optimization**

* **Multi-Million-Dollar P&L Management:** Develop, justify, and manage a $15M–$30M+ IT operations budget, maintaining strict fiscal discipline across OPEX, CAPEX, vendor contracts, and software licensing.
* **Data-Driven Economics:** Apply rigorous cost-benefit and repair-versus-replace analyses to hardware maintenance, vendor agreements, and service models, identifying opportunities to reduce operational costs while improving service quality.
* **Vendor & Outsourced Partner Management:** Negotiate and manage contracts with third-party vendors, hardware suppliers, and managed service providers to ensure accountability and maximum return on investment.

**7. Talent Development & Organizational Leadership**

* **Inspirational People Leadership:** Lead, mentor, and coach a diverse, geographically dispersed organization of managers, engineers, analysts, and technicians.
* **Cross-Training & Team Resilience:** Eliminate single-point dependencies by building structured cross-training programs, clear career pathways, and flexible skill coverage across teams.
* **High-Accountability & Morale:** Cultivate a high-morale, low-turnover environment rooted in psychological safety, diversity, equity, and inclusion, while holding staff to clear performance standards through active coaching and accountability.

  

### **What you bring to Pacific Seafood**

**Required:**

* **Executive or Senior Leadership Track Record:** 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in IT Operations, Service Delivery, or Technical Operations, including 5+ years at the Director or Senior level within a complex, multi-site, or enterprise environment.
* **Proven Operational Impact:** Demonstrated history of scaling support teams, managing multi-million-dollar budgets, and delivering measurable reductions in operational costs and ticket turnaround times.

records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

### **Job Description:**

Shield AI is actively seeking candidates with deep expertise in manufacturing and quality methodologies, paired with a relentless drive to enable supplier success and strengthen mission-critical operations.

Shield AI’s Supply Chain Quality team is responsible for global quality oversight across our supplier base. The team reduces supply-chain risk through supplier assessments and internal risk reviews, proactively drives supplier qualification and development activities.

In this role, you will lead a supplier quality team responsible for supplier qualification, development, performance management, and quality assurance across Shield AI’s aerospace and defense supply base. You will set supplier-quality priorities; manage team capacity, technical execution, and resource allocation; and develop high-performing quality leaders. The role also oversees supplier audits, nonconformance resolution, root-cause investigations, and hands on hardware dispositions.

You will evaluate supplier capability, quality performance, organizational risk, and resource needs to ensure purchased hardware and materials meet Shield AI engineering, customer, regulatory, and quality requirements. As an experienced aerospace quality leader, you will partner closely with Supply Chain, Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, and Program teams to resolve complex supplier-quality issues, improve supplier capability, and reduce quality and delivery risk across the supply base.

**What you'll do:**

* Develop the supplier quality team responsible for supplier qualification, surveillance, performance management, and corrective-action activities across Shield AI’s global aerospace and defense supply base.
* Establish supplier-quality priorities, allocate resources, and translate functional objectives into staffing, workload, and execution plans that support product, program, and organizational needs.
* Develop Supplier Quality leaders and engineering personnel through coaching, performance management, succession planning, workforce development, and technical mentorship.
* Oversee supplier qualification, risk assessments, periodic performance reviews, supplier audits, source inspections, and approved-supplier status across complex aerospace hardware, commodities, and manufacturing processes.
* Ensure supplier requirements are effectively flowed down and that suppliers comply with applicable quality management system, engineering, customer, contractual, regulatory, and statutory requirements.
* Escalate significant supplier-quality risks and direct SCARs, supplier recovery efforts, and capability-improvement plans that could affect product quality, delivery, mission readiness, or program execution.
* Partner with Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, and Program teams to address supplier producibility, design-for-manufacturability, process capability, technical execution, and quality risks.
* Advance supplier-quality processes, business systems, data analytics, and continuous-improvement practices that strengthen supplier capability, product quality, delivery performance, and supply-base resilience.

**Required qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or another related technical discipline.
* At least 7 years of relevant experience, including 2–5 years of leadership or people-management experience with direct responsibility for Quality Engineering and/or Supplier Quality Engineering personnel.
* Strong working knowledge of AS9100 and/or ISO 9001 quality-management systems, as well as aerospace and defense supplier-quality requirements.
* Demonstrated proficiency in root-cause analysis and structured problem-solving methods, including 8D, 5 Whys, and fishbone analysis.
* Experience with supplier qualification, supplier development, PPAP, and First Article Inspection processes, including AS9102 requirements.
* Understanding of ITAR, EAR, DFARS, and other requirements applicable to aerospace and defense suppliers.
* Demonstrated people-leadership capability, including coaching, performance management, organizational development, and building high-performing technical teams.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration, executive communication, and supplier relationship-management skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.
* Experience using ERP/MRP systems.
* Ability to travel to Shield AI manufacturing locations and supplier sites domestically and, as needed, internationally—up to approximately 20% of the time.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Quality Manager (CQM), or equivalent quality certification.
* Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.
* Experience leading supplier-quality functions in a high-growth aerospace, defense, autonomy, robotics, or advanced-manufacturing environment.
* Experience supporting the production and qualification of complex electromechanical, electronic, precision-machined, composite, or avionics hardware.
