records.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form!

In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by *TIME* as a “Best Invention”, *MIT Technology Review* as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and *Fast Company* as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia.

Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing - might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.

**Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.**

**Role Description**
--------------------

Form Energy is looking for an experienced Senior Director of Quality to join our battery manufacturing organization. In this role you will lead the Quality department for Form Energy. Your scope will be company-wide and your team will implement systems and processes that ensure products are designed, manufactured and shipped to the highest levels of performance, reliability, and quality.

This role is for an executive leader with experience developing new technologies and bringing high-volume manufacturing facilities to life. You will provide vision, strategy and leadership to help Form achieve manufacturing scale, cost-reduction, and daily operation execution.

As the key driver for shipping the highest quality products, you will thrive when working closely with leadership and cross-functional teams throughout the product development lifecycle, from early R&D to validation testing, pilot builds, and ultimately commercial production of customer-facing products.

*Relocation assistance is available.*

### **What you'll do:**

* Develop and sustain a world-class quality management system powered by a highly-trained, flexible, and proactive staff
* Maintain product risk profiles and manage quality systems to ensure Form Energy is meeting or exceeding risk expectations
* Ensure Form Energy production operations are releasing only conforming products to our customers
* Communicate key risks and opportunities to leadership and provide direction to resolve top issues and drive definitive corrective action
* Plan and efficiently manage Quality resources (labor, OpEx, and CapEx) and report on department performance and needs
* Communicate Form Energy's commitment to quality with internal and external interested parties
* Drive a customer-focused culture anchored by strong individual ownership and accountability

### **What you'll bring:**

* At least 10 years experience in quality, manufacturing, or manufacturing engineering
* At least 5 years in a senior-leader / site-leader quality role, demonstrating a clear record of success in building industry-leading teams that can execute in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
* Expertise in building Quality Management Systems (e.g., IATF 16949, ISO9001).
* Highly technical background, with a strong foundation in logical reasoning that allows for a steep learning curve and the ability to adapt to new technologies
* Excellent leadership, project management, communication, and organizational skills
* Bachelor’s Degree (or higher) in Engineering

### **Where you'll work:**

This role is based at Form Factory 1 in Weirton, WV—an easy commute from the city of Pittsburgh, PA. This 550,000-square-foot facility is our hub for high-volume battery production and a leader in the new era of American energy manufacturing. **Relocation assistance is available.**

*When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed.*

records.title: Director, Industrial Engineering
records.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**
------------------

Anduril's Manufacturing Engineering Team is seeking a Director, Industrial Engineering to lead IE strategy and execution for the Air Defense & Strike (AD&S) division. The Manufacturing Team is responsible for rapidly iterating and building cutting-edge defense hardware — including static equipment, moving ground equipment, sensors, undersea, and flight vehicles — and scaling these products across our production footprint, including our new 5M sq ft manufacturing facility, Arsenal-1.

Industrial Engineering at Anduril operates in a matrix with a Center of Excellence (COE) and embedded IEs directly into the divisions they support. Every embedded IE takes day-to-day direction and priorities from their business line, while the central IE organization provides the methodology, standards, tools, mentorship, career development, surge coverage, and cross-divisional visibility that make each individual IE more effective than they could be on their own. The Director, IE — AD&S is the senior IE leader dedicated to one of Anduril's highest-growth, most operationally complex divisions — owning the IE strategy, team, and results for AD&S and operating as a peer member of the division's production leadership team.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
------------------

As the Director, Industrial Engineering — AD&S, you will own the industrial engineering function for the Air Defense & Strike division end-to-end. You will build, lead, and develop the IE team embedded in AD&S — hiring the right people, designing the team structure, and setting the IE agenda in lockstep with the division's production strategy and ramp trajectory and COE standards and enterprise vision / system. You report to the Director of Industrial Engineering (central IE CoE) and sit as a peer alongside AD&S production leadership, connected to the VP of Production, Director of Manufacturing Engineering, and Program Directors who shape division priorities.

This is a division-level leadership role with enterprise accountability. You are not inheriting a mature, steady-state operation — AD&S is in active ramp across multiple product lines, standing up new production systems, scaling from prototype through low-rate into full-rate production, and doing so at a pace that demands IE leadership who can build the plane while flying it. You will define what IE looks like for AD&S: which capabilities to stand up first, how to staff and structure the team, where to invest in labor standards, layouts, simulation, and capacity planning, and how IE integrates into the division's NPI and production ramp cadence.

You will translate company-wide IE standards and the Manufacturing Development Plan (MDP) into AD&S-specific execution — adapting central methodology to the division's unique product mix, production maturity, and operational tempo while maintaining consistency with enterprise IE standards and Core 4 reporting. You are accountable for IE outcomes across the division: labor standards coverage, layout quality, line balance efficiency, capacity model accuracy, and the measurable impact of IE on AD&S production performance.

The right person for this role is a seasoned IE or manufacturing engineering leader who thrives in start-up and ramp environments — someone who has built teams from scratch, stood up production systems, and driven measurable operational impact in fast-moving, complex manufacturing. You have deep technical credibility in IE fundamentals but lead through strategy and people: setting vision, building organizational capability, and creating the systems that let a growing team deliver at scale. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, making decisions with incomplete information, and operating at the intersection of divisional execution and enterprise IE strategy. You communicate with clarity and conviction to senior leadership and are energized by the challenge of building something new in a high-stakes environment.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

**Divisional IE Strategy and Execution**

* Own the IE strategy for AD&S — defining the roadmap, capability priorities, and investment plan aligned to the division's ramp trajectory, NPI pipeline, and business objectives.
* Translate company-wide IE standards and the MDP process into AD&S-specific execution — ensuring IE deliverables (labor standards, layouts, line balances, capacity models) are completed at the right maturity gates and integrated into division planning.
* Drive Core 4 metrics performance (labor hours per unit, line balance efficiency, throughput, units per square foot) — setting targets, tracking results, and ensuring IE work moves the numbers that matter to AD&S. IE provides the roadmap to scale.
* Serve as the primary IE interface to AD&S leadership for capacity questions, ramp feasibility, layout approvals, make-vs-buy analysis, and production system design. Connect AD&S needs to central IE capabilities and enterprise resources.

**Team Building and Leadership**

* Build the AD&S IE team into a high-performing, right-sized organization — designing the structure, defining roles, leading hiring, and onboarding IEs, IE Leads, and IE Technicians aligned to the division's product lines and production stages.
* Directly manage the embedded IE team — setting expectations, driving accountability, conducting performance reviews, and investing in the growth and career development of every team member. Own the headcount plan and budget.
* Develop high-potential talent, build succession depth, and ensure every IE is proficient in core methodology (time studies, MODAPTS/MTM, line balancing, layout design, capacity modeling, Core 4 measurement).

**Production System Design and NPI**

* Lead IE involvement in production line stand-ups and NPI ramps — from process characterization and layout design through labor standards development, line balancing, rate-readiness validation, and system optimization.
* Own production line and workstation layout design — cell configurations, material flow, equipment placement, and spatial planning for both low-rate and full-rate production using simulation-backed approaches.
* Drive capacity planning and production modeling — ensuring AD&S has accurate capacity models, proactively identifying bottlenecks and constraints, and supporting capital investment decisions with IE analysis.

**Cross-Functional Partnership and Communication**

* Operate as a peer member of the AD&S production leadership team — shaping production strategy, influencing capital and staffing decisions, and representing IE in all forums where production decisions are made.
* Build strong working relationships across Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Program Management, and Facilities. Represent AD&S IE in cross-divisional forums, bringing enterprise best practices back to the division.
* Be present on the floor. Walk the lines, build credibility with operators and supervisors, and model the Gemba-first, data-driven culture the IE team stands for. Communicate IE impact to senior leadership with clarity and conviction.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Systems Engineering, Operations Research, or a related field.
* 12+ years of experience in industrial engineering, manufacturing engineering, or production operations, with demonstrated depth across multiple IE disciplines (labor standards, layout design, capacity planning, simulation).
* 5+ years managing industrial engineers or manufacturing engineers, including experience managing managers or leads — with demonstrated hiring, org design, and team-building experience.
* Experience building or scaling an IE team in a ramp or start-up production environment — designing team structure, hiring into it, and standing up capabilities from early stages.
* Deep technical credibility in core IE fundamentals: time studies, labor standards (MTM/MODAPTS), line balancing, layout design, capacity planning, and production system design.
* Experience operating as a peer of production leadership — influencing strategy, owning budgets and headcount, and communicating IE impact to VP-level audiences.
* Track record of driving measurable operational improvement — IE initiatives that moved production metrics and can be quantified.
* Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Operations Research, MBA, or a related field.
* Experience in defense, aerospace, or other highly regulated, high-mix manufacturing environments with complex compliance and traceability requirements.
* Experience standing up a centralized or embedded IE function from scratch — methodology selection, standards development, tooling, and organizational adoption.
* Proficiency in simulation software (FlexSim, Arena, AnyLogic, or equivalent), data analytics/visualization (Power BI, Tableau), or experience integrating IE deliverables with MES/ERP platforms.
* Experience designing and commissioning new production lines or manufacturing facilities.
* Active security clearance, or ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  

### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* **Please always verify communications:**
  + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address.
  + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
* **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
* **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

### **Data Privacy**

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

  

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. records.description:
**Optum Insight** is improving the flow of health data and information to create a more connected system. We remove friction and drive alignment between care providers and payers, and ultimately consumers. Our deep expertise in the industry and innovative technology empower us to help organizations reduce costs while improving risk management, quality and revenue growth. Ready to help us deliver results that improve lives? Join us in making healthcare work better for everyone through people-led, responsible AI while **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Senior Director, Back Operations - Collections is the senior operational leader responsible for domestic hospital and professional collections performance across assigned client portfolios. This role directly leads the domestic collections organization and is accountable for cash acceleration, accounts receivable resolution, aging and inventory reduction, productivity, quality, workforce effectiveness, and achievement of client and operational commitments.

The Senior Director works closely with offshore/global delivery leadership to coordinate collections activities across domestic and global operations, including alignment of work allocation, performance expectations, quality standards, escalation pathways, and reporting.

In addition to direct responsibility for domestic collections, this position provides strategic and operational oversight across the broader back-end revenue cycle, including billing, global collections, denial management, and cash posting. These functions do not report directly to this position. The Senior Director is responsible for ensuring strong cross-functional coordination, identifying dependencies and barriers, facilitating resolution of issues impacting collections performance, and promoting accountability for overall back-end revenue cycle outcomes.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely \* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Domestic Collections Leadership and Performance
  + Provide direct leadership and accountability for domestic collections operations across hospital and professional accounts receivable portfolios
  + Lead a large, distributed organization through directors, managers, supervisors, and frontline collections teams
  + Own domestic collections performance related to cash, days in A/R, aging, inventory reduction, productivity, quality, cost to collect, service levels, and client commitments
  + Establish priorities for collections activities based on payer, aging, balance, account complexity, recovery opportunity, and client requirements
  + Ensure appropriate allocation of staffing and resources to maximize cash recovery and reduce unresolved A/R
  + Maintain disciplined management of aged, high-dollar, complex, and escalated inventories, including underpayments, stalled claims, administrative denials, payer escalations, and accounts requiring cross-functional intervention
  + Hold operational leaders accountable for established performance expectations and lead corrective action and performance recovery when results fall below targeted levels
* Global Collections Partnership
  + Partner closely with offshore/global collections leadership to align domestic and global collections activities
  + Establish consistent expectations for work allocation, work queues, productivity, quality, documentation, escalation, and performance reporting
  + Align domestic and global work based on account complexity, payer requirements, system access, client commitments, resource capabilities, and automation opportunities
  + Identify and resolve gaps in ownership, handoffs, and accountability that may impede collections performance
  + Maintain effective operating rhythms with global leadership to ensure visibility into performance, capacity, risks, and emerging client needs
* Back Operations Oversight and Integration
  + Provide strategic and operational oversight across billing, global collections, denial management, and cash posting, while maintaining direct leadership accountability for domestic collections
  + Partner with functional leaders to monitor performance, identify risks and dependencies, and address issues that may affect cash flow, aging, collections, or client commitments
  + Facilitate cross-functional resolution of issues involving billing delays, claim defects, denials, payment posting, payer behavior, system access, or workflow breakdowns
  + Establish clear mechanisms for escalating significant performance or operational barriers and monitoring remediation through resolution
  + Promote effective integration across back-end revenue cycle functions and appropriate accountability for end-to-end outcomes
  + Identify recurring operational issues and partner with appropriate revenue cycle leaders to address upstream and downstream root causes
* Performance Management and Analytics
  + Establish and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly operating rhythms, including performance reviews, dashboards, scorecards, forecasts, and corrective action plans
  + Monitor and manage key revenue cycle performance indicators, including cash collections, days in A/R, aging, inventory, productivity, quality, denial trends, cost to collect, staffing, and forecast performance
  + Analyze results by client, payer, account type, aging category, work queue, team, and other relevant dimensions to identify trends, risks, and opportunities
  + Establish transparent capacity and workforce plans that connect inventory, expected cash, productivity, staffing, training, attrition, and global delivery assumptions
  + Use data to distinguish performance issues driven by capacity from those caused by process, technology, payer behavior, access limitations, or upstream revenue cycle issues
  + Translate operational data into clear actions, priorities, and performance improvement plans
* Operational Excellence, Technology and Continuous Improvement
  + Identify opportunities to standardize and improve collections workflows, work queues, payer strategies, account segmentation, documentation practices, escalation processes, and operating procedures
  + Partner with Product, Technology, Analytics, and Automation teams to identify and prioritize opportunities to improve collections efficiency and effectiveness
  + Sponsor workflow redesign and automation initiatives that reduce manual activity, improve work prioritization, accelerate account resolution, and strengthen quality
  + Support appropriate adoption of analytics, predictive capabilities, automation, and AI-enabled tools within collections operations
  + Establish appropriate human review, exception handling, quality validation, and operational controls for automated processes
  + Identify recurring collections and denial root causes and partner with the appropriate operational leaders to address issues affecting revenue realization
* Client, Payer and Executive Leadership
  + Serve as the senior operational leader for domestic collections in discussions with client revenue cycle executives, internal executive leadership, and other key stakeholders
  + Lead client performance discussions, operational reviews, remediation planning, and executive escalations related to collections performance
  + Communicate operational performance, risks, root causes, corrective actions, and expected recovery timelines clearly and effectively
  + Coordinate payer escalation strategies when payer behavior contributes to significant payment delays, denials, underpayments, or administrative burden
  + Support new client transitions, expansions, and other operational initiatives involving collections or back-end revenue cycle capabilities
  + Partner across Finance, Client Management, Sales, Technology, Product, Human Capital, Compliance, and other operational functions to achieve client and organizational objectives
* People Leadership and Workforce Development
  + Build, develop, and retain a strong domestic collections leadership team, including directors, managers, supervisors, and emerging leaders
  + Oversee recruiting, selection, onboarding, training, coaching, performance management, succession planning, and retention strategies
  + Establish appropriate spans of control, role expectations, career pathways, and capability requirements based on operational complexity
  + Ensure leaders consistently communicate performance expectations, provide meaningful coaching and feedback, recognize strong performance, and address performance gaps in a timely manner
  + Foster a collaborative, inclusive, accountable, and performance-oriented culture across domestic teams and in partnership with global operations
  + Partner with Human Capital and other stakeholders on workforce planning, organizational change, employee relations, and other personnel matters
* Risk, Compliance and Operational Controls
  + Ensure collections activities comply with applicable federal and state requirements, payer requirements, contractual obligations, client policies, privacy requirements, and company controls
  + Maintain appropriate controls related to account handling, documentation, system access, quality, escalation, and other revenue cycle processes
  + Identify operational and compliance risks and ensure appropriate escalation and remediation
  + Partner with Compliance, Legal, Human Capital, and client leadership as appropriate to address identified risks

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of progressive healthcare revenue cycle experience
* 5+ years of experience in a leadership role with responsibility for operational performance
* 5+ years of experience leading accounts receivable follow-up and collections operations within a complex hospital, health system, physician, or outsourced revenue cycle environment
* 5+ years of experience leading large, geographically distributed teams through multiple levels of management

records.description:
Working in the Office of the Chief Medical Officer and reporting to the VP of Point of Care & Risk Stratification, the Senior Director of Strategy & Operations, Point of Care, will lead day-to-day operations, partnerships, go-to-market efforts, and wraparound support services to maximize the impact of Aledade’s value-based care insights to our partner practices.

The team is looking for a high-output generalist with a strong business analyst toolkit, looking to rapidly take ownership of complex content with high visibility, working across multiple stakeholders. Candidates that thrive managing multiple deadlines on tight timelines and learning content quickly are best positioned to succeed; successful team members in the same function primarily have backgrounds in consulting and generalist healthcare strategy & operations roles.

To start, the role will focus on 1) scaling the deployment of our point of care tools and 2) broadening and deepening the insights available in our point of care tools, to maximize the impact of Aledade’s insights on our patients’ health outcomes and partner practices’ success in their value-based care contracts.

At the end of their first year, a successful leader in the role will own end-to-end accountability for 1) proactive identification, development, and execution of Point of Care deployment improvement opportunities, including field, practice, and clinician education, deployment automation and monitoring, and go to market approach and materials, 2) strategic relationship building and partnership with Aledade’s payer partners to advance point of care tool adoption and impact, 3) goal setting, metric identification and development, and impact evaluation for our point of care tools, 4) identification, evaluation, contracting, and cross-functional execution of net new vendor and external partnerships that support insight delivery and impact.

Additionally, this role will 1) provide direction and expert guidance to junior team members owning individual initiatives, including incentive and adoption programs, educational efforts, hotspotting, monitoring, and alerting development, practice and user-level prioritization and triage, and 2) coordinate with cross-functional product, analytics, technology, performance, care programs, and other senior leaders across Aledade to advance point of care tool adoption and impact.

The role is expected to start as a senior individual contributor, but is expected to grow into a people manager in the near term.

### **Primary Duties:**

In collaboration with cross-functional product, analytics, technology, performance, care programs, and other senior leaders across Aledade:

* Own single-threaded accountability for proactive identification, development, and execution of Point of Care deployment improvement opportunities, including field, practice, and clinician education, deployment automation and monitoring, and go to market approach and materials

* Lead strategic relationship building and partnership with Aledade’s payer partners to advance point of care tool adoption and impact

* Drive goal setting, metric identification and development, and impact evaluation for our point of care tools

* In support of maximizing insight delivery and impact, lead the evaluation, contracting, and cross-functional execution of net new vendor and external partnerships

* Direct and support other Transformation team members’ ideation and execution of strategic initiatives related to point of care deployment and impact

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree required, preferably in Economics, Business, Healthcare, or a related field
* 12+ years of progressive professional experience, or 7+ years progressive professional experience with a Master’s Degree, strongly preferred
* 6+ years of experience in healthcare
* 2+ years of experience in value-based care

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Advanced exploration of emerging AI tools, with additional preference given to individuals that have demonstrated ability building, scaling, and/or teaching AI tooling to broader teams
* Expert Excel skills required, including the ability to work with large, complex, & often incomplete data sets; conduct one-off complex analyses quickly; and utilize Index / Match, XLOOKUP, FILTER, and other advanced formulas
* Advanced PPT skills required, including storyboarding skills, ability to translate complex analyses and concepts into engaging slides, and ability to draft executive-level materials with limited direction
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, as well as the ability to build strong relationships and work with individuals at all levels of the organization, tailoring communication style as appropriate based on audience
* Excellent project management skills, including proven track record leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in health care operations settings
* Strong strategic planning and analytical skills
* Strong “business analyst” toolkit, including abilities to independently prioritize, solve problems via hypothesis-driven analytical methods, manage across multiple responsibilities and projects, execute with attention to detail, and overcome ambiguity
* Poise, confidence, and maturity interacting with key stakeholders, including senior leaders
* Commitment to confidentiality and discretion in appropriately handling sensitive information is required

### **Physical Requirements:**

Sitting for prolonged periods of time. Extensive use of computers and keyboard. Occasional walking and lifting may be required.

**Who We Are:**

Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.

records.description:
**Description**

  
  
  

ofi is a global leader in food & beverage ingredients and solutions. Through our core ingredient platforms that we’re known for globally – cocoa, coffee, dairy, nuts, and spices – we partner with food and beverage manufacturers, retailers, and foodservice operators worldwide to help meet evolving consumer needs.

With deep roots in origin countries and close relationships with farmers, we help deliver quality, traceability, transparency, and resilient supply chains. By combining sourcing expertise, market knowledge, innovation, and technical capabilities, we create value for customers while driving positive impact for people and the planet.

Together, ofi employees advance our Purpose: to be the change for good food and a healthy future.

Position Summary:

ofi values in-person collaboration with colleagues – employees are expected to work their specific work schedule on site at their ofi location.

Reporting to the Global Head of Operational Excellence, the Senior Director Operational Excellence will be responsible for driving Operational Excellence in all value chain domains in a given geography. This role will provide the incumbent with a unique opportunity to build their career at ofi. The role involves intensive management of function teams for effective implementation and outcome across the region. It also involves significant internal and external stakeholder management. As Senior Director Operational Excellence, the incumbent will have to adapt and translate Global ofi Operational Excellence framework to regional nuances thereby accelerating the pursuit towards excellence across the E2E value chain domains.

The ideal candidate for this position will be detail orientated, and strategic minded with effective communication skills. They will be able to work well both independently and on a team. The ability to manage priorities, stay organized and meet multiple competing demands will be required for success in this position.

What You’ll Do - Position Responsibilities:

* Responsible for deploying Operational Excellence strategy leading to world class value chain process.
* Engage and communicate the importance of continuous improvement (CI) throughout the organization.
* Develops and executes the strategic roadmap for the region to drive Operational Excellence culture and regional business results.
* Define new Operational Excellence roll-out requirements by identifying project milestones, phases, and elements.
* Deliver bottom line results through successful implementation of high impact projects, identify potential to improve the value delivery pipeline and contribute to Cost and Capital Transformation.
* Determine important metrics by analysing business models, gathering information, and evaluating output requirements and formats as per ofi Management Systems
* Drives the Stable, Reliable and Agile framework of Operational Excellence for Problem Solving and Performance delivery at Operations

records.title: General Manager, Data Operations
records.description:
**About David AI**
------------------

At David AI, our vision is to bring impactful AI into billions of lives through voice. Our mission is to help the world's leading AI companies build better voice models and agents. We're building the data and evaluation infrastructure behind those models.

Founded in 2024, we're a fast-growing Series B company backed by NVIDIA, Meritech, First Round, YC, and others, with ~70 people across San Francisco and New York City.

**About our Data Operations team**
----------------------------------

Our Data Operations team powers David AI's Data Factory, transforming raw audio into high-quality training datasets for leading AI labs. Our mandate is to spin up new data pipelines and run them at a massive scale.

This means starting from a model capability we want a model to unlock, experimenting with different shapes of data and collection strategies, and validating them with researchers. Once an approach works, we industrialize it, building pipelines that can process audio with reliability, quality, and efficiency. We are relentless operators who thrive in ambiguity, equally comfortable prototyping novel workflows as we are managing large-scale production systems.

**About this role**
-------------------

As **General Manager of Data Operations** at David AI, you will lead one of the most critical functions at David AI. You’ll own a major slice of our Data Factory: the engine that powers high-quality, scalable data production. You’ll lead the team responsible for building and scaling pipelines, from 0 1 experiments that unlock new model capabilities to 1 N industrialization that processes data reliably and efficiently.

**In this role, you will**
--------------------------

* Build and lead a team of Data Product Operations Leads, to spin up and scale data pipelines, from early experiments to production systems that generate high-quality audio data at scale.
* Act as a thought partner to executive leadership on how we can evolve and scale delivery capabilities in service of customer needs.
* Continuously monitor and improve pipeline health, spotting issues in sourcing, quality, or process early and owning solutions end-to-end.
* Use metrics to drive decisions, tracking throughput, quality, and cost to guide prioritization and identify where to scale or invest next.
* Work with researchers at leading AI labs to identify new model capabilities and turn them into concrete data workflows and project plans.
* Partner with our internal research team to design and test new data shapes that unlock frontier model capabilities.
* Own outcomes across functions, designing systems, managing execution, unblocking bottlenecks, and ensuring delivery at both prototype and production scale.

**Your background looks like**
------------------------------

* 5 to 10+ years of experience in high-ownership roles (e.g., founder, GM, COO, or strategy/ops at a venture-backed startup).
* Prior experience scaling large-scale operational efforts at high-growth startups or fast-paced companies.
* Technical fluency with data and operations; SQL proficiency required.
* Prior experience designing and scaling systems, processes, and teams across different customer segments and product lines.
* A relentless operator with high standards, bias to action, and strong attention to detail.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid pace; thrives in a “build while flying” environment.
* Low-ego, collaborative, and mission-driven, focused on team and company success.

**Bonus points if you have**
----------------------------

* Experience in data, ML, or large-scale operations.
* Background in CS, industrial engineering, or similar.

**Benefits**
------------

* Unlimited PTO.
* Top-notch health, dental, and vision coverage with 100% coverage for most plans.
* FSA & HSA access.
* 401k access.
* Meals 2x daily through DoorDash + snacks and beverages available at the office.
* Unlimited company-sponsored Barry's classes.

**Visas**
---------

We sponsor international candidates across several visa types, including H-1B *transfers*, H-1B1, O-1, E-3, and TN. We also hire candidates on STEM OPT. If you’re on STEM OPT, we’ll want to confirm you have a path to one of the visas listed above before your OPT ends. While we can’t guarantee any individual outcome, we’ve successfully sponsored teammates from all over the world.

Compensation Range: $205K - $235K

records.title: General Manager - Wastewater Operations
records.description:
**Are You a Wastewater Expert Who Knows How to Build a Business?**

We are looking for a dynamic, entrepreneurial, results-driven **General Manager – Wastewater Operations** to lead, grow, and transform our **Eastern United States Region.**

This is not a traditional operations management position. This is an opportunity for a proven wastewater leader and business-minded entrepreneur to take ownership of a region, build high-performing teams, strengthen customer partnerships, drive profitable growth, and establish a standard of operational excellence.

At Solution Group, we deliver specialized wastewater treatment solutions, chemical program management, and operational expertise to some of the most demanding industrial environments in the country, including dairy processing, rendering, and food and beverage manufacturing.

Our customers depend on us to solve complex wastewater challenges, maintain regulatory compliance, improve treatment performance, and reduce operating costs. We need a leader who understands these challenges firsthand and has the technical credibility, business acumen, and leadership presence to take our regional operations to the next level.

**We are looking for a leader who thinks like an owner, operates like an expert, and leads like an entrepreneur.**

**THE OPPORTUNITY: OWN IT. GROW IT. LEAD IT.**

As General Manager, you will have full accountability for the performance and growth of your assigned region. You will lead a multi-site wastewater operation with accountability for financial performance, customer relationships, business development, operational execution, safety, and talent development.

You will have the autonomy and accountability to make an impact, identify opportunities, challenge the status quo, and build a stronger, more profitable business.

Your mission is to create a high-performing regional organization that consistently delivers exceptional wastewater treatment results, outstanding customer experiences, strong financial performance, and a culture of accountability.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

**1. Business Growth & Entrepreneurial Leadership**

* Take ownership of regional growth, identifying new customers, developing market opportunities, and expanding our presence within existing accounts.
* Build executive-level customer relationships that create trust, strengthen retention, and generate new business.
* Identify opportunities to introduce additional services, technologies, and revenue streams across existing customer locations.
* Partner with Business Development, Key Account Managers, and Technical Services to win new business and successfully launch new customer operations.
* Explore strategic partnerships, acquisitions, and opportunities to expand our regional footprint.
* Develop and execute a regional growth strategy with measurable revenue and profitability targets.

**2. Full P&L Ownership & Financial Performance**

* Own the financial performance of the region, including revenue, EBITDA, labor, chemicals, materials, maintenance, and capital expenditures.
* Drive profitable growth through disciplined financial management, cost optimization, and operational accountability.
* Establish clear financial expectations and performance metrics throughout the organization.
* Develop accurate forecasts, budgets, and action plans to improve business performance.
* Communicate financial results, opportunities, challenges, and corrective actions to executive leadership.

**3. Wastewater Expertise & Operational Excellence**

* Provide strategic and technical leadership across a portfolio of industrial wastewater treatment operations.
* Leverage your deep wastewater knowledge to improve treatment performance, process stability, compliance, and operating efficiency.
* Establish consistent operating standards, SOPs, preventive maintenance programs, and performance metrics across all locations.
* Drive standardization and best-practice implementation while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce costs.
* Lead troubleshooting and problem-solving efforts on complex wastewater treatment challenges.
* Champion continuous improvement, root cause analysis, process optimization, and operational discipline.

**4. Customer Leadership & Retention**

* Own the overall customer experience and build long-term, trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders.
* Maintain a strong customer retention rate through proactive engagement, exceptional service delivery, and measurable results.
* Lead strategic customer business reviews and identify opportunities to deliver additional value.
* Partner with Key Account Managers to ensure customer expectations are consistently met and exceeded.
* Position Solution Group as a strategic wastewater partner, not simply a service provider.

**5. Safety, Compliance & Operational Discipline**

* Establish a culture where safety, environmental compliance, and operational excellence are non-negotiable.
* Partner with HSE leadership to drive safety performance, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure all locations maintain strong environmental compliance, documentation, training, and preventative safety practices.
* Champion 5S, workplace organization, and consistent execution of operational standards.
* Lead with visibility, accountability, and a commitment to ensuring every employee goes home safely.

**6. Build, Develop & Inspire High-Performing Teams**

* Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional operational leaders and wastewater professionals.
* Lead and coach Key Account Managers, Regional Managers, and Site Managers.
* Establish clear expectations, performance goals, and accountability throughout the region.
* Develop succession plans and create opportunities for employees to grow into greater leadership responsibilities.
* Build a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and results.
* Lead by example and inspire teams to take pride in their work, their customers, and their performance.

**7. Enterprise Leadership & Collaboration**

* Work closely with other General Managers and corporate leadership to share best practices and drive company-wide success.
* Collaborate with Technical Services, Business Development, Sales, HR, Finance, and HSE to strengthen capabilities and execute strategic initiatives.
* Contribute to the long-term growth, scalability, and success of Solution Group.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a strong, confident, entrepreneurial leader who brings together deep technical wastewater expertise, proven operational leadership, and a genuine passion for building a business.

**You are someone who:**

* Knows wastewater treatment. You understand industrial wastewater processes, treatment systems, troubleshooting, chemistry, compliance, and the operational challenges our customers face.
* Thinks like a business owner. You understand P&L performance, revenue growth, cost control, and what it takes to build a profitable operation.
* Is commercially driven. You naturally identify opportunities, build relationships, grow accounts, and turn customer challenges into business opportunities.
* Leads with confidence. You know how to build trust, set expectations, develop people, and hold teams accountable.
* Is operationally disciplined. You believe in KPIs, standardization, preventative maintenance, continuous improvement, and measurable results.
* Is entrepreneurial. You are energized by growth, change, new opportunities, and the ability to make a meaningful impact.
* Is a problem solver. You are comfortable navigating complex operational challenges and making decisions in a fast-paced environment.
* Is collaborative. You understand that regional success contributes to company-wide success.

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS**

* 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in industrial wastewater treatment, environmental services, industrial services, utilities, or related operational environments.
* Demonstrated expertise in industrial wastewater treatment operations, including treatment processes, troubleshooting, environmental compliance, and emerging technologies.
* Proven experience leading multi-site or regional operations with direct leadership responsibility for multiple levels of management.
* Previous full P&L ownership with demonstrated success improving profitability and financial performance.
* A track record of growing revenue, expanding customer relationships, and developing new business opportunities.
* Experience building and implementing operational standards, KPIs, SOPs, audit programs, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, cost management, and accountability.
* Experience with Lean, TPM, 5S, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, customer relationship, and change management skills.
* Ability and willingness to travel 50% or more throughout the Eastern US Region.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Business, Operations, or a related discipline.
* State-issued wastewater operator license (Class A, B, C, or D, as applicable).
* Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement certifications.
* Experience with mergers, acquisitions, and business integration.

**WHY SOLUTION GROUP?**

At Solution Group, you won't simply inherit a job description and maintain the status quo. You will have the opportunity to influence the direction of a growing business, develop exceptional teams, strengthen customer partnerships, and make a measurable impact on our future.

We offer:

* **Executive-Level Compensation:** $140,000–$200,000 base salary, plus eligibility for an annual performance bonus.
* **Meaningful Leadership:** Full regional ownership and the opportunity to directly influence business performance and strategy.
* **Entrepreneurial Opportunity:** The ability to identify opportunities, drive growth, and help shape the future of the organization.
* **Strong Team Environment:** Work alongside experienced wastewater professionals and collaborative corporate leadership.
* **Competitive Benefits:** Health, dental, vision, 401k, Paid Time Off.
* **Professional Development:** Continued technical training and opportunities for career advancement.
* **Travel Reimbursement:** Mileage reimbursement for business travel.

**THE BOTTOM LINE**

**We are looking for a wastewater expert who is ready to lead a business, not just manage operations.**

If you have the technical depth to understand complex wastewater challenges, the business acumen to drive profitable growth, and the leadership ability to build exceptional teams, we want to hear from you.

**Come build something great with Solution Group.**

records.title: Director Quality Assurance
records.description:
**Obsessed by Science. Entrepreneurial by Nature. United by Purpose.**
Diasorin is a global leader in immunodiagnostic and molecular diagnostic solutions, advancing science to improve patient outcomes worldwide. For more than 50 years, we have combined scientific rigor with an entrepreneurial mindset, operating with a strong commitment to innovation, accountability, and results to deliver trusted diagnostic solutions.
  
  
As the Diagnostics Specialist, Diasorin continuously invests in research, technology, and people. Guided by our values of operational excellence, customer focus, and teamwork, we empower teams to think boldly, act decisively, and transform ideas into meaningful impact across one of the industry’s broadest specialty diagnostic portfolios.
  
  
When you join Diasorin, you are not just filling a role. You are helping build what comes next.
  
  
**Why Join Diasorin**

* Build What Matters Take ownership, challenge the status quo, and contribute directly to solutions that improve patient care worldwide.
* Innovate with Agility at a Global Scale Work in an entrepreneurial environment that enables speed, collaboration, and global impact.
* Grow in a People-Centered Culture Thrive in a culture that values accountability, inclusion, and continuous development.

**Job Scope:**
The Director, Quality Assurance for Austin will lead, establish, implement and maintain quality assurance systems and activities ensuring compliance with domestic and international quality system standards and regulations for commercial medical devices designed, produced and marketed by Luminex. Partner with Manufacturing, Design/Development, Systems Engineering, Quality Control and others across functions to deliver the highest quality instruments, and reagents. This position is responsible for the oversight, control and release of instruments and reagents, quality organizational management, budget preparation, personnel management, organizational goals and metrics, and Executive Level presentations. The Director, Quality Assurance for Austin is a leader and a mentor.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities And Duties**

* Ensures that the Austin site demonstrates regulatory compliance per GLP/GCP/cGMP/GXP, ISO, and other applicable regulations.
* Support instrument new product development and manufacturing changes, provides guidance to the core teams and participate in the process.
* Leader in process optimization by Identifying and analyzing opportunities for continual improvements in product/service quality, customer satisfaction, and company profitability.
* Leads the strategy and improvements for the manufacturing and service depot of Instruments for our customers and partners in compliance with regulations and standards.
* Participates and manage activities for external audits such as ISO, FDA or other regulatory bodies for the Austin site. Acts in Audits - as co-host, SME or escort
* Responds to alleged QMS violations of regulations, policies, procedures as the result of both external and external audits by evaluating and recommending the initiation of investigative activities, immediate corrections and risk analysis processes. Coordinates responses to external audits and manages corrective actions to close.
* Interacts with various internal and external groups to facilitate the completion of internal audits, handling of non-conformances, performing Risk Assessments, CAPA, investigation and support, manufacturing validation as well as Design Transfer.
* QMS improvements and enhancements and is a leading member of the Quality Management Team. Works across the corporation to align and define quality approach for molecular diagnostic products.
* Partners with Site Leadership and Field Quality to conduct, manage, and evaluate investigations related to customer complaints, nonconformances, audits, corrective/preventive action concerns, deviations, recalls, and potential injuries
* Appropriately escalate Quality issues to the Vice President Quality Assurance Molecular Division
* Provide leadership in the application of Quality Tools such as Risk Management, Root Cause Investigations, Designs of Experiments, Capability Studies, in the establishment and investigation of process and products failures and implement lasting solutions of such failures.
* May act as IVDR Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC) for Luminex sites to ensure: the conformity of the devices is appropriately checked before a device is released, the post-market surveillance and reporting obligations are fulfilled and all requirements established between Luminex and Authorized representative are met.
* May act as Management Representative for the site. In this capacity, ensure that product meets label claims and customer satisfaction, any quality or regulatory issue is elevated to the President and/or Vice President Quality Assurance Compliance North America and oversee and drive continuous improvement.
* Develops and releases Change Plans and actions to support the changing needs and requirements of the organization as the result of strategic changes in business direction
* Provide other Quality related technical training as necessary
* Directs activities of employees or through managers who exercise full supervision for daily operations. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws.
* Maintains talent through recruiting and development opportunities. Continually develops internal candidates through succession planning and career development.
* Responsible for enforcing all EHS policies in their span of control
* Be part of any the new key and strategic projects and due diligence process if required
* Ensure all site-level activities and related documentation are aligned with corporate procedures and conducted in accordance with DiaSorin’s established Corporate and Quality Assurance governance requirements.

**Education, Experience And Qualifications**

* Minimum Bachelor degree in a science or engineering discipline with 8+ years of relevant experience/training
* 10+ Years of Experience in Quality Assurance or Regulatory Affairs activities in a cGMP Medical Device or Pharmaceutical environment
* 5+ years of Demonstrated knowledge of current industry quality practices under ISO 13485, ISO 14971, CFR 820 and CFR 806 and international regulations preferred
* 2+ years of Management experience in a complex quality assurance/quality systems field
* 2+ years of Ability to provide leadership to others in the organization through influence, innovative practices and coaching skills to foster a corporate culture of responsiveness, compliance awareness, self-regulation, quality system ownership, challenge of status quo, and continuous improvement in order to achieve the highest level of compliance.
* 5+ years of Excellent problem solving methodology, using industry accepted concepts and tools to solve complex problems in creative and effective ways as they apply to compliance issues.
* 5+ years of Hands-on ability to sort through technical complexities and work in a flexible changing environment.
* 5+ years of Possesses a strong scientific and technical background, sufficient to establish creditability with senior management as well as the manufacturing and product development teams.
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills
* Thorough knowledge of standards and regulations (cGMP, ISO 13485)
* Highly organized with proven time management and prioritization skills
* Ability to work independently and with minimal supervision
* High degree of problem solving, attention to detail, and analytical skills.
* Experience working independently in a fast-paced environment with rapidly changing priorities
* Ability to handle the pressure of meeting tight deadlines

**What We Offer**
Diasorin offers a competitive rewards package focused on your overall well-being. We are proud to offer a comprehensive plan of health benefits, retirement and financial wellbeing, time off programs, wellbeing support and perks. Benefits may vary by role, country, region, union status, and other employment status factors. You may also be eligible to participate in an annual incentive program. An incentive award, if any, depends on various factors, including, individual and organizational performance.
  
  
Diasorin is committed to building a workplace where people feel empowered to contribute ideas, take ownership, and grow their careers. We believe diverse perspectives strengthen innovation and help us deliver meaningful impact for patients and customers worldwide.
  
  
Diasorin is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
  
  
This posting and recruitment process are subject to applicable local laws and regulations in the country where the position is located. Additional employment disclosures, candidate rights, and employment conditions may apply based on local jurisdiction.
  
  
Individuals hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work and may be subject to a background check and drug screening where permitted by law. Diasorin is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities during the application process. If assistance is required, please contact hr@diasorin.com.
  
  
Recruitment Fraud Notice
  
  
Diasorin never requests payment, financial information, or personal banking details from candidates at any stage of the recruitment process. Official communications from Diasorin recruiters will only come from a verified
**@diasorin.com**
email address. If you have questions about the legitimacy of a recruitment communication, please contact hr@diasorin.com for verification.
  
  
Unauthorized third-party recruiting agencies may not submit candidates for this position without prior written authorization from the Diasorin Human Resources Department.

**Summit Polymers is a leading, global supplier of automotive interior systems including consoles, door panels, and instrument panels. With over 50 years serving the industry, we deliver engineering and product excellence to our customers, on time, in budget, with the latest innovations.**
JOIN A TEAM WHERE YOU’LL BE CHALLENGED AND valued.
  
  
A career with Summit Polymers means working with smart people in a culture that thrives on challenging, meaningful work. At Summit, we look for growth potential with every hire. We don’t just fill seats, we set people on career paths. We’re always on the lookout for smart people who are committed to continuous improvement, customer service and quality.
  
  
**Job Description**
**JOB TITLE:**
Director, Corporate Quality
**FLSA STATUS:**
Exempt
  
  
**REPORTS TO:**
Regional Director of Manufacturing (Corporate)
  
  
**Summary**
This management position is responsible for developing, implementing and continually improving the company’s standardized manufacturing quality systems globally. The Director, Corporate Quality works collaboratively with plant quality managers, general managers and other company resources to achieve world class quality performance as measured by customer quality scorecards. The Director, Corporate Quality interfaces with key customer personnel to build customer confidence in Summit Polymers, ensure Summit Polymers meets customer expectations and requirements, and to resolve significant customer quality concerns.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Duties**
Is responsible for the following major tasks:
  
  

* Exhibits positive leadership and acts with highest levels of integrity and ethics
* Champions corporate wide manufacturing quality system standardization

+ Leads and collaborates with plant quality managers, general managers and RDMs to determine best practices and develop standardized quality system and procedures applicable to all manufacturing facilities
+ Administers, trains, and communicates the company’s standardized quality system and procedures to ensure they are effectively implemented and maintained throughout the company
+ Performs plant quality system standards compliance audits and leads follow up action plan reviews with each plant
+ Lead continuous improvement of quality systems

* Champions overall quality scorecard performance for all customers

+ Develops deep knowledge of every customer quality scorecard
+ Leads specific customer scorecard training for plant quality managers, materials managers and general managers to ensure these leaders understand scoring methodology and act to ensure scorecard success
+ Monitors customer scorecard methodology and scoring changes, and ensures corporate procedures, metrics and personnel proactively adapt to changes to ensure customer scorecard success
+ Engages with other functional departments to ensure all aspects of customer scorecards are understood and actions are taken to ensure scorecard success (examples Sales – cost reductions, materials – minority sourcing)
+ Assists in developing internal performance metrics that support successful customer scorecard results

* Interfaces with key customer personnel & engages customer quality events

+ Develops constructive relationships with key customer contacts
+ Builds customer’s confidence in SPI’s performance, capabilities, systems, and integrity
+ Represents the company at customer “quality roundtable” events
+ Reviews customer quality system requirements and specifications and ensure they are effectively communicated and implemented at all levels of the organization

* Engages in significant customer quality concerns and warranty issues

+ Participates in problem solving and customer response preparation for significant customer quality issues
+ Represents the company at critical customer quality concern reviews, leading company response and negotiation to achieve successful resolution
+ Acts as point of contact for customer warranty concerns and engages plant and engineering resources to solve warranty concerns

* Provides quality expertise as a corporate resource

+ Champions Practical Problem Solving activities across the company, including improving effectiveness of management team leadership of the process
+ Key leader for development, update, training and compliance to corporate IATF-16949 compliant systems and procedures
+ Supports new business initiatives and projects with data, metrics, support plans, and technical expertise as related to quality
+ Provide support in developing and performing training plans for quality managers and quality engineers at manufacturing plants
+ Provides additional support at manufacturing plants as needed

* Other tasks and duties as assigned

**Education And Experience**

* 4-year college degree in technical or management field preferred
* 5 years’ experience in role of Quality Manager at automotive supplier preferred

**Skills And Abilities**

* Broad knowledge of quality systems and management practices in automotive plastics manufacturing operations
* Expertise in major automotive OEM quality systems; Ford Q1, GM BIQS, FCA, Nissan, VW, BMW, and Toyota
* Expert problem solving skills utilizing root cause based methods; Practical Problem Solving (PPS), 8D, and 5 why methodology
* Must be able to gather and analyze information easily and make appropriate decisions.
* Outstanding leadership, team building, coaching and decision making abilities
* Highly energetic, confident, and assertive with the ability to lead and motivate others
* Must have excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills
* A minimum score of 50 on the Wonderlic Select Assessment (Traditional score of 28 on the cognitive portion).

**Travel Requirements**
This position typically does require approximately 18 weeks per year of travel to Summit Polymers Manufacturing Sites.
  
  
**DISCLAIMER**
The information contained in this job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of the duties and responsibilities of the job, nor are they intended to be an all-inclusive list of the skills and abilities required to do the job. Management may, at its discretion, assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Agreement to complete all post-hire required training.

records.title: Quality Director
records.description:
As the
**Director of Quality**
, you will lead the quality strategy and continuous improvement efforts across all Bison manufacturing sites. You will be responsible for ensuring that the products meet or exceed customer expectations, industry standards, and regulatory requirements while driving overall quality performance and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to establish and maintain effective quality systems, drive process improvements, and ensure compliance with industry certifications.
  
  
This position can be based at either our
**Whitsett, NC**
or
**Reynosa, MX**
facility.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
  
  

* Leadership & Strategy

+ Develop and execute a strategic quality plan in alignment with business unit goals.
+ Lead, mentor, and develop a team of quality professionals across two locations, ensuring consistency in processes and objectives.
+ Champion a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

* Quality Management Systems (QMS)

+ Oversee the implementation, maintenance, and improvement of the QAD Elements QMS and other relevant Quality Management Systems at both locations. Ensure compliance with customer, regulatory, and industry-specific quality standards (e.g., FDA, ISO, AS9100, etc.).
+ Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of quality management systems and propose enhancements to improve overall performance.

* Process & Product Quality

+ Collaborate with sales, operations, engineering, and supply chain teams to identify drive resolution of quality issues, ensuring process and product integrity.
+ Support root cause analysis and drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) for internal and external quality issues.
+ Oversee first article inspections, process capability studies, and validation/qualification activities to ensure robust manufacturing processes.

* Continuous Improvement

+ Lead Lean Six Sigma or other continuous improvement initiatives aimed at reducing defects, enhancing efficiency, and improving overall quality.
+ Implement data-driven decision-making tools (e.g., SPC, FMEA, Control Plans) to monitor and improve process capabilities.
+ Facilitate cross-functional value stream mapping sessions and quality workshops to drive process improvements.

* Customer & Supplier Relations

+ Serve as the main point of contact for customer quality issues, audits, and feedback, ensuring timely and effective resolution.
+ Oversee supplier quality management, including audits, performance monitoring, and supplier development initiatives.

* Metrics & Reporting

+ Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to quality performance, including scrap/rework, defect rates, customer complaints, and audit findings.
+ Regularly report quality performance metrics to senior leadership, highlighting trends and recommending corrective actions.

* Regulatory Compliance & Audits

+ Lead internal and external audits, ensuring the sites comply with relevant standards and certifications.
+ Ensure the manufacturing facilities are audit-ready at all times and coordinate responses to audit findings.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in quality management within a manufacturing environment, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* Demonstrated experience with quality management systems (ISO 9001, AS9100, FDA, or equivalent) and continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma).
* Demonstrated ability and willingness to use AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and to reduce costs. The successful candidate must be able to identify appropriate AI use cases and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs.
* Proven track record of driving quality improvements across multi-site operations.
* Ability to travel as needed to the BU manufacturing sites (up to 30%)
* Strong leadership and team-building skills.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization.
* Proficiency in quality tools such as SPC, FMEA, 8D, and Root Cause Analysis.

**Compensation**
Employee Type: Salaried
  
  
Currency: USD
  
  
Salary Minimum: 135,000
  
  
Salary Maximum: 185,000
  
  
Incentive: Yes
  
  
Disclaimer: Where a specific pay range is noted, it is a good faith estimate at the time of this posting. The actual salary offered will be based on experience, skills, qualifications, market / business considerations, and geographic location.
  
  
For more information on AMETEK's competitive benefits, please click here.
  
  
AMETEK, Inc. is a leading global provider of industrial technology solutions serving a diverse set of attractive niche markets with annual sales over $7.5 billion.
  
  
AMETEK is committed to making a safer, sustainable, and more productive world a reality. We use differentiated technology solutions to solve our customers’ most complex challenges. We employ 22,000 colleagues, in 35 countries, that are grounded by our core values: Ethics and Integrity, Respect for the Individual, Inclusion, Teamwork, and Social Responsibility.
